phrasal_verbs.meaning: 穿着；戴着；欺骗，开玩笑；有（约会或安排）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I didn't realize you were having me on about the promotion; I actually believed you!
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我没意识到你在升职的事上逗我玩呢，我还真信了！

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 邀请（某人）到家中作客
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We are planning to have the new neighbors over for dinner this weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们打算这周末请新邻居来家里吃晚饭。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与某人直截了当地摊牌；争辩以求彻底解决分歧
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She decided to have it out with her roommate about the unpaid bills.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她决定就未付账单的问题跟室友彻底摊牌解决。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 储备（食物或日常用品）；请（专业人员）来家里施工或维修
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We're having a plumber in tomorrow to fix the persistent leak under the sink.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们明天请了一位水管工来家里修水槽下一直漏水的问题。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拔掉（牙齿）；切除（器官等）；同某人坦诚沟通消除误会
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He had to go to the oral surgeon to have his wisdom teeth out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他不得不去口腔外科医生那里拔掉智齿。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对某人心存不满；故意找某人麻烦；怀恨在心
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Ever since I disagreed with him in the meeting, he's had it in for me.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 自从我在会议上反对他之后，他就一直故意找我麻烦。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 掌握某人的把柄或罪证
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The detectives suspected the suspect, but they had nothing on him to justify an arrest.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 侦探们怀疑那名嫌疑人，但手里没有任何证据足以对他实施逮捕。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 休假；请假休工
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I've been working overtime all month, so I asked to have next Friday off.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我整整加了一个月的班，所以申请下周五调休一天。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 要回；收回；再次请某人到访作客
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Can I have my copy of the novel back once you finish reading it?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你读完那本小说后能还给我吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因违法犯罪传讯某人出庭受审；起诉某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He was had up before the magistrate for reckless driving.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他因危险驾驶被传讯到地方法官面前受审。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将某人看作；认定某人是某种性格或身份
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I had always had him down as a quiet introvert, but he was surprisingly outgoing.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我一直以为他是个内向安静的人，没想到他出奇地外向。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 邀请某人到自己家里（用餐、聚会等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's have a few close colleagues round for drinks after work.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 下班后我们请几位关系好的同事来家里喝两杯吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 反对；反感；对……持有异议或不满
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I don't know what you have against the proposal; it seems completely viable to me.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我不知道你对这项提案有什么成见，在我看来它完全可行。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 动手攻击；竭力尝试；全神贯注地对付
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The coach blew the whistle and told the team to have at the drills with full energy.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教练吹响哨子，让全队打起十二分精神全力投入训练。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 带某人同行；邀请某人一起参加
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Do you mind if we have Mark along on our road trip to the coast?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你介意我们去海边的公路旅行带上马克一起吗？

idioms.meaning: 百感交集；喜忧参半；内心矛盾
idioms.example_en: She had mixed feelings about moving abroad for her career.
idioms.example_zh: 为了事业移居海外，她心里真是百感交集。

idioms.phrase: have a bone to pick with sb
idioms.meaning: 有牢骚要理论；有笔账要算；对某事心存不满需找人当面说清
idioms.example_en: I have a bone to pick with you regarding your comments in yesterday's meeting.
idioms.example_zh: 关于你在昨天会议上的言论，我可得找你好好理论理论。

idioms.meaning: 忙得不可开交；应接不暇
idioms.example_en: With three newborn puppies and a toddler, they certainly have their hands full.
idioms.example_zh: 养着三只刚出生的小狗还有一个刚学会走路的孩子，他们确实忙得不可开交。

idioms.meaning: 占上风；处于优势地位
idioms.example_en: Thanks to their cutting-edge technology, they have the upper hand in negotiations.
idioms.example_zh: 凭借尖端技术，他们在谈判中牢牢占据了上风。

idioms.meaning: 忐忑不安；感到极度紧张心慌
idioms.example_en: Every time I step onto the stage to give a presentation, I have butterflies in my stomach.
idioms.example_zh: 每次走上讲台做演示汇报时，我心里总是七上八下的。

idioms.meaning: 产生疑虑；重新考虑并改变主意
idioms.example_en: After evaluating the excessive risks, the investors began to have second thoughts.
idioms.example_zh: 评估了过高的风险后，投资者们开始打退堂鼓重新考虑。

idioms.meaning: 发发慈悲；行行好；宽容一点
idioms.example_en: Have a heart and give him another chance to fix his mistake.
idioms.example_zh: 发发善心吧，再给他一次弥补过错的机会。

collocations.meaning: 对……产生重要影响或作用
collocations.example_en: The newly introduced policy will have a profound impact on local businesses.
collocations.example_zh: 新出台的政策将对当地企业产生深远的影响。

collocations.meaning: 有权使用；能够接近或获取
collocations.example_en: All employees should have access to the internal learning database.
collocations.example_zh: 所有员工都应该有权访问内部学习数据库。

collocations.meaning: 做某事有困难；难以完成某事
collocations.example_en: Many international students have difficulty adapting to the humid climate.
collocations.example_zh: 很多留学生很难适应这种潮湿的气候。

collocations.example_en: Despite recent setbacks, the board continues to have absolute faith in her leadership.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管最近遭遇挫折，董事会仍然对她的领导能力坚信不疑。

collocations.meaning: 与……有共同之处；共享相似特质
collocations.example_en: Although they come from different backgrounds, the two artists have a great deal in common.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管出身背景不同，这两位艺术家却有着极多的共同点。

collocations.phrase: have no choice but to do
collocations.example_en: Facing severe financial deficits, they had no choice but to lay off staff.
collocations.example_zh: 面对严重的财政赤字，他们别无选择只能裁员。

collocations.meaning: 对……有独特的鉴赏力或敏锐眼光
collocations.example_en: She has a trained eye for discovering exceptional vintage jewelry.
collocations.example_zh: 她练就了一副敏锐的眼光，极擅长发掘绝佳的古董珠宝。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 没有……也行；设法对付过去；舍弃
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We had to do without hot water for three days when the boiler broke down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 锅炉坏掉后，我们不得不将就着过了三天没有热水的日子。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 废除；消灭；摆脱；杀死
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The university decided to do away with traditional written exams in favor of practical projects.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该大学决定废除传统的笔试考核，转而采用实践项目评估。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 系上，扣好（衣服/鞋带）；翻新修缮（建筑/家具）；精心打扮
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They bought a dilapidated 19th-century cottage and spent years doing it up.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们买下了一座破败的19世纪乡村小屋，花了好几年时间对其进行修缮翻新。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 重做，重新执行；彻底粉刷翻新；入室彻底搜查或洗劫；狠狠揍一顿
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The professor rejected his first draft and instructed him to do the entire essay over.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教授驳回了他的初稿，并要求他把整篇论文重新写一遍。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 极想得到；非常需要；很乐意有
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After five continuous hours of driving, I could really do with a hot cup of coffee.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 连续开了五个小时的车，我现在真需要来一杯热咖啡提提神。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 处理；与……有关（多用于 have to do with）；想要或容忍
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What did you do with the confidential files that were on my desk this morning?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 今天早上放在我桌上的绝密文件，你放到哪里去了？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 欺诈骗取某人应得之物；剥夺某人合法利益
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Dishonest partners tried to do him out of his rightful share of the business profits.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 不老实的合伙人企图欺骗并侵吞他在商业利润中应得的份额。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使精疲力竭；谋杀害死某人；毁掉某事物
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Running that steep mountain trail in the midday heat completely did me in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 正午顶着酷热跑完那条陡峭的山路彻底把我累垮了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 照料家务，操持杂务；毁灭，使彻底完蛋；适合于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: That engine breakdown in the desert finally did for their hope of finishing the rally.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 沙漠里的发动机故障最终彻底粉碎了他们跑完拉力赛的希望。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 贬低；诋毁；贬损某人的声誉或成就
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Stop doing yourself down in interviews; you need to project confidence in your skills.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在面试中别老贬低自己，你需要展现出对自身技能的自信。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 彻底打扫，整理收拾；装潢粉刷（房间）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She spent the entire Saturday morning doing out the garage and discarding clutter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她把周六整整一个上午都花在彻底清理车库和丢弃杂物上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对待（某人，常与 well/badly 搭配）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The elderly gentleman always made sure he did right by his dedicated employees.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那位老绅士始终确保自己厚待那些恪尽职守的员工。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用……装饰或布置（房间、环境）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The dining hall was lavishly done out in white lilies and crystal chandeliers for the wedding.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 为了这场婚礼，宴会厅用白百合与水晶吊灯装点得富丽堂皇。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 翻译成（另一门语言）；改编为（另一种形式）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The ancient Latin manuscript was skillfully done into modern English.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这份古老的拉丁文手稿被巧妙地翻译成了现代英语。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 盛情款待某人；使某人深感骄傲或面子十足
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The hosts really did us proud with a magnificent seven-course banquet.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 主人们用一场七道菜的丰盛宴席极体面地盛情款待了我们。

idioms.meaning: 奏效；达到预期效果；解决难题
idioms.example_en: A little bit of lubricant on the hinges should do the trick to stop that squeak.
idioms.example_zh: 在铰链上涂一点润滑剂应该就能奏效，消除那咯吱咯吱的噪音。

idioms.meaning: 帮某人一个忙
idioms.example_en: Could you do me a favor and review these figures before the presentation?
idioms.example_zh: 你能不能帮我个忙，在汇报前帮我核对一下这些数据？

idioms.meaning: 竭尽全力；尽最大可能
idioms.example_en: The medical rescue team did their utmost to save every trapped survivor.
idioms.example_zh: 医疗救援团队竭尽全力抢救每一位受困的幸存者。

idioms.meaning: 创造奇迹；产生神奇惊人的良好效果
idioms.example_en: A brief holiday in the mountains will do wonders for your mental health.
idioms.example_zh: 去山里度个短假会对你的心理健康产生神奇的舒缓效果。

idioms.meaning: 孤注一掷；不成功便成仁；破釜沉舟
idioms.example_en: The final championship match is a do-or-die situation for the entire franchise.
idioms.example_zh: 这场总冠军决赛对于整个俱乐部来说是一场背水一战的生死决战。

idioms.meaning: 对某人有益；改善某人的身心状态
idioms.example_en: You have been staring at the monitor all day; fresh air will do you good.
idioms.example_zh: 你盯着显示器看了一整天了，去户外透透新鲜空气对你有好处。

idioms.meaning: 够了；行了；到此为止（用于制止不当行为或表示数量已足）
idioms.example_en: That will do, children! Settle down and turn to page twenty.
idioms.example_zh: 够了，孩子们！安静下来，翻到第二十页。

collocations.meaning: 与……开展业务往来或商业合作
collocations.example_en: It has always been an absolute pleasure to do business with your company.
collocations.example_zh: 与贵公司开展商业合作始终是一件非常愉快的事。

collocations.meaning: 对……进行调查或科学研究
collocations.example_en: The laboratory is doing pioneering research into neurodegenerative diseases.
collocations.example_zh: 该实验室正在对神经退行性疾病开展开创性的科学研究。

collocations.meaning: 对……造成实质性损害或危害
collocations.example_en: Prolonged exposure to ultraviolet rays will do severe damage to your skin.
collocations.example_zh: 长时间暴露在紫外线下会对你的皮肤造成严重损伤。

collocations.example_en: Don't stress over the final outcome, as long as you know you did your best.
collocations.example_zh: 只要知道自己已经尽了最大努力，就不要为最终结果而焦虑。

collocations.meaning: 公平对待；如实展现……的美好或价值
collocations.example_en: A photograph cannot do justice to the breathtaking grandeur of the Grand Canyon.
collocations.example_zh: 单凭一张照片根本无法真正展现大峡谷那令人屏息的壮阔之美。

collocations.meaning: 滑稽模仿某人的神情或言行举止
collocations.example_en: He had the entire room laughing by doing an accurate impression of the boss.
collocations.example_zh: 他惟妙惟肖地模仿了老板的言行，逗得全场哄堂大笑。

collocations.meaning: 清洗碗盘 / 洗衣服（核心家务动宾搭配）
collocations.example_en: If you prepare dinner tonight, I'll gladly do the dishes afterward.
collocations.example_zh: 如果你今晚负责做饭，饭后我很乐意把碗洗了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 起床；起立，站起来；组织，筹备
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I usually get up at six, but this morning I stayed in bed until eight.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我通常六点起床，但今天早上我一直赖床赖到八点。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从（疾病、打击、悲伤）中恢复；克服，解决（困难）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It took him several months to get over the shock of losing his job.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他花了好几个月才从失业的打击中走出来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 登上（车、船、飞机等）；（与某人）相处；进展，取得进展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: How are you getting on with your new research project?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你的新研究项目进展如何了？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 下（车、船、飞机等）；下班，离开工作岗位；免受（惩罚）；动身出发
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Make sure you get off the train at Central Station, not North Station.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 务必在中心火车站下车，而不是北站。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 进入，到达；收割，收集；被录取，获选
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What time does your flight get in tonight?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你的航班今晚几点到达？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 离开，出去；（消息、秘密）泄露；出版，发布
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Word got out that the CEO was planning to resign before the end of the year.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 首席执行官打算在年底前辞职的消息走漏了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 离开，脱身；外出度假；逃脱，逃跑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'm hoping to get away for a couple of days and relax by the sea.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我希望能抽空离开几天，去海边放松一下。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 做坏事未受惩罚，侥幸逃脱；携……逃跑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He thought he could get away with cheating on the exam, but the proctor caught him.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他以为考试作弊能蒙混过关，但还是被监考老师抓住了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……和睦相处；（工作、生活等）进展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She gets along very well with all of her colleagues in the marketing department.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她和市场部所有的同事都相处得非常融洽。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 返回，回家；取回，收回；报复，报复惩罚
phrasal_verbs.example_en: When do you think you'll get back from your business trip?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你认为你出差什么时候能回来？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回复（某人）；重新回到（某话题或某项活动）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I don't have the figures right now, but I'll get back to you by tomorrow morning.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我现在手头没有具体数据，但我明早之前会给你答复。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 勉强维持生计；过得去，敷衍应付
phrasal_verbs.example_en: My French is limited, but it's enough to get by when traveling.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我的法语水平有限，但旅行时应付日常交流足够了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 完成，通过（考试、难关）；接通电话；（向某人）讲清楚
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I tried calling customer service several times, but I couldn't get through.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我打了好几次客服电话，但一直没能接通。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 写下，记下；使沮丧，使情绪低落；吞下
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The continuous gloomy weather in winter is really starting to get me down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 冬天这种持续阴沉的天气真让人情绪低落。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 认真开始处理，着手做（严肃事务）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Now that the introductions are over, let's get down to business.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 既然介绍环节结束了，那我们就开始谈正事吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 到处走动，出行；（消息）传开；规避，避开（规则、问题）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Clever accountants found a legal loophole to get around the new tax regulation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 精明的会计师找到了法律漏洞，绕过了新的税收法规。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 够得着，触及；意指，暗示；查明（真相）；批评，指责
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What exactly are you getting at with all these indirect questions?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你问这些拐弯抹角的问题，到底想表达什么意思？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （使观点、信息）被理解，传达明白
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The speaker used vivid examples to get his message across to the audience.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 演讲者运用生动的例子将自己的观点清晰地传达给听众。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 取得成功，出人头地，取得领先地位
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Hard work and networking are essential if you want to get ahead in this industry.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你想在这个行业出人头地，努力工作和拓展人脉必不可少。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 进入；染上（习惯）；对……产生兴趣；卷入（麻烦）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She has recently gotten into gardening and spends every weekend in her backyard.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她最近迷上了园艺，每个周末都泡在后院里。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 逃避，摆脱（责任、承诺）；从……中获得（益处）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He tried every excuse to get out of attending the boring corporate seminar.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他想尽各种借口，试图逃避参加那个枯燥的企业研讨会。

idioms.meaning: 摸清……的诀窍，掌握……的使用方法
idioms.example_en: It was difficult at first, but after a few tries I finally got the hang of the software.
idioms.example_zh: 起初有点难，但试了几次之后我终于掌握了这个软件的诀窍。

idioms.meaning: 惹恼某人，让某人心烦意乱
idioms.example_en: The continuous ticking sound of that old clock is really getting on my nerves.
idioms.example_zh: 那座老挂钟持续不断的滴答声真让我心烦意乱。

idioms.meaning: （在行动前）临阵退缩，心生恐惧
idioms.example_en: The groom got cold feet right before the ceremony and almost ran away.
idioms.example_zh: 新郎在婚礼仪式开始前突然临阵退缩，差点跑掉。

idioms.meaning: 失去控制，不可收拾
idioms.example_en: The party quickly got out of hand when uninvited guests started showing up.
idioms.example_zh: 当不请自来的客人开始出现时，派对迅速失控了。

idioms.meaning: 振作起来，整顿好自己的状态以高效行事
idioms.example_en: If you don't get your act together soon, you risk losing your scholarship.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你还不赶紧振作起来好好表现，你的奖学金可能就保不住了。

idioms.meaning: 启动某事，促使事情开局运转
idioms.example_en: Let's get the ball rolling by brainstorming a few initial concepts for the campaign.
idioms.example_zh: 我们先为这次营销活动头脑风暴几个初步构想，把事情启动起来吧。

idioms.meaning: 控制住情绪，冷静下来，镇定自若
idioms.example_en: Stop panicking, take a deep breath, and get a grip on yourself.
idioms.example_zh: 别慌了，深吸一口气，让自己冷静下来。

collocations.example_en: We need to clear out the attic and get rid of all these broken appliances.
collocations.example_zh: 我们得把阁楼清理一下，扔掉所有这些坏掉的电器。

collocations.example_en: Please get in touch with our representative if you have any further questions.
collocations.example_zh: 如果您有任何进一步的问题，请与我们的代表取得联系。

collocations.meaning: 联系到某人；获得，弄到某物
collocations.example_en: I've been trying to get hold of the landlord all morning to report the leak.
collocations.example_zh: 我一整个上午都在试图联系房东反映漏水的问题。

collocations.example_en: It takes time to get used to the humid climate in this tropical region.
collocations.example_zh: 适应这个热带地区潮湿的气候需要一段时间。

collocations.example_en: Hurry up and get ready, otherwise we're going to miss the opening scene.
collocations.example_zh: 赶紧准备好，否则我们就要错过开场戏了。

collocations.meaning: 迷路；走开，滚开（祈使句中）
collocations.example_en: Without a reliable GPS navigation app, it's very easy to get lost in the old town.
collocations.example_zh: 如果没有好用的导航软件，在老城区很容易迷路。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想要（做某事）；感觉像，感觉仿佛
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I really feel like having a cup of hot chocolate on this chilly evening.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在这个寒冷的夜晚，我真想喝一杯热巧克力。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 看起来像，外表类似于；看起来似乎要（发生某事）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Those dark storm clouds indicate that it looks like rain very soon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那些乌云表明看起来很快就要下雨了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 听起来像；听上去似乎
phrasal_verbs.example_en: That proposal sounds like a great idea, but we need to assess the budget first.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那个提议听起来是个好主意，但我们首先需要评估预算。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 似乎像，给人的印象仿佛是
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It seems like only yesterday that we graduated from college together.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们一起大学毕业的场景仿佛就在昨天。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 闻起来像；（情境）有……的可疑迹象
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The whole kitchen smells like freshly baked cinnamon rolls.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 整个厨房闻起来都是新鲜烘焙的肉桂卷香气。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 尝起来像，具有……的味道
phrasal_verbs.example_en: This plant-based substitute tastes remarkably like real chicken meat.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这种植物基替代品尝起来与真正的鸡肉极为相似。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 表现得像，假装，装作……的样子
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't act like you don't know what happened; we saw everything on camera.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别装作不知道发生了什么，我们在监控录像里看得清清楚楚。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想要，愿意（委婉表达意愿或请求）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We would like to book a table for four near the window tonight.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们今晚想预订一张靠窗的四人桌。

idioms.phrase: like a fish out of water
idioms.meaning: 感到格格不入，感到陌生尴尬而极不自在
idioms.example_en: Surrounded by tech experts, he felt like a fish out of water talking about algorithms.
idioms.example_zh: 被一群技术专家环绕着谈论算法，他感到极为格格不入。

idioms.meaning: 非常有规律地，顺利准确地，像钟表一样按部就班
idioms.example_en: The entire stage production went off like clockwork thanks to rigorous rehearsals.
idioms.example_zh: 多亏了严谨的排练，整场舞台演出的进行如钟表般准确顺利。

idioms.phrase: like two peas in a pod
idioms.meaning: 一模一样，宛如一个模子刻出来的
idioms.example_en: The twin brothers share the same smile and habits; they're like two peas in a pod.
idioms.example_zh: 这对双胞胎兄弟有着相同的笑容和习惯，真是一个模子刻出来的。

idioms.phrase: like water off a duck's back
idioms.meaning: 如耳旁风，对（批评或责难）毫无作用、毫无触动
idioms.example_en: Harsh criticism rolled off him like water off a duck's back.
idioms.example_zh: 严厉的批评对他来说就像耳旁风一样，毫无触动。

idioms.phrase: like a bull in a china shop
idioms.meaning: 鲁莽冲动的人，笨手笨脚闯祸的人
idioms.example_en: His blunt approach in delicate negotiations made him seem like a bull in a china shop.
idioms.example_zh: 他在微妙的谈判中那种粗暴的做法，让他显得像个闯进瓷器店的莽汉。

idioms.meaning: 胃口极小，吃得极少
idioms.example_en: No wonder she's so thin; she eats like a bird and skips lunch constantly.
idioms.example_zh: 难怪她这么瘦，她吃得像鸟一样少，还经常不吃午饭。

collocations.meaning: 开始喜欢上，对……产生好感
collocations.example_en: The rescue dog took an immediate liking to the friendly little girl.
collocations.example_zh: 那只救助犬立即对那个友善的小女孩产生了好感。

collocations.meaning: 不管喜不喜欢，不管愿不愿意（客观事实不容改变）
collocations.example_en: Like it or not, automation is transforming the future of modern manufacturing.
collocations.example_zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，自动化正在重塑现代制造业的未来。

collocations.meaning: 好多了，这还差不多（表示情况更符合期望或更满意）
collocations.example_en: Now that you've lowered the price by ten percent, that's more like it.
collocations.example_zh: 既然你把价格降低了百分之十，这还差不多。

collocations.example_en: We rarely see the likes of such exceptional musical talent in our local theater.
collocations.example_zh: 在我们当地的剧场里，我们很少能见到具有如此非凡音乐天赋的人才。

collocations.meaning: 拼命地，发疯般地，非常剧烈地
collocations.example_en: The team worked like crazy over the weekend to finalize the proposal before the deadline.
collocations.example_zh: 团队周末拼命加班，力争在截止日期前敲定方案。

collocations.meaning: 如果你愿意的话；可以说，不妨说（用于引出建议或解释）
collocations.example_en: We can reschedule our weekly meeting for Friday afternoon, if you like.
collocations.example_zh: 如果你愿意的话，我们可以把每周例会改到周五下午。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 编造（故事/借口）；化妆；组成/构成；和解/和好；弥补/补上
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They had an intense quarrel yesterday, but they quickly made up and went out together.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们昨天大吵了一架，但很快就和好如初并一起出门了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 辨认出/听清；理解/弄懂；开立（支票/文件）；进展；亲热接吻
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I could barely make out the silhouette of a ship through the thick fog.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 透过浓雾，我勉强辨认出一艘船的轮廓。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 弥补；补偿
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He bought her a gorgeous bouquet to make up for forgetting their anniversary.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他买了一束绚丽的花束，以弥补忘记结婚纪念日的过失。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对……有某种理解或看法；看待
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I honestly don't know what to make of his sudden resignation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 说实话，我不知道该如何看待他突然辞职这件事。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 走向/冲向；促成/导致
phrasal_verbs.example_en: As soon as the final bell rang, the students made for the playground.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 下课铃声一响，学生们就直奔操场而去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 仓促离开；仓皇逃跑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The burglar made off as soon as the burglar alarm was triggered.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 防盗警报一响，窃贼就仓皇逃窜了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 偷走；携……潜逃
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Thieves broke into the gallery at midnight and made off with three priceless paintings.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 盗贼半夜闯入画廊，盗走了三幅价值连城的画作。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……改造成/制成
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The old textile factory has been made into a bustling modern art center.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家旧纺织厂已经被改造成了一个繁华的现代艺术中心。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 改造/翻新；把（财产等）转让给
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Before his passing, the elderly tycoon made over his entire estate to a charitable foundation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在去世前，这位年迈的富商将全部财产转让给了一个慈善基金会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 奉承；巴结；讨好
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He has been making up to the regional manager in hopes of securing a swift promotion.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他一直在巴结区域经理，希望能迅速获得升职。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 携……而逃；杀死/消灭；挥霍
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The dishonest treasurer made away with thousands of dollars of club funds.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那个不诚实的财务管理员卷走了俱乐部数千美元的资金。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 获得成功；按时到达；度过难关/幸存
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite severe blizzard conditions, we managed to make it to the airport in time.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管暴风雪肆虐，我们还是及时赶到了机场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 朝……走去/移向
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Seeing the dark storm clouds gathering, the hikers made towards the mountain shelter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 看到乌云密布，徒步旅行者们便朝着山间避难所走去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 装作好像；做出……的姿态
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He made as if to speak, but thought better of it and held his peace.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他做出一副要开口的样子，但又觉得不妥而保持了沉默。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拿出；提供（口语，通常用于祈使句）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Come on, stop stalling and make with the explanations!
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 得了吧，别再拖延了，快点给出解释！

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用……原料做成；从……提炼出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sculptor makes striking contemporary figures out of scrap metal.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这位雕塑家用废旧金属创作出引人瞩目的现代人物雕塑。

idioms.meaning: 收支相抵；维持生计
idioms.example_en: With the sharp rise in living costs, many families struggle to make ends meet.
idioms.example_zh: 随着生活成本急剧上升，许多家庭都在勉强维持生计。

idioms.meaning: 兴风作浪；挑起事端；引起骚动
idioms.example_en: As a newcomer in the firm, she preferred to blend in rather than make waves.
idioms.example_zh: 作为公司的新人，她宁愿低调融入，也不愿惹是生非。

idioms.phrase: make a mountain out of a molehill
idioms.meaning: 小题大做；大惊小怪
idioms.example_en: It was merely an honest typing typo, so there is no need to make a mountain out of a molehill.
idioms.example_zh: 那不过是一个无心的打字错误，完全没必要小题大做。

idioms.meaning: 产生影响；起重要作用
idioms.example_en: Even small volunteer contributions can make a tremendous difference to local communities.
idioms.example_zh: 即便是微小的志愿者贡献，也能对当地社区产生巨大的积极影响。

idioms.meaning: 凑合；将就使用
idioms.example_en: We didn't have professional photography equipment, so we had to make do with our smartphones.
idioms.example_zh: 我们没有专业摄影器材，只能用智能手机将就应付。

idioms.meaning: 让某人非常开心/高兴
idioms.example_en: Hearing that her scientific paper was accepted by the journal made her day.
idioms.example_zh: 得知自己的科研论文被该期刊录用，她开心了一整天。

idioms.meaning: 当众大吵大闹；失态大闹
idioms.example_en: Please lower your voice; there's no reason to make a scene in a quiet restaurant.
idioms.example_zh: 请放低声音，没必要在安静的餐厅里当众大闹。

collocations.meaning: 讲得通/有道理；理解/搞懂
collocations.example_en: I have reread the cryptic instruction multiple times, but I cannot make sense of it.
collocations.example_zh: 我把那条隐晦的指示重读了好几遍，依然无法理解。

collocations.example_en: Make sure that all the laboratory windows are securely latched before leaving.
collocations.example_zh: 离开前务必确保实验室的所有窗户都已插紧锁好。

collocations.example_en: You need to make a conscious effort to improve your pronunciation.
collocations.example_zh: 你需要自觉努力来改善自己的发音。

collocations.example_en: They moved the heavy bookshelf to make room for a baby crib.
collocations.example_zh: 他们搬走了厚重的书架，为婴儿床腾出空间。

collocations.example_en: The research team has made remarkable progress in decoding the gene sequence.
collocations.example_zh: 研究团队在破译该基因序列方面取得了显著进展。

collocations.example_en: We should make the most of the sunny weekend and go on a camping trip.
collocations.example_zh: 我们应该充分利用这个晴朗的周末，去露营一番。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 履行/兑现（承诺）；赔偿/补偿（损失）；发迹/获得成功
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After years of hardship in the city, the young entrepreneur finally made good.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在城市经历多年艰辛之后，这位年轻创业者终于功成名就。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 履行（诺言）；偿付（债务）；兑现
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The candidate promised to lower taxes, and voters expect him to make good on his word.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该候选人承诺减税，选民们期待他能兑现诺言。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （规则/理论等）依然适用；依然有效
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The fundamental principles of classical mechanics still hold good in everyday engineering.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经典力学的基本原理在日常工程中依然适用。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （经过波折后）最终好转/成功；兑现潜力
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite a sluggish start to the season, the striker finally came good in the finals.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管赛季初表现平平，这位前锋最终在决赛中大放异彩。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对某人有好处/有益处
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A brisk morning walk in the fresh air will do you a world of good.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在清新的空气中进行晨间快走会对你的身体大有裨益。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 仍然有效；保持成立
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Our written agreement stands good until the end of the current fiscal year.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们的书面协议在本财政年度结束前一直有效。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 看起来不错；显得体面；有吸引力/前景良好
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The economic indicators look good for the upcoming quarter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 即将到来的季度的经济指标看起来前景不错。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 感觉舒适/良好；自我感觉良好
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It feels good to wrap up such a demanding project ahead of schedule.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 能够提前完成这样一个要求严苛的项目，感觉棒极了。

idioms.meaning: 永远地；一劳永逸地
idioms.example_en: He decided to give up smoking for good after his health checkup.
idioms.example_zh: 体检过后，他决定彻底戒烟。

idioms.meaning: 几乎；实际上等于
idioms.example_en: With a three-goal lead and five minutes left, the match was as good as won.
idioms.example_zh: 领先三球且只剩五分钟，这场比赛实际上已经稳赢了。

idioms.meaning: 好得难以置信（往往不切实际）
idioms.example_en: The investment offer sounded too good to be true, and it eventually turned out to be a scam.
idioms.example_zh: 这项投资收益听起来好得难以置信，最终证实是一场骗局。

idioms.meaning: 受到妥善照料；处于可靠之人的掌管下
idioms.example_en: Don't worry about the accounting audit; with Sarah leading the team, we are in good hands.
idioms.example_zh: 别担心财务审计，有莎拉带队，一切都在妥善掌控之中。

idioms.meaning: 与……关系良好/和睦相处
idioms.example_en: Even after their business partnership ended, they remained on good terms.
idioms.example_zh: 即使商业合作关系结束了，他们之间依然保持着良好关系。

idioms.meaning: 划算的交易；大量/许多
idioms.example_en: We spent a good deal of time analyzing user feedback before launching the update.
idioms.example_zh: 在推出更新之前，我们花了很多时间分析用户反馈。

idioms.meaning: 没有用处；糟糕的；徒劳的
idioms.example_en: It is no good complaining about the train delays when the weather is this foul.
idioms.example_zh: 在如此恶劣的天气下，抱怨列车晚点是毫无用处的。

collocations.example_en: She has always been exceptionally good at resolving interpersonal conflicts.
collocations.example_zh: 她向来极其擅长化解人际冲突。

collocations.meaning: 对……有益；能够承受/有效期限为
collocations.example_en: Eating leafy green vegetables on a daily basis is good for heart health.
collocations.example_zh: 每天吃绿叶蔬菜对心脏健康非常有益。

collocations.meaning: 对（某人）友善/亲切；对……是好的
collocations.example_en: The elderly landlady was always exceedingly good to the international students.
collocations.example_zh: 那位年迈的女房东对国际留学生总是格外友善。

collocations.example_en: We have encountered a few minor bugs, but so far, so good.
collocations.example_zh: 我们遇到了一些小错误，但到目前为止一切进展顺利。

collocations.meaning: 玩得开心；度过愉快时光
collocations.example_en: The kids had a wonderful time at the interactive science museum yesterday.
collocations.example_zh: 孩子们昨天在互动科学博物馆玩得非常开心。

collocations.example_en: The landscaping crew did a good job of revamping the public park.
collocations.example_zh: 绿化施工队把改造公园的工作完成得非常漂亮。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 继续；发生；（灯等）亮起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please go on with your work while I check what is going on outside.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在我去查看外面发生什么事时，请继续你的工作。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （闹钟/炸弹）响起/爆炸；（食物）变质；离开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The milk has gone off, and just then my alarm went off unexpectedly.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 牛奶变质了，恰在此时我的闹钟又莫名其妙地响了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 外出（社交/娱乐）；（灯火）熄灭；过时
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The campfire went out just as we were planning to go out for a night walk.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 就在我们正打算外出夜游时，营火熄灭了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 经历（苦难/危机）；仔细检查；（法案/交易）获通过
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She went through a painful divorce while accountants went through all company files.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她经历了一场痛苦的离婚，与此同时会计师们审查了公司所有的账目。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 上升，上涨；（建筑物）拔地而起；被烧毁
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Housing prices continue to go up as modern apartments go up all over the city.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 随着现代公寓在全市拔地而起，房价仍在持续上涨。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 下降，减少；被载入史册；（系统/服务器）瘫痪
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The website went down for hours, but eventually user complaints began to go down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 网站瘫痪了数小时，但最终用户的投诉量开始下降了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 仔细检查，复习；走过去；受欢迎/被接受
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's go over the contract one more time to ensure no clauses were overlooked.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们把合同再过一遍，确保没有遗漏任何条款。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 详细讨论/深入探究；从事（行业）；耗费（时间/金钱）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I don't want to go into details now, but immense effort went into this research.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我现在不想细谈细节，但这项研究投入了巨大的心血。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 返回；追溯到；与某人相识已久
phrasal_verbs.example_en: This ancient tradition goes back hundreds of years, and locals still go back to celebrate it every spring.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这项古老传统可以追溯到几百年前，当地人每年春天仍会回去庆祝。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 选择；努力争取；适用于；袭击
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I think you should go for that promotion; the same logic goes for your colleagues.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我认为你应该去争取这次晋升，这一道理同样适用于你的同事。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 赞同，顺从（观点或决定）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He decided to go along with the committee's proposal despite his personal reservations.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管他个人持保留态度，但最终还是决定赞同委员会的提议。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （时间）流逝；遵循，依照；顺便走访
phrasal_verbs.example_en: As years go by, you will realize you shouldn't go by appearances alone.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 随着岁月流逝，你会明白不该仅仅凭外表来做判断。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 着手进行，准许发生；领先
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The board gave us permission to go ahead with the renewable energy initiative.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 董事会批准我们着手开展这项可再生能源计划。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 离开，外出度假；（痛苦/问题）消退
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Take this medicine and your persistent headache should go away soon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 服下这药，你持续的头痛很快就会消退。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 忍受没有...；将就，勉强应付
phrasal_verbs.example_en: During the harsh winter storm, thousands had to go without electricity for days.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在这场严酷的冬季暴风雪中，数千人不得不连续几天在没有电的情况下度日。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 着手处理，着手做；（谣言等）流传
phrasal_verbs.example_en: How do you intend to go about solving such a complicated engineering problem?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你打算如何着手解决这样一个复杂的工程难题？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与...相配；伴随；选择
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A balanced diet goes with a healthy lifestyle, so I'll go with the salad.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 均衡饮食与健康生活方式相得益彰，所以我选沙拉。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 坚持完成（艰难或令人不快的决定）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite facing severe public criticism, the mayor went through with the tax reforms.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管面临公众的严厉批评，市长依然坚持完成了税收改革。

idioms.meaning: 付出超出预期的努力，格外卖力
idioms.example_en: Our customer support team is always willing to go the extra mile to resolve issues.
idioms.example_zh: 我们的客服团队总是愿意加倍努力来解决问题。

idioms.meaning: 顺其自然，随大流
idioms.example_en: Instead of overplanning the vacation, let's just relax and go with the flow.
idioms.example_zh: 与其把假期规划得太满，不如放松下来顺其自然。

idioms.meaning: 不言而喻，显而易见
idioms.example_en: It goes without saying that hard work is indispensable for achieving long-term success.
idioms.example_zh: 不言而喻，努力奋斗是取得长期成功必不可少的。

idioms.meaning: 特意，格外费心（去帮助他人）
idioms.example_en: My neighbor went out of his way to help me repair the broken fence during the rain.
idioms.example_zh: 我邻居冒雨格外热心地帮我修理坏掉的栅栏。

idioms.meaning: 破产，彻底倒闭
idioms.example_en: Many small tech startups went belly up when funding dried up suddenly.
idioms.example_zh: 当资金骤然枯竭时，许多小型初创科技公司纷纷倒闭。

idioms.phrase: go back to the drawing board
idioms.meaning: 从头再来，重新制定计划
idioms.example_en: The prototype failed the safety test, so the engineers had to go back to the drawing board.
idioms.example_zh: 原型机未通过安全测试，工程师们不得不推倒重来。

collocations.example_en: No matter how meticulously you plan, things can still go wrong.
collocations.example_zh: 无论你计划得多么周密，事情仍有可能出差错。

collocations.meaning: （在网络上）迅速走红，病毒式传播
collocations.example_en: The short rescue video went viral within hours and attracted millions of views.
collocations.example_zh: 那段救援短视频在几小时内走红网络，吸引了数百万次观看。

collocations.example_en: The retail chain was forced to go bankrupt after accumulating massive debts.
collocations.example_zh: 在背负巨额债务后，该零售连锁店被迫宣告破产。

collocations.example_en: Several key documents went missing right before the audit took place.
collocations.example_zh: 就在审查开展前夕，几份关键文件不翼而飞了。

collocations.example_en: The ecstatic crowd went crazy when the singer walked onto the stage.
collocations.example_zh: 当歌手走上舞台时，狂喜的观众们陷入了疯狂。

collocations.example_en: Her diligent contributions to the department did not go unnoticed by senior management.
collocations.example_zh: 她对部门的辛勤贡献并没有被管理层忽视。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 突然离去，不辞而别
phrasal_verbs.example_en: One morning he just upped and left without giving any explanation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一天早上他突然不辞而别，没有给出任何解释。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 突然做出（某出人意料的举动）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After years in finance, she upped and moved to Spain to become an artist.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在金融界工作多年后，她突然搬去西班牙当了艺术家。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 忙于/从事（尤指捣乱或秘密活动）；胜任；取决于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What have you been up to recently, and are you up to managing this project?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你最近在忙些什么？你胜任管理这个项目吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 愿意参与；面临（选拔/出售/审判）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Are you up for a quick dinner downtown before the concert starts?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 音乐会开始前，你乐意在市中心一起吃个便饭吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 面临（强大的对手或严重的困难）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The young team found itself up against the reigning world champions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这支年轻的队伍发现自己正面临卫冕世界冠军的强劲挑战。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 精通，熟悉，了解（最新资讯）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: As a legal analyst, you must stay well up on recent regulatory changes.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 作为法律分析师，你必须密切熟悉最新的监管变动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 支持/拥护（口号用法）；赶上/了解
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The crowd chanted 'Up with reform!' as political delegates entered the hall.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当政治代表们步入大厅时，人群高呼“拥护改革！”。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 突然死去，突然报废（口语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: My laptop simply upped and died right in the middle of the presentation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我的笔记本电脑偏偏在演讲正中间突然彻底报废了。

idioms.meaning: 悬而未决，尚未敲定
idioms.example_en: Our travel itinerary remains up in the air due to conflicting flight schedules.
idioms.example_zh: 由于航班时间冲突，我们的旅行日程依然悬而未决。

idioms.meaning: 达到标准，令人满意
idioms.example_en: The revised manuscript was still not up to scratch, so revisions continued.
idioms.example_zh: 修改后的书稿仍未达到要求标准，因此修改工作仍在继续。

idioms.meaning: 强烈抗议，竭力反对
idioms.example_en: Local residents were up in arms over the plan to demolish the historic theater.
idioms.example_zh: 当地居民对拆除这座历史悠久的剧院的计划表示强烈抗议。

idioms.meaning: 蒸蒸日上；诚实守信
idioms.example_en: Her consulting career is decidedly on the up and up thanks to glowing client reviews.
idioms.example_zh: 由于客户的一致好评，她的咨询事业显然正蒸蒸日上。

idioms.meaning: 深陷于，忙得不可开交
idioms.example_en: I'm up to my ears in paperwork right now, so let's discuss this tomorrow.
idioms.example_zh: 我现在忙于处理文书工作不可开交，我们明天再讨论这个吧。

idioms.meaning: 加大筹码，增加要求或风险
idioms.example_en: Competitors upped the ante by providing free delivery and lifetime warranties.
idioms.example_zh: 竞争对手通过提供免费送货和终身保修提高了竞争门槛。

collocations.example_en: Suppliers decided to up the price of raw materials due to high transport costs.
collocations.example_zh: 由于高昂的运输成本，供应商决定提高原材料的价格。

collocations.example_en: The newly upgraded database is now fully up and running without errors.
collocations.example_zh: 新升级的数据库现已全面投入正常运行，没有任何错误。

collocations.example_en: His mood has been up and down all week because of the fluctuating stock market.
collocations.example_zh: 由于股市波动，他整整一周的心情都起伏不定。

collocations.example_en: Entering international markets will up the stakes significantly for our brand.
collocations.example_zh: 进军国际市场将大幅增加我们品牌的风险与投入。

collocations.example_en: Make sure your antivirus software is kept completely up to date.
collocations.example_zh: 请确保你的杀毒软件始终保持在最新状态。

collocations.example_en: The automotive factory must up production to satisfy soaring consumer demand.
collocations.example_zh: 这家汽车制造厂必须提高产量，以满足不断飙升的消费者需求。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 公开揭露/曝光某人的秘密身份或性取向
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The journalist was criticized for trying to out the actor before he was ready to speak publicly.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该记者因企图在那位演员准备好公开之前强行曝光其取向而受到批评。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 坦白说出，吐露（常用于祈使表达）；换掉，驱逐（旧事物）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Come on, out with it—what did the manager really say about my proposal?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 快点，痛快说出来吧——经理到底对我的提案说了什么？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 竭力想，存心/企图（做某事）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Be careful around him; he is out to take full credit for your hard work.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 提防着他点；他正处心积虑要把你辛勤工作的成果据为己有。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 一心谋求，企图捞取（利益、报复等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She isn't interested in a fair compromise; she's clearly out for revenge.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她对公平妥协毫无兴趣；她显然一心只想复仇。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用光，耗尽；摆脱，脱离（某种状态）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We are completely out of printer paper, so we'll need to reorder this afternoon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们的打印纸彻底用光了，今天下午得重新采购。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （计算、预算或时间估计上）相差，偏差
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Our revenue forecast for the third quarter was out by almost ten percent.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们第三季度的营收预测偏差了将近百分之十。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 主动公开自身秘密身份或出柜；不打自招
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He accidentally outed himself during the interview by revealing classified details.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在采访中透露了机密细节，不慎暴露了自身身份。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 参与（罢工、抗议）；外出执行（巡逻等任务）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Thousands of factory workers have been out on strike over pay cuts since Monday.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 自周一以来，数千名工厂工人因减薪而走上街头举行罢工。

idioms.meaning: 出乎意料地，突然之间
idioms.example_en: After five years of complete silence, she called me out of the blue last night.
idioms.example_zh: 在杳无音信整整五年后，她昨晚突然给我打来了电话。

idioms.meaning: 绝不可能，毫无商量余地
idioms.example_en: Buying a brand-new car right now is completely out of the question.
idioms.example_zh: 眼下买一辆全新汽车是绝不可能考虑的事。

idioms.meaning: 外出走动，病后能下床活动
idioms.example_en: It's wonderful to see grandma out and about again after her knee surgery.
idioms.example_zh: 看到祖母在膝盖手术后又能四处走动，真令人高兴。

idioms.meaning: 失去控制；立即，断然（拒绝）
idioms.example_en: The dispute between the two departments got completely out of hand.
idioms.example_zh: 两个部门之间的争执彻底失控了。

idioms.meaning: 迅速熟睡，立即昏睡过去
idioms.example_en: The baby was so exhausted from the trip that she was out like a light the moment her head hit the pillow.
idioms.example_zh: 宝宝旅途太劳累了，脑袋一碰到枕头就立刻呼呼大睡。

idioms.meaning: 穷困潦倒的，走投无路的
idioms.example_en: He lost his home and was completely down and out before a local charity took him in.
idioms.example_zh: 在一家当地慈善机构收留他之前，他失去了住所，陷入了走投无路的绝境。

collocations.meaning: 够不着；力所不及，负担不起
collocations.example_en: Skyrocketing property prices have put homeownership out of reach for many young couples.
collocations.example_zh: 飞涨的房价让许多年轻夫妇根本负担不起购房成本。

collocations.meaning: 发生故障；不合规矩，失礼不当
collocations.example_en: The elevator has been out of order since yesterday morning, forcing everyone to take the stairs.
collocations.example_zh: 电梯自昨天早上起就坏了，迫使大家只能走楼梯。

collocations.example_en: I was completely out of breath after sprinting to catch the morning train.
collocations.example_zh: 为了赶上早班火车一路冲刺后，我喘得几乎说不出话来。

collocations.example_en: Just out of curiosity, how much did you actually pay for that vintage watch?
collocations.example_zh: 纯粹出于好奇，你买这块复古手表到底花了多少钱？

collocations.example_en: Inflation ran out of control, eroding the purchasing power of ordinary citizens.
collocations.example_zh: 通货膨胀失控，严重侵蚀了普通民众的购买力。

collocations.meaning: 不在适当地点；格格不入，不适宜
collocations.example_en: Wearing a formal tuxedo to a beach barbecue made him feel decidedly out of place.
collocations.example_zh: 穿着正装燕尾服去参加海滩烧烤让他觉得格外格格不入。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （计算机网络等）超时中断；（体育比赛）申请暂停
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The server request timed out before the database could respond with the user data.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在数据库响应返回用户数据之前，服务器请求已超时中断。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 选定...的时间以配合；使与...同步发生
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The marketing team timed the product launch to coincide with the major trade expo.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 市场团队特意调整了新品发布时间，以使其与大型贸易博览会同步。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 测定...的时间/速度为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The race officials timed the sprinter at an impressive 9.85 seconds.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 赛会裁判测出该短跑选手的成绩为令人瞩目的9.85秒。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把...的时机掌握得很好/很糟
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You timed your arrival perfectly; we were just about to sit down for dinner.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你到得正是时候；我们刚准备坐下来吃晚餐。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打卡上班，签到记录到岗时间；（比赛计时器）重新恢复计时
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All factory operators are required to time in using their electronic badges before 8:00 AM.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 所有工厂操作员都必须在早上8点之前使用电子工牌打卡签到。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因超过限定时间而自动退出/失效
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If you don't enter the verification code within two minutes, you will time out of the login session.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果两分钟内未输入验证码，系统将判定超时并自动退出登录会话。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把握好...的恰当时机
phrasal_verbs.example_en: To profit from stock trading, you must time your market entries and exits right.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 要想在股票交易中获利，你必须精准把握进出市场的时机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 给...计时结束；设定定时关闭
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The system is set to time the air conditioner off after four hours of continuous operation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该系统设置为在空调连续运转四小时后自动定时关闭。

idioms.meaning: 在最后一刻，千钧一发之际
idioms.example_en: Paramedics arrived in the nick of time to save the drowning swimmer.
idioms.example_zh: 急救医护人员在千钧一发之际赶到，挽救了溺水游泳者的生命。

idioms.meaning: 思想超前，领先于时代
idioms.example_en: His visionary architectural designs were so far ahead of their time that few appreciated them initially.
idioms.example_zh: 他前瞻性的建筑设计极为超前，以至于起初鲜有人能真正赏识。

idioms.meaning: 时间会证明，日久见人心
idioms.example_en: Whether the bold corporate merger was the right move remains uncertain; only time will tell.
idioms.example_zh: 这次大胆的企业合并是否是明智之举尚无定论；唯有时间会证明一切。

idioms.meaning: 陈旧落伍，赶不上时代步伐
idioms.example_en: Relying on manual paper filing makes their administrative office look terribly behind the times.
idioms.example_zh: 依靠手工纸质归档让他们的行政办公室显得极其落伍于时代。

idioms.phrase: have the time of one's life
idioms.meaning: 过得极开心，享受生命中最美妙的时光
idioms.example_en: The kids had the time of their lives riding rollercoasters at the amusement park.
idioms.example_zh: 孩子们在游乐园坐过山车，玩得尽兴极了。

idioms.meaning: 偶尔，不时
idioms.example_en: Even though they live far apart, the old college roommates still meet up from time to time.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管彼此住得很远，这几位大学室友依然会不时聚一聚。

idioms.meaning: 消磨时间，打发时光
idioms.example_en: I browsed through the airport duty-free shops just to kill time before boarding.
idioms.example_zh: 登机前我逛了逛机场免税店，纯粹为了消磨时间。

collocations.example_en: No matter how frantic his work schedule is, he always makes time for his family.
collocations.example_zh: 无论工作日程多么繁忙，他总会腾出时间陪伴家人。

collocations.example_en: There's no hurry to complete the questionnaire, so please take your time.
collocations.example_zh: 完成这份调查问卷无需着急，请慢慢填写。

collocations.example_en: The speaker ran out of time before she could present her final conclusions.
collocations.example_zh: 演讲者还没来得及展示最终结论，时间就用光了。

collocations.example_en: During the long power outage, we played board games to pass the time.
collocations.example_zh: 在漫长的停电期间，我们玩棋盘游戏来打发时间。

collocations.example_en: Our five-year-old daughter has just learned how to tell the time on an analog clock.
collocations.example_zh: 我们五岁的女儿刚刚学会了如何在指针式钟表上看时间。

collocations.example_en: Stop wasting time arguing over minor details and focus on the main objective.
collocations.example_zh: 别再把时间浪费在为细枝末节争执上了，专注于核心目标吧。

collocations.example_en: We will continue using the legacy software for the time being until the upgrade is tested.
collocations.example_zh: 在升级测试完毕之前，我们暂时会继续使用旧版软件。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 自言自语；心里琢磨；暗自思忖
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Seeing the dark clouds gathering, she said to herself that it was going to pour.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 看到乌云聚集，她心想肯定要下大雨了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为自己辩护；为自己解释
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What do you have to say for yourself after arriving two hours late?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你迟到了整整两小时，有什么要为自己辩解的吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对……提出看法或建议；（征求意见）觉得……怎么样
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What do you say to taking a weekend trip to the coast?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 周末去海边走走，你觉得怎么样？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 大声说出；毫无顾忌地直说
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If you disagree with the proposal, don't keep silent—say it out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你不同意这项提议，别保持沉默，痛快说出来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 谈论；对……发表看法或评价
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Critics had nothing but praise to say about her debut performance.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 剧评人对她的首秀赞不绝口。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 继续说；就……发表进一步意见
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The minister refused to say anything further on the controversial policy.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 部长拒绝就这项有争议的政策作进一步表态。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 说……的坏话；反对；提出不利于……的意见
phrasal_verbs.example_en: No one can say anything against his dedication to the team.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 没人能挑出他对团队奉献方面的毛病。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 默念；重复朗诵；复述
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He said the speech over several times until he had committed it to memory.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他把演讲稿反复念了好几遍，直到烂熟于心。

idioms.meaning: 退一步说；往轻了说；至少可以这么说
idioms.example_en: The transition period has been challenging, to say the least.
idioms.example_zh: 往轻了说，这一过渡时期充满了挑战。

idioms.meaning: 也就是说；换言之
idioms.example_en: We will provide full logistics, that is to say, transport, meals, and lodging.
idioms.example_zh: 我们将提供全面的后勤保障，也就是说包括交通、餐饮和住宿。

idioms.meaning: 不用说；不言而喻；显而易见
idioms.example_en: Needless to say, the sudden announcement left everyone in utter shock.
idioms.example_zh: 不用说，这一突如其来的消息让所有人都震惊不已。

idioms.meaning: 理所当然；不言而喻
idioms.example_en: It goes without saying that safety remains our topmost priority.
idioms.example_zh: 不言而喻，安全始终是我们最优先考虑的事项。

idioms.phrase: when all is said and done
idioms.meaning: 说到底；归根结底；毕竟
idioms.example_en: When all is said and done, execution matters far more than mere strategy.
idioms.example_zh: 归根结底，执行力远比单纯的策略重要得多。

idioms.meaning: 一点也没错；我完全同意
idioms.example_en: "It's freezing outside!" — "You can say that again."
idioms.example_zh: “外面太冷了！”——“可不是嘛，一点没错。”

idioms.meaning: 不得不说；坦白讲；确实
idioms.example_en: I must say, your presentation was one of the most persuasive I've seen.
idioms.example_zh: 我不得不说，你的演讲是我见过的最具说服力的演讲之一。

collocations.example_en: Employees demand to have a say in major corporate restructuring decisions.
collocations.example_zh: 员工要求在公司重大重组决策中拥有发言权。

collocations.meaning: 无话可说；无可奉告；拒绝评论
collocations.example_en: The spokesperson had nothing to say regarding the ongoing investigation.
collocations.example_zh: 发言人对正在进行的调查表示无可奉告。

collocations.meaning: 一言不发；守口如瓶；不泄露秘密
collocations.example_en: She promised not to say a word about the surprise party to anyone.
collocations.example_zh: 她保证对惊喜派对的事守口如瓶，绝不对任何人透露。

collocations.example_en: After weighing the risks, the board finally decided to say yes to the merger.
collocations.example_zh: 权衡风险后，董事会最终决定批准这项合并案。

collocations.example_en: It only takes a moment to say thanks to those who support you every day.
collocations.example_zh: 对那些日常支持你的人说声谢谢，其实只需片刻。

collocations.example_en: It is hard to say whether the new market regulations will stimulate growth.
collocations.example_zh: 很难说新的市场监管法规是否会刺激经济增长。

collocations.example_en: As they say, time and tide wait for no man.
collocations.example_zh: 常言道，岁月不饶人，时不我待。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 了解……的情况；知晓关于……的事情
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Does the project manager know about the delay in the supply chain?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 项目经理知道供应链延误的情况吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 听说过；知晓……的存在（但无深入了解）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I don't know the author personally, but I certainly know of her groundbreaking research.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我个人并不认识这位学者，但我确实听说过她开创性的研究。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……和……区分开来；辨别；认知差异
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He was so exhausted that he could barely know right from wrong.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他疲惫不堪，几乎无法分辨是非对错。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分清；辨别（两者或多个相似事物）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The twin brothers look so identical that even their teachers can't know them apart.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这对双胞胎兄弟长得一模一样，连老师都分不清谁是谁。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 凭……认出；根据……了解
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I knew her instantly by her distinctive laugh.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 凭她那独特的笑声，我立刻就认出了她。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 最清楚；最有发言权；自以为是
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Doctors don't always know best—patients should also listen to their own bodies.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 医生并不总能洞悉一切——病人也应该倾听自己身体的反应。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以……著称；被称作；被公认为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The city is known as the cultural and financial capital of the continent.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该市被公认为该大洲的文化与金融之都。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因……而闻名；以……见长
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The restaurant is known for its authentic handmade pasta and warm hospitality.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家餐厅以其正宗的手工意面和热情的待客之道而闻名。

idioms.meaning: 懂得更多道理而不至于做错事；心知肚明；明智得不至于
idioms.example_en: You know better than to click on suspicious email attachments.
idioms.example_zh: 你明白事理，绝不至于去点击可疑的邮件附件。

idioms.meaning: 懂得门道；摸清诀窍；熟悉行规流程
idioms.example_en: Once you know the ropes, handling daily client requests will be much smoother.
idioms.example_zh: 一旦你摸清了门道，处理日常客户需求就会顺手得多。

idioms.meaning: 对……了如指掌；对……极为精通
idioms.example_en: Having maintained the software for a decade, she knows the code inside out.
idioms.example_zh: 维护该软件整整十年后，她对这段代码了如指掌。

idioms.meaning: 知情的；消息灵通的；掌握内部信息的
idioms.example_en: Insiders in the know suggest that a leadership reshuffle is imminent.
idioms.example_zh: 消息灵通的内部人士暗示，领导层大换血迫在眉睫。

idioms.meaning: 据我所知；天晓得；说不定（常表推测与不确定）
idioms.example_en: He hasn't called for days; for all I know, he might have already left town.
idioms.example_zh: 他好几天没打电话了；天晓得，说不定他早就离开这座城市了。

idioms.phrase: not know the first thing about
idioms.meaning: 对……一无所知；完全外行
idioms.example_en: He agreed to fix the engine despite not knowing the first thing about mechanics.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管对机械一窍不通，他还是答应去修那台发动机。

idioms.meaning: 明白事理；懂得世故；心里有数
idioms.example_en: Ask Sarah for career advice—she has been in the industry long enough to know what's what.
idioms.example_zh: 向萨拉请教职业建议吧——她入行已久，深谙行业门道。

collocations.phrase: know for sure / know for certain
collocations.example_en: We won't know for sure whether the bid was accepted until Friday morning.
collocations.example_zh: 要到周五上午我们才能确切知道竞标是否被采纳。

collocations.example_en: The orientation program helps freshmen get to know their peers and faculty.
collocations.example_zh: 迎新培训项目有助于新生逐渐熟悉同龄人和教职员工。

collocations.example_en: He knew full well that his decision violated the company's code of conduct.
collocations.example_zh: 他心知肚明自己的决定违反了公司的行为准则。

collocations.example_en: Please let me know as soon as the revised draft is ready for review.
collocations.example_zh: 修改稿准备好审阅时，请第一时间通知我。

collocations.example_en: As far as I know, the contract terms have not yet been finalized.
collocations.example_zh: 据我所知，合同条款目前尚未敲定。

collocations.example_en: The actor rehearsed every monologue until he knew the entire script by heart.
collocations.example_zh: 该演员反复排练每段独白，直到把整个剧本倒背如流。

collocations.meaning: 自我介绍；使自己为人所知；引人注目
collocations.example_en: Upon arriving at the conference, she immediately made herself known to the keynote speaker.
collocations.example_zh: 一到达研讨会现场，她便立刻主动向主旨发言人作了自我介绍。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 起飞；脱下（衣帽）；迅速走红/大获成功；休假/离开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The new business took off rapidly after the endorsement, prompting him to take a few days off to celebrate.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家新企业在获得代言后迅速走红，促使他休了几天假去庆祝。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 承担（责任/工作）；雇佣（员工）；呈现（特征/面貌）；同...较量
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The agency decided to take on extra staff as the project began to take on a whole new dimension.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 随着该项目展现出全新的格局，该机构决定增聘人手。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 开始从事（爱好/职业）；占用（时间/空间）；接纳/采纳（建议）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She decided to take up photography, though editing pictures takes up a great deal of her spare time.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她决定开始把摄影当作爱好，尽管修图占用了她大量的空闲时间。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 接管/接手；接替；取代/占主导地位
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The multinational corporation plans to take over the local firm once the current CEO steps down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 现任首席执行官离职后，这家跨国公司计划接管这家本土企业。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 吸收/理解；收留/接纳；欺骗/蒙骗；改小（衣服）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It was difficult to take in all the details at once, and he felt slightly taken in by the salesman's rhetoric.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一下子很难消化所有细节，而且他觉得自己有点被推销员的花言巧语蒙骗了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拿出/取出；带...外出（就餐/约会）；取得/办理（贷款/保险）；消除/摧毁
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He took out a substantial loan to start his venture and later took his family out for dinner.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他办了一笔数额可观的贷款来创业，随后带全家人出去吃了晚餐。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 收回（言论）；退货；带回；使回想起/使忆起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I take back what I said earlier, as that melody always takes me back to my childhood days.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我收回之前说的话，因为那段旋律总能让我回想起童年时光。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 记下/写下；拆卸/拆除；拿下/取下；击败/挫伤某人锐气
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The journalist quickly took down notes before the crew began to take down the stage.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在工作人员开始拆除舞台之前，记者迅速记下了笔记。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （外貌、性格等）长得像/像（父母或长辈）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In terms of determination and quick wit, she definitely takes after her grandmother.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 就坚定和机智而言，她无疑很像她的祖母。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拆卸/拆散；轻而易举击败；严厉剖析/批评
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The mechanic took the engine apart to identify the leak, while the critics took apart the author's new thesis.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 技工把发动机拆开以找出漏油点，而评论家们则对这位作者的新论点进行了严厉剖析。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拿走/带走；消除/剥夺；打包（外卖）；领悟/汲取（要点）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The pain relievers helped take away the ache, leaving me free to digest the key message I took away from the seminar.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 止痛药帮助消除了疼痛，使我能静心体会从研讨会中汲取的核心要点。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 喜欢上/对...产生好感；养成...习惯；逃往/前往
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The rescue dog took to its new owner almost immediately and took to sleeping by the fireplace.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这只救援犬几乎立刻喜欢上了新主人，并养成了睡在壁炉旁的习惯。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 误以为/把...当作；把...看作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Do you take me for a fool who would fall for such an obvious scheme?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你以为我是个会中这种浅显圈套的傻子吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 详细向...解释；引领...一步步经历
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let me take you through the software installation step by step so you don't miss anything.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 让我带你一步一步走一遍软件安装流程，免得遗漏任何步骤。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使吃惊/使震惊（通常用被动语态 be taken aback）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We were completely taken aback by the sudden announcement of his immediate resignation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他突然宣布立即辞职，让我们感到极度震惊。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与...结交/与...混在一起；向...提出（问题/申诉）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You ought to take the dispute up with human resources rather than arguing in public.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你应该向人力资源部反映这起纠纷，而不是在公开场合争吵。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拿...出气；将（坏情绪）发泄到...身上
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Even if you had a frustrating day at work, do not take it out on your family.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 即便你工作上度过了沮丧的一天，也不要把脾气发泄在家人身上。

idioms.meaning: 认为...理所当然；对...不以为意/不加重视
idioms.example_en: We often take clean running water for granted until a drought hits the region.
idioms.example_zh: 在干旱席卷该地区之前，我们往往把干净的自来水视作理所当然。

idioms.phrase: take sth with a grain of salt
idioms.meaning: 对某事持保留/半信半疑的态度
idioms.example_en: Online rumors should always be taken with a grain of salt until credible proof emerges.
idioms.example_zh: 在可靠证据出现之前，网络传言总应持保留态度看待。

idioms.phrase: take the bull by the horns
idioms.meaning: 当机立断/迎难而上
idioms.example_en: Instead of waiting for matters to worsen, she took the bull by the horns and settled the dispute directly.
idioms.example_zh: 她没有坐视事态恶化，而是迎难而上，直接化解了纠纷。

idioms.meaning: 放轻松/别紧张；悠着点
idioms.example_en: The doctor advised him to take it easy for a couple of weeks following the surgical procedure.
idioms.example_zh: 医生建议他在手术后的几周内放慢节奏、好好静养。

idioms.meaning: 产生负面影响；造成严重损坏/损耗
idioms.example_en: Years of relentless shift work finally took a heavy toll on his overall health.
idioms.example_zh: 长年累月的倒班工作终于对他的整体健康造成了沉重损害。

idioms.meaning: 美得让人屏息；令人惊叹不已
idioms.example_en: The panoramic vista from the summit was so spectacular that it took our breath away.
idioms.example_zh: 山顶俯瞰的壮丽全景美得令人屏息凝神。

idioms.meaning: 走光明正大的路；采取宽宏大量/道德高尚的做法
idioms.example_en: Rather than retaliating against the insult, she chose to take the high road and remain silent.
idioms.example_zh: 面对侮辱，她没有施加报复，而是选择采取宽容大度的姿态保持沉默。

collocations.example_en: The committee must take into account local weather patterns when designing the drainage system.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会在设计排水系统时，必须把当地的天气状况考虑在内。

collocations.meaning: 利用（机会/有利条件）；占...便宜
collocations.example_en: Young graduates should take advantage of every internship opportunity to gain practical experience.
collocations.example_zh: 年轻毕业生应当把握每一个实习机会以获取实践经验。

collocations.example_en: Hundreds of energetic volunteers eagerly took part in the annual coastal cleanup.
collocations.example_zh: 数百名热情的志愿者积极参与了一年一度的海滩清理活动。

collocations.example_en: Don't fret about the billing discrepancy; our accounting team will take care of it immediately.
collocations.example_zh: 别为账单出入发愁，我们的财务团队会立即处理妥当。

collocations.example_en: Regulatory authorities need to take decisive action against illicit financial operations.
collocations.example_zh: 监管机构需要对非法金融运作采取果断措施。

collocations.example_en: The international trade conference is scheduled to take place in Geneva this November.
collocations.example_zh: 该国际贸易峰会定于今年十一月在日内瓦举行。

collocations.example_en: Entrepreneurs are often required to take calculated risks to achieve breakthrough innovations.
collocations.example_zh: 创业者往往需要承担经过审慎权衡的风险，才能实现突破性创新。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想起/记起；考虑；对...持某种看法/评价
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I couldn't think of his name at first, but I've always thought highly of his research.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我一开始没想起他的名字，但我一直对他的学术研究评价极高。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 琢磨/深思；回想；打算
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She sat quietly on the balcony to think about her career trajectory and future possibilities.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她静静地坐在阳台上，深思自己的职业发展轨迹与未来的各种可能性。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 仔细考虑/认真掂量（决定、建议）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The job offer is remarkably attractive, but I need a few days to think it over.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这份录用待遇十分诱人，但我需要几天时间仔细掂量一番。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 充分推敲/全面考虑（后果或全过程）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Before signing the long-term lease, make sure you have thought through all potential risks.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在签署长期租赁协议前，请确保你已经全面推敲了所有潜在风险。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想出/虚构/捏造（借口、新主意）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He had to think up a plausible explanation for his absence from the executive meeting.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他不得不编造一个看似合理的解释，来说明自己为何缺席高管会议。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 仔细规划/精心构思（常用于 well-thought-out）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Their emergency contingency strategy was clearly thought out long before the crisis erupted.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们的应急预案显然在危机爆发很久之前就已经经过了周密构思。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回想/追溯过去（常与 to 搭配）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: When I think back to our humble beginnings, it seems astonishing how far we have come.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当回想起我们当初艰辛的起点时，真不敢相信我们如今竟走出了这么远。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 未雨绸缪/提前打算/作长远考虑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Competent supply chain managers always think ahead to mitigate impending shortages.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 称职的供应链经理总是能提前打算，以缓解即将出现的物资短缺。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打消念头/改变主意（自知原想法不明智）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He initially wanted to confront his manager in anger, but thought better of it and stayed calm.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他本想愤怒地去找经理理论，但转念一想觉得不妥，便打消了念头保持克制。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将...视为/看作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Throughout her childhood, she always thought of her mentor as a second mother.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在她的成长岁月中，她一直把自己的导师视作第二位母亲。

idioms.meaning: 跳出固有思维/创造性思考
idioms.example_en: To conquer this competitive market, the design department must think outside the box.
idioms.example_zh: 为了攻克这个竞争激烈的市场，设计部门必须打破常规、创新思考。

idioms.meaning: 头脑反应敏捷/临场应变迅速
idioms.example_en: During press conferences, political spokespersons must be capable of thinking on their feet.
idioms.example_zh: 在新闻发布会上，政治发言人必须具备随机应变、迅速作答的能力。

idioms.meaning: 三思而后行/深思熟虑
idioms.example_en: You ought to think twice before investing your life savings in such an unproven market.
idioms.example_zh: 把毕生积蓄投入这样一个未经检验的市场之前，你务必三思而后行。

idioms.meaning: 胸怀大志/放开眼界去设想
idioms.example_en: If you wish to build an enduring global empire, you need to dare to think big from day one.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你想打造一个持久的全球商业帝国，第一天起就得敢于立大志、做宏图规划。

idioms.meaning: 依我看来/在我看来
idioms.example_en: To my way of thinking, prioritizing product durability will earn stronger consumer trust.
idioms.example_zh: 依我看来，把产品耐用度放在首位会赢得消费者更坚实的信任。

idioms.meaning: 回想起来/话又说回来（突然意识到某事）
idioms.example_en: Come to think of it, I don't recall seeing his car parked outside this morning at all.
idioms.example_zh: 话说回来，我仔细一想，今早根本没印象在外面见过他的车。

idioms.meaning: 发人深省/引人深思
idioms.example_en: The professor's closing remarks on ethical artificial intelligence gave us all food for thought.
idioms.example_zh: 教授最后关于伦理人工智能的点评引人深思，给所有人带来了启迪。

collocations.example_en: Senior executives think highly of her analytical acumen and leadership potential.
collocations.example_zh: 高管层对她的敏锐分析能力与领导潜能评价极高。

collocations.meaning: 自言自语/把想法说出来以帮助梳理
collocations.example_en: I'm just thinking out loud here, so feel free to point out any flaws in my reasoning.
collocations.example_zh: 我只是把心里所想随口念叨出来，大家尽管挑我逻辑上的漏洞。

collocations.example_en: The judge thought fit to reduce the defendant's sentence in light of fresh evidence.
collocations.example_zh: 鉴于新出示的证据，法官认为适当减轻被告的刑罚是合理的。

collocations.meaning: 头脑清醒/有条理地理性思考
collocations.example_en: After hours of nonstop negotiations, fatigue made it nearly impossible to think straight.
collocations.example_zh: 经过数小时不间断的谈判后，极度疲劳让人几乎无法保持清醒理性的思考。

collocations.example_en: If we stop to think about the environmental costs, we may revise our production strategy.
collocations.example_zh: 如果我们停下来反思一下环境代价，就可能会修正我们的生产策略。

collocations.meaning: 往好处想/抱持积极乐观的心态
collocations.example_en: Maintaining resilience during economic crises requires leaders to think positively.
collocations.example_zh: 在经济危机期间保持韧性，要求领导者抱持积极乐观的心态去面对。

collocations.phrase: think poorly of / think ill of
collocations.meaning: 对...评价低/看轻/对...有成见
collocations.example_en: She feared that resigning so soon would make colleagues think poorly of her commitment.
collocations.example_zh: 她担心这么快辞职会让同事看轻她对工作的投入与责任心。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在…中布满（某类人）；使居住着
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The author peopled his fictional universe with quirky, memorable characters.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 作者在他的虚构世界中塑造了一群古怪而令人难忘的人物。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 由…所居住；充斥着，布满
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In the nineteenth century, the remote valley was peopled mainly by sheep farmers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在19世纪，这座偏僻的山谷主要居住着牧羊人。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （在公共场所）观察行人，看众生相
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I love sitting at sidewalk cafés on Sunday mornings just to people-watch.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我喜欢周日早晨坐在路边咖啡馆里，纯粹为了看街上来来往往的行人。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 迎合讨好他人，当老好人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She spent years people-pleasing until she realized she had completely lost herself.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她花了多年时间一味讨好他人，直到意识到自己已经完全迷失了自我。

idioms.meaning: 善于与人打交道的人，人缘好的人
idioms.example_en: Mark is an absolute people person, which makes him the ideal choice for head of human resources.
idioms.example_zh: 马克是个特别擅长与人打交道的人，这使他成为人力资源主管的理想人选。

idioms.phrase: a man / woman of the people
idioms.meaning: 贴近大众的人，平民领袖
idioms.example_en: Despite his immense wealth, the candidate campaigned as a man of the people.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管家财万贯，这位候选人仍以平民代表的形象开展竞选活动。

idioms.phrase: be all things to all people
idioms.meaning: 面面俱到，取悦所有人
idioms.example_en: A realistic politician knows that they cannot be all things to all people.
idioms.example_zh: 务实的政治家懂得自己不可能取悦所有人。

idioms.phrase: people who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones
idioms.meaning: 正人先正己；自己有短处就别挑别人毛病
idioms.example_en: You shouldn't criticize her punctuality when you are always late—people who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones.
idioms.example_zh: 你自己总是迟到，就别挑剔她不守时了——正人先正己。

idioms.meaning: 名流贵族，时尚富贵圈人士
idioms.example_en: The red-carpet gala attracted all the beautiful people of the fashion and film industries.
idioms.example_zh: 这场红毯晚会吸引了时尚圈和电影界的所有名流大腕。

idioms.meaning: 权力归于人民（常作抗议口号）
idioms.example_en: The demonstrators gathered outside the parliament chanting, 'Power to the people!'
idioms.example_zh: 示威者聚集在议会外高呼：“权力归于人民！”

collocations.meaning: 人际交往能力，人际沟通技巧
collocations.example_en: Strong people skills are just as crucial as technical expertise for modern project managers.
collocations.example_zh: 对现代项目经理而言，出色的人际沟通技巧与专业技能同样至关重要。

collocations.example_en: Rising energy prices are taking a heavy toll on ordinary people across the country.
collocations.example_zh: 不断上涨的能源价格给全国普通百姓带来了沉重的负担。

collocations.example_en: The legislation aims to protect the ancestral lands and linguistic heritage of indigenous people.
collocations.example_zh: 该法案旨在保护原住民的祖传土地和语言文化遗产。

collocations.example_en: International relief organizations are rushing clean water and tents to displaced people in the border region.
collocations.example_zh: 国际救援组织正紧急向边境地区的流离失所者运送饮用水和帐篷。

collocations.example_en: Music has a unique, transcendent power to bring people together regardless of their backgrounds.
collocations.example_zh: 音乐拥有一种独特的超然力量，能够跨越背景将人们凝聚在一起。

collocations.example_en: The government launched new community programs connecting young people with lonely elderly people.
collocations.example_zh: 政府启动了新的社区项目，让年轻人与孤独的老年人建立帮扶纽带。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为…送行；击败，战胜；驱赶，赶走
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We went to the airport to see our daughter off, while the home team managed to see off their rivals in extra time.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们去机场给女儿送行；与此同时，主队在加时赛中成功击退了对手。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 看穿，识破（骗局/伪装）；支持…渡过难关；将（某事）贯彻到底
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I saw through his smooth excuses instantly, but I still lent him enough money to see him through the week.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我一眼识破了他那套圆滑的托辞，但还是借给他足够的钱帮他撑过这周。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 处理，照料，负责办理
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't worry about booking the hotel rooms; I'll see to that personally this afternoon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 不用担心预订酒店房间的事，今天下午我亲自来办。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 务必做到，确保…发生
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please see to it that all laboratory doors are securely locked before you leave tonight.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 今晚离开前，请务必确保所有实验室的门都已锁好。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 着手安排，处理；查问，考虑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It is getting noisy in the hallway; I will go and see about having the doors adjusted.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 走廊里越来越吵了，我去安排一下把门调整修整好。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 送（客人）到大门口；度过，熬过（某段困难时期）；见证…结束
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The host saw his guests out to the gate, confident his supplies would see out the harsh winter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 主人将客人们送到大门口，他坚信储备物资足以支撑他们熬过严冬。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 领…进门，迎来；迎接（新年或新纪元）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The receptionist saw the delegation in, just as the crowd gathered at midnight to see in the new millennium.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 接待员领代表团进了屋，正如午夜时分人群聚集在一起迎接新千年的到来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 参观，游览，察看（建筑或景点）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The real estate agent allowed us an hour to see round the entire country estate.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 房产中介给了我们一个小时的时间全面参观这座乡村庄园。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 仔细视察，巡视，逐个察看（房屋、地产）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Before signing the long-term lease, they insisted on seeing over the entire warehouse facility.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在签署长期租赁合同之前，他们坚决要求仔细视察整座仓库设施。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 调查，看清，探察…的真相或内部情况
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The internal affairs division was summoned to see into the discrepancies in the company accounts.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 内审部门受命调查公司账目中出现的出入。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 护送…穿过（马路、河流等危险地带）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The traffic crossing guard made sure to see the blind pedestrian safely across the busy avenue.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 交通协管员确保将那位盲人行人安全护送到繁忙的大道对面。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 送（某人）返回（住处/某地）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It was late and pitch black, so David offered to see her back to her dormitory.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 天色已晚且一片漆黑，大卫便主动提出送她回宿舍。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 护送某人回家
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You shouldn't walk alone through the park at this hour; let me see you home.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这个点你一个人穿过公园不安全，让我送你回家吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 送（某人）下楼；护送离开楼上区域
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After our interview in the executive penthouse, the director's assistant saw us down to the lobby.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在顶层行政套房结束面谈后，主管助理把我们送下楼到了大厅。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 押送/驱逐出场，将…驱离场地
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Security guards quickly intervened to see the disruptive trespassers off the premises.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 保安迅速介入，将闹事的非法侵入者驱逐出了园区场地。

idioms.meaning: 意见一致，看法相同
idioms.example_en: Although they are business partners, they rarely see eye to eye on long-term strategy.
idioms.example_zh: 他们虽然是商业合伙人，但在长期战略上却极少达成共识。

idioms.meaning: 勃然大怒，火冒三丈
idioms.example_en: Whenever he hears people belittling his family's sacrifices, he sees red.
idioms.example_zh: 每当听到有人贬低他家庭做出的牺牲，他就会火冒三丈。

idioms.meaning: 恍然大悟，改邪归正；问世，公之于众
idioms.example_en: After years of making poor financial bets, he finally saw the light and began saving regularly.
idioms.example_zh: 在经历了多年的糟糕金融投机之后，他终于幡然醒悟，开始定期存钱。

idioms.meaning: 认为合适，自以为妥当
idioms.example_en: The editor saw fit to delete the most controversial paragraphs without consulting the author.
idioms.example_zh: 编辑在未征询作者意见的情况下，自行决定删除了最具争议的段落。

idioms.phrase: as far as the eye can see
idioms.meaning: 一望无际，极目所致
idioms.example_en: In the desert, shimmering golden dunes stretch out as far as the eye can see.
idioms.example_zh: 在沙漠中，金色的沙丘泛着波光，一望无际地延展向天边。

idioms.phrase: see sth coming a mile off
idioms.meaning: 早就看出来，料事如神，早就预见到
idioms.example_en: Their messy breakup was no surprise to anyone; our friends saw it coming a mile off.
idioms.example_zh: 他们难看的收场让大家都不感到意外，朋友们早就预见到了这一天。

idioms.meaning: 风光不再，破败衰落
idioms.example_en: This antique leather armchair has certainly seen better days, but it is still remarkably comfortable.
idioms.example_zh: 这把老式真皮扶手椅确实风光不再、略显破旧，但坐起来依然非常舒适。

idioms.meaning: 静观其变，拭目以待
idioms.example_en: We cannot predict how the market will respond to the interest rate hike; we will just have to wait and see.
idioms.example_zh: 我们无法预测市场会对加息做出何种反应，我们只能拭目以待、静观其变。

collocations.meaning: 明白意义所在，领会意图
collocations.example_en: I understand your technical explanation, but I still fail to see the point of changing the entire interface.
collocations.example_zh: 我听懂了你的技术解释，但我仍然没看出来彻底更换界面的意义何在。

collocations.meaning: 明白事理，接受劝告，服理
collocations.example_en: We argued with him for two hours before he finally saw reason and agreed to compromise.
collocations.example_zh: 我们劝了他两个小时，他才终于听劝并同意做出妥协。

collocations.example_en: If that persistent chest cough does not clear up by Friday, you must go see a doctor.
collocations.example_zh: 如果那顽固的咳嗽到周五还没好，你必须去医院看医生。

collocations.meaning: 看出幽默风趣之处，苦中作乐
collocations.example_en: Even when the tent collapsed during the rainstorm, Sarah managed to see the funny side of the disaster.
collocations.example_zh: 即便暴风雨中帐篷被吹塌了，萨拉依然能从中找到风趣可乐的一面。

collocations.example_en: The manager saw no harm in letting the team work from home on Friday afternoons.
collocations.example_zh: 经理觉得周五下午让团队在家办公无伤大雅。

collocations.example_en: Her grandfather saw active service as a navy officer in the Mediterranean during the war.
collocations.example_zh: 她祖父在战争期间作为海军军官在地中海服过现役并参加了战斗。

collocations.example_en: The hospital saw a marked improvement in patient recovery times following the procedural overhaul.
collocations.example_zh: 在该流程全面改革之后，医院见证了患者康复时间的显著缩短。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 锻炼健身；计算出；解决/弄清；事情进展顺利；最终导致某种结果
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I try to work out at the gym three times a week, and things usually work out for the best in the end.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我尽量每周去健身房锻炼三次，事情最终通常也都会圆满解决。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 致力于/从事；试图说服/影响某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He is currently working on a new novel, while his friends are working on him to join their trip.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他目前正致力于写一部新小说，而他的朋友们则在极力劝说他一起去旅行。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 激发/激起（情绪、食欲等）；逐步建立/发展；锻炼出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A brisk walk in the crisp morning air helped us work up a hearty appetite.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 清晨凉爽空气中的快步走帮我们激发出极好的食欲。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 克服/理清（复杂问题、负面情绪等）；逐步完成
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It took her several months of therapy to work through her grief and trauma.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她接受了几个月的心理治疗，才逐渐走出了悲伤和心理创伤。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 通过体力运动消除/发泄（精力、压力、怒气等）；以工作偿还（债务）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She went for a long run to work off the stress accumulated after a demanding day.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她去长跑了一大圈，以排解这令人精疲力竭的一天所积聚的压力。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把...挤进/安排进（紧张日程）；巧妙插入/融入（想法、材料）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The dentist is fully booked today, but the receptionist promised to work me in between appointments.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 牙医今天预约全满了，但前台答应在两个预约空隙中把我加塞插进去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为...努力；争取实现（特定目标）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Both nations pledged to work towards establishing a lasting peace treaty.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 两国均承诺为达成持久和平协议而共同努力。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 避开/绕过（困难、阻碍）；妥协解决
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We hit a technical bottleneck, but our engineers managed to find a clever way to work around it.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们遇到了技术瓶颈，但工程师们设法找到了一个巧妙的方法绕过了该问题。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 逐步上升/增加到；鼓足勇气做（难事）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Start with light weights and gradually work up to heavier loads to prevent muscle injury.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 先从轻重量开始，逐步增加到更大负荷，以防止肌肉拉伤。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将...揉合进/渗透入；巧妙使...进入（话语或状态）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She managed to work a subtle promotion of her product into the casual conversation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她巧妙地在闲聊中穿插进了对自家产品的委婉推介。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 不停地苦干；埋头工作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The carpenter worked away in his quiet workshop until late into the night.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 木匠在安静的工作室里一直埋头苦干到深夜。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 仔细审查/重新修改；（非正式）痛打/严讯逼供
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The editorial board thoroughly worked over the draft before approving its publication.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 编辑委员会在批准出版前对草稿进行了彻底的仔细润色与修改。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 努力改善/致力于某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Improving your spoken English requires you to work at it consistently every day.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 提高英语口语需要你日复一日持之以恒地去下功夫。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对...不利；与...相背离
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Lack of relevant work experience will inevitably work against fresh graduates in the job market.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 缺乏相关工作经验在就业市场上难免会对应届毕业生不利。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与...合作；处理/驾驭（现有材料或局限条件）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We have a very tight budget, so the design team has to work with what is currently available.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们的预算非常紧，所以设计团队必须利用手头现有的一切资源进行创作。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 反向推导；逆向追溯
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Determine your project launch date first and then work back to establish milestone deadlines.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 先确定项目发布日期，然后再倒推设定各个阶段的时间节点。

idioms.meaning: 创造奇迹；产生极佳效果
idioms.example_en: A cup of warm chamomile tea can work wonders when you are struggling with insomnia.
idioms.example_zh: 当你饱受失眠困扰时，一杯温热的洋甘菊茶能产生奇效。

idioms.meaning: 极其奏效；万试万灵
idioms.example_en: I applied his troubleshooting trick to my laptop, and it worked like a charm.
idioms.example_zh: 我把他排查故障的小窍门用在笔记本上，立刻灵验奏效了。

idioms.meaning: 面临艰巨任务；有硬仗要打
idioms.example_en: With a deadline only two days away, the audit team will certainly have their work cut out.
idioms.example_zh: 距离截止日期仅剩两天，审计团队肯定面临极其繁重的任务。

idioms.meaning: 日常工作的一部分；家常便饭
idioms.example_en: Rescuing frightened cats from tall trees is all in a day's work for local firefighters.
idioms.example_zh: 从高树上营救受惊的猫咪对于当地消防员来说只是家常便饭。

idioms.phrase: work one's fingers to the bone
idioms.meaning: 拼命苦干；辛劳累断筋骨
idioms.example_en: She worked her fingers to the bone for decades to send all her three children to college.
idioms.example_zh: 几十年来她辛劳苦干，终于供三个孩子全都念完了大学。

idioms.meaning: 极其勤勉地拼命工作
idioms.example_en: He worked like a dog for months to ensure the startup's successful initial public offering.
idioms.example_zh: 他拼命苦干了数月，确保了这家初创公司成功首次公开募股。

collocations.example_en: Employees were offered extra bonuses if they agreed to work overtime during the holiday season.
collocations.example_zh: 员工如果同意在节假日期间加班，将获得额外的奖金。

collocations.example_en: The modern tech firm allows its software engineers to work remotely from anywhere in the world.
collocations.example_zh: 这家现代科技公司允许其软件工程师在世界任何地方远程办公。

collocations.example_en: The hiring manager emphasized that the ideal candidate must be capable of working under extreme pressure.
collocations.example_zh: 招聘经理强调，理想的候选人必须能够在极端压力下胜任工作。

collocations.meaning: 把...投入使用；使...发挥效益
