collocations.example_en: He decided to put his savings to work by investing in diversified index funds.
collocations.example_zh: 他决定投资多元化指数基金，让自己的积蓄产生效益。

collocations.example_en: Without wasting any time, the repair crew set to work fixing the ruptured pipeline.
collocations.example_zh: 维修人员没有浪费任何时间，立即动手抢修破裂的管道。

collocations.example_en: She chose to work full-time after graduation to gain immediate professional experience.
collocations.example_zh: 毕业后她选择全职工作，以便立即获取专业从业经验。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用完；耗尽
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We have used up all the printer toner, so someone needs to reorder supplies right away.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们已经把打印机墨粉用光了，得有人立刻重新订购耗材。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 利用（证据、弱点等）来对付/打击某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Anything you confess during the interrogation may be used against you in court.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 审讯期间你招供的任何内容都可能在法庭上被用作对你不利的证据。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把...作为/用作...
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In emergencies, this public basement can be used as a temporary bomb shelter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在紧急情况下，这个公共地下室可用作临时防空避难所。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把...用于特定目的或用途
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What kind of cleaning solvent do you typically use for removing tough oil stains?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你通常用哪种清洁溶剂来去除顽固油渍？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在...中采用/使用（原料、技巧等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The fragrant herbs used in this traditional dish are harvested fresh every day.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这道传统名菜中所使用的香草都是每天新鲜采摘的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在...身上施加/使用（药物、技巧、手段）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Never use harsh chemical disinfectants directly on sensitive human skin.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 切勿将强效化学消毒剂直接使用在人体敏感皮肤上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将（资金、补助等）用于支付...
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The grant money must be strictly used towards laboratory equipment upgrades.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该笔资助款必须严格用于实验室设备的更新升级。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 过去常常（后接动词原形）；用以（表示用途或目的）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I used to walk along this river bank every evening when I lived here years ago.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 多年前我住在这里时，过去常在每天傍晚沿着这条河岸散步。

idioms.meaning: 急需/很想得到；来一个正合适
idioms.example_en: After five continuous hours of meetings, I could really use a strong cup of black coffee.
idioms.example_zh: 连续开了五个小时的会，我真想来一杯浓浓的黑咖啡。

idioms.meaning: 利用；使用
idioms.example_en: Students should make full use of the university library's comprehensive digital archives.
idioms.example_zh: 学生们应当充分利用大学图书馆丰富的数字化档案资源。

idioms.meaning: 物尽其用；使...发挥良好作用
idioms.example_en: She decided to put her multilingual skills to good use by volunteering as an international liaison.
idioms.example_zh: 她决定发挥自己的多语种优势，志愿担任国际联络员以物尽其才。

idioms.meaning: 毫无用处；无济于事
idioms.example_en: Arguing over who was at fault is of no use now that the project has been cancelled.
idioms.example_zh: 既然项目已经被取消，现在争论到底是谁的错也无济于事了。

idioms.meaning: 何必呢；有什么用（表示无奈或放弃）
idioms.example_en: What's the use of worrying constantly about things that are entirely beyond our control?
idioms.example_zh: 整天为那些完全超出我们掌控的事情担忧又有什么用呢？

idioms.meaning: 不需要；极度讨厌/看不惯某人或某事
idioms.example_en: Our straightforward manager has no use for hypocrites who flatter rather than deliver results.
idioms.example_zh: 我们直率的经理极为厌恶那些只会阿谀奉承而不做实事的人。

collocations.example_en: The new transit payment system will officially come into use early next month.
collocations.example_zh: 新的公交支付系统将于下月初正式投入使用。

collocations.example_en: Many archaic English idioms have gradually fallen out of common use over time.
collocations.example_zh: 许多古旧的英语习语随着时间的推移已逐渐不再被常用。

collocations.example_en: This rugged laptop is engineered specifically to withstand heavy use in harsh outdoor environments.
collocations.example_zh: 这款坚固型笔记本电脑专为承受恶劣户外环境中的高频使用而设计。

collocations.meaning: 一直在使用中；持续占用
collocations.example_en: The communal kitchen microwave is in constant use throughout the lunch rush hour.
collocations.example_zh: 在午餐高峰期间，公共厨房的微波炉一直处于被使用的状态。

collocations.example_en: The primary selling point of the new mobile operating system is its remarkable ease of use.
collocations.example_zh: 这款新手机操作系统的主要卖点在于其出色的易用性。

collocations.meaning: 谨慎行事；自行斟酌裁决
collocations.example_en: Airport security officers are advised to use discretion when dealing with anxious travelers.
collocations.example_zh: 建议机场安检人员在对待焦虑的旅客时酌情谨慎行事。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想要加入/参与某事；想进屋
phrasal_verbs.example_en: As soon as they saw how profitable the startup was, several investors wanted in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一看到这家初创公司利润如此丰厚，好几位投资人都想入伙。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想要退出/摆脱（协议、关系或困境）；想出去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After years of constant stress, she decided she wanted out of the corporate world.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在承受了多年的持续压力后，她决定脱离企业界。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 缺少/匮乏（多用于否定句 want for nothing 表示“应有尽有”）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The children were well cared for and wanted for nothing growing up.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 孩子们受到悉心照料，成长过程中衣食无忧、应有尽有。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想要要回（某物）；希望与某人复合
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He realized his mistake and desperately wanted his ex-girlfriend back.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他意识到自己的错误，极其渴望与前女友复合。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想下车；想退出（项目或任务）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The passenger rang the bell, indicating he wanted off at the next stop.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 乘客按了铃，表示他想在下一站下车。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 希望某人过来（家里或办公室）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The director wants you over in her office immediately to discuss the project.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 总监要你马上到她办公室去讨论这个项目。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想上楼；想被抱起来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The toddler raised his arms, showing he wanted up onto his mother's lap.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 刚学步的孩子举起双臂，示意想被抱到妈妈膝盖上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想下来；想下楼
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The little girl struggled in her high chair, signaling she wanted down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 小女孩在餐椅上挣扎，表示她想要下来。

idioms.meaning: 因缺少/缺乏…
idioms.example_en: The expedition failed not from lack of courage, but for want of proper supplies.
idioms.example_zh: 探险队的失败并非因为缺乏勇气，而是因为缺少充足的物资。

idioms.meaning: 坚决不想参与某事；不愿与…有任何瓜葛
idioms.example_en: He made it clear that he wanted no part of their dishonest scheme.
idioms.example_zh: 他明确表示，绝不想卷入他们不光彩的阴谋中。

idioms.phrase: you don't want to do that
idioms.meaning: （委婉的劝告或警告）你最好别那样做
idioms.example_en: You don't want to open that email attachment; it looks suspicious.
idioms.example_zh: 你最好别打开那个邮件附件，它看起来很可疑。

idioms.meaning: 想要两全其美；既要…又要…（多指妄图兼得不可兼得之物）
idioms.example_en: You can't have flexible hours and a rigid corporate salary; you can't want it both ways.
idioms.example_zh: 你不可能既要弹性工时又要体制内死工资，世上哪有两全其美的事。

idioms.phrase: what do you want from me?
idioms.meaning: （表示挫败或无奈）你究竟想让我怎样？
idioms.example_en: I've already apologized twice; what do you want from me?
idioms.example_zh: 我已经道过两次歉了，你到底还想让我怎样？

idioms.meaning: 找不到合适的词句表达（多作 not want for words 伶牙俐齿/从不词穷）
idioms.example_en: She was so overwhelmed with gratitude that for once she wanted for words.
idioms.example_zh: 她感激涕零，破天荒地一时语塞、找不出合适的话来。

collocations.example_en: She wanted the promotion desperately after years of dedication.
collocations.example_zh: 奉献了这么多年，她极度渴望得到这次晋升。

collocations.phrase: want nothing to do with sb/sth
collocations.meaning: 不想与某人/某事发生任何牵扯
collocations.example_en: Ever since the argument, he wants nothing to do with his former partners.
collocations.example_zh: 自从那次争吵后，他就不想和过去的合伙人有任何瓜葛了。

collocations.meaning: 要求给出解释/寻求真相与答案
collocations.example_en: The victims' families are demanding justice and want answers from officials.
collocations.example_zh: 受害者家属要求伸张正义，并要求官方给出确切说法。

collocations.meaning: 寻求释怀；想要一个彻底的了结
collocations.example_en: Meeting her ex-husband one last time helped her find the closure she wanted.
collocations.example_zh: 最后见前夫一面，帮助她获得了梦寐以求的心灵释怀。

collocations.phrase: want nothing more than to do sth
collocations.example_en: After a grueling shift, he wanted nothing more than to sleep undisturbed.
collocations.example_zh: 在高强度值班结束后，他别无所求，只想安安静静睡一觉。

collocations.example_en: We can rearrange the furniture however you want.
collocations.example_zh: 我们可以完全按照你的想法重新摆放家具。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 偶然碰见/发现；给人…的印象；被理解
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He came across some old family letters while cleaning the attic, and they came across as very touching.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在打扫阁楼时偶然发现了一些旧家书，这些信件读来令人深感触动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 进展/好转；跟随一起来；出现/到来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Your English is coming along nicely, so come along with us to the international conference.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你的英语进步很大，跟我们一起去参加国际会议吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 破碎/解体；散架；崩溃
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The antique book began to come apart in my hands as I turned the fragile pages.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当我翻动脆弱的书页时，那本古书开始在我手中散架。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 改变看法/妥协；苏醒；顺道拜访；（定期事件）再次来临
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Give him time and he will come around to our proposal once he calms down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 给他点时间，等他冷静下来就会转而赞同我们的提议。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回来/归来；重新流行/卷土重来；重拾记忆；反驳
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Vinyl records have really come back in popularity among young listeners.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 黑胶唱片在年轻听众中确实又重新流行起来了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 设法获得/搞到；顺道串门/拜访
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Jobs this rewarding are extremely hard to come by in today's market.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在当今市场上，如此有回报的工作极其难得。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 下降/跌落；（雨/雪）倾盆而下；流传；决定/裁决
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Property prices are expected to come down slightly later this year.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 预计今年晚些时候房地产价格会略有下降。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 实质上在于；归结为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In the end, success comes down to consistent discipline and relentless focus.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 归根结底，成功取决于持续的自律和不懈的专注。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 染上/患上（非致命疾病，如感冒）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I think I'm coming down with the flu because my throat is sore.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我觉得我可能感冒了，因为嗓子很痛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 挺身而出；主动自荐/提供帮助或证词
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Police have appealed for witnesses to come forward with any relevant information.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警方呼吁目击者挺身而出，提供任何相关线索。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 出生于/来自；由…引起/根源于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His fierce competitiveness comes from growing up with four athletic brothers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他强烈的求胜心源于从小与四个擅长体育的兄弟一起成长。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 进来/到达；上市/开始供应；获得（名次）；起作用/派上用场
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The runners came in first and second, while fresh supplies will come in tomorrow.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这两名跑者分获冠亚军，而新的补给品将于明天到货。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 继承（财产/头衔）；开始具备/卷入
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She came into a substantial inheritance after her grandfather passed away.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 祖父去世后，她继承了一大笔遗产。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 脱落/脱开；奏效/成功举办；表现得…
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The risky marketing strategy actually came off and doubled their sales.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那个冒险的营销策略竟然成功了，使他们的销售额翻了一番。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 快点/加油；（疾病/天气等）悄然袭来；（灯光/装置）开启；进展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Come on, we have to hurry before the rain starts to come on heavily.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 快点，我们得在大雨倾盆之前赶过去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 出版/发行；（秘密/真相）暴露；结果是；（花朵）绽放
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her latest novel is scheduled to come out next month, and the truth will finally come out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她的最新小说定于下个月上市，真相也终将大白于天下。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顺便拜访；（情绪/感觉）突然袭来；给人…的感受
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A sudden wave of exhaustion came over him as he finished the presentation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 做完报告后，一股突如其来的疲倦感席卷了他全身。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 安然度过（困境/病痛）；兑现承诺；（官方信息/款项）传达/获批
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The bank loan finally came through, helping the team come through the crisis.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 银行贷款终于批下来了，帮助团队顺利度过了危机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 苏醒过来；总计为；谈及/涉及
phrasal_verbs.example_en: When the boxer finally came to, the restaurant bill had already come to fifty dollars.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当那个拳击手终于苏醒过来时，餐厅账单总额已经达到了五十美元。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 被提及/讨论；意外发生；升起/走近
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The topic of salary increases came up during the meeting, but an urgent issue came up shortly after.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 会议期间提到了涨薪的话题，但紧接着突发了一件紧急事件。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想出/提出（计划、主意）；筹措/拿出（资金）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Engineers must come up with an innovative solution to reduce carbon emissions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工程师们必须构想出一种创新的解决方案来减少碳排放。

idioms.meaning: 逐渐接受/妥协/面对（严酷的现实）
idioms.example_en: It took him years to come to terms with the end of his athletic career.
idioms.example_zh: 他花了好几年时间才坦然接受自己运动生涯的结束。

idioms.meaning: 坦白交代；全盘招供
idioms.example_en: The accountant decided to come clean about the irregular financial entries.
idioms.example_zh: 会计决定全盘坦白那些违规的财务账目。

idioms.meaning: 派上用场；很有用
idioms.example_en: Keep this pocketknife with you; you never know when it might come in handy.
idioms.example_zh: 随身带上这把折叠刀，说不定什么时候就能派上大用场。

idioms.meaning: 兜了一圈回到原点；重回起点
idioms.example_en: His career came full circle when he returned to teach at the high school he once attended.
idioms.example_zh: 当他回到曾经就读的高中任教时，他的职业生涯仿佛兜了个圈又回到了原点。

idioms.meaning: 成年；走向成熟/达到鼎盛期
idioms.example_en: Artificial intelligence has truly come of age over the past few years.
idioms.example_zh: 在过去的几年里，人工智能技术已真正走向成熟阶段。

idioms.meaning: 遭受猛烈批评/抨击
idioms.example_en: The company came under fire for failing to protect user privacy.
idioms.example_zh: 该公司因未能保护用户隐私而遭到了口诛笔伐。

idioms.meaning: 无论发生什么；不管怎样
idioms.example_en: I will stand by your side and support your choice, come what may.
idioms.example_zh: 无论发生什么，我都将站在你身边支持你的选择。

collocations.example_en: The golden era of cheap energy has finally come to an end.
collocations.example_zh: 廉价能源的黄金时代终于落下了帷幕。

collocations.example_en: New evidence came to light during the secondary investigation.
collocations.example_zh: 在二次调查过程中，新的证据浮出了水面。

collocations.example_en: The strict environmental regulations will come into effect starting next January.
collocations.example_zh: 严格的环保法规将于明年一月起正式生效实施。

collocations.example_en: Production came to a complete halt due to a widespread power outage.
collocations.example_zh: 由于大范围停电，生产陷入了彻底停滞状态。

collocations.example_en: Her abrupt resignation came as a massive surprise to everyone on the board.
collocations.example_zh: 她的突然辞职让董事会里的每一个人都深感震惊与意外。

collocations.example_en: After evaluating all data, researchers came to the conclusion that the hypothesis was sound.
collocations.example_zh: 在评估所有数据后，研究人员得出了该假说完全成立的结论。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （通过言辞或行动）意指；以此表达……意思
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What exactly do you mean by that remark?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你那句话究竟是什么意思？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打算给……使用；预定使……成为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: This parcel was clearly meant for the previous tenant.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这个包裹显然原本是寄给上一位租客的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打算做；故意去做
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'm sorry I spilled coffee on your notes; I didn't mean to do it.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 对不起把咖啡洒在你的笔记上了，我不是故意的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 注定要属于；天生适合于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They get along so naturally that everyone thinks they were meant for each other.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们相处得极为合拍，人人都觉得他们天生是一对。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 照理应当；本意旨在；被期望
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The meeting was meant to start at nine, but the chair was delayed.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 会议原定于九点开始，但主持人被耽搁了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 当作……来意指；本意是作为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: My constructive comments were meant as helpful advice, not harsh criticism.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我那些建设性的意见本意是提供有益建议，而不是严厉批评。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对……有重要意义；对……很有价值
phrasal_verbs.example_en: This antique watch belonged to my grandfather, so it means a lot to me.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这块古董表属于我祖父，因此它对我意义重大。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对……毫无价值；对……毫无吸引力或意义
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Fame and empty compliments mean nothing to him compared to real integrity.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 比起真正的正直，虚名与奉承对他而言毫无意义。

idioms.meaning: 态度严肃认真；动真格的，绝非儿戏
idioms.example_en: When the CEO canceled the weekend off, we knew she meant business.
idioms.example_zh: 当首席执行官取消了周末休假时，我们知道她是动真格的了。

idioms.meaning: 我是认真的；我绝不开玩笑
idioms.example_en: Stop tracking mud across the clean carpet right now—I mean it!
idioms.example_zh: 立刻别把泥巴踩在干净的地毯上了——我是认真的！

idioms.meaning: 对某人来说至关重要；是某人的全部
idioms.example_en: Her children mean the absolute world to her.
idioms.example_zh: 她的孩子们对她来说就是全世界。

idioms.meaning: 理解某人的想法；明白某人的意思
idioms.example_en: Now that you point out the flaw in the layout, I see what you mean.
idioms.example_zh: 既然你指出了版面上的缺陷，我明白你的意思了。

idioms.meaning: 绝无冒犯之意；无心之失
idioms.example_en: No offense meant, but your calculations don't quite add up.
idioms.example_zh: 无意冒犯，但你的计算结果似乎有些不对劲。

idioms.meaning: 你懂我意思吧（口语中用于寻求对方认同或共鸣）
idioms.example_en: It's just exhausting dealing with bureaucracy all day, you know what I mean?
idioms.example_zh: 整天应付官僚程序真让人筋疲力尽，你懂我意思吧？

collocations.example_en: Don't be angry with your mother; she meant well when she tidied your desk.
collocations.example_zh: 别生你母亲的气，她收拾你的书桌完全是出于一片好意。

collocations.meaning: 预示着麻烦；意味着惹上祸事
collocations.example_en: Those dark gathering storm clouds mean trouble for our sailing trip.
collocations.example_zh: 那些聚积的乌云意味着我们的航行要遇到大麻烦了。

collocations.example_en: The barking dog sounds terrifying, but he doesn't mean any harm.
collocations.example_zh: 那只狗叫起来声音吓人，但它并无恶意。

collocations.meaning: 说话算数；言出必行；说的是真心话
collocations.example_en: If he promised to back your project, you can trust that he means what he says.
collocations.example_zh: 如果他答应支持你的项目，你可以相信他绝对说到做到。

collocations.meaning: 字字发自肺腑；完全是由衷之言
collocations.example_en: I thanked them profusely for their hospitality, and I meant every word.
collocations.example_zh: 我对他们的热情款待连连致谢，且字字句句发自肺腑。

collocations.example_en: Having the support of her family meant everything to the young athlete.
collocations.example_zh: 得到家人的全力支持，对这位年轻的运动员而言意味着一切。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 帮忙；协助某人解决困难或分担劳动
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Could you help out with the inventory count this Friday afternoon?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这周五下午你能帮忙协助盘点库存吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 给某人夹（菜）/盛（饭）；招待某人取用食物
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The host warmly helped the guests to more roasted lamb and wine.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 主人热情地给客人们添了烤羊肉和葡萄酒。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 搀扶起；扶起（摔倒的人）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A kind passerby immediately helped up the cyclist after the skid.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在自行车滑倒后，一位热心的路人立刻将骑车人扶了起来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 帮某人脱去（厚衣服、大衣等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The butler politely helped the visitor off with his drenched overcoat.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 管家彬彬有礼地帮访客脱下了湿漉漉的大衣。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 帮某人穿上（大衣、夹克等外套）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He gallantly helped his grandmother on with her warm winter jacket.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他体贴地帮祖母穿上了温暖的冬装夹克。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 搀扶某人下来（如从梯子、车厢、台阶等高处）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The instructor reached out to help the child down from the climbing wall.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教练伸出手把孩子从攀岩墙上搀扶了下来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 搀扶或引导某人进入（车辆、轮椅、房间等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The paramedic helped the injured driver into the waiting ambulance.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 医护人员搀扶着受伤的司机坐进了一旁待命的救护车。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 扶某人离开/走出（车厢、困境等）；帮某人脱下（衣物）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She helped the elderly lady out of the taxi and onto the pavement.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她扶着老太太走出出租车，来到人行道上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 推动；促进（进展、恢复等）；扶持前行
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A generous research grant helped along the development of the vaccine.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一笔丰厚的研究拨款有力地推进了该疫苗的研发进程。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 推动，促进（事业、计划或运动）向前发展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her innovative suggestions greatly helped forward the environmental campaign.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她的创新建议极大地推动了这项环保运动的发展。

idioms.meaning: 忍不住；禁不住（做某事）
idioms.example_en: I couldn't help laughing when the puppy chased its own tail in circles.
idioms.example_zh: 当看到小狗绕着圈追自己的尾巴时，我忍不住笑出了声。

idioms.meaning: 不得不；只能（做某事）
idioms.example_en: Listening to his tragic story, we could not help but sympathize with him.
idioms.example_zh: 听完他悲惨的遭遇，我们禁不住深表同情。

idioms.meaning: 请自便；请随意取用（食物、饮品或物品）
idioms.example_en: There's fresh coffee and warm bagels on the counter, so please help yourself.
idioms.example_zh: 吧台上备有新鲜咖啡和热百吉饼，请各位随意享用。

idioms.phrase: not if I can help it
idioms.meaning: 只要我能阻止，就绝不让它发生；绝不答应
idioms.example_en: They won't shut down the neighborhood library—not if I can help it.
idioms.example_zh: 他们休想关掉社区图书馆——只要我能阻止，就绝不答应。

idioms.meaning: 聚沙成塔；微小的努力也能发挥作用
idioms.example_en: Even donating a single dollar helps the shelter, because every little helps.
idioms.example_zh: 即使只向收容所捐赠一美元也有所助益，因为聚沙成塔，滴水成河。

idioms.meaning: 向上帝发誓，绝无虚言；（口语中用于表气愤或发誓）我保证
idioms.example_en: I will tell the whole truth in court tomorrow, so help me God.
idioms.example_zh: 明天在法庭上我将陈述全部实情，向上帝发誓绝无虚言。

collocations.example_en: It is a sign of strength, not weakness, to seek professional help for mental health.
collocations.example_zh: 为心理健康寻求专业帮助是坚强的表现，而非软弱。

collocations.meaning: 主动提供协助；施以援手
collocations.example_en: Several local volunteers arrived promptly to offer help after the flash flood.
collocations.example_zh: 山洪暴发后，几名当地志愿者迅速赶来提供援助。

collocations.meaning: 请求援助；开口求人帮忙
collocations.example_en: Don't hesitate to ask for help if you run into difficulties with the assignment.
collocations.example_zh: 如果你在作业中遇到困难，请毫不犹豫地寻求帮助。

collocations.example_en: Your prompt feedback on the draft helped a great deal in refining our proposal.
collocations.example_zh: 你对草案的及时反馈对我们完善方案起到了极大的帮助。

collocations.example_en: She took a part-time job on campus to help pay for her tuition and textbooks.
collocations.example_zh: 她在校内找了一份兼职，以协助支付学费和书本费。

collocations.meaning: 大声呼救；（引申）极度迫切需要救助
collocations.example_en: The dilapidated rural clinic is crying out for help and modern equipment.
collocations.example_zh: 这家破旧的乡村诊所急需援助与现代化设备。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 试穿（衣服、鞋帽）；试探，耍花招（尤指试探底线或反应）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You should try on the jacket before buying it to make sure it fits.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 买这件夹克之前你最好先试穿一下，确保合身。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 试验，试用（新机器、方法）；参加选拔，参加选拔赛
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The lab is trying out a brand new method to increase solar panel efficiency.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该实验室正在测试一种提高太阳能电池板效率的全新方法。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 参加…的选拔，试镜（以获得角色或进入团队）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Over a hundred students turned up to try out for the school play.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 有一百多名学生前来参加校戏剧表演的角色试镜。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 谋求，争取获得；试图达到（某个目标或职位）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She decided to try for a scholarship at Cambridge University.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她决定争取剑桥大学的奖学金。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 故意试探底线；企图蒙骗某人；向某人调情搭讪
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't let the contractor overcharge you; he's just trying it on.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别让承包商多收你的钱，他只是在试探你的底线。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （电话中）稍后再打，过会儿再试
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The manager is currently in a meeting; could you try back in an hour?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经理现在正在开会，您能过一个小时再打来吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在某人身上试验；向某人试探征求对某想法的意见
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'd like to try my presentation out on you before tomorrow's conference.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在明天的会议之前，我想先把我的演示文稿在你身上试讲一下。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 试穿以检验大小；体验，权衡考虑（某个新方案或想法）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Here's an alternative proposal for you to try on for size.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这里有一个备选方案，供你权衡考量一下。

idioms.meaning: 初试身手，尝试做某事
idioms.example_en: After retiring from teaching, he decided to try his hand at pottery.
idioms.example_zh: 从教师岗位退休后，他决定初试身手学做陶艺。

idioms.meaning: 考验某人的耐心，使人忍无可忍
idioms.example_en: The child's constant whining was beginning to try the mother's patience.
idioms.example_zh: 孩子持续不断的哭闹开始挑战这位母亲的耐心极限。

idioms.meaning: 碰运气，撞大运
idioms.example_en: He went to Hollywood to try his luck as an actor.
idioms.example_zh: 他前往好莱坞碰碰运气，想当一名演员。

idioms.meaning: 无论怎样努力，尽管竭尽全力
idioms.example_en: Try as he might, he simply couldn't open the jammed safe.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管他竭尽全力，却无论如何也打不开卡住的保险箱。

idioms.meaning: 尝试一下，试一试某事物
idioms.example_en: If you've never eaten sushi before, you really ought to give it a try.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你以前从没吃过寿司，真应该尝试一下。

idioms.phrase: don't try to run before you can walk
idioms.meaning: 不要未学走先学跑，做事要循序渐进
idioms.example_en: Master the basic chords first; don't try to run before you can walk.
idioms.example_zh: 先把基础和弦练扎实，别还没学会走就想跑。

idioms.phrase: try every trick in the book
idioms.meaning: 使出浑身解数，千方百计
idioms.example_en: The defense attorney tried every trick in the book to clear his client.
idioms.example_zh: 辩护律师使出了浑身解数，试图为他的委托人洗脱罪名。

collocations.example_en: We must try our utmost to reduce carbon emissions across all sectors.
collocations.example_zh: 我们必须竭尽全力削减各领域的碳排放。

collocations.example_en: The paramedics tried in vain to revive the unconscious driver.
collocations.example_zh: 急救人员徒劳地尝试唤醒那名失去知觉的司机。

collocations.example_en: The judge will try the high-profile fraud case next Monday.
collocations.example_zh: 法官将于下周一审理这起备受瞩目的诈骗案。

collocations.example_en: Since traditional advertising failed, the company tried a new approach using influencer marketing.
collocations.example_zh: 由于传统广告收效甚微，公司尝试了一种利用网红营销的新策略。

collocations.example_en: Trapped climbers tried desperately to stay warm through the blizzard.
collocations.example_zh: 被困的登山者拼命挣扎着在暴风雪中保持体温。

collocations.meaning: 惹某人发火，考验某人的脾气
collocations.example_en: Dealing with rude customers every day will certainly try anyone's temper.
collocations.example_zh: 每天跟粗鲁的顾客打交道绝对会考验任何人的脾气。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 放下工具，罢工；停工
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Factory workers decided to down tools over the unpaid overtime dispute.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工人们因无薪加班纠纷决定放下工具举行罢工。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 一口气喝光，一饮而尽
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The crowd cheered as he downed his pint of beer in one.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当他一口气喝光那品脱啤酒时，人群爆发出一阵欢呼。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 就着（水或液体）吞咽/服下某物
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She downed the bitter pill with a big gulp of orange juice.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她就着一大口橙汁咽下了那粒苦药片。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （体育比赛或战斗中）击倒对手，击败竞争者
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The boxer downed his opponent with a lethal left hook in the third round.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 拳击手在第三回合以一记致命的左勾拳击倒了对手。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 击落飞机/飞行器
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Anti-aircraft missiles downed two enemy fighter jets near the border.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 防空导弹在边境附近击落了敌方的两架战斗机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 仰头干掉一杯酒/烈酒
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He quickly downed a shot of tequila to calm his nerves before going onstage.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在登台前迅速干了一杯龙舌兰酒来平复紧张的情绪。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （美式橄榄球）触地停球，持球触地以使死球
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The receiver caught the kick in the end zone and wisely chose to down the ball.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 接球手在端区接住来球，明智地选择触地停球。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 患上（疾病）；（因病）卧床不起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Half the office staff is currently down with seasonal flu.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 办公室有一半员工目前都患上季节性流感而病倒了。

idioms.meaning: 倒霉，走霉运，处于窘境
idioms.example_en: The charity provides hot meals and shelter to people down on their luck.
idioms.example_zh: 该慈善机构为落魄落难的人们提供热饭和庇护所。

idioms.meaning: 心情低落，郁郁寡欢
idioms.example_en: Ever since he failed the driving test, he has been feeling down in the dumps.
idioms.example_zh: 自从驾考不及格以来，他就一直闷闷不乐。

idioms.meaning: 直到最后一刻，悬念留到最后
idioms.example_en: The presidential election was extremely close and went right down to the wire.
idioms.example_zh: 这场总统选举竞争极其激烈，悬念一直保留到了最后一刻。

idioms.meaning: 付诸东流，全盘泡汤，化为乌有
idioms.example_en: All our months of hard preparation went down the drain when the event was canceled.
idioms.example_zh: 活动取消后，我们数月以来的辛勤准备全都付诸东流了。

idioms.meaning: 脚踏实地，平易近人，实事求是
idioms.example_en: Despite her international fame, the actress remains incredibly down to earth.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管享誉国际，这位女演员依然极其平易近人、脚踏实地。

idioms.meaning: 在未来某个时刻；彻底，全盘
idioms.example_en: If we cut corners now, it will cause serious maintenance issues down the line.
idioms.example_zh: 如果我们现在偷工减料，将来一定会引发严重的维护问题。

idioms.meaning: 穷困潦倒，走投无路，无家可归
idioms.example_en: A sudden bankruptcy left the former entrepreneur completely down and out.
idioms.example_zh: 突如其来的破产让这位昔日的女企业家彻底陷入了穷困潦倒的境地。

collocations.example_en: After a grueling shift at the warehouse, he headed to the pub to down a cold pint.
collocations.example_zh: 在仓库完成了繁重的轮班后，他前往酒吧痛饮了一大杯冰啤酒。

collocations.example_en: Metro operators threatened to down tools in protest against unsafe working conditions.
collocations.example_zh: 地铁运营人员威胁将通过停工罢工来抗议不安全的工作环境。

collocations.example_en: The military confirmed that their air defense system had downed a fighter jet.
collocations.example_zh: 军方证实其防空系统击落了一架战斗机。

collocations.meaning: 因疾病/高烧而卧床不起
collocations.example_en: The star striker was downed by a severe fever and missed the championship final.
collocations.example_zh: 这名主力前锋因突发高烧卧床不起，错过了总决赛。

collocations.example_en: She downed the prescribed allergy pill with a glass of warm water.
collocations.example_zh: 她就着一杯温水吞下了医生开的抗过敏药丸。

collocations.phrase: down an opponent in the first round
collocations.example_en: The reigning champion stunned the arena by downing his opponent in the first round.
collocations.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在第一回合就击倒了对手，震惊了全场观众。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 坦白；认错；爽快承认（过失或错误）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: No one would own up to breaking the window until the teacher threatened to keep the whole class after school.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 直到老师威胁要全班放学后留堂，才有人坦白打碎了窗户。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 供认，公开承认（罪行、过失或不良行为）；勇于承担（责任）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He had the courage to own up to his mistakes and apologize directly to the team.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他有勇气承认自己的错误，并直接向团队道了歉。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （正式）承认，认可；公开表白（某种情感或事实）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She owned to a feeling of deep apprehension before walking onto the stage.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在走上舞台之前，她坦承自己内心感到极度忧虑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （口语/网络俚语）彻底击垮某人；在竞争、辩论或游戏中完全压制/完胜某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The veteran lawyer completely owned the opposition during cross-examination.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那位资深律师在交叉质询中彻底碾压了对手。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 归……所有；受……完全控制或操纵
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The independent publisher was eventually owned by a multinational media conglomerate.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家独立出版机构最终被一家跨国传媒集团控股。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 完全拥有（某房产、车辆等）；全款持有（无抵押或负债）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After twenty years of hard work, they finally own their home outright.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经过二十年的辛勤打拼，他们终于全款还清房贷，彻底拥有了自己的房子。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与他人共同所有；合伙持有（产权、股权等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The property is owned jointly by the three siblings.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这处房产由三兄妹共同所有。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 无留置权地全权拥有；无任何债务纠纷地持有（资产）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She paid off the final installment and now owns the vehicle free and clear.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她还清了最后一笔分期付款，现在完全无抵押地拥有了这辆车。

idioms.meaning: 充分展现才能；得到应有的地位和承认；大显身手
idioms.example_en: She really came into her own once she was promoted to head of research.
idioms.example_zh: 一旦被提升为研发主管，她便真正开始大显身手。

idioms.meaning: 坚守阵地；不落下风，表现得毫不逊色；（病人）情况未恶化
idioms.example_en: Despite her lack of experience, she held her own in the debate against seasoned politicians.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管缺乏经验，她在与老练政客的辩论中依然不落下风。

idioms.meaning: 独自一人；自食其力，独立自主地；全凭自己
idioms.example_en: She has lived on her own since she graduated from university at twenty-two.
idioms.example_zh: 她从二十二岁大学毕业起就一直一个人独立生活。

idioms.phrase: have a mind of one's own
idioms.meaning: 极有主见，不随波逐流；（机器、物体等）不听使唤，自顾自运转
idioms.example_en: You won't convince him easily; he definitely has a mind of his own.
idioms.example_zh: 你很难说服他；他是个极有主见的人。

idioms.phrase: in a league of one's own
idioms.meaning: 独步天下，独树一帜；无与伦比，无可比拟
idioms.example_en: When it comes to violin technique, the young prodigy is in a league of his own.
idioms.example_zh: 谈到小提琴演奏技法，这位年轻的神童可谓独步天下。

idioms.phrase: stand on one's own two feet
idioms.meaning: 独立自主；自立自强，不依赖他人
idioms.example_en: It is time for him to stop relying on his parents' money and stand on his own two feet.
idioms.example_zh: 他该停止依赖父母的资助、学着自立自强了。

idioms.phrase: take the law into one's own hands
idioms.meaning: 公然违法擅自解决；私设公堂，私自以暴力执法
idioms.example_en: Frustrated by police inaction, the villagers decided to take the law into their own hands.
idioms.example_zh: 由于对警方的无所作为感到愤怒，村民们决定擅自采取私刑。

collocations.example_en: The investment firm owns a significant stake in the renewable energy startup.
collocations.example_zh: 这家投资公司在这家可再生能源初创企业中持有可观的股份。

collocations.example_en: The local agency is a wholly owned subsidiary of a global corporation.
collocations.example_zh: 这家本地机构是一家跨国公司的全资子公司。

collocations.meaning: 拥有……的版权/专有经营权
collocations.example_en: The studio owns the exclusive rights to the best-selling novel.
collocations.example_zh: 该电影制片厂拥有这部畅销小说的独家改编版权。

collocations.meaning: 正视并坦然面对……的事实；大方承认
collocations.example_en: You need to own the fact that your behavior hurt the people around you.
collocations.example_zh: 你必须正视并承认你的行为伤害了身边人的事实。

collocations.meaning: 私有的 / 公有的（国有或上市公司所有的）
collocations.example_en: The country is moving toward privatizing several major state-owned enterprises.
collocations.example_zh: 该国正逐步推进对数家主要国有企业的私有化进程。

collocations.meaning: 置业；购置并拥有房产/不动产
collocations.example_en: Rising interest rates have made it harder for young adults to own property.
collocations.example_zh: 利率上升使年轻人购置房产变得更加困难。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 坚持到底，撑过去；（储备、食物、钱财等）足够支撑到……结束
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We only have enough drinking water to last out for two more days.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们的饮用水储备仅够再支撑两天。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 熬过，挺过（艰难的时期、冬天、风暴等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Many small businesses struggled to last through the prolonged economic downturn.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 许多小企业在长期的经济低迷中苦苦支撑以求渡过难关。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （钱款、物品等）足够某人用/维持（某段时间）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A single tank of gas will last her for nearly two full weeks of commuting.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 加满一箱油足够支撑她近两周的通勤日常。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 持续达（某段具体时间）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The negotiations lasted for over twelve hours without reaching a consensus.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 谈判持续了十二个多小时，仍未达成共识。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 一直延续/维持到（某个时间点）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The warm weather is expected to last until the end of next week.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 预计温暖的天气将一直持续到下周末。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 延续进入（下一个季节、世纪、时代或阶段）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The drought that began in early spring lasted well into the late autumn.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那场始于早春的旱情一直延续到了深秋。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 延续超过（预期期限、寿命或正常时限）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His profound artistic influence lasted far beyond his untimely death.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他深远的艺术影响力在他英年早逝之后依然久久不衰。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 咬牙熬完（任期、考验等）；活着度过
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Doubting his health, critics questioned whether the prime minister could last the winter out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 因担忧其健康状况，批评人士质疑首相能否挺过这个冬天。

idioms.meaning: 终于，最终；历经波折后终于
idioms.example_en: After months of grueling delays, the new bridge was opened to traffic at long last.
idioms.example_zh: 经过数月令人疲惫的延误后，新大桥终于通车了。

idioms.meaning: 压死骆驼的最后一根稻草；忍无可忍的最后一击
idioms.example_en: When he lied about his finances again, it proved to be the last straw for her.
idioms.example_zh: 当他再次对自己的财务状况撒谎时，彻底成了压垮她耐心的最后一根稻草。

idioms.meaning: 笑到最后；最终取得胜利（让曾经嘲笑者哑口无言）
idioms.example_en: They ridiculed his startup idea at first, but he had the last laugh when it went public.
idioms.example_zh: 起初他们嘲笑他的创业构想，但在公司上市后，他笑到了最后。

idioms.meaning: 最后但同样重要的
idioms.example_en: And last but not least, I want to thank my family for their unwavering support.
idioms.example_zh: 最后但同样重要的一点是，我要感谢家人坚定不移的支持。

idioms.meaning: 直到最后一刻；坚持到底；至死
idioms.example_en: The old soldier remained fiercely loyal to his comrades to the last.
idioms.example_zh: 这位老兵直到生命的最后一刻，依然对战友怀着无比深厚的忠诚。

idioms.phrase: be the last person / thing to do sth
idioms.meaning: 最不可能做某事的人/物；最不情愿做某事的人/物
idioms.example_en: She is the last person I would expect to gossip about a colleague.
idioms.example_zh: 她是那类我最不可能料到会说同事闲话的人。

idioms.meaning: （幽默讽刺）自满的大话；言之过早的自信断言
idioms.example_en: 'Don't worry, this project will only take an hour.' — Famous last words!
idioms.example_zh: “别担心，这个项目只要一小时搞定。”——真是典型的大话！

collocations.meaning: 经久耐用；做工扎实，结构结实
collocations.example_en: These vintage mechanical watches were truly built to last for generations.
collocations.example_zh: 这些老式机械表确实做工扎实，经久耐用，能代代相传。

collocations.example_en: The lessons learned during those formative years will last a lifetime.
collocations.example_zh: 在那些成长岁月中所汲取的教训将让人受益终生。

collocations.meaning: 跑完全程；坚持到底，经受住长久考验
collocations.example_en: Analysts wonder whether the fragile coalition can last the distance until the next election.
collocations.example_zh: 分析人士怀疑这个脆弱的执政联盟能否撑到下次大选。

collocations.meaning: 维持不了多久；短暂易逝
collocations.example_en: Given their constant bickering, the partnership probably won't last long.
collocations.example_zh: 鉴于他们频繁争执，这段合作关系恐怕维持不了多久。

collocations.meaning: 万不得已的手段；最后的救命稻草
collocations.example_en: Military intervention should always be considered only as a last resort.
collocations.example_zh: 军事干预应始终仅作为万不得已时的最后手段。

collocations.meaning: 事无巨细地；详尽无遗地，精确到每一处细节
collocations.example_en: The security team planned the president's visit down to the last detail.
collocations.example_zh: 安保团队把总统出访的行程计划精确到了每一个细节。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 舍弃，放弃，出让（尤指不舍得或不情愿地）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I was reluctant to part with my old vinyl record collection.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我很舍不得卖掉我收藏的老黑胶唱片。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……分开，告别；离开（某人）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She found it agonizingly difficult to part from her children even for a few days.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 即便是分开短短几天，她也觉得离开孩子们是件痛苦万分的事。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分道扬镳；终止合作关系；（因意见不合而）断绝往来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The manager parted company with the football club after a series of heavy defeats.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在一连串惨败之后，主教练与这家足球俱乐部解除了合作关系。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拆件出售（将汽车、电脑等设备拆解后分批售卖零件）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Instead of fixing the damaged vehicle, he decided to part it out online.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他决定不在网上修这辆受损的车，而是把它拆散当配件卖。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 隔开，划分（用隔板、屏风等隔出独立空间）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They parted off a small section of the warehouse to use as an on-site office.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们把仓库隔出一小块区域用作现场办公室。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因……而产生分歧；因……而各自分开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The two business partners eventually parted over a disagreement about long-term investments.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 两位商业伙伴最终因在长期投资规划上的分歧而分道扬镳。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分开，解散，断绝恋爱关系
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After years of arguments, the couple finally decided to part up for good.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 争吵多年后，这对夫妻最终决定彻底分手。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 梳分（头发），在某处分出头缝
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He parted his hair neatly down the middle for the formal ceremony.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 为了参加正式典礼，他把头发整整齐齐地梳成了中分。

idioms.meaning: ……不可或缺的一部分，必不可少的要素
idioms.example_en: Dealing with demanding clients is part and parcel of being a public relations consultant.
idioms.example_zh: 与苛刻的客户打交道是作为公关顾问必不可少的一部分。

idioms.phrase: a fool and his money are soon parted
idioms.meaning: 傻瓜存不住钱；愚人聚财易散财
idioms.example_en: He lost thousands on that fraudulent scheme—truly, a fool and his money are soon parted.
idioms.example_zh: 他在那个诈骗项目上损失了数千元——真是傻瓜存不住钱。

idioms.meaning: 至死不渝，直到死亡将我们分开
idioms.example_en: They exchanged marriage vows, promising to love and cherish each other till death do them part.
idioms.example_zh: 他们交换了结婚誓言，承诺彼此相爱珍重，至死不渝。

idioms.meaning: 就我而言，在我看来
idioms.example_en: For my part, I have no objections whatsoever to the revised proposal.
idioms.example_zh: 就我而言，我对修改后的提案没有任何异议。

idioms.meaning: 站在某人一边，支持/偏袒某人
idioms.example_en: Whenever my brother and I argued, my grandmother would always take my part.
idioms.example_zh: 每当我和弟弟争吵时，祖母总是站在我这一边。

idioms.meaning: 在……中起作用；参与……
idioms.example_en: Diet and regular physical activity play a crucial part in preventing chronic illnesses.
idioms.example_zh: 饮食和规律运动在预防慢性疾病方面起着至关重要的作用。

collocations.meaning: 分道扬镳，各自谋生；中止合作
collocations.example_en: The band parted ways due to irreconcilable creative differences.
collocations.example_zh: 由于无法调和的创作分歧，乐队最终分道扬镳。

collocations.meaning: 和平分手，友好协商解约
collocations.example_en: Although the contract was terminated prematurely, both parties parted amicably.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管合同提前终止，但双方是和平友善解约的。

collocations.example_en: Security guards quickly parted the crowd to allow the ambassador to exit safely.
collocations.example_zh: 安保人员迅速拨开人群，确保大使安全撤离。

collocations.meaning: 微微张嘴，启齿（欲言或表惊讶）
collocations.example_en: She parted her lips in astonishment upon hearing the stunning news.
collocations.example_zh: 听到这个震惊的消息，她惊讶得微微张开了嘴。

collocations.example_en: He parted the heavy velvet curtains to let the morning sunlight illuminate the room.
collocations.example_zh: 他拉开厚重的天鹅绒窗帘，让清晨的阳光照亮整个房间。

collocations.example_en: They parted reluctantly at the gate, promising to write every single day.
collocations.example_zh: 他们在检票口依依不舍地道别，并承诺每天都要写信。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将……置于（特定状态、困境或职务中）；安插，安排
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The unexpected supply chain disruption placed the entire enterprise in severe jeopardy.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 意料之外的供应链中断使整个企业陷入了严重危机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 寄托于（期望/信任）；对……施加（限制/赋税/重压）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The current administration has placed heavy emphasis on renewable energy initiatives.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 现任政府高度重视发展可再生能源项目。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使处于……之下（逮捕/监视/管辖/麻醉/压力）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The suspect was immediately placed under arrest following a tip-off from a witness.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在目击者提供线索后，嫌疑人随即被依法逮捕。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 外包，发包（工程或订单）；安置（寄养儿童）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The publishing house places out all its specialized indexing to experienced freelancers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家出版社将所有专业索引工作外包给经验丰富的自由职业者。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将（订单/投资等）交给；把（孩子/宠物等）安置给
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They decided to place the multimillion-dollar manufacturing contract with an overseas supplier.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们决定将价值数百万美元的制造合同交给一家海外供应商。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将……呈递给，提交给（供审阅或考虑）；置于……之前（优先考虑）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The research committee placed the preliminary findings before the board of directors.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 研究委员会将初步调查结果呈报给了董事会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将……抛在脑后，告别（痛苦或不快的过往）；支持，力挺
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It took her several years to place the traumatic incident behind her and rebuild her life.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她花了数年时间才将那次创伤性事件抛在脑后，重新开始生活。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将……置于……之上，把……看得重于一切
phrasal_verbs.example_en: An ethical journalist must always place the public's right to truth above commercial interests.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 有道德操守的新闻记者必须始终将公众对真相的知情权置于商业利益之上。

idioms.meaning: 将某人奉若神明，盲目崇拜，偶像化
idioms.example_en: Fans often place movie stars on a pedestal, forgetting that they are flawed human beings.
idioms.example_zh: 粉丝常把影星奉若神明，却忘了他们也只是有缺点的凡人。

idioms.meaning: 认不出某人，记不得某人在何处见过
idioms.example_en: Her face seems strikingly familiar, but for the life of me, I simply cannot place her.
idioms.example_zh: 她的面孔看着极其眼熟，但我无论如何也想不起在哪儿见过她。

idioms.meaning: 乱七八糟，毫无条理；到处都是；心神不宁
idioms.example_en: His presentation was all over the place and failed to make a convincing argument.
idioms.example_zh: 他的演讲毫无头绪、东拉西扯，完全没有说服力。

idioms.meaning: 起初，一开始；（用于列举或解释原因）首先
idioms.example_en: If you had read the instructions carefully in the first place, we wouldn't be facing this mess.
idioms.example_zh: 要是你一开始就仔细阅读说明书，我们现在就不会面临这种烂摊子了。

idioms.meaning: 格格不入的，不相称的；不合时宜的
idioms.example_en: Dressed in casual jeans at the black-tie gala, he felt distinctly out of place.
idioms.example_zh: 穿着休闲牛仔裤出席这场要求穿燕尾礼服的盛会，他感觉格外格格不入。

idioms.meaning: 有利地位，显要位置，扬名立万的机会
idioms.example_en: After decades of tireless research, the young scientist finally secured her place in the sun.
idioms.example_zh: 经过数十年的不懈研究，这位年轻的科学家终于赢得了属于自己的一席之地。

collocations.example_en: Customers can place an order online and receive delivery within twenty-four hours.
collocations.example_zh: 顾客可以在线提交订单，并在24小时之内收到送达的货物。

collocations.example_en: Voters placed their faith in the progressive candidate's pledge to tackle inequality.
collocations.example_zh: 选民们把信任寄托在激进派候选人解决不平等问题的承诺上。

collocations.example_en: Modern tech companies place a high premium on creativity and adaptability.
collocations.example_zh: 现代科技企业极其重视员工的创造力与适应能力。

collocations.example_en: The local council decided to place strict restrictions on vehicular traffic in the old town.
collocations.example_zh: 市政委员会决定对老城区的机动车通行实施严格限制。

collocations.example_en: The emergency dispatcher placed a call directly to the nearest fire station.
collocations.example_zh: 应急调度员直接向最近的消防局拨通了电话。

collocations.meaning: 将过错/责任推卸给某人
collocations.example_en: It is totally unfair to place all the blame on the junior engineer for system collapse.
collocations.example_zh: 把整个系统崩溃的责任完全推卸到初级工程师身上是极其不公的。

collocations.example_en: The educational curriculum places special emphasis on critical thinking and problem-solving.
collocations.example_zh: 该教学大纲特别注重培养批判性思维与解决问题的能力。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （导弹、飞机等）导向，飞向；把注意力全部集中于，对准（问题、目标等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The detectives quickly homed in on the discrepancy in the suspect's alibi.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 侦探们很快将注意力集中在嫌疑人不在场证明的矛盾之处。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 引导向，追踪导向（目标、信号源）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The missile system uses infrared sensors to home onto enemy aircraft.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该导弹系统利用红外传感器自动导向敌机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 归宿于，返回到（栖息地或大本营）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Migrating birds instinctively home to the same nesting grounds every spring.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 候鸟每年春天凭本能返回同一个筑巢地。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （信鸽或动物）归巢，飞回原处
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Carrier pigeons can home back from hundreds of miles away.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 信鸽能从数百英里外飞回巢穴。

idioms.meaning: 把（观点、事实）讲得清清楚楚，使深刻理解；击中要害
idioms.example_en: The coach used video analysis to drive home the importance of defense.
idioms.example_zh: 教练通过视频分析深刻强调了防守的重要性。

idioms.meaning: （批评、话语等）触及痛处，击中要害；被充分理解感受
idioms.example_en: Her harsh words really hit home, and he began to reconsider his lifestyle.
idioms.example_zh: 她严厉的话击中了他的痛处，他开始重新反思自己的生活方式。

idioms.meaning: 使某人深切意识到（某事的危险性、严重性等）
idioms.example_en: The documentary brought home to viewers the devastating reality of famine.
idioms.example_zh: 这部纪录片让观众深刻体会到了饥荒的残酷现实。

idioms.meaning: 挣钱养家；取得成功
idioms.example_en: Both partners work long hours to bring home the bacon for their growing family.
idioms.example_zh: 为了养活不断壮大的家庭，夫妻双方都长时间辛勤工作。

idioms.meaning: 别客气，拘束消除，就像在自己家里一样
idioms.example_en: Sit down, grab a drink, and please make yourself at home.
idioms.example_zh: 请坐，喝杯水，别客气就像在自己家一样。

idioms.phrase: close to home / hit close to home
idioms.meaning: 触及某人的痛处，说得太准让人感到不适
idioms.example_en: The movie's plot about job loss felt a little too close to home for many workers.
idioms.example_zh: 电影中关于失业的情节让许多工人感到过于切身体会，甚至有些扎心。

idioms.meaning: （恶行或错误）产生恶果，自食其果
idioms.example_en: His reckless financial decisions have finally come home to roost.
idioms.example_zh: 他鲁莽的财务决策终于让他自食其果。

idioms.phrase: eat sb out of house and home
idioms.meaning: 吃得极多，几乎把某人吃穷
idioms.example_en: Having three teenage boys around will quickly eat you out of house and home.
idioms.example_zh: 家里有三个十几岁的男孩子，很快就会把你给吃穷。

collocations.meaning: 感到自在放松；对...得心应手
collocations.example_en: It took only a few weeks for her to feel at home in the new office.
collocations.example_zh: 只过了几周，她在新办公室就感到无拘无束了。

collocations.meaning: 找到安身之处；（物品等）找到归宿或接收方
collocations.example_en: The abandoned puppy soon found a loving home with a local family.
collocations.example_zh: 那只被遗弃的小狗很快在当地一个家庭找到了充满爱的归宿。

collocations.meaning: 离开父母独立生活；离家出走
collocations.example_en: She left home at eighteen to attend university across the country.
collocations.example_zh: 她十八岁离家，去往全国另一头的大学就读。

collocations.example_en: They decided to settle down and make a home in the countryside.
collocations.example_zh: 他们决定安定下来，在乡村安家落户。

collocations.example_en: It's getting late, so we'd better head home before the storm hits.
collocations.example_zh: 天色已晚，我们最好在暴风雨来临前动身回家。

collocations.example_en: A crowd gathered at the airport to welcome the champions home.
collocations.example_zh: 人群聚集在机场，热烈欢迎冠军们凯旋回国。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 查明真相，发现；获悉，打听清楚
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I need to find out when the next train leaves for London.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我需要查一下下一趟开往伦敦的火车几点开。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 识破某人的欺骗行为，查出某人的劣迹
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He cheated on his taxes for years before authorities finally found him out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他偷税漏税多年，最终还是被当局识破查处。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （法官或陪审团）裁定...胜诉
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The jury took only two hours to find for the plaintiff in the damages case.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 陪审团仅用了两小时就裁定该损害赔偿案的原告胜诉。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （法官或陪审团）裁定...败诉
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The court found against the corporation, ordering it to pay substantial compensation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 法庭判决该企业败诉，并责令其支付巨额赔偿金。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 不知不觉身处（某种境地）；认识自我，明确人生目标
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After years of drifting, she took a gap year and finally found herself.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在漂泊多年后，她休学一年，终于找到了真实的自我与人生目标。

phrasal_verbs.phrase: find in oneself to do sth
phrasal_verbs.meaning: （通常用于否定句或疑问句）鼓起勇气/下定决心做某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After everything he had done, she couldn't find it in her heart to forgive him.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经历了他做的一切之后，她实在无法打心底原谅他。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打听，深入了解（某事或某人）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: How did you first find out about this internship opportunity?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你最初是怎么了解到这个实习机会的？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 判定某人有罪/无罪
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The defendant was found guilty of grand theft by an unanimous verdict.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 被告经一致裁判定犯有重大盗窃罪。

idioms.meaning: 适应新环境，逐渐自信熟练
idioms.example_en: It took him a couple of months to find his feet in the new role.
idioms.example_zh: 他在新岗位上花了几个月才慢慢适应并进入状态。

idioms.meaning: 敢于公开发表意见；找到独特的表达风格
idioms.example_en: She was timid at first, but she soon found her voice during debates.
idioms.example_zh: 起初她很胆小，但在辩论中很快就敢于自信表达观点了。

idioms.meaning: 找到去...的路线；辗转流入/进入
idioms.example_en: A significant amount of plastic waste finds its way into the oceans each year.
idioms.example_zh: 每年有大量的塑料废弃物流入海洋。

idioms.meaning: 吹毛求疵，挑剔，抱怨
idioms.example_en: No matter what we do, our manager always manages to find fault with our work.
idioms.example_zh: 不管我们怎么做，经理总能挑出我们工作中的毛病。

idioms.phrase: find a needle in a haystack
idioms.meaning: 大海捞针，极难找到
idioms.example_en: Searching for one lost earring on the crowded beach was like finding a needle in a haystack.
idioms.example_zh: 在拥挤的海滩上寻找一只遗失的耳环犹如大海捞针。

idioms.meaning: 寻求共同点，达成一致意见
idioms.example_en: Despite ideological differences, the two leaders managed to find common ground on trade.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管存在意识形态差异，两位领导人仍在贸易问题上找到了共同语言。

idioms.meaning: 得到...的青睐，受到赏识或支持
idioms.example_en: The proposed tax reforms did not find favour with the business community.
idioms.example_zh: 拟议中的税收改革方案并未受到商界的青睐。

collocations.phrase: find it hard / easy to do sth
collocations.meaning: 发觉做某事很困难/容易
collocations.example_en: Many foreigners find it hard to adapt to the local climate.
collocations.example_zh: 很多外国人发觉很难适应当地的气候。

collocations.example_en: Engineers are working around the clock to find a solution to the software bug.
collocations.example_zh: 工程师们正在夜以继日地工作，以找出修复该软件漏洞的解决方案。

collocations.example_en: Despite a packed schedule, she always finds time to exercise daily.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管日程排得满满当当，她每天总能挤出时间锻炼身体。

collocations.meaning: 在...中体现出来，通过...表达出来
collocations.example_en: His deep dissatisfaction found expression in a series of protest songs.
collocations.example_zh: 他的深重不满在一系列抗议歌曲中得到了充分体现。

collocations.example_en: Working parents constantly strive to find a balance between career and family life.
collocations.example_zh: 在职父母一直在努力寻求事业与家庭生活之间的平衡点。

collocations.meaning: 吃亏/付出代价后才明白
collocations.example_en: He found out to his cost that cheap tools often break on the first use.
collocations.example_zh: 他付出了代价才懂得廉价工具往往第一次用就会坏。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 寻找；寻觅；招致（麻烦）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I've been looking for my keys everywhere all morning.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我整个上午都在到处找钥匙。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 看；注视；审视；仔细考虑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The committee is currently looking at several different proposals.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 委员会目前正在审议几项不同的提案。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 照顾；照料；负责处理
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Could you please look after my cat while I'm on vacation?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我休假期间你能帮我照看下猫吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 盼望；期待
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We are eagerly looking forward to hearing your presentation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们热切期盼着听您的报告。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 查阅（资料/字典）；拜访（熟人）；（形势）好转
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Things were tough at first, but business is finally looking up.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 起初困难重重，但生意终于开始好转了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 敬佩；仰慕；尊敬
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Young athletes always look up to their coaches as role models.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 年轻运动员总是把教练当作榜样来敬仰。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 轻视；瞧不起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She looks down on anyone who doesn't share her political views.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她瞧不起任何与她政治观点不同的人。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 调查；深入研究
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The police promised to look into the allegations of fraud.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警方承诺将深入调查这些诈骗指控。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回顾；回头看；停滞反悔
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Looking back on my college years, I realize how much I took for granted.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 回想起大学时光，我才意识到自己曾把多少东西视作理所当然。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 当心；留神；朝外看
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Look out! There's an icy patch right ahead of you.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 小心！你正前方有一块结冰的地方。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 提防；留意；照应/关照
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Older siblings should look out for the younger ones on the playground.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在操场上，哥哥姐姐应当照应弟弟妹妹。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 快速浏览；仔细翻查；对…视而不见
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I quickly looked through the contract before signing on the dotted line.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我在虚线处签字前快速翻阅了这份合同。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 过目；快速检查；巡视
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Could you look over my essay and give me some constructive feedback?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你能帮我过目一下论文并提些建设性意见吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 环视四周；四处打量；观光闲逛
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We arrived early, so we spent an hour looking around the old town.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们到得很早，所以花了一个小时在老城区四处逛了逛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把…视作；旁观
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I have always looked upon him as an older brother and trusted mentor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我一直把他看作兄长和值得信赖的导师。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顺道探望；顺便拜访（以确认是否安好）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'll look in on my grandmother on my way home from work.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我下班回家的路上会顺道去看看我祖母。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 转过脸去；移开目光
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The scene in the movie was so gruesome that she had to look away.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 电影里的那一幕太可怕了，她不得不把目光移开。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向前看；未雨绸缪；展望未来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Successful companies always look ahead to anticipate changing market trends.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 成功的企业总是未雨绸缪，预判不断变化的市场趋势。

idioms.meaning: 容光焕发；极有魅力
idioms.example_en: Dressed in that tailored tuxedo, he looked like a million dollars.
idioms.example_zh: 穿上那套定制礼服，他看起来容光焕发、魅力非凡。

idioms.meaning: 一路走向成功；势如破竹
idioms.example_en: Since launching her startup last year, she has never looked back.
idioms.example_zh: 自从去年创立公司以来，她一路走高、蒸蒸日上。

idioms.meaning: 假装没看见；熟视无睹；姑息纵容
idioms.example_en: Officials were accused of looking the other way while illegal dumping occurred.
idioms.example_zh: 官员们被指控对非法倾倒垃圾的行为熟视无睹。

idioms.meaning: 乐观面对；看到事物积极的一面
idioms.example_en: Even when the flight was delayed, she looked on the bright side and read a good book.
idioms.example_zh: 即便航班延误，她也往好的一面看，读了一本好书。

idioms.meaning: 对某人怒目而视
idioms.example_en: His colleague looked daggers at him for revealing the surprise during the meeting.
idioms.example_zh: 同事因他在会议上泄露了惊喜而对他怒目而视。

idioms.meaning: 三思而后行
idioms.example_en: It is crucial to look before you leap when making major investment decisions.
idioms.example_zh: 在做出重大投资决策时，三思而后行至关重要。

collocations.example_en: Let's take a closer look at the financial data before reaching a conclusion.
collocations.example_zh: 在得出结论之前，让我们仔细审视一下这组财务数据。

collocations.meaning: 直视某人的眼睛（以示坦荡或诚实）
collocations.example_en: He couldn't look me in the eye when he gave his weak explanation.
collocations.example_zh: 他给出牵强的解释时，甚至不敢正眼看我。

collocations.meaning: 穿戴整洁利落；动作快点
collocations.example_en: Make sure you look sharp for your job interview tomorrow morning.
collocations.example_zh: 务必穿戴利落整洁去参加明早的求职面试。

collocations.meaning: 给某人一个眼神；瞪某人一眼
collocations.example_en: My mother gave me a stern look across the dinner table to quiet me down.
collocations.example_zh: 母亲在餐桌另一端严厉地瞪了我一眼，示意我安静。

collocations.meaning: 理论上看似可行；表面上看起来不错
collocations.example_en: The strategic plan looked good on paper, but practical execution failed.
collocations.example_zh: 这项战略计划在纸面上看起来很棒，但实际执行却失败了。

collocations.example_en: Let me have a look at your engine to see what is causing that strange noise.
collocations.example_zh: 让我看一下你的发动机，找出异响的成因。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 需要某人返回；需要某人重新效力
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The team needs him back on the pitch if they hope to win the final.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果球队希望赢得决赛，就必须让他重返赛场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 需要要回某物；需要某物归还
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You can borrow my laptop today, but I will need it back by tomorrow morning.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你今天可以借用我的笔记本电脑，但明天早上我需要拿回来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想要进来；渴望参与/分一杯羹
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The dog is scratching at the back door because it needs in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那只狗正在挠后门，因为它想进屋。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想要出去；迫切想要退出/摆脱
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After years under high pressure, the executive realized he needed out of the corporate rat race.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在高压下工作多年后，这位高管意识到自己需要跳出职场内卷。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 需要某人在身边照料或陪伴
phrasal_verbs.example_en: As his health declined, the elderly man needed someone around to help with daily chores.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 随着健康状况恶化，这位老人身边需要有人照料日常起居。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因…而需要；对…的需求
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What specific tools do you need for this woodworking project?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 做这个木工活你具体需要哪些工具？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （口语中）需要起床；需要被扶起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The toddler woke from his nap and cried because he needed up from his crib.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 蹒跚学步的孩子午睡醒来哭闹，因为他想让人从婴儿床里抱起来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （口语中）需要下来；需要被放下来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The cat climbed too high up the bookshelf and mewed because it needed down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 猫咪爬得太高下不来书架，喵喵叫着想要下来。

idioms.phrase: need sth like a hole in the head
idioms.meaning: 根本不需要某物；极不想要某物
idioms.example_en: With all my current deadlines, I need another project like a hole in the head.
idioms.example_zh: 眼下各种截稿期催得紧，我再接一个项目简直就是自找倒霉。

idioms.meaning: 必要的话；如果有需要
idioms.example_en: We can reschedule the team meeting for next Monday if need be.
idioms.example_zh: 如果有需要，我们可以把团队会议推迟到下周一。

idioms.phrase: a friend in need is a friend indeed
idioms.meaning: 患难之交才是真朋友
idioms.example_en: He stood by me during my bankruptcy, proving that a friend in need is a friend indeed.
idioms.example_zh: 在我破产时他对我施以援手，证明了患难见真情。

idioms.meaning: 妇孺皆知；无需赘言介绍
idioms.example_en: Our guest speaker tonight is a legend who needs no introduction.
idioms.example_zh: 今晚的演讲嘉宾是一位家喻户晓的传奇人物，无需赘述介绍。

idioms.meaning: 还用我多说吗？；不言而喻
idioms.example_en: The revenue dropped by eighty percent in one quarter; need I say more?
idioms.example_zh: 单季度营收暴跌了百分之八十，还用我多说什么吗？

idioms.meaning: 谁稀罕呢？；何必自讨苦吃
idioms.example_en: Dealing with all that political infighting every day—who needs it?
idioms.example_zh: 每天都要应对那种勾心斗角的内耗——谁稀罕受那份罪呢？

collocations.example_en: The local clinic is in dire need of fresh medical supplies and staff.
collocations.example_zh: 当地诊所急需补充医疗物资和医护人员。

collocations.example_en: The software update was customized to meet the specific needs of enterprise clients.
collocations.example_zh: 该软件更新进行了定制，以满足企业客户的特定需求。

collocations.example_en: The new resort caters to the needs of families traveling with young children.
collocations.example_zh: 这家新度假村专门迎合带着幼儿出行的家庭需求。

collocations.phrase: feel the need to do sth
collocations.example_en: I did not feel the need to defend myself against groundless accusations.
collocations.example_zh: 我觉得没有必要针对莫须有的指责去为自己辩解。

collocations.phrase: have no need to do sth
collocations.meaning: 无需做某事；没必要做某事
collocations.example_en: You have no need to apologize for an honest mistake made in good faith.
collocations.example_zh: 对于出于善意而犯的无心之失，你完全没必要道歉。

collocations.example_en: The drought-stricken farmlands desperately need rain to save this year's harvest.
collocations.example_zh: 遭受旱灾的农田急需降雨来挽救今年的收成。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 发生；逐渐展现/展开；演完；耗尽
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We'll just have to wait and see how the situation plays out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们只能静观事态如何发展。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 淡化；对……轻描淡写；贬低
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The government tried to play down the seriousness of the economic crisis.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 政府试图淡化这场经济危机的严重性。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 夸大；大做文章；调皮捣蛋；（机器或身体部位）出毛病
phrasal_verbs.example_en: My old knee injury is starting to play up again in this damp weather.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在这潮湿的天气里，我膝盖的老毛病又开始犯了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 假装配合；顺从；合奏
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I didn't agree with his lie, but I played along to avoid blowing his cover.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我并不认同他的谎言，但为了不拆穿他，我还是假装配合了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 利用（他人的弱点、情感、恐惧等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Advertisements often play on people's insecurities to sell beauty products.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 广告经常利用人们的不安全感来推销美容产品。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 挑拨离间（使两方相争）；加赛决胜负
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He skillfully played the two rival companies off against each other to get a higher salary.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他巧妙地挑拨两家竞争公司相互竞价，以获得更高的薪水。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 闹着玩；胡闹；对待不严肃；乱动（设备）；出轨/鬼混
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Stop playing around with the thermostat; you'll break it.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别乱动恒温器了，你会弄坏它的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……玩耍；把玩；玩弄（感情等）；不认真对待（想法）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was just playing with his feelings and never intended to marry him.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她只是在玩弄他的感情，从没打算和他结婚。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回放；重播（录音、录像等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The coach played back the match footage to analyze the defense errors.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教练回放了比赛录像，以分析防守失误。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 正中……下怀；落入……圈套（常用 play into sb's hands）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Losing your temper will only play into their hands and weaken your credibility.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 大发脾气只会正中他们下怀，削弱你的信誉。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 心不在焉地做；闹着玩似地从事；假扮
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He doesn't take his art seriously; he's just playing at being a painter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他对艺术并不认真，只是闹着玩似地扮画家罢了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从头到尾演完/弹奏完；打通关；（高尔夫）让后一组先行穿过
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The orchestra played through the entire symphony without stopping.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 管弦乐队中途未停，从头到尾演奏完了整部交响曲。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 巴结；迎合；讨好
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She deliberately played up to the director to secure the lead role.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她故意讨好导演，以确保拿到主角名额。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （在脑海中）反复回想；重温；重放
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He kept playing the interview over in his mind, wondering what went wrong.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在脑海中一遍遍回想面试的经过，琢磨到底是哪里出了问题。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从（困境或劣势位置）中解脱/打出；脱离原有位置
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The defender successfully played the ball out of danger under intense pressure.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 后卫在巨大压力下成功将球踢出危险区域。

idioms.meaning: 见机行事；随机应变
idioms.example_en: We don't have a strict itinerary for tomorrow, so let's just play it by ear.
idioms.example_zh: 我们明天没有固定的行程，所以到时候看情况见机行事吧。

idioms.meaning: 玩火；冒极大风险惹火烧身
idioms.example_en: Investing your life savings in high-risk stocks is really playing with fire.
idioms.example_zh: 把一生的积蓄投资在高风险股票上无异于玩火。

idioms.meaning: 采取强硬手段；态度坚决不妥协
idioms.example_en: If the union refuses our reasonable offer, management will have to play hardball.
idioms.example_zh: 如果工会拒绝我们合理的报价，管理层就不得不采取强硬手段了。

idioms.meaning: 故意唱反调；充当反对者以激发深入讨论
idioms.example_en: I agree with your proposal, but let me play devil's advocate to test its robustness.
idioms.example_zh: 我赞同你的提议，但我先故意唱个反调，来检验它是否足够严密。

idioms.meaning: 欲擒故纵；摆架子故作难以接近
idioms.example_en: Don't respond to his text immediately; play hard to get for a bit.
idioms.example_zh: 别马上回复他的短信，稍微欲擒故纵一下。

idioms.meaning: 屈居次席；充当副手；居于次要地位
idioms.example_en: After years of playing second fiddle, she finally took over as the head chef.
idioms.example_zh: 在当了多年副手后，她终于接任成为主厨。

idioms.meaning: 出牌得当；行事明智；处理得体
idioms.example_en: If you play your cards right, this internship could lead to a permanent job.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你处理得当，这次实习可能会转为正式职位。

collocations.example_en: Diet and exercise play a crucial role in maintaining heart health.
collocations.example_zh: 饮食和锻炼在维持心脏健康方面起着至关重要的作用。

collocations.meaning: 谨慎行事；稳扎稳打；不冒风险
collocations.example_en: Instead of launching a radical redesign, the company decided to play safe.
collocations.example_zh: 公司决定谨慎行事，不进行彻底的重新设计。

collocations.example_en: In any healthy competition, all participants are expected to play fair.
collocations.example_zh: 在任何良性竞争中，所有参与者都应当公平竞争。

collocations.meaning: 耍花招；虚伪不诚实；玩弄心机
collocations.example_en: Stop playing games and tell me directly what your bottom line is.
collocations.example_zh: 别耍心机了，直接告诉我你的底线是什么。

collocations.meaning: 捉弄；开……玩笑；（幻觉等）使产生错觉
collocations.example_en: The dim lighting was playing tricks on my eyes, making shadows look like figures.
collocations.example_zh: 昏暗的灯光让我产生了错觉，把影子看成了人影。

collocations.example_en: He always plays the fool to defuse tension during awkward social moments.
collocations.example_zh: 在尴尬的社交场合，他总是装疯卖傻来缓和紧张气氛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 放弃；戒除；投降；把（时间/权利等）让给
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He decided to give up smoking for the sake of his newborn child.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 为了刚出生的孩子，他决定戒烟。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对……绝望/死心；放弃对……的希望
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The doctors haven't given up on her recovery despite the bleak odds.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管希望渺茫，医生们仍未放弃对她康复的希望。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 屈服；让步；交上（作业、表格等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After hours of relentless negotiation, the management finally gave in to the demands.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经过数小时激烈的谈判，管理层最终向诉求妥协了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 免费赠送；泄露（秘密、真相）；（婚礼上）将新娘交给新郎
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His nervous body language gave away the fact that he was lying.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他紧张的肢体语言泄露了他在撒谎的事实。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分发/散发；耗尽/失灵/体力不支；公布/发表
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After running twenty miles, his stamina completely gave out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 跑完二十英里后，他的体力完全耗尽了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 散发出（气味、光、热、气体等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The rotting fruit began to give off a foul, pungent smell.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 腐烂的水果开始散发出一股难闻的刺鼻气味。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 归还；回馈（社会）；恢复（健康、力量等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Successful entrepreneurs often look for meaningful ways to give back to their communities.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 成功的企业家往往会寻求有意义的方式来回馈社区。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 倒塌/崩塌；让步/妥协；让行；被……取代（give way to）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The old wooden bridge gave way under the immense weight of the floodwaters.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那座老木桥在巨大洪水的冲击下垮塌了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……移交/转交；停止（令人厌烦的行为）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Give over complaining and help us finish the project on time.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别再抱怨了，快帮我们按时完成这个项目。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 专用于；沉溺于；把（时间/精力）全部投入于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The entire afternoon was given over to intense budget discussions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 整个下午都专门用于激烈的预算讨论。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （门、窗、建筑）通向；朝向；俯瞰
phrasal_verbs.example_en: French double doors in the dining room give onto a sunlit patio.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 餐厅的双开法式玻璃门通向一个洒满阳光的庭院。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 慷慨付出；全心奉献（常与 oneself 连用）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She always gives freely of her time to mentor underprivileged students.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她总是慷慨地抽出时间来指导贫困学生。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 发出（声音、气味等）；公布/宣布
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The rusty church bell gave forth a deep, mournful toll across the valley.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 生锈的教堂大钟在山谷间发出低沉哀婉的鸣响。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 纵容/屈从于（诱惑、欲望、压力等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Try not to give in to the temptation of snacking late at night.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽量不要向深夜吃零食的诱惑屈服。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 自首/投降；沉溺于（某种情感）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Surrounded by police officers, the fugitive chose to give himself up peacefully.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在被警察包围后，逃犯选择和平自首。

idioms.meaning: 互谅互让；相互妥协；交流互动
idioms.example_en: Any enduring marriage requires a fair amount of give and take.
idioms.example_zh: 任何持久的婚姻都需要相当程度的互谅互让。

idioms.meaning: 饶了某人；别苛求某人；给某人一次机会
idioms.example_en: Give him a break; it's only his first day on the job.
idioms.example_zh: 饶了他吧，今天只是他入职的第一天。

idioms.phrase: give sb the benefit of the doubt
idioms.meaning: 先相信某人是无辜的/善意的；姑且信之
idioms.example_en: I wasn't sure if his apology was sincere, but I decided to give him the benefit of the doubt.
idioms.example_zh: 我拿不准他的道歉是否真诚，但我还是决定先相信他一次。

idioms.meaning: 故意冷落/怠慢某人
idioms.example_en: Ever since their argument, she has been giving him the cold shoulder.
idioms.example_zh: 自从两人争吵之后，她就一直对他爱理不理。

idioms.phrase: give sb a run for their money
idioms.meaning: 成为强劲对手；让某人全力以赴才获胜
idioms.example_en: The underdog team gave the defending champions a real run for their money.
idioms.example_zh: 这支不被看好的队伍给卫冕冠军制造了极其激烈的竞争。

idioms.meaning: 引起；导致；造成
idioms.example_en: The ambiguous clause in the contract gave rise to numerous disputes.
idioms.example_zh: 合同中那条含糊不清的条款引发了诸多争议。

idioms.phrase: give it a shot / give it a whirl
idioms.meaning: 试一试；碰碰运气
idioms.example_en: I've never tried rock climbing before, but I'm eager to give it a shot.
idioms.example_zh: 我以前从未攀过岩，但我很想尝试一下。

collocations.example_en: Have you given any serious thought to what you want to study at university?
collocations.example_zh: 你有没有认真考虑过大学想学什么专业？

collocations.meaning: 优先考虑；置于首要地位
collocations.example_en: The council decided to give priority to green energy projects this fiscal year.
collocations.example_zh: 理事会决定在本财政年度优先考虑绿色能源项目。

collocations.example_en: Could you give me a hand moving this heavy bookcase into the study?
collocations.example_zh: 你能帮我一把，把这个沉重的书柜搬进书房吗？

collocations.example_en: We must give credit to the research team for their tireless dedication.
collocations.example_zh: 我们必须对研发团队不知疲倦的奉献予以肯定和赞赏。

collocations.example_en: The doctor cannot perform the operation until the patient gives consent.
collocations.example_zh: 在病人同意之前，医生不能进行手术。

collocations.example_en: The witness was asked to give a detailed account of the accident.
collocations.example_zh: 目击者被要求详细叙述事故的经过。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 支持，证实；倒车；备份（文件/数据）；（使交通、管道等）积压堵塞
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The witness's testimony backed up his alibi, and the traffic backed up for miles during the investigation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 目击者的证词证实了他的不在场证明，而在调查期间交通堵塞了数英里。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 让步，认输，放弃先前的要求或立场
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Neither side was willing to back down, leading to a complete deadlock in the negotiations.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 双方都不肯让步，导致谈判彻底陷入僵局。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 食言，中途退出，反悔；（车辆）倒退离开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He promised to invest in our startup, but backed out at the last minute.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他答应过要投资我们的创业公司，但在最后一刻反悔退出了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 后退，退让；别管闲事，停止纠缠或施压；放慢（攻击/批评）节奏
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The protesters were ordered to back off, and the media was told to back off from the victim's family.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 抗议者被命令后退，媒体也被告诫不要再去打扰受害者家属。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （因害怕、警惕而）后退，退缩；回避，逐渐放弃（原计划或观点）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She backed away slowly from the aggressive dog, keeping her eyes fixed on it.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她眼睛死死盯着那只具攻击性的狗，慢慢往后退。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 违约，单方面撤出（合同、协议或承诺）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company cannot legally back out of the agreement without paying a heavy penalty.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该公司在法律上不得擅自违约退出协议，否则将面临巨额罚金。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （倒车时）撞上；（车辆）倒进；无意中卷入
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He accidentally backed into a lamppost while trying to park in the narrow alley.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在试图将车停进窄巷时不小心倒车撞到了路灯柱上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （房屋、建筑物等）后方紧邻，背靠
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The newly built cottages back onto a scenic pine forest.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这排新建的乡间小屋后方背靠着一片风景秀丽的松树林。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从（对峙、承诺或既定立场）退缩，放弃进行
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The government refused to back off from its controversial tax reforms.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 政府拒绝在备受争议的税收改革立场上作出退让。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 倒车轧过，倒车辗过
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Always check your mirrors carefully to make sure you don't back over a child's toy.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 倒车时一定要仔细看后视镜，确保不会碾过小孩的玩具。

idioms.meaning: 押错宝，看错人，支持注定失败的一方
idioms.example_en: By investing heavily in that outdated technology, they backed the wrong horse.
idioms.example_zh: 他们在那项过时的技术上投入重金，显然是押错了宝。

idioms.meaning: 全力以赴支持某人，毫无保留地支持到底
idioms.example_en: The board assured the CEO that they would back his restructuring plan to the hilt.
idioms.example_zh: 董事会向首席执行官保证，他们将全力以赴支持他的重组计划。

idioms.meaning: 将某人逼入绝境，使某人走投无路而不得不反击
idioms.example_en: The aggressive cross-examination backed the suspect into a corner.
idioms.example_zh: 咄咄逼人的交叉盘问将嫌疑人逼入了无路可退的死角。

idioms.meaning: 优柔寡断，反复变卦，立场动摇不定
idioms.example_en: The committee has spent months backing and filling instead of taking decisive action.
idioms.example_zh: 委员会数月来优柔寡断、反复变卦，而不是采取果断行动。

idioms.meaning: 两头下注，同时支持对立双方以确保自己不输
idioms.example_en: The pragmatic businessman decided to back both horses by funding both political parties.
idioms.example_zh: 这位务实的商人决定两头下注，同时资助两个对立政党。

collocations.example_en: Local residents solidly backed the campaign to protect the historic park.
collocations.example_zh: 当地居民坚定支持保护这座历史公园的行动。

collocations.meaning: 支持一项提案/法案/计划
collocations.example_en: Most senators agreed to back the healthcare reform bill.
collocations.example_zh: 大多数参议员同意支持这项医疗改革法案。

collocations.meaning: 在经济上资助某事，为……提供资金后盾
collocations.example_en: Several venture capital firms stepped in to back the clean energy project financially.
collocations.example_zh: 几家风投机构介入，为该清洁能源项目提供资金支持。

collocations.meaning: 用证据支持/证实某种说法
collocations.example_en: You must back your academic claims with rigorous empirical evidence.
collocations.example_zh: 你必须用严密的实证证据来支撑你的学术主张。

collocations.example_en: The union voted overwhelmingly to back the incumbent candidate in the upcoming election.
collocations.example_zh: 工会以压倒性多数投票支持现任候选人连任。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 郑重声明，正式记录在案（作为法定或正式用语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let me state for the record that I was never informed of this financial transaction.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 请允许我郑重声明并记入笔录：我从未被告知过这笔财务交易。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 宣誓陈述，在宣誓后作证
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The accountant stated under oath that the ledgers had been altered intentionally.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 会计宣誓作证称，账本确实遭到了人为蓄意篡改。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以书面形式陈述/声明
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The landlord promised repairs verbally, but I insisted that he state it in writing.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 房东口头答应维修，但我坚持要求他以书面形式明确列出。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 详细陈述，逐一具体说明
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The report states in detail the systemic errors that contributed to the plane crash.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该报告详细陈述了导致这起空难的系统性错误。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 陈述如下，具体内容列明如下
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The core findings of the committee can be stated as follows.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 委员会的核心调查结论可陈述如下。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 作出相反陈述/声明，提出反对意见
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Unless the contract explicitly states to the contrary, standard terms will apply.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 除非合同中有明确的相反陈述，否则均适用标准条款。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 完整陈述，全盘写明
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Applicants are required to state in full their employment history over the past decade.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 申请人必须完整陈述过去十年内的全部就业经历。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……当作事实陈述，指称某事为定论
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She stated as a fact what was actually mere speculation on her part.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她把本属于自己无根据的臆测当作无可争辩的事实来陈述。

idioms.meaning: 阐明自己的论点/理由，为自己的立场辩护
idioms.example_en: The union representatives were given thirty minutes to state their case before management.
idioms.example_zh: 工会代表获得了三十分钟时间在管理层面前陈述他们的诉求与理由。

idioms.meaning: 说人尽皆知的大实话，讲显而易见的废话
idioms.example_en: At the risk of stating the obvious, running out of cash will bankrupt the firm.
idioms.example_zh: 虽然说这可能是句显而易见的废话，但资金链断裂确实会让公司破产。

idioms.meaning: 开出条件，明确提出要求或底线
idioms.example_en: The kidnappers stated their terms in a short recorded message delivered to the police.
idioms.example_zh: 绑匪在递交给警方的一段简短录音中开出了他们的条件。

idioms.meaning: 表明态度，正式表态立场
idioms.example_en: The prime minister clearly stated her position regarding national sovereignty.
idioms.example_zh: 首相在国家主权问题上明确表明了她的坚定立场。

idioms.meaning: 正式表达偏好，明确声明意向
idioms.example_en: When asked about the relocation, none of the employees stated a clear preference.
idioms.example_zh: 当被问及岗位调动时，没有一位员工明确表达过自己的偏好。

collocations.meaning: 清楚/明确地陈述，毫无含糊地说明
collocations.example_en: The policy states clearly that refunds are not permitted after thirty days.
collocations.example_zh: 该政策明确规定三十天后概不退款。

collocations.meaning: 毫不含糊地声明，斩钉截铁地表示
collocations.example_en: The spokesperson stated unequivocally that no troops would be deployed.
collocations.example_zh: 发言人斩钉截铁地声明绝不会派驻军队。

collocations.example_en: The senator has publicly stated that he will not seek another term.
collocations.example_zh: 这位参议员已公开声明他将不再寻求连任。

collocations.example_en: As stated above, all expenditures must be approved by the chief financial officer.
collocations.example_zh: 如上所述，所有支出均须经首席财务官批准。

collocations.example_en: The employee resigned without stating a reason for his sudden departure.
collocations.example_zh: 该员工离职时并未陈述他突然离开的原因。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （液体）涌出，溢出；（强烈情感）涌上心头，油然而生
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Tears welled up in her eyes as she heard the heartbreaking news, and a deep sense of sorrow welled up inside her.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 听到这个令人心碎的消息，泪水涌上了她的眼眶，内心也涌起一阵强烈的悲痛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （液体）漫溢出来；（情绪）难以抑制而外露
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The boiling milk quickly welled over the rim of the pot before he could turn down the heat.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他还没来得及关小火，煮沸的牛奶就从锅边漫溢出来了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （液体或气体）喷涌而出，汩汩流出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Blood was welling out from the deep cut on his forearm.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 鲜血从他前臂深长的伤口中汩汩流出。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （大量泉水、声音等）奔涌而出，倾泻而出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Fresh spring water welled forth from the rocky crevice beneath the ancient tree.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 清冽的泉水从古树下方的岩石缝隙中奔涌而出。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从……源源不断流出；源于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Genuine sympathy seemed to well from every member of the tight-knit community.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这个紧密团结的社区里的每一个人似乎都流露出了发自内心的同情。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （液体或气流）涌入，渗入……内部
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The groundwater welled into the newly excavated basement during the heavy rainstorm.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在暴风雨期间，地下水不断涌入新开挖的地下室。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （液体）渗透涌过，穿透冒出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Water began to well through the microscopic cracks in the aging concrete dam.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 水开始穿过老化混凝土大坝上的微小裂缝渗涌出来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （液体）顺流散开，流淌而去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The excess rainwater welled away into the storm drainage system smoothly.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 多余的雨水顺畅地流淌排入暴雨排水系统中。

idioms.meaning: 也，还；同样
idioms.example_en: She speaks fluent French and German, and understands a bit of Italian as well.
idioms.example_zh: 她法语和德语说得很流利，而且也懂一点意大利语。

idioms.meaning: 除……之外还；不仅……而且
idioms.example_en: The training program covers technical skills as well as leadership development.
idioms.example_zh: 该培训计划不仅包含专业技能，还涵盖领导力的培养。

idioms.phrase: might as well / may as well
idioms.meaning: 不妨，倒不如，还不如做某事
idioms.example_en: Since the meeting was canceled, we might as well grab an early lunch together.
idioms.example_zh: 既然会议取消了，我们倒不如一起提早去吃午饭。

idioms.meaning: 诚然不错，很好（但后面常接转折）
idioms.example_en: High profits are all well and good, but employee safety should always come first.
idioms.example_zh: 高利润诚然很好，但员工的安全必须始终放在第一位。

idioms.meaning: 完全地，彻底地，不折不扣地
