idioms.example_en: By midnight, the tired travelers were well and truly lost in the foggy mountains.
idioms.example_zh: 到了半夜，疲惫的旅行者们在大雾弥漫的群山中彻底迷失了方向。

idioms.meaning: 维持现状，切勿画蛇添足，知足常乐
idioms.example_en: The engine is running fine now, so let's just leave well enough alone instead of tinkering further.
idioms.example_zh: 发动机现在运转良好，我们还是维持现状吧，别再去瞎折腾了。

idioms.meaning: 幸好，幸亏如此，万幸
idioms.example_en: It's just as well you brought an umbrella, as the sky has suddenly turned completely dark.
idioms.example_zh: 幸亏你带了伞，天色突然全暗下来了。

idioms.meaning: 健在；依然盛行，充满生机
idioms.example_en: Despite rumors of its decline, the traditional craft is alive and well in the rural villages.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管有衰落的传闻，这种传统手工艺在乡村地区依然充满生机。

collocations.example_en: The steady growth in consumer spending bodes well for the upcoming holiday retail season.
collocations.example_zh: 消费者支出的稳步增长预示着即将到来的假日零售季有好兆头。

collocations.meaning: 表现出色；取得成功；繁荣昌盛；康复良好
collocations.example_en: She did exceptionally well in the interview and was offered the position immediately.
collocations.example_zh: 她在面试中表现极为出色，并立刻获得了录用通知。

collocations.example_en: Don't be offended by his direct advice; he really means well.
collocations.example_zh: 别为他直率的建议感到不快，他确实是出于好意。

collocations.example_en: Management is well aware of the current staffing shortages and is actively recruiting.
collocations.example_zh: 管理层充分意识到了当前人员短缺的问题，正在积极开展招聘。

collocations.example_en: Every client she has ever worked with speaks very well of her professionalism.
collocations.example_zh: 每一位与她合作过的客户都对她的敬业精神赞不绝口。

collocations.meaning: 非常值得（投入时间、精力或金钱）
collocations.example_en: The breathtaking view from the summit was well worth the grueling four-hour hike.
collocations.example_zh: 从山顶俯瞰的壮丽景色，绝对配得上那段长达四个小时的艰难跋涉。

collocations.meaning: 祝福某人，祝某人一切顺利
collocations.example_en: All his colleagues gathered to wish him well on his new career venture.
collocations.example_zh: 所有的同事都聚在一起，祝愿他在新的职业生涯中一切顺利。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （人）站稳身形，恢复平衡；重新振作，改过自新
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He slipped on the patch of black ice but managed to right himself before falling.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在一块暗冰上滑了一下，但赶在摔倒前稳住了身形。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （船只等）自行扶正，恢复原位；（局势、经济等）自发好转，重回正轨
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After taking a violent roll in the stormy wave, the vessel slowly righted itself.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在暴风巨浪中猛烈侧翻后，船身缓缓自行扶正了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把（翻倒的物体）扶正，摆正；端正姿态
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The workers rushed over to right up the fallen scaffolding before traffic backed up.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工人们赶忙跑过去把倾倒的脚手架扶正，以免交通堵塞。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 彻底整顿纠正；平息平定下来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The incoming audit team worked tirelessly to right down all irregularities in the ledger.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 新到任的审计团队夜以继日地工作，彻底纠正了账簿中的所有违规记录。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 彻底拉直，平整复位；完全纠偏
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The technician used a clamp to right out the bent frame of the conveyor belt.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 技术人员用夹具将传送带弯曲的框架彻底拉直复位。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使彻底改观；掉转方向并纠偏
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The new CEO managed to right about the failing company's financial trajectory within a year.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 新任首席执行官在一年的时间里成功扭转了这家濒临倒闭公司的财务走向。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把（倾斜或翻转的物体）彻底翻正过来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The rescue crew used heavy winches to right over the overturned delivery truck.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 救援人员使用重型绞盘将侧翻的货车彻底翻正过来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 全面贯穿调整；彻底修正到位
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We need to right through the entire supply chain to eliminate recurring bottlenecks.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们需要对整条供应链进行彻底梳理纠偏，以消除反复出现的瓶颈。

idioms.meaning: 立刻，马上，毫不迟疑地
idioms.example_en: Please send the finalized contract to legal right away for their signature.
idioms.example_zh: 请立即把定稿的合同发给法务部门签字。

idioms.meaning: 从一开始，立即，开门见山
idioms.example_en: Right off the bat, she made it clear that budget cuts would be inevitable.
idioms.example_zh: 她一开场就明确表示削减预算是不可避免的。

idioms.meaning: 按理说，照理应该，按理应当
idioms.example_en: By rights, the championship trophy belongs to our team based on overall performance.
idioms.example_zh: 按理说，根据整体表现，冠军奖杯本应属于我们队。

idioms.meaning: 神志正常，头脑清醒
idioms.example_en: No one in their right mind would attempt to cross the desert on foot in midsummer.
idioms.example_zh: 任何神志正常的人都不会尝试在仲夏徒步穿过沙漠。

idioms.meaning: 走在正确的轨道上，思路正确，方向对头
idioms.example_en: Your preliminary test results show that you are definitely on the right track with this research.
idioms.example_zh: 你的初步测试结果表明，这项研究的方向绝对是正确的。

idioms.meaning: 切中要害；拿捏得恰到好处；引起广泛共鸣
idioms.example_en: Her keynote speech hit the right note with both younger staff and senior executives.
idioms.example_zh: 她的主旨演讲拿捏得恰到好处，引起了年轻员工和高层主管的共鸣。

idioms.meaning: 就在某人眼皮底下（却未被察觉）
idioms.example_en: The missing documents had been sitting on the conference table right under his nose.
idioms.example_zh: 遗失的文件一直就放在会议桌上，就在他的眼皮底下。

idioms.phrase: have two left feet / put a foot wrong
idioms.meaning: 犯错，失足（反义表达：never put a foot right / never put a foot wrong）
idioms.example_en: Throughout the rigorous press conference, the seasoned diplomat didn't put a foot wrong.
idioms.example_zh: 在整场严苛的记者会上，这位经验丰富的外交官没有出任何差错。

collocations.meaning: 平反冤屈；纠正错误；拨乱反正
collocations.example_en: The newly discovered forensic evidence helped right a devastating judicial wrong.
collocations.example_zh: 新发现的法医物证帮助平反了一起毁灭性的司法冤案。

collocations.meaning: 收拾局面；纠正错误；恢复正常秩序
collocations.example_en: He promised to do whatever it takes to set things right with his estranged family.
collocations.example_zh: 他承诺将不惜一切代价来修复与疏远家人的关系，让一切重归于好。

collocations.example_en: It serves him right that he got a speeding ticket after driving so recklessly.
collocations.example_zh: 他开车那么鲁莽，被开超速罚单真是活该。

collocations.meaning: 把……做对；准确理解；恰当处理
collocations.example_en: It took several attempts to get the delicate recipe exactly right.
collocations.example_zh: 经过多次尝试，才把这份讲究的食谱拿捏得完全到位。

collocations.phrase: have the right to do sth
collocations.example_en: Every citizen has the fundamental right to express their opinions peacefully.
collocations.example_zh: 每一位公民都拥有和平表达个人意见的基本权利。

collocations.meaning: 捍卫自己的权益；挺身维护权利
collocations.example_en: The union encouraged all employees to stand up for their rights to fair wages.
collocations.example_zh: 工会鼓励所有员工挺身而出，捍卫自己获得合理薪酬的权利。

collocations.example_en: Entering the emerging electric vehicle market at the right time proved crucial to their success.
collocations.example_zh: 在恰当的时机切入新兴的电动汽车市场，对他们的成功起到了至关重要的作用。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 坚强起来，振作起来；拿出男子汉气概；勇敢承担责任
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You need to man up and admit that you made a mistake.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你需要像个男子汉一样坚强起来，承认自己犯了错。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （俚语/口语）有人倒下，有人受伤；丧失斗志，退缩
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The medic shouted 'man down!' as soon as the soldier fell.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 士兵一倒下，医护兵就大喊“有人受伤倒地！”

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为……配备人员/人手
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The rescue boat was fully manned with experienced divers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 搜救艇上配备的全都是经验丰富的潜水员。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 组织人员防守以抵御（攻击或灾害）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Local residents manned the dikes against the rising floodwaters.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当地居民组织起来把守堤坝，抵御不断上涨的洪水。

idioms.meaning: 说话算话的人，守信用的男子
idioms.example_en: You can trust him completely; he is always a man of his word.
idioms.example_zh: 你可以完全信任他，他一向言出必行。

idioms.meaning: 人人自保，各自为战
idioms.example_en: When the ship started sinking, it was every man for himself.
idioms.example_zh: 轮船开始下沉时，大家只能各自逃命。

idioms.meaning: 无一例外地，全体一致地
idioms.example_en: The committee rejected the proposal to a man.
idioms.example_zh: 委员会全体一致拒绝了这项提案。

idioms.meaning: 风云人物，当红人物，焦点人物
idioms.example_en: After scoring the winning goal, he was the man of the hour.
idioms.example_zh: 踢进绝杀球后，他成了全场瞩目的风云人物。

idioms.phrase: separate the men from the boys
idioms.meaning: 见真章，考验谁是真正强者/成熟老练者
idioms.example_en: This brutal marathon will really separate the men from the boys.
idioms.example_zh: 这场极其艰难的马拉松将真正考验谁是真正的强者。

idioms.meaning: 独立自主，不受他人摆布
idioms.example_en: He left the family business because he wanted to be his own man.
idioms.example_zh: 他离开了家族企业，因为他想独立自主地打拼。

idioms.meaning: 与众不同的人，被排斥的人，多余者
idioms.example_en: Being the only non-smoker in the group made him feel like the odd man out.
idioms.example_zh: 作为聚会中唯一不抽烟的人，他觉得自己像个局外人。

collocations.meaning: 守在电话旁，负责接听电话
collocations.example_en: Volunteers manned the phones throughout the 24-hour charity event.
collocations.example_zh: 志愿者在24小时慈善活动期间一直坚守在电话机旁。

collocations.meaning: 坚守前台/接待处，值守服务台
collocations.example_en: Who will be manning the reception desk while Sarah is on leave?
collocations.example_zh: 萨拉休假期间谁来值守前台？

collocations.meaning: 把守街垒；投身抗争/捍卫阵地
collocations.example_en: Workers manned the barricades to protest against the plant closure.
collocations.example_zh: 工人们把守街垒，抗议工厂倒闭。

collocations.meaning: 竭力抢救危局，全力应付紧急危机
collocations.example_en: The executive team had to man the pumps to prevent bankruptcy.
collocations.example_zh: 高管团队不得不全力以赴抢救危局以防破产。

collocations.example_en: With a seasoned CEO manning the helm, the company navigated the crisis.
collocations.example_zh: 在一任经验丰富的首席执行官掌舵下，公司渡过了危机。

collocations.example_en: The new emergency ward is modern and fully manned.
collocations.example_zh: 新的急诊病房设施现代且人员配备齐全。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使平整；使均等，拉平差距；（波动后）趋于平稳/恢复平静
phrasal_verbs.example_en: House prices are expected to even out after a period of rapid growth.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 房价经历快速增长期后预计会趋于平稳。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使扯平/拉平差距；使胜算均等；结清（账目）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A late penalty kick evened up the score just before the final whistle.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 终场哨响前的一记点球将比分扳平。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使平齐；使持平/走稳
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The carpenter carefully evened off the edges of the tabletop.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 木匠仔细地将桌面边缘刨平整。

idioms.meaning: 向某人报复，与某人扯平恩怨
idioms.example_en: He promised himself that he would get even with the rival who betrayed him.
idioms.example_zh: 他暗自发誓一定要报复背叛他的竞争对手。

idioms.meaning: 盈亏平衡，不赚不赔，保本
idioms.example_en: The startup managed to break even in its second year of operations.
idioms.example_zh: 这家初创公司在运营的第二年实现了收支平衡。

idioms.meaning: 即便如此，尽管那样
idioms.example_en: The weather was terrible; even so, they decided to go hiking.
idioms.example_zh: 天气非常糟糕；即便如此，他们还是决定去徒步。

idioms.meaning: 平稳地，稳定地运行
idioms.example_en: It took several months to get the business back on an even keel.
idioms.example_zh: 花了几个月的时间才让业务重新恢复平稳运转。

idioms.meaning: 扳平比分；报仇，扯平宿怨
idioms.example_en: She scored in the final minute to even the score at 2-2.
idioms.example_zh: 她在最后一分钟进球，将比分扳平为2比2。

idioms.meaning: 公平竞争的机会，平等的机会
idioms.example_en: All he ever asked for was an even break in the market.
idioms.example_zh: 他一直以来所要求的只是市场上一个公平竞争的机会。

collocations.meaning: 消除差距/分歧，抹平差异
collocations.example_en: Tax reforms are aimed at evening out the economic disparities across regions.
collocations.example_zh: 税制改革旨在缩小不同地区之间的经济差距。

collocations.meaning: 扯平胜算，增加对等的机会
collocations.example_en: New technology has helped even the odds for smaller independent firms.
collocations.example_zh: 新技术帮助规模较小的独立公司拉平了竞争胜算。

collocations.example_en: The irrigation system ensures an even distribution of water across the field.
collocations.example_zh: 该灌溉系统确保了水在整片农田中的均匀分布。

collocations.meaning: 对半的几率，五五开的机会
collocations.example_en: Doctors said that the patient has an even chance of full recovery.
collocations.example_zh: 医生说病人有五成的希望完全康复。

collocations.example_en: Despite her internal anger, she replied in a perfectly even tone.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管内心愤怒，她还是用非常平静的语气作答。

collocations.example_en: The houses on this side of the street all have even numbers.
collocations.example_zh: 街道这侧的房屋都是双数门牌号。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 认真钻研；突击温习，临时抱佛脚
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I need to study up on the local labor laws before the compliance audit tomorrow.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 明天的合规审计之前，我需要突击学习一下当地的劳动法。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 师从于，受教于（名师）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She had the unique privilege of studying under one of the world's most renowned cellists.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她有幸师从于世界最著名的大提琴大师之一。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为（考试、学位、资格证等）备考学习
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He spends six hours every evening studying for the medical board certification exam.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他每天晚上花六个小时备考执业医师资格考试。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 深入调查；深究，仔细探寻
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The committee decided to study into the root causes of the recent structural failures.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 委员会决定深入调查近期结构故障的根本原因。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 埋头苦读，持续用功
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite the noisy construction outside, she just sat by the window and studied away.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管外面施工噪音震天，她依然坐在窗边埋头苦读。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 彻底想通，琢磨透彻；拟定出（方案）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The engineers spent weeks studying out an ingenious workaround to the engine overheating problem.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工程师们花了数周时间琢磨出了解决发动机过热问题的巧妙方案。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从头到尾通读研读；仔细通查
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The legal counsel studied through all thirty binders of discovery materials before the trial.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 法律顾问在开庭前从头到尾仔细研读了整整三十卷庭前证据材料。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 反复斟酌，仔细考量
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Take the contract home and study it over carefully before putting your signature on it.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 把合同带回家仔细斟酌一番，然后再签字。

idioms.meaning: 领悟力强的人，学得快的人
idioms.example_en: She had no background in programming, but she proved to be a remarkably quick study.
idioms.example_zh: 她虽然没有编程背景，但事实证明她是个领悟力极强的人。

idioms.meaning: 鲜明的对比，截然相反的对照物
idioms.example_en: The twin brothers are a study in contrasts: one is introverted and analytical, while the other is boisterous and impulsive.
idioms.example_zh: 这对双胞胎兄弟形成了鲜明的对比：一个内向理性，另一个却喧闹冲动。

idioms.meaning: 陷入沉思，出神发呆
idioms.example_en: He sat staring blankly into the distance, lost in a deep brown study until the doorbell rang.
idioms.example_zh: 他呆呆地注视着远方陷入了深思，直到门铃响起才回过神来。

idioms.meaning: 审时度势；研判赛马/竞争对手的以往表现
idioms.example_en: Savvy investors always study the market form thoroughly before committing any venture capital.
idioms.example_zh: 精明的投资者在投入风险资金前总会透彻研判市场走势。

idioms.meaning: 专门研究某事物，对某事下苦功观察
idioms.example_en: Over the past decade, she has made a detailed study of traditional herbal medicine in rural areas.
idioms.example_zh: 在过去的十年里，她对乡村地区的传统草药学进行了系统而深入的研究。

collocations.example_en: Gaining cross-cultural perspective is one of the main reasons students choose to study abroad.
collocations.example_zh: 获得跨文化视野是学生们选择出国留学的主要原因之一。

collocations.example_en: The detective studied the surveillance footage closely to catch any overlooked details.
collocations.example_zh: 侦探密切查看了监控录像，以捕捉任何被忽略的细节。

collocations.meaning: 开展/实施一项调查研究
collocations.example_en: Independent researchers were commissioned to conduct a comprehensive study on the ecological impact.
collocations.example_zh: 独立研究人员受托就生态影响开展一项综合性研究。

collocations.meaning: 论证/研究某事的可行性
collocations.example_en: The urban planning board met yesterday to study the feasibility of building a light rail network.
collocations.example_zh: 城市规划委员会昨天开会论证了修建轻轨网络的可行性。

collocations.meaning: 实证研究 / 纵向追踪研究
collocations.example_en: This thirty-year longitudinal study provides compelling evidence on the cognitive benefits of bilingualism.
collocations.example_zh: 这项长达三十年的追踪研究为双语对认知能力的有益影响提供了令人信服的证据。

collocations.example_en: Linguistic variation among online subcultures has become a popular object of academic study.
collocations.example_zh: 网络亚文化中的语言变体已成为一个热门的学术研究对象。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使失望，辜负；放下，调低；（给轮胎等）放气
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I promised the team I would deliver the project on schedule, and I refuse to let them down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我向团队保证过会按期交付项目，我绝不会让他们失望。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 允许进入，放进；透进（光、风、水等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She cracked open the window just wide enough to let in some crisp autumn air.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她把窗户开了一条缝，刚好能放进些许清爽的秋日空气。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 释放，放出；发出（叫声、叹息）；放宽（衣物）；（学校/会议等）放学散场
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He let out a huge sigh of relief when he learned that the tumor was benign.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 得知肿瘤是良性的之后，他长长地松了一口气。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 免受惩罚，从轻发落；引爆，燃放；准许（乘客）下车
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The judge took pity on the first-time offender and let him off with a stern reprimand.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 法官怜悯这名初犯，仅予以严厉训诫便将他从轻免罚。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 透露，泄露秘密；装出……的样子
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Although she was in severe pain, she didn't let on that anything was wrong.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 虽然她疼痛难忍，但她一点也没表露出身体有任何不适。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （风雨、坏天气）减弱，减缓；（努力、压力）放松，停歇
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The torrential downpour showed no signs of letting up, turning the streets into shallow rivers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 倾盆大雨丝毫没有减弱的迹象，把街道变成了浅水河。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 松手，放开；解雇，裁减；摒弃（执念、旧事）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Due to budget cutbacks, the company was forced to let go of nearly twenty percent of its workforce.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于预算削减，公司被迫裁减了近百分之二十的员工。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 允许进入；把……嵌进；让某人知悉（秘密、内情）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Only a handful of trusted advisors were let into the strategic takeover plan.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 只有少数几位心腹顾问获准知晓这项战略收购计划的内情。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 放行，准许通过（关卡、筛查）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Border guards inspected all passports carefully before letting the humanitarian convoy through.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 边防警卫仔细检查了所有护照，随后才对人道主义车队予以放行。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 不打扰，由他去，听其自然
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He is clearly exhausted and irritable right now, so it is best to let him be.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他现在显然心力交瘁且烦躁易怒，最好还是由他去，别打扰他。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 放过，听之任之，不予追究
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His rude remarks were deliberate, but the CEO chose to let them pass without a confrontation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他那些粗鲁的话是故意的，但首席执行官选择不予追究，避免正面冲突。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 听任其发展，暂且搁置不管
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We can't solve this bureaucratic dispute right away, so let's just let it ride until Monday.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们目前无法立刻解决这场官僚纠纷，所以就先搁着听其自然，周一再说吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 猛掷出，射出；猛烈攻击，破口大骂
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Unable to contain his rage any longer, the coach let fly with a barrage of curses at the referee.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教练再也按捺不住心中的怒火，对着裁判破口大骂。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 放任自流，全速奔驰；毫无保留地尽情发泄
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Once the car hit the open highway, he stepped hard on the accelerator and let rip.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 车子一上空旷的高速公路，他就猛踩油门全速狂飙。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 无意间说漏嘴，不经意透露
phrasal_verbs.example_en: During dinner, he let slip that he had been secretly interviewing for jobs in London.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 吃晚饭时，他无意中说漏了嘴，透露自己一直在暗中面试伦敦的职位。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使参与；告诉（某人内幕/秘密）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They finally let me in on their surprise party plans for our manager's milestone birthday.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们终于把为经理逢十生日准备惊喜派对的计划告诉了我。

idioms.meaning: 更不用说，遑论，何谈
idioms.example_en: He can barely afford to feed his own family, let alone buy a luxury sports car.
idioms.example_zh: 他连养活自己的家人都捉襟见肘，更不用说买一辆豪华跑车了。

idioms.phrase: let the cat out of the bag
idioms.meaning: 走漏风声，泄露天机，露出马脚
idioms.example_en: We wanted the merger to stay under wraps, but an anonymous tip let the cat out of the bag.
idioms.example_zh: 我们本想对并购案保密，但一条匿名爆料让消息彻底走漏了风声。

idioms.meaning: 莫招惹是非，勿重提旧怨，过去的就让它过去
idioms.example_en: Reopening that settled grievance will only cause bitter friction; it is better to let sleeping dogs lie.
idioms.example_zh: 重新翻开那桩已了结的恩怨只会引起惨痛的冲突，最好还是莫惹是非，息事宁人。

idioms.meaning: 既往不咎，一笑泯恩仇
idioms.example_en: After years of estrangement, the brothers shook hands and agreed to let bygones be bygones.
idioms.example_zh: 在疏远多年后，兄弟二人握手言和，同意对往事既往不咎。

idioms.meaning: 卸下防备，尽情放松欢闹
idioms.example_en: The corporate gala was a rare occasion for the executives to let their hair down and enjoy themselves.
idioms.example_zh: 这场公司盛典是高管们难得卸下包袱、尽情欢聚放松的时刻。

idioms.meaning: 待人宽容，各行其是；宽以待人，互不干涉
idioms.example_en: I may not agree with his lifestyle choices, but my personal motto has always been to live and let live.
idioms.example_zh: 我可能不赞同他的生活方式，但我个人的座右铭历来是待人宽容、互不干涉。

idioms.meaning: 静观其变，等待事态平息/尘埃落定
idioms.example_en: Rather than making a hasty decision amidst the crisis, let's wait a week and let the dust settle.
idioms.example_zh: 与其在危机中仓促做决定，倒不如等上一周，静待事态平息。

collocations.example_en: Please let me know as soon as you have confirmed your travel itinerary.
collocations.example_zh: 一旦确认了您的出行行程，请尽早告知我。

collocations.meaning: 释放，放任；大发雷霆，纵情发泄
collocations.example_en: When the final whistle blew, the jubilant fans let loose a deafening roar across the arena.
collocations.example_zh: 终场哨声响起时，狂喜的球迷们在整个赛场上爆发出震耳欲聋的欢呼声。

collocations.meaning: 痛斥某人，狠狠训诫；痛击某人
collocations.example_en: The sergeant let the recruits have it after catching them sneaking out after curfew.
collocations.example_zh: 在抓到新兵们宵禁后偷溜出去之后，士官狠狠把他们痛斥了一顿。

collocations.example_en: Doctors advised against unnecessary invasive interventions, preferring to let nature take its course.
collocations.example_zh: 医生建议不要进行不必要的侵入性干预，主张顺其自然。

collocations.example_en: He hesitated for too long and let a once-in-a-lifetime career opportunity slip by.
collocations.example_zh: 他犹豫了太久，以致白白错失了一生难逢的职业发展良机。

collocations.meaning: 放下顾虑，抛开束缚，敞开心扉
collocations.example_en: Dancing around the campfire helped the introverted teenager finally let go of his inhibitions.
collocations.example_zh: 围着篝火起舞帮助这个内向的少年终于抛开了束缚与顾虑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以……的名字命名；给……取名以纪念
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They decided to name their second son after his grandfather.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们决定用祖父的名字给次子命名。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因……而命名；以……命名（主要用于美式英语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The university was named for the generous benefactor who funded its construction.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这所大学是以出资兴建它的慷慨捐助者的名字命名的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 任命为；指定为；指出某人/某物作为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was widely expected to be named as the next chief executive.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 大家普遍预计她会被任命为下一任首席执行官。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 任命……加入（委员会、内阁或运动队等组织）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Two local professors were named to the scientific advisory committee.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 两位本土教授被任命加入科学咨询委员会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在（遗嘱、诉讼、报道等）中列名或提及
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Several prominent politicians were named in the leaked documents.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 数名著名政客在泄露的文件中被点名提及。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 逐一点出名字；大声念出姓名
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The teacher named out the award winners one by one.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 老师逐一念出了获奖者的名字。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 记录下……的名字；登记姓名
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The officer named down everyone who entered the restricted area.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警官记下了进入限制区域的每一个人的名字。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 源自……的名字；根据……命名
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The element californium was named from the state where it was discovered.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 锎元素是以其被发现的州（加利福尼亚州）命名的。

idioms.meaning: 凡是你能说得出的；应有尽有
idioms.example_en: They had everything at the party: burgers, sushi, cocktails, you name it.
idioms.example_zh: 聚会上应有尽有：汉堡、寿司、鸡尾酒，凡是你能想到的都有。

idioms.meaning: 指名道姓；揭发涉案牵连人员的姓名
idioms.example_en: The whistleblower refused to name names during the initial investigation.
idioms.example_zh: 告密者在初步调查中拒绝指名道姓指认涉事者。

idioms.meaning: 成名；崭露头角；赢得声誉
idioms.example_en: She worked relentlessly to make a name for herself in the competitive fashion industry.
idioms.example_zh: 她在竞争激烈的时尚界拼搏努力，最终闯出了自己的名堂。

idioms.meaning: 拉大旗作虎皮；随口提及名人显赫朋友以抬高自己
idioms.example_en: He kept dropping names to impress the interview panel.
idioms.example_zh: 他不断提及名人显贵，试图给面试官留下深刻印象。

idioms.meaning: 洗刷冤屈；恢复名誉
idioms.example_en: It took him nearly five years to finally clear his name in court.
idioms.example_zh: 他花了近五年时间才最终在法庭上洗刷了罪名。

idioms.meaning: 准确叫出……的名字；明确指认出某事物
idioms.example_en: I recognized the melody immediately, but I couldn't put a name to it.
idioms.example_zh: 我立刻认出了那段旋律，但一时叫不出它的名字。

idioms.meaning: 确定结婚日期；定下吉日
idioms.example_en: After five years of engagement, they have finally named the day.
idioms.example_zh: 订婚五年后，他们终于定下了婚期。

collocations.example_en: The seller asked us to name a price for the vintage painting.
collocations.example_zh: 卖家让我们给这幅古董画开个价。

collocations.example_en: We must name a date for the upcoming shareholder meeting.
collocations.example_zh: 我们必须为即将召开的股东大会定下日期。

collocations.meaning: 指定接班人；任命继任者
collocations.example_en: The board met privately to name a successor to the retiring CEO.
collocations.example_zh: 董事会秘密开会，指定了即将退休的首席执行官的继任者。

collocations.example_en: The research wing was named in honour of the Nobel laureate.
collocations.example_zh: 该研究中心侧楼是以这位诺贝尔奖得主的名字命名的，以示敬意。

collocations.example_en: The striking workers invited management to sit down and name terms.
collocations.example_zh: 罢工工人邀请管理层坐下来开出协商条件。

collocations.meaning: 全称列出；完整拼写出某物名称
collocations.example_en: Please avoid acronyms and name each institution in full on the application.
collocations.example_zh: 在申请表上请避免使用首字母缩写，务必完整写出每个机构的名称。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因……向某人致谢；归因于/受累于（多用于反讽）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I wrote a handwritten note to thank her for the lovely dinner.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我写了一张手写便条，感谢她盛情款待的晚餐。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……归功于（好的结果）；拜……所赐/归咎于（坏的结果）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You have your own carelessness to thank for this embarrassing mistake.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 出现这种令人尴尬的错误，你只能怪你自己粗心大意。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 通过客气道谢来婉拒退出；致谢辞别
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He thanked himself out of the committee, citing personal commitments.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他以个人事务为由，客气地致谢并退出了委员会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 挨个向众人表达感谢；到处致谢
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After receiving the promotion, she went around thanking everyone on the team.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 获得晋升后，她挨个走到团队每个人面前表达谢意。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 预先致谢；在事情完成前道谢
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Thanking you ahead for your valuable time and consideration.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 预先感谢您抽出宝贵时间并给予关照。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回谢；对别人的道谢予以回应致谢
phrasal_verbs.example_en: When he praised my presentation, I thanked him back for all his help.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当他夸奖我的演讲时，我也回谢了他之前所给予的全部帮助。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 客套道谢后打发走；礼貌谢绝送别
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The manager thanked off the interviewees and promised to email the results.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经理客气地向面试者致谢并送走了他们，承诺会通过邮件通知结果。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （在致辞结尾）向台下/全场依次致谢
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The actor thanked down the entire crew before leaving the stage.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 演员在离开舞台前向台下的整个制作团队逐一致谢。

idioms.meaning: 谢天谢地；庆幸自己的好运
idioms.example_en: I thank my lucky stars every day that no one was injured in the accident.
idioms.example_zh: 我每天都谢天谢地，庆幸在那场事故中没有人受伤。

idioms.phrase: I'll thank you to do sth
idioms.meaning: 请你……（用于表示不满或警告，带有讽刺命令口吻）
idioms.example_en: I'll thank you to mind your own business and stay out of my affairs.
idioms.example_zh: 我希望你少管闲事，别插手我的私事。

idioms.meaning: 谢天谢地；幸好（表示如释重负）
idioms.example_en: Thank goodness the storm cleared up before the outdoor wedding began.
idioms.example_zh: 谢天谢地，暴风雨在户外婚礼开始前就停了。

idioms.meaning: 全怪自己；自作自受
idioms.example_en: If you fail the test after skipping classes, you have only yourself to thank.
idioms.example_zh: 要是你逃课导致考试不及格，那只能怪你自己自食其果。

idioms.meaning: 不用谢我；举手之劳何足挂齿
idioms.example_en: "No need to thank me," she replied with a smile, "anyone would have done the same."
idioms.example_zh: “不用谢我，”她微笑着回答，“换作任何人都会这么做的。”

idioms.meaning: 多谢某人；非常感谢（稍带幽默或客套色彩）
idioms.example_en: "I thank you kindly for the lift, sir," the old traveller said.
idioms.example_zh: “先生，非常感谢您让我搭便车，”那位老旅人说道。

collocations.meaning: 对某人感激不尽；感谢之情无以言表
collocations.example_en: We cannot thank the rescue team enough for saving our family.
collocations.example_zh: 我们对救援队挽救了我们一家人的性命感激不尽。

collocations.meaning: 连声向某人道谢；再三由衷致谢
collocations.example_en: The lost tourist thanked us profusely when we returned his passport.
collocations.example_zh: 迷路的游客在我们归还他的护照时连声道谢。

collocations.meaning: 预先感谢某人；提前向某人致意
collocations.example_en: Thank you in advance for your cooperation with the building inspection.
collocations.example_zh: 预先感谢您对大楼安全检查工作的配合。

collocations.example_en: The patient made a special trip to the hospital to thank the surgeon personally.
collocations.example_zh: 该患者特意去了一趟医院，当面向主刀医生致谢。

collocations.meaning: 热情真挚地向某人道谢
collocations.example_en: The host thanked the guest speaker warmly before concluding the seminar.
collocations.example_zh: 主持人在研讨会结束前热情真挚地向主讲嘉宾致谢。

collocations.meaning: 由衷地感谢某人；真诚地向某人道谢
collocations.example_en: I want to thank you sincerely for standing by me through these difficult times.
collocations.example_zh: 我想由衷地感谢你在这些艰难时刻始终陪伴在我身边。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 继续前进；转换话题/开始新活动；释怀并展开新生活
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It took her months to move on after the breakup, but she is finally happy again.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 分手后她花了数月时间才释怀，不过她终于重新快乐起来了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 搬进新居；（警察或军队）逼近并采取行动
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Our new neighbours moved in last weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们的新邻居上周末搬了进来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 搬出；迁离现住处
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her son turned eighteen and decided it was time to move out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她儿子满十八岁了，决定是时候搬出去独立生活了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 搬离原住地；背离/脱离（传统、原则或原有模式）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company is moving away from fossil fuels toward renewable energy.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该公司正在脱离化石燃料，转向可再生能源。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向前移动；推进，取得进展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We need to resolve these differences before the project can move forward.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在项目推进之前，我们需要解决这些分歧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 晋升，升职；挪动位置（腾出空间）；提高（排名或价格）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She moved up quickly through the ranks to become chief financial officer.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她快速晋升，最终成为了首席财务官。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 后退；迁回原处；推迟（时间或日期）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The crowd moved back to let the paramedics through.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 人群退后以便让急救医务人员通过。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 挪开让位；让出职位/权力以供他人接替
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Can you move over a bit so I can sit down?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你能往旁边挪一点让我坐下吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （车辆、队伍）启程出发；离去；偏离（议题）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The train blew its whistle and slowly moved off.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 火车鸣笛后缓缓驶离站台。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顺延/下移；降职，排名下滑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The team moved down two places after yesterday's defeat.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在昨天的失利后，该队的排名下滑了两位。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 包围逼近；企图抢占/夺取（控制权、市场份额或伴侣）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Rival firms were quick to move in on the bankrupt competitor's clients.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 竞争对手们迅速行动，争抢破产同行的客户资源。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 走开，勿滞留；（事情）顺利进展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The police officer told the crowd of onlookers to move along.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警察让围观的人群不要停留，继续往前走。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 四处走动；频繁搬迁/辗转各地
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Growing up in a military family, he moved around a lot as a child.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 成长在军人家庭的他，童年时期四处频繁搬家。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 进驻，迁入；涉足，打入（新行业或市场）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The tech giant is planning to move into the healthcare sector.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家科技巨头正计划进军医疗保健领域。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 取得领先；继续向前推进
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite supply chain delays, the construction will move ahead as scheduled.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管供应链受阻，施工仍将按原计划继续推进。

idioms.meaning: 采取行动；动身离开；（向某人）示爱或展开追求
idioms.example_en: If we want to secure this deal, we need to make a move now.
idioms.example_zh: 如果我们想拿下这笔交易，现在就必须采取行动。

idioms.meaning: 竭尽全力；排除万难
idioms.example_en: He promised to move heaven and earth to get her tickets to the sold-out concert.
idioms.example_zh: 他承诺会想尽一切办法为她搞到那场售罄演唱会的门票。

idioms.meaning: 改变规则；在进行中提高标准或改变目标
idioms.example_en: Every time we meet their requirements, they move the goalposts.
idioms.example_zh: 每次我们达到他们的要求，他们又改变标准刁难我们。

idioms.meaning: 与时俱进；顺应时代潮流
idioms.example_en: Traditional retailers must move with the times and embrace e-commerce.
idioms.example_zh: 传统零售商必须与时俱进，积极拥抱电子商务。

idioms.meaning: 飞黄腾达；社会地位或经济状况显著提升
idioms.example_en: Ever since his promotion, he has really been moving up in the world.
idioms.example_zh: 自从升职后，他的社会地位确实水涨船高了。

idioms.meaning: 抓紧时间；赶快
idioms.example_en: We'd better get a move on, or we'll miss our flight.
idioms.example_zh: 我们最好动作快点，否则要赶不上飞机了。

idioms.meaning: 朝正确的方向发展；有所好转
idioms.example_en: Inflation figures suggest the economy is finally moving in the right direction.
idioms.example_zh: 通胀数据表明经济终于在朝着好的方向发展。

collocations.example_en: The audience was moved to tears by the pianist's emotional performance.
collocations.example_zh: 观众被钢琴家深情动人的演奏感动得热泪盈眶。

collocations.example_en: Neither side was willing to make the first move in the peace talks.
collocations.example_zh: 在和平谈判中，双方都不愿意率先迈出第一步。

collocations.example_en: Moving house is widely considered one of the most stressful life events.
collocations.example_zh: 搬家被普遍认为是生活中最耗费心神的事情之一。

collocations.meaning: 付诸行动；开始投入运作
collocations.example_en: As soon as the alarm sounded, emergency crews moved into action.
collocations.example_zh: 警报一响，应急救援人员立刻投入行动。

collocations.meaning: 自由活动；畅通无阻地流动
collocations.example_en: After weeks in a cast, she can finally move her fingers freely.
collocations.example_zh: 打了数周石膏后，她的手指终于能够自如活动了。

collocations.example_en: The chairman moved a motion to adjourn the meeting until tomorrow morning.
collocations.example_zh: 主席提议休会，会议推迟至次日早晨继续进行。

collocations.meaning: 以某种速度移动或推进
collocations.example_en: Technological advancements are moving at a breakneck pace.
collocations.example_zh: 技术进步正以惊人的极快速度向前推进。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 指出；向某人提醒（事实、错误或信息）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The accountant pointed out several discrepancies in the financial report.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 会计指出了财务报告中的几处出入。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 指向；表明，预示；把...列为原因/证据
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All the evidence points to a deliberate system failure.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 所有证据都表明这是一起蓄意的系统故障。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （用手指、武器等）对准，指向
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It is considered rude to point at strangers in public.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在公共场合用手直指陌生人被认为是不礼貌的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 朝向；显示出...的趋势，暗示未来走向
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Recent survey results point toward a growing demand for remote work.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 近期的调查结果显示出对远程办公的需求正在增长。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 突出显示；加深表明；凸显（问题或重要性）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The latest crisis points up the urgent need for structural reform.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 最近的危机凸显了进行结构性改革的迫切需要。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 追溯到；表明其根源在于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The current friction points back to an unresolved dispute from two years ago.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 目前的摩擦追根溯源在于两年前一桩未决的纠纷。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向下指；指向下方
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The arrow on the screen pointed down, indicating a decline in sales.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 屏幕上的箭头朝下，指示着销售额出现下滑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 指向别处；使方向偏转
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Always keep the muzzle of the gun pointed away from people.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 枪口务必要始终避开人群，指向别处。

idioms.meaning: 无关紧要的；离题的，不相干的
idioms.example_en: Whether you like him or not is beside the point; he is qualified for the job.
idioms.example_zh: 你喜不喜欢他无关紧要，关键是他能胜任这份工作。

idioms.meaning: 切中要害；简明扼要
idioms.example_en: Her remarks were brief and straight to the point.
idioms.example_zh: 她的发言简短有力且切中要害。

idioms.meaning: 没抓住要领；理解错误，领会错核心意图
idioms.example_en: You completely missed the point of what I was trying to explain.
idioms.example_zh: 你完全没有领会我想表达的核心意思。

idioms.meaning: 特别注意；务必做到；特意做（某事）
idioms.example_en: He makes a point of thanking every team member individually after each project.
idioms.example_zh: 每次项目结束后，他都会特意逐一致谢每位团队成员。

idioms.meaning: 证明自己的观点正确；证明自己的能力以博取认同
idioms.example_en: She ran the marathon not for the medal, but to prove a point to herself.
idioms.example_zh: 她跑马拉松不是为了奖牌，而是为了向自己证明自己的能力。

idioms.meaning: 破例；通融，放宽限制
idioms.example_en: The manager agreed to stretch a point and accept the late application.
idioms.example_zh: 经理同意破例一次，接受了逾期的申请。

idioms.meaning: 痛处；伤心事；触及容易引人不悦的话题
idioms.example_en: Don't ask about his exam results—it's a very sore point right now.
idioms.example_zh: 别问他的考试成绩，那现在可是他的伤心事。

idioms.meaning: 在那时；在那个当口/关头
idioms.example_en: We were completely exhausted, and at that point we gave up searching.
idioms.example_zh: 我们已经筋疲力尽，就在那个关头我们放弃了搜寻。

collocations.meaning: 阐明观点；提出有说服力的意见
collocations.example_en: You make a good point, but we still have to consider the cost implications.
collocations.example_zh: 你说的很有道理，但我们仍须考虑成本方面的影响。

collocations.example_en: I take your point, but I still believe my original plan is safer.
collocations.example_zh: 我明白你的意思，但我仍然认为我最初的方案更稳妥。

collocations.meaning: 出发点；起点；讨论的基点
collocations.example_en: This draft can serve as a useful starting point for our negotiations.
collocations.example_zh: 这份草案可以作为我们谈判的一个良好起点。

collocations.example_en: Winning that scholarship proved to be a major turning point in her life.
collocations.example_zh: 获得那笔奖学金被证明是她人生的一个重大转折点。

collocations.example_en: The fireplace serves as the main focal point of the living room.
collocations.example_zh: 壁炉是客厅整体视觉的核心焦点。

collocations.example_en: Try to look at the situation from a customer's point of view.
collocations.example_zh: 试着站在客户的立场来审视这一情况。

collocations.example_en: At this point in time, we cannot confirm whether any data was leaked.
collocations.example_zh: 在目前的这个时间节点，我们无法确认是否有数据遭到泄露。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 写下，记下；（会计上）减记（资产价值）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Make sure you write down the address before you leave.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 出门前务必把地址记下来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 认定…毫无价值/失败；注销（坏账、债务）；彻底撞毁（车辆）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The bank had to write off billions in bad loans, while critics quickly wrote off the project.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 银行不得不注销数十亿坏账，而批评者也很快认定该项目彻底失败。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 详尽写出，写出全文；开具（支票、处方、单据等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The doctor wrote out a prescription for antibiotics.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 医生开了一张抗生素处方。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把…写成报道或详尽总结；（因违规而）书面记过/向上级告发某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She spent the afternoon writing up the results of the survey.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她花了一下午时间把调查结果整理成详细报告。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 致信（电视台、广播电台或报刊）；在选票上附笔提名（未印在选票上的候选人）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Thousands of viewers wrote in to complain about the controversial broadcast.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 成千上万名观众写信投诉这一极具争议的广播节目。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将（条款、条件）明确写入（法律、合同或协议中）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A non-disclosure clause was written into her employment contract.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她的雇佣合同中被写入了一条保密条款。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （通过编剧处理）把（角色）从剧情或剧本中剔除/写死
phrasal_verbs.example_en: When the actor fell ill, the writers had to write him out of the show.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当那位演员生病后，编剧们不得不将他的角色从剧中删掉。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回信，书面回复
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I sent them an inquiry last Monday, but they haven't written back yet.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我上周一给他们发了问询函，但他们至今还没回信。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 函购，写信索取（物品、资料等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He wrote away for the free university prospectus.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他写信索取了该大学的免费招生简章。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以居高临下/降尊迁就的通俗口吻迎合（读者或受众）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A good children's author never writes down to their audience.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 优秀的儿童作家从不会用居高临下的迁就态度对待小读者。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （向多家机构、个人等）群发信件征询信息
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We wrote around to all the local schools to assess the demand.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们给当地所有学校都写了信，以评估实际需求。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将某事草率归结为…；将…轻视为…
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't write the whole incident off as just a simple misunderstanding.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别把整起事件轻描淡写地归结为一场单纯的误会。

idioms.meaning: 平平常常，不值一提，没有什么特别出色的地方
idioms.example_en: The food at the new restaurant was okay, but nothing to write home about.
idioms.example_zh: 新餐馆的菜品尚可，但真没什么值得大书特书的。

idioms.meaning: （情绪、内疚或秘密等）昭然若揭，全写在脸上
idioms.example_en: Guilt was written all over his face when the manager walked in.
idioms.example_zh: 当经理走进来时，他的内疚全写在脸上了。

idioms.meaning: 开出自己的条件，自定待遇，随心所欲决定前途
idioms.example_en: With her extraordinary credentials, she can pretty much write her own ticket in the tech sector.
idioms.example_zh: 凭她过硬的资历，她在科技圈基本可以随意自开薪资待遇。

idioms.meaning: 板上钉钉，不可变更，固定不可更改
idioms.example_en: These schedule guidelines are flexible and not written in stone.
idioms.example_zh: 这些时间表安排是具有弹性的，并非板上钉钉不可更改。

idioms.meaning: 到此为止，全完了，事情彻底结束了
idioms.example_en: The engine blew up on the final lap, and that was all she wrote.
idioms.example_zh: 最后一圈时引擎爆炸了，这下彻底全完了。

idioms.meaning: 开空头支票；给予无限授权/全权支配
idioms.example_en: The government refused to write a blank check for the bailout.
idioms.example_zh: 政府拒绝为这次救助计划提供无限制的资金授权。

collocations.example_en: He pulled out his pen to write a check for the deposit.
collocations.example_zh: 他掏出钢笔开了一张押金支票。

collocations.example_en: Candidates are required to write the exam answers in blue or black ink.
collocations.example_zh: 考生须用蓝色或黑色墨水书写考试答案。

collocations.meaning: 撰写论文/报告/起草初稿
collocations.example_en: She had to write a comprehensive report before the board meeting.
collocations.example_zh: 她必须在董事会会议召开前撰写出一份详尽的报告。

collocations.example_en: Please write legibly so that our staff can read your delivery address.
collocations.example_zh: 请字迹工整清晰，以便工作人员辨认您的送货地址。

collocations.meaning: 给某人写信/发书面函件
collocations.example_en: I will write to the CEO directly regarding this unresolved dispute.
collocations.example_zh: 我将就这起尚未解决的纠纷直接致信首席执行官。

collocations.example_en: It is prudent to write a will while you are still in sound health.
collocations.example_zh: 趁身体健康时立下一份遗嘱是明智之举。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 齐心协力，组队协作，联手合作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The two research groups decided to team up to speed up vaccine development.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 两个研究小组决定联手合作，以加快疫苗的研发进程。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与…联手，与…搭档合作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The tech giant teamed up with a local startup to launch the new streaming platform.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家科技巨头与当地一家初创公司联手推出了新的流媒体平台。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与…紧密配对/联合；（与介词搭配使用表示搭档）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He will team with our senior architect on the downtown redevelopment project.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他将与我们的资深建筑师搭档负责市区重建项目。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 协同组队，联合行动
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If we all team together, we can finish painting the community center by dusk.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果我们所有人齐心协力组队干，黄昏前就能把社区活动中心粉刷完毕。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 联手共同对抗/对付（对手、困难等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Smaller retailers teamed up against the dominant e-commerce conglomerate.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 小型零售商联合起来，共同对抗占垄断地位的电商巨头。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 跨部门/跨界组建团队协作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Engineers teamed across departments to troubleshoot the persistent hardware bug.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工程师们跨部门联合协作，排查那个顽固的硬件故障。

idioms.meaning: 为集体利益做出牺牲，顾全大局受委屈
idioms.example_en: John agreed to work through the holiday, taking one for the team.
idioms.example_zh: 约翰同意在假期全程值班，为了顾全团队大局做出了牺牲。

idioms.meaning: 具有团队协作精神的人，善于与集体配合的人
idioms.example_en: In modern corporate environments, being a team player is just as crucial as technical competence.
idioms.example_zh: 在现代企业环境中，具备团队协作精神与专业技能同样至关重要。

idioms.meaning: 梦之队，最强阵容组合
idioms.example_en: The firm assembled a dream team of top trial lawyers to handle the high-profile lawsuit.
idioms.example_zh: 该事务所召集了一支由顶级诉讼律师组成的梦之队来应对这场引人注目的诉讼。

idioms.phrase: cheer for / play for the other team
idioms.meaning: （俚语/幽默）站在对立阵营；特指同性恋倾向
idioms.example_en: We realized early in the debate that he was covertly cheering for the other team.
idioms.example_zh: 在辩论初期我们就意识到，他暗中站在了对方阵营一边。

idioms.meaning: 车轮战搭档；轮流接替配合
idioms.example_en: The detectives tag-teamed the suspect throughout the night during interrogation.
idioms.example_zh: 整夜的审讯中，侦探们轮番上阵接替讯问嫌疑人。

collocations.example_en: The company organized an outdoor retreat to facilitate team building and communication.
collocations.example_zh: 公司组织了一次户外拓展，以促进团队建设与沟通。

collocations.example_en: She proved that she has the leadership capabilities required to lead a team through a crisis.
collocations.example_zh: 她证明了自己具备带领团队渡过危机所需的领导能力。

collocations.example_en: Our marketing analysts team closely with the sales reps to identify consumer trends.
collocations.example_zh: 我们的市场分析师与销售代表紧密协作，捕捉消费趋势。

collocations.example_en: We are thrilled that a brilliant data scientist has decided to join our team.
collocations.example_zh: 我们非常高兴有一位才华横溢的数据科学家决定加入我们的团队。

collocations.meaning: 团队共同努力，集体协作
collocations.example_en: Winning this prestigious contract was truly a combined team effort.
collocations.example_zh: 赢得这份重要合同确实是全体成员共同努力的成果。

collocations.example_en: The manager implemented flexible work hours to boost team morale.
collocations.example_zh: 经理推行了弹性工作制以提振团队士气。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 穿上，戴上；增加（体重）；上演，举办；涂抹
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She put on her heavy coat and stepped out into the freezing wind.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她穿上厚外套，走进了刺骨的寒风中。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 推迟，延期；使反感，使失去兴趣；使分心
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The meeting was put off until next Tuesday due to a scheduling conflict.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于日程冲突，会议被推迟到了下周二。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 忍受，容忍
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I don't know how she puts up with his constant complaining.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我真不知道她是怎么忍受他那没完没了的抱怨的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 扑灭，熄灭；出版，发布；使不便，添麻烦；生产
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Firefighters took nearly two hours to put out the blaze.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 消防员花了近两个小时才将大火扑灭。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 张贴，竖立；提供食宿；提高（价格）；建造
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They put up a tent near the river and stayed for the weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们在河边搭起帐篷度过周末。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 提出（建议、理论）；把（钟表）拨快；推荐某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Several interesting proposals were put forward at the conference.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 会上提出了几项颇有意思的提案。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 放下；写下，记下；平定，镇压；使（动物）安乐死
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Make sure you put down everything the lecturer says.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 务必把讲师说的每一句话都记下来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 收好，放回原处；储存（金钱）；把…送入精神病院或监狱
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He put away his tools after finishing the repair work.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 完成修理工作后，他把工具收拾好收了起来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为…接通电话；使经历（困难、考验）；使（法案等）获得通过
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Could you put me through to the marketing department, please?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 请帮我接通市场部好吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 放回原处；推迟；把（钟表指针）往回拨
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please put the dictionary back on the shelf when you're done.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 用完后请把词典放回书架上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 留出，储存（时间或金钱）；把…置于一旁，暂时不理会
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They try to put aside a little money each month for their vacation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们尽量每个月存一点钱作为度假基金。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 组装，装配；筹集，组织（团队、方案）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It took him all afternoon to put together the flat-pack wardrobe.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他花了一整个下午才把那个平板包装的衣柜组装好。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 投入（时间、精力）；正式提出（申请、索赔）；安装（设备）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She has put in countless hours preparing for the bar exam.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她为备考律师资格考试投入了无数个日夜。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把…表达清楚，使被理解
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He managed to put across his complex ideas in very simple terms.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他设法用非常浅显的语言把复杂的想法解释清楚了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 贬低，当众羞辱某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A good manager inspires confidence rather than putting people down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 优秀的管理者会激发自信，而不是贬低他人。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 储蓄，存蓄（备用资金）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It's always wise to have some savings put by for a rainy day.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 存一些应急资金以备不时之需向来是明智的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 散布，散播（谣言、消息）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Someone has been putting around rumors about impending layoffs.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 有人一直在四处散布即将裁员的谣言。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向某人提出（问题、建议以征询意见或求证）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The journalist put the allegations directly to the minister.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 记者直接向部长就这些指控提出了质询。

idioms.meaning: 根据现有事实推断出真相
idioms.example_en: He hadn't told anyone they were dating, but we easily put two and two together.
idioms.example_zh: 他没跟任何人提过他们在约会，但我们很容易就猜出真相了。

idioms.meaning: 坚决反对，采取强硬立场
idioms.example_en: When the kids demanded expensive phones, their father finally put his foot down.
idioms.example_zh: 当孩子们索要昂贵的手机时，父亲终于态度坚决地表示反对。

idioms.meaning: 准确指出症结所在，明确说出原因
idioms.example_en: There was something strange about his story, but I couldn't put my finger on it.
idioms.example_zh: 他的说法有些古怪，但我一时说不上来究竟不对在哪里。

idioms.phrase: put all one's eggs in one basket
idioms.meaning: 孤注一掷，把所有希望寄托于一处
idioms.example_en: Diversify your investments instead of putting all your eggs in one basket.
idioms.example_zh: 分散你的投资，不要把所有鸡蛋放在同一个篮子里。

idioms.phrase: put the cart before the horse
idioms.meaning: 本末倒置，因果倒置
idioms.example_en: Designing the marketing campaign before finishing the product is putting the cart before the horse.
idioms.example_zh: 产品还没完成就先设计营销活动，完全是本末倒置。

idioms.meaning: 让某人认清自己的地位，挫其傲气
idioms.example_en: His blunt response quickly put the arrogant newcomer in his place.
idioms.example_zh: 他直截了当的回答迅速挫伤了那个傲慢新人的锐气。

idioms.phrase: put one's cards on the table
idioms.meaning: 开诚布公，坦白交代自己的意图或底牌
idioms.example_en: Let's put our cards on the table and negotiate a fair deal.
idioms.example_zh: 我们打开天窗说亮话，谈一笔公平的交易吧。

collocations.example_en: The ceasefire agreement finally put an end to years of armed conflict.
collocations.example_zh: 停火协议终于结束了长达数年的武装冲突。

collocations.example_en: It is much harder to put these principles into practice than to preach them.
collocations.example_zh: 贯彻这些原则远比嘴上宣讲要困难得多。

collocations.example_en: Campaigners are putting pressure on the government to act immediately.
collocations.example_zh: 活动人士正向政府施压，要求其立即采取行动。

collocations.example_en: reckless driving puts innocent lives at risk.
collocations.example_zh: 鲁莽驾驶把无辜的生命置于危险境地。

collocations.example_en: She decided to put her multilingual skills to good use in diplomacy.
collocations.example_zh: 她决定在外事外交工作中充分发挥自己的多语言优势。

collocations.example_en: The new syllabus puts heavy emphasis on critical thinking skills.
collocations.example_zh: 新教学大纲重点强调批判性思维能力。

collocations.example_en: The emergency response system was put to the test during the storm.
collocations.example_zh: 应急响应系统在暴风雨期间经受了实战检验。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 朗读，宣读出声
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The clerk read out the names of the selected candidates one by one.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 办事员逐一宣读了入选候选人的名单。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从头到尾仔细阅读，通读
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Always read through the contract thoroughly before signing it.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 签字前务必将合同从头到尾仔细通读一遍。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 过目，细查，校对
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'll read over your essay tonight and give you feedback tomorrow.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我今晚会把你的论文细看一遍，明天给你反馈意见。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 过度解读，主观臆断深层含义
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't read too much into his casual comment; he was just joking.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别对他随口说的话过度解读，他只是在开玩笑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 专项研读，查阅资料深入了解
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I need to read up on local tax laws before expanding the business.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在拓展业务之前，我需要仔细查阅并了解当地的税法。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 照着念，迅速朗读（清单或数据）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The nurse read off the patient's vital signs from the monitor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 护士照着监护仪迅速读出了病人的生命体征数据。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 复诵，将记录的信息读回以核对确认
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let me read that phone number back to you to make sure I got it right.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我把电话号码给你复诵一遍，确保我没记错。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （计算机）读取数据；向…通报内情背景
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The software reads in sensor data every millisecond.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该软件每毫秒读取一次传感器数据。

idioms.meaning: 体会言外之意，读出字里行间的深意
idioms.example_en: Reading between the lines of her email, it was clear she was unhappy.
idioms.example_zh: 从她邮件的字里行间可以看出，她显然很不高兴。

idioms.meaning: 把某人的心思看得一清二楚，了如指掌
idioms.example_en: You can't fool your mother; she can read you like a book.
idioms.example_zh: 你骗不过你母亲的，她对你的心思了如指掌。

idioms.meaning: 察言观色，审时度势
idioms.example_en: He completely failed to read the room and cracked an insensitive joke during the solemn meeting.
idioms.example_zh: 他完全不懂察言观色，在庄严肃穆的会议上讲了个不合时宜的笑话。

idioms.meaning: 严厉警告，申斥，大加训斥
idioms.example_en: The coach read the players the riot act after their lackluster performance.
idioms.example_zh: 在球员们表现疲软之后，教练把他们狠狠训斥了一顿。

idioms.meaning: 把…视为理所当然，想当然地认为无需讨论
idioms.example_en: We can take it as read that everyone agrees with the core objective.
idioms.example_zh: 我们可以想当然地认为大家都赞同这项核心目标。

idioms.meaning: 引人入胜的读物，一本好书
idioms.example_en: His latest historical thriller is an exceptionally compelling read.
idioms.example_zh: 他最新的历史惊悚小说是一本极其扣人心弦的佳作。

collocations.example_en: The teacher asked the student to read the poem aloud to the class.
collocations.example_zh: 老师让该学生把这首诗大声朗读给全班同学听。

collocations.example_en: As a child, she read voraciously about astronomy and space travel.
collocations.example_zh: 孩提时代，她便如饥似渴地阅读有关天文学和太空旅行的书籍。

collocations.example_en: Scholars are expected to read widely beyond their immediate field of study.
collocations.example_zh: 学者们理应博览群书，涉猎超出自身直接研究领域的知识。

collocations.example_en: I was just about to suggest coffee—you must have read my mind!
collocations.example_zh: 我正想提议去喝咖啡呢——你准是猜透了我的心思！

collocations.phrase: read the fine print / small print
collocations.meaning: 仔细阅读附加条款/细则
collocations.example_en: Always read the fine print before agreeing to the loan conditions.
collocations.example_zh: 在同意贷款条件之前，务必仔细阅读细则条款。

collocations.meaning: 从头到尾完整读完（整本书）
collocations.example_en: The biography was so gripping that I read it from cover to cover in one sitting.
collocations.example_zh: 这本传记太引人入胜了，我一口气从头到尾读完了整本书。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 继续，坚持；唠叨不休；雇用留用
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite the rain, the players kept on running until the final whistle.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管下着雨，队员们还是继续奔跑，直到终场哨声响起。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 保持，维持（高水平/速度）；使...保持清醒；持续（好天气）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You've been doing brilliant work lately—keep it up!
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你最近工作非常出色——继续保持！

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 跟上，与...步调一致；了解（时事/技术等最新动态）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It is increasingly difficult to keep up with the fast pace of modern technology.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 要跟上现代科技的快速步伐变得越来越难。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 遵守，遵循（规则、时间表）；局限于，不偏离（主题/路线）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If we keep to the schedule, we should finish the project by Friday.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果我们严格按照日程表进行，周五前就能完成这个项目。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 远离，不靠近；避开；使...避开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Parents should keep dangerous cleaning chemicals away from small children.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 家长应让年幼儿童远离危险的清洁化学用品。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 隐瞒，保留（信息）；阻挡，阻止上前；克制（泪水/情感）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Police used barricades to keep the protesters back from the entrance.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警察设置了路障，以阻止抗议者接近入口。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 压低（声音）；控制，抑制（成本/通胀）；咽下（食物等不吐出来）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please keep your voice down; the baby is finally asleep.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 请小点声，宝宝终于睡着了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 不接近，勿践踏；避开（特定话题）；禁食，戒除（烟酒等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sign in the botanical garden clearly warns visitors to keep off the grass.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 植物园里的告示牌明确提醒游客请勿践踏草坪。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 阻止进入；把...关在外面；留在外面
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Heavy blackout curtains are used to keep out the harsh morning sunlight.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 厚重的遮光窗帘被用来阻挡清晨刺眼的阳光。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 置身事外，不卷入（纠纷、麻烦等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I try to keep out of office politics whenever possible.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我尽量不卷入办公室政治。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抑制，忍住（情感）；把...留在室内；罚（学生）留校
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The teacher decided to keep the unruly students in after school.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 老师决定放学后把那些不听话的学生留下来罚站。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 阻止，抑制；隐瞒（某事不让某人知道）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She could hardly keep from laughing at his ridiculous costume.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 看到他那滑稽的装扮，她几乎忍不住笑了出来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 坚持做，不懈努力于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Learning a new language is difficult at first, but keep at it and you will improve.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 刚开始学一门外语很困难，但只要坚持下去你就会进步。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 不与他人交往，独处；对（某事）守口如瓶，保守秘密
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He is quite introverted and prefers to keep to himself most weekends.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他非常内向，大多数周末都宁愿独自一人待着。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 保留在身边，留在近处随时备用
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I always keep a flashlight around in case of sudden power outages.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我总是在手边备着一个手电筒，以防突然停电。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 保持领先地位，保持优势
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Continuous innovation is the only way for the company to keep ahead of its competitors.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 持续创新是这家公司在竞争对手面前保持领先地位的唯一途径。

idioms.meaning: 密切注意，留意，照看
idioms.example_en: Could you please keep an eye on my luggage while I go to the restroom?
idioms.example_zh: 我去洗手间时，你能帮我照看一下行李吗？

idioms.meaning: 祈求好运，希望一切顺利
idioms.example_en: I'm keeping my fingers crossed that the interview goes well tomorrow.
idioms.example_zh: 我祈祷明天的面试一切顺利。

idioms.meaning: 绷着脸不笑，强忍住笑意
idioms.example_en: It was impossible to keep a straight face after his hilarious blunder.
idioms.example_zh: 在他闹出那个搞笑的大乌龙后，谁也憋不住笑了。

idioms.meaning: 随时向某人通报最新进展/情况
idioms.example_en: I'm waiting for the lab results, and I'll keep you posted as soon as they arrive.
idioms.example_zh: 我正在等化验结果，一出来我就会随时向你通报。

idioms.meaning: 使某人保持高度警惕，让人不敢松懈
idioms.example_en: The unpredictable pop quizzes are designed to keep the students on their toes.
idioms.example_zh: 难以预测的突击测验旨在让学生们时刻保持警觉不敢懈怠。

idioms.meaning: 保持乐观，不气馁，振作精神
idioms.example_en: Keep your chin up; things are bound to get better soon.
idioms.example_zh: 振作起来，情况很快就会好转的。

idioms.meaning: 密切监视，记录核查...的行踪或动向
idioms.example_en: The manager uses modern software to keep tabs on project milestones.
idioms.example_zh: 经理使用现代软件来密切跟进项目的各个里程碑。

collocations.meaning: 铭记于心，牢记，考虑在内
collocations.example_en: Keep in mind that prices are subject to change without prior notice.
collocations.example_zh: 请牢记，价格如有更改，恕不另行通知。

collocations.meaning: 记录，掌握...的线索/最新信息
collocations.example_en: I use a budgeting app to keep track of my daily expenses.
collocations.example_zh: 我使用记账软件来记录并掌握我每天的花销。

collocations.phrase: keep a promise / keep one's word
collocations.example_en: He earned everyone's trust because he always keeps his word.
collocations.example_zh: 他赢得了所有人的信任，因为他总是言出必行。

collocations.example_en: Even after graduating, the roommates promised to keep in touch regularly.
collocations.example_zh: 即使在毕业后，室友们也承诺会经常保持联系。

collocations.meaning: 保持冷静，控制脾气不发火
collocations.example_en: It was difficult to keep his temper when provoked so rudely.
collocations.example_zh: 遭到如此粗鲁的挑衅，要抑制住怒火确实很难。

collocations.example_en: Thank you for staying behind to keep me company while I finished the report.
collocations.example_zh: 谢谢你留下来陪我完成这份报告。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 最终到达；最终落得...下场；结果是（后接形容词、介词短语或动名词）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If you drive recklessly like that, you will end up in hospital.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你那样莽撞驾驶，最终会落得进医院的下场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以...告终，导致...结果（常接 failure, disaster, a draw 等结果词）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The negotiations ended in a stalemate after neither side was willing to compromise.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于双方都不愿妥协，谈判最终以僵局告终。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以...结束，以...收尾（指最后的组成部分或形式）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The classical concert ended with a breathtaking performance of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 音乐会以震撼人心的贝多芬第九交响曲演奏作为压轴落幕。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使彻底结束，画上句号；收尾
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We ended off the evening with a round of drinks and cheerful conversation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们在饮酒畅谈中为这个愉快的夜晚画上了句号。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 最终得到，最终面临（意外或不愿看到的结局）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I went out just to buy bread and ended up with a basket full of snacks.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我本来只是出门买个面包，结果却拎回了一整篮零食。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 最终以做某事结束，最后做了某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After hours of heated debate, they ended by agreeing on a joint statement.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经过数小时的激烈争论，他们最终达成一致并发表了联合声明。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 最终沦为；最终成为（某种身份或状态）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What started as a modest local startup ended up as a multinational corporation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当初一家不起眼的本土初创公司，最终成长为一家跨国企业。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （名词化短语动词）至高无上之物，决定性因素（常用于 the be-all and end-all）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Getting into an elite college is important, but it is not the be-all and end-all of life.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 进入顶尖大学固然重要，但这绝不是人生的全部与终极目的。

idioms.meaning: 量入为出，使收支平衡，维持生计
idioms.example_en: Many families are working multiple jobs just to make ends meet in this economy.
idioms.example_zh: 在当前的经济形势下，许多家庭身兼数职仅仅是为了勉强维持生计。

idioms.phrase: at the end of the day
idioms.meaning: 归根结底，说到底，到头来
idioms.example_en: At the end of the day, client satisfaction is the only metric that truly matters.
idioms.example_zh: 说到底，客户满意度才是唯一真正重要的衡量指标。

idioms.meaning: 智穷才尽，束手无策，走投无路
idioms.example_en: I'm at my wit's end trying to figure out why this computer program keeps crashing.
idioms.example_zh: 我实在想不通为什么这个电脑程序老是崩溃，已经束手无策了。

idioms.phrase: burn the candle at both ends
idioms.meaning: 起早贪黑，过度透支精力，过度操劳
idioms.example_en: You will ruin your health if you keep burning the candle at both ends.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你继续这样起早贪黑过度透支，身体迟早会垮掉的。

idioms.phrase: light at the end of the tunnel
idioms.meaning: 隧道尽头的亮光；（困境中）苦尽甘来的希望，曙光
idioms.example_en: After months of painful medical treatments, she can finally see the light at the end of the tunnel.
idioms.example_zh: 经过数月痛苦的治疗后，她终于看到了康复的曙光。

idioms.meaning: 遥遥无期，看不到尽头
idioms.example_en: With the rain pouring relentlessly, there was no end in sight to the delays.
idioms.example_zh: 大雨倾盆而下，航班延误看起来遥遥无期。

idioms.meaning: 尽到自己的职责，不甘示弱，独当一面
idioms.example_en: In a team effort, every member is expected to hold their end up.
idioms.example_zh: 在团队合作中，每位成员都应当恪尽职守、各司其职。

collocations.example_en: The long era of rapid economic growth has finally come to an end.
collocations.example_zh: 经济高速增长的漫长时代终于画上了句号。

collocations.example_en: The government introduced strict laws to put an end to illegal poaching.
collocations.example_zh: 政府出台了严厉的法律，以彻底杜绝非法偷猎行为。

collocations.example_en: The signing of the peace treaty brought the decades-long war to an end.
collocations.example_zh: 和平条约的签署使这场长达数十年的战争走向了终结。

collocations.meaning: 结束一段感情关系/婚姻
collocations.example_en: They mutually decided to end their marriage on amicable terms.
collocations.example_zh: 他们和平商定，以友好的方式结束彼此的婚姻。

collocations.meaning: 以灾难/失败收场，惨淡告终
collocations.example_en: The ill-conceived military expedition ended in total disaster.
collocations.example_zh: 这次谋划不周的军事远征最终以彻底的灾难惨淡收场。

collocations.example_en: As the fiscal year drew near the end, departments rushed to balance their books.
collocations.example_zh: 随着财政年度临近尾声，各部门纷纷抓紧结清账目。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 变成；换上（衣服）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Caterpillars change into butterflies, just as she changed into dry clothes after the storm.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 毛毛虫会蜕变成蝴蝶，正如暴风雨后她换上了干爽的衣服。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 脱下换掉（衣服）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Give me five minutes to change out of my work uniform.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 给我五分钟把工作制服换下来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 彻底转变；切换（系统、方式或班次）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The hospital will change over to a fully digital records system next month.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 医院下个月将彻底切换为全数字化病历系统。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 重新安排；调换（家具位置、顺序等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We changed around the furniture in the living room to create more space.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们重新挪动了客厅的家具，以腾出更多空间。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 变回原样；换回（原本的衣服、货币等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He changed back into his casual jeans as soon as the wedding was over.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 婚礼一结束，他就立刻换回了舒适的牛仔裤。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （驾驶车辆时）换低速挡
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You need to change down before going up this steep hill.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 爬上这个陡坡前，你得换到低速挡。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （驾驶时）换高速挡；做出改变/调整（以提高效果）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The coach decided to change up the team's defensive strategy for the second half.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教练决定在下半场调整球队的防守策略。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 轮流；交替替换
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The drivers changed off every two hours during the cross-country trip.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在横跨全国的公路旅行中，司机们每两小时轮换一次。

idioms.meaning: 改变主意；改变想法
idioms.example_en: She was planning to study law, but she changed her mind at the last moment.
idioms.example_zh: 她本打算学法律，但在最后一刻改变了主意。

idioms.meaning: 态度改变；回心转意
idioms.example_en: The landlord had a change of heart and decided to extend our lease.
idioms.example_zh: 房东回心转意，决定延长我们的租约。

idioms.meaning: （因情势变化）彻底改变口风或态度
idioms.example_en: He opposed the project until he saw the budget, and then he quickly changed his tune.
idioms.example_zh: 他原本反对这个项目，但一看到预算就立刻改了口风。

idioms.meaning: （财产、公司等）易主；转手
idioms.example_en: The historic manor has changed hands several times over the past century.
idioms.example_zh: 过去一个世纪里，这座历史悠久的庄园已经多次易主。

idioms.meaning: 换换节奏；调节一下生活/工作状态
idioms.example_en: Working from home once a week provides a welcome change of pace.
idioms.example_zh: 每周在家办公一天是调节工作节奏的不错方式。

idioms.meaning: 换汤不换药；以不同方式变换花样
idioms.example_en: You can ring the changes on this simple recipe by adding different herbs.
idioms.example_zh: 你可以在这道简单食谱中加入不同的香草，变出新花样。

idioms.meaning: 别老调重弹；换个话题（常用于表示厌烦）
idioms.example_en: Stop complaining about the weather and change the record!
idioms.example_zh: 别老抱怨天气了，换个话题吧！

collocations.example_en: His health took a sudden change for the worse over the weekend.
collocations.example_zh: 周末他的健康状况突然恶化。

collocations.example_en: Whenever I ask about his finances, he immediately changes the subject.
collocations.example_zh: 每当我问起他的财务状况，他就立刻岔开话题。

collocations.meaning: 与某人调换位置；与某人易地而处
collocations.example_en: Nobody in their right mind would want to change places with the prime minister right now.
collocations.example_zh: 眼下头脑清醒的人谁都不想与首相换位处之。

collocations.meaning: 做出改变；（以 It makes a change 开头）真难得/换个样真好
collocations.example_en: It makes a pleasant change to see the sun after weeks of rain.
collocations.example_zh: 连绵阴雨数周后终于见到太阳，真是让人心情舒畅。

collocations.example_en: When direct criticism failed, the manager decided to change tack and offer encouragement.
collocations.example_zh: 当直接批评无济于事时，经理决定改变策略，转而给予鼓励。

collocations.meaning: 转变方向；转变人生/事业轨迹
collocations.example_en: After twenty years in banking, she changed direction and opened a bakery.
collocations.example_zh: 在银行业工作二十年后，她转变了职业方向，开了一家面包店。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 导致；引起；通往（某处）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Careless driving often leads to accidents, just as this narrow trail leads to the summit.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 粗心驾驶往往导致事故，正如这条狭窄的小径通往山顶。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 作为…的先导；逐渐引向（某个关键事件或话题）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The documentary details the tense political climate leading up to the war.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这部纪录片详述了导致战争爆发前夕的紧张政治局势。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 哄骗（使抱有虚假希望）；带领…继续前行
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She realized too late that he was just leading her on and had no intention of marrying.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她意识到得太晚了，他只是在吊她胃口，根本没有结婚的打算。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 带头发起；以…开始
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The chairman led off the meeting with a summary of the quarterly profits.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 主席以季度利润总结拉开了会议的序幕。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把…引开；押走
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The suspect was handcuffed and led away by the police officers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 嫌疑人被戴上手铐，由警官押解离开。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 引入；过渡到（下一部分）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The guitar solo smoothly leads into the final chorus of the song.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 吉他独奏丝滑地过渡到了歌曲的最后一段副歌。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 领出；带头退场；（骑行或赛跑中）为冲刺选手领骑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The captain led out the players onto the pitch before fifty thousand fans.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 队长带领队员们走入五万名球迷瞩目的球场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 追溯到；引回到（原本的根源或地点）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All the clues in the fraud case eventually led back to an offshore account.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这桩欺诈案的所有线索最终都指向了一个离岸账户。

idioms.meaning: 牵着某人的鼻子走；彻底操纵某人
idioms.example_en: He is so gullible that his business partner leads him by the nose in every deal.
idioms.example_zh: 他太轻信他人了，以至于生意合伙人在每笔交易中都牵着他的鼻子走。

idioms.meaning: 引路；走在前面；树立榜样/处于领跑地位
idioms.example_en: The company has led the way in developing renewable energy solutions.
idioms.example_zh: 该公司在开发可再生能源解决方案方面始终处于领跑地位。

idioms.phrase: lead sb up the garden path
idioms.meaning: 故意误导；欺骗某人
idioms.example_en: Consumers were led up the garden path by false claims in the advertisement.
idioms.example_zh: 消费者被广告中的虚假宣传彻底误导了。

idioms.meaning: 过双重生活
idioms.example_en: It turned out that the mild-mannered accountant was leading a double life as a master thief.
idioms.example_zh: 事实证明，这位举止温和的会计师竟然过着大盗的暗地双重生活。

idioms.meaning: 身先士卒；以身作则树立榜样
idioms.example_en: A good manager should lead from the front during challenging crises.
idioms.example_zh: 优秀的管理者在面临危机挑战时应当身先士卒。

idioms.meaning: 处于领头羊地位；在竞争中拔得头筹
idioms.example_en: With its innovative camera technology, the smartphone brand continues to lead the pack.
idioms.example_zh: 凭借创新的摄像技术，该智能手机品牌继续在行业中领跑。

idioms.meaning: 过着牛马不如的生活；日子困苦悲惨
idioms.example_en: Under the tyranny of the cruel boss, the factory workers led a dog's life.
idioms.example_zh: 在那位残酷老板的暴政下，工厂工人们过着牛马不如的生活。

collocations.example_en: Great leaders inspire others by leading by example rather than just giving orders.
collocations.example_zh: 伟大的领导者通过以身作则而非仅仅发号施令来激励他人。

collocations.example_en: Even in her eighties, my grandmother continues to lead an active life.
collocations.example_zh: 即使到了八十多岁，我祖母依然过着活力充沛的生活。

collocations.example_en: A senior detective was appointed to lead the murder investigation.
collocations.example_zh: 一名资深侦探被指派主持这起谋杀案的调查工作。

collocations.example_en: Our team took the lead in the second quarter and held it until the final whistle.
collocations.example_zh: 我们队在第二节取得领先，并将优势一直保持到终场哨声吹响。

collocations.meaning: 把某人引上歧途；误导某人
collocations.example_en: The teenager was led astray by older kids who were involved in petty theft.
collocations.example_zh: 这名青少年被涉嫌小偷小摸的大龄孩子引上了歧途。

collocations.example_en: She managed to hold the lead throughout the entire marathon.
collocations.example_zh: 她在整场马拉松比赛中都成功保持了领先地位。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用完，耗尽；（合同、协议等）到期，失效
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We've run out of milk, and my gym membership runs out at the end of the month.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们的牛奶喝完了，而且我的健身会员卡月底也要到期了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 偶遇，意外碰到；撞上（车辆或障碍物）；陷入（困境、麻烦）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I ran into an old classmate yesterday right after our project ran into serious budget problems.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 昨天我们的项目刚陷入严重的预算困境，随后我就偶遇了一位老同学。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 偶然碰见（某人）；偶然发现（某物）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: While cleaning the attic, she ran across a stack of love letters from the 1950s.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在打扫阁楼时，她偶然翻出了一叠20世纪50年代的情书。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 逃跑，离家出走；逃避，回避（问题、责任）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You cannot keep running away from your responsibilities whenever things get tough.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 每当事情变棘手时，你不能总是一味地逃避自己的责任。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 追赶，追逐；追求（某人）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He had to run after the bus, but nowadays he spends most of his time running after wealthy clients.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他不得不去追公交车，不过如今他大部分时间都在追逐有钱的客户。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （车辆）碾过，撞倒；（液体）溢出；超时；快速过一遍
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The meeting ran over by twenty minutes because we had to run over the safety checklist again.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 会议超时了二十分钟，因为我们不得不把安全检查清单重新快速过一遍。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 快速过一遍，排练；贯穿，充斥；挥霍，耗尽（金钱）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's run through the presentation once more before the anxiety running through the team worsens.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在团队蔓延的焦虑加剧之前，我们再把演示文稿完整过一遍吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （动力、电池）耗尽；撞倒；批评，贬低；逐步减少，削减
phrasal_verbs.example_en: My phone battery has completely run down, and stop running down your colleagues behind their backs.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我的手机完全没电了；另外，别再在背后贬低你的同事了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 积欠，累积（债务、账单）；迅速升起（旗帜）；匆忙缝制
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He ran up enormous credit card debts while living beyond his means in London.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在伦敦过着入不敷出的生活，欠下了巨额信用卡债务。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 遭遇，面临（困难、阻力、竞争对手）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The new environmental policy ran up against fierce opposition from local manufacturers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这项新环保政策遭遇了当地制造商的强烈反对。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （时间）继续，拖长；以……为动力，靠……运转；喋喋不休
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Electric cars run on batteries, but this debate has been running on for hours without a conclusion.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 电动汽车依靠电池驱动，但这争论已经持续拖延数小时仍无定论。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 迅速跑开；复印，印制；流走；与某人私奔 (run off with)
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Could you run off twenty copies of the agenda before the participants run off?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在参会者散去之前，你能复印二十份议程吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 试车，磨合（新引擎/机器）；顺道走访；逮捕（非正式）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You should drive at moderate speeds for the first thousand miles to run the new engine in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 最初的一千英里内你应该中速行驶，以便磨合新引擎。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抛弃，遗弃（家庭、伴侣或需要帮助的人）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He walked out of the house and ran out on his wife and three young children.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他走出家门，抛弃了他的妻子和三个年幼的孩子。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 走开，离开（常用于温和地吩咐儿童离开）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Run along now, kids; the adults need to discuss private family matters.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 孩子们，现在先去一边玩吧；大人们需要商量私人的家庭事务。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向某人征求意见，把……讲给某人听 (run sth by sb)
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'd like to run a few new marketing ideas by you before tomorrow's executive meeting.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在明天的管理层会议之前，我想先把几个新的营销想法拿来听听你的意见。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 四处奔波，忙得团团转；（儿童）到处乱跑打闹
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I've been running around all morning trying to finalize the contracts and book flights.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我一整个上午都在忙得团团转，敲定合同并预订航班。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 倒带，回放（音频/视频）；开车送某人返回
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Can you run that surveillance tape back so we can identify the suspect's vehicle?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你能把那段监控录像倒回去重放一下吗，以便我们辨认嫌疑人的车辆？

idioms.meaning: 精疲力竭，失去势头或动力
idioms.example_en: After five consecutive hours of intense negotiations, both parties seemed to run out of steam.
idioms.example_zh: 在连续进行了五个小时的紧张谈判后，双方似乎都筋疲力尽、没了后劲。

idioms.meaning: （特征、才华或疾病）世代相传，家族遗传
idioms.example_en: Musical talent runs in their family; every single child plays at least one instrument well.
idioms.example_zh: 音乐天赋是他们家族世代相传的；每个孩子都至少精通一种乐器。

idioms.meaning: 管理严格，纪律严明
idioms.example_en: The new headmistress runs a tight ship, ensuring every teacher adheres to the strict schedule.
idioms.example_zh: 新任女校长治校极严，确保每位老师都严格遵守时间表。

idioms.meaning: 从长远来看，终究
idioms.example_en: Investing in high-quality equipment may seem expensive now, but it will save money in the long run.
idioms.example_zh: 现在投资高品质设备看似昂贵，但从长远来看能够节省资金。

idioms.meaning: 冒着……的风险
idioms.example_en: If you skip the testing phase, you run the risk of releasing a defective software update.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你跳过测试环节，就会冒着发布有缺陷软件更新的风险。

idioms.meaning: 普通的，平淡无奇的，乏善可陈的
idioms.example_en: It wasn't an extraordinary movie, just a run-of-the-mill romantic comedy.
idioms.example_zh: 那并不是一部特别出彩的电影，只是一部平淡无奇的浪漫喜剧。

idioms.meaning: 远胜于某人，把某人耍得团团转
idioms.example_en: In debates, she easily runs circles around her opponents thanks to her sharp legal mind.
idioms.example_zh: 在辩论中，凭借敏锐的法律思维，她可以轻而易举地把对手驳得毫无还手之力。

collocations.example_en: Running a small business requires not only capital but also relentless dedication.
collocations.example_zh: 经营一家小企业不仅需要资金，还需要不懈的投入与专注。

collocations.example_en: The lab technicians will run several diagnostic tests on the blood samples today.
collocations.example_zh: 实验室技术人员今天将对这些血液样本进行几项诊断测试。

collocations.example_en: The child woke up crying in the middle of the night and was running a high fever.
collocations.example_zh: 孩子半夜哭着醒来，发着高烧。

collocations.example_en: I'm terribly sorry for running late; my commuter train was delayed by signal failures.
collocations.example_zh: 非常抱歉我迟到了，我坐的通勤火车因为信号故障延误了。

collocations.example_en: I have to spend my Saturday afternoon running errands like grocery shopping and picking up dry cleaning.
collocations.example_zh: 我周六下午得用来跑腿办杂务，比如买菜和取干洗的衣服。

collocations.meaning: （情感、信念、传统等）根深蒂固，刻骨铭心
collocations.example_en: Rivalry between the two neighboring cities runs deep and dates back several centuries.
collocations.example_zh: 这两座相邻城市之间的对抗根深蒂固，可以追溯到几个世纪之前。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 争取过来，赢得……的好感与支持
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His articulate presentation and genuine passion won over even the most skeptical investors.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他清晰流畅的陈述和由衷的热情赢得了即使是最持怀疑态度的投资者的支持。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 赢回，夺回，重获（信任、市场、失地）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company launched an aggressive marketing campaign to win back its lost market share.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该公司发起了一场攻势猛烈的营销活动，以夺回失去的市场份额。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 最终战胜，克服困难后获胜，占上风
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Although there was intense internal debate, common sense finally won out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管内部争论激烈，常识和理性最终还是占了上风。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 渡过难关，克服艰难困苦最终成功
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite facing severe financial hardships and supply shortages, the startup managed to win through.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管面临严重的财务困境和供应短缺，这家初创企业还是成功渡过了难关。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 说服，使转变观念，赢得赞同（英式常用）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her parents were initially strictly opposed to the marriage, but she gradually won them round.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 起初她的父母极力反对这桩婚事，但她逐渐说服了他们并获得了认同。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从……处赢取（钱财或奖品）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He boasted that he had won fifty dollars off his colleague in a poker match last night.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他吹嘘说昨晚在扑克牌比赛中从同事那里赢了五十美元。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将（客户、拥护者等）从竞争对手处争取/抢夺过来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: By offering substantial price cuts, the retailer won many regular customers away from its rival.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 通过大幅降价，该零售商从竞争对手那里抢走了许多常客。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 战胜，压倒（对手或负面情绪）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In the final set of the championship, her mental resilience won out over her opponent's raw power.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在冠军赛的最后一盘中，她的心理韧性战胜了对手的纯蛮力。

idioms.meaning: 轻而易举地获胜，毫无悬念地赢得
idioms.example_en: Given her remarkable experience, she won the mayoral election hands down.
idioms.example_zh: 鉴于她卓越的资历与经验，她轻而易举地赢得了市长选举。

idioms.meaning: 获得最终胜利，取得成功
idioms.example_en: It was their team's superior endurance and disciplined defense that ultimately won the day.
idioms.example_zh: 正是该团队出色的耐力和纪律严明的防守最终锁定了胜局。

idioms.meaning: 赢得某人的芳心，博得某人的喜爱
idioms.example_en: With his warm sense of humor and attentiveness, he quickly won her heart.
idioms.example_zh: 凭借温暖的幽默感和体贴入微，他迅速赢得了她的芳心。

idioms.meaning: 人生不可能事事如意，胜败乃家常便饭（安慰他人）
idioms.example_en: Don't be too disheartened by losing this single contract; you can't win them all.
idioms.example_zh: 不要因为失去这一份合同就太沮丧；胜败乃兵家常事，不可能事事顺心。

idioms.meaning: 立功立业，崭露头角，确立自己的地位与声誉
idioms.example_en: He won his spurs as a fearless foreign correspondent covering conflicts across the Middle East.
idioms.example_zh: 他作为一名无畏的战地记者报道中东冲突，从而确立了自己的行业声誉。

idioms.meaning: 不论输赢，无论成败
idioms.example_en: Win or lose, we should be proud of having given everything we had on the pitch.
idioms.example_zh: 不论输赢，我们都应该为自己在球场上拼尽全力而感到自豪。

collocations.example_en: Her debut novel won several prestigious literary awards within months of release.
collocations.example_zh: 她的处女作小说在出版数月内便赢得了数个极具声望的文学奖项。

collocations.example_en: The incumbent governor won the election by an unexpectedly wide margin.
collocations.example_zh: 现任州长以出人意料的巨大优势赢得了大选。

collocations.example_en: The infrastructure proposal must win parliamentary approval before funds can be released.
collocations.example_zh: 这项基础设施方案必须在获得议会批准后才能拨付资金。

collocations.example_en: The engineering consortium successfully won the multimillion-dollar railway construction contract.
collocations.example_zh: 该工程财团成功赢得了这项价值数百万美元的铁路建设合同。

collocations.example_en: Over three decades, the hospital has won an international reputation for cardiac surgery.
collocations.example_zh: 三十多年来，该医院在心脏外科手术领域赢得了国际声誉。

collocations.example_en: The newly appointed CEO worked tirelessly to win the confidence of skeptical shareholders.
collocations.example_zh: 新任命的首席执行官不知疲倦地工作，以赢得多疑股东们的信任。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 达到，符合（期望、标准、诺言）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sequel failed to live up to the high expectations of the audience.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这部续集未能达到观众的高度期望。
