phrasal_verbs.meaning: 依靠（特定金钱或食物）生活；（名声、记忆等）继续存在，流传
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They had to live on bread and water during the siege, but their spirit lives on.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 围城期间他们不得不靠面包和水度日，但他们的精神永存。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 忍受，容忍（难以改变的局面）；与……同居
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He couldn't change the diagnosis, so he had to learn to live with it.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他无法改变诊断结果，因此只能学会坦然接受它。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 度过，经历（艰难时期、灾难等考验）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: My grandparents lived through two world wars and the Great Depression.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我的祖父母经历过两次世界大战和大萧条。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 洗刷，让人忘掉（过去的过失或耻辱）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If you make such a silly mistake on stage, you will never live it down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你在舞台上犯了这么愚蠢的错误，你将永远洗刷不掉这个笑柄。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 靠……供养/啃老；依赖（积蓄或他人）过活
phrasal_verbs.example_en: At thirty-five, he was still living off his elderly parents.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他都三十五岁了，还在靠年迈的父母供养。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 实现（梦想）；度过（余生）；（佣人或雇员）住在雇主家外
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She went to Hollywood determined to live out her wildest dreams.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她去了好莱坞，决心实现自己最狂野的梦想。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 遵循（某种原则或信条）；靠（某种手段）谋生
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Integrity is the core value that our family has always lived by.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 正直是我们家族一直恪守的核心原则。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为……而活；视……为生命中最重要的事情
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He completely lives for his music and cares little about worldly possessions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他完全为音乐而活，对世俗名利漠不关心。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 住在工作场所（如寄宿制保姆、医生等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The wealthy couple hired a full-time live-in nanny to take care of the triplets.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这对富有的夫妇雇了一位全职住家保姆来照顾三胞胎。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 同居；共同生活
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They decided to live together for a year before getting married.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们决定在结婚前先同居一年。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 重新经历；重温（过去的体验）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In her quiet moments, she would live over the happiest days of her youth.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在宁静的时刻，她总会重温年轻时那些最幸福的时光。

idioms.meaning: 尽情狂欢，纵情享乐
idioms.example_en: After winning the lottery, they went to Las Vegas to live it up.
idioms.example_zh: 中彩票之后，他们去拉斯维加斯尽情享乐了一番。

idioms.meaning: 待人宽容，各行其是（包容他人的不同生活方式）
idioms.example_en: I don't agree with their lifestyle, but I believe in live and let live.
idioms.example_zh: 我并不认同他们的生活方式，但我主张宽以待人、互不干涉。

idioms.meaning: 过着勉强度日、朝不保夕的生活
idioms.example_en: Without a steady income, the family was forced to live hand to mouth.
idioms.example_zh: 没有稳定的收入，这一家人不得不勉强糊口度日。

idioms.meaning: 活一天算一天；时日无多；大难不死而苟活
idioms.example_en: Since surviving the plane crash, he felt he was living on borrowed time.
idioms.example_zh: 自从空难幸存以来，他觉得自己多活的每一天都是赚来的。

idioms.meaning: 过着自欺欺人、掩盖真相的虚伪生活
idioms.example_en: She could no longer bear to live a lie and finally told her family the truth.
idioms.example_zh: 她再也无法忍受这种自欺欺人的生活，终于向家人坦白了真相。

idioms.meaning: 形影不离；过于密切以致缺乏个人空间
idioms.example_en: Sharing a tiny studio made them feel like they were living in each other's pockets.
idioms.example_zh: 挤在一间狭小的单身公寓里，让他们觉得彼此毫无隐私和个人空间。

collocations.example_en: Financial advisors urge young workers to live within their means.
collocations.example_zh: 理财顾问敦促年轻工薪族要量入为出。

collocations.example_en: Relying on multiple credit cards led him to live beyond his means.
collocations.example_zh: 依靠多张信用卡透支导致他陷入了入不敷出的生活。

collocations.example_en: Civilians in the conflict zone have to live in fear every day.
collocations.example_zh: 冲突地区的平民每天都不得不生活在恐惧之中。

collocations.example_en: The secret agent lived a double life as a quiet bookstore owner.
collocations.example_zh: 这名特工过着双重生活，表面上是一家书店的沉静店主。

collocations.meaning: 死里逃生，幸存下来讲述经历
collocations.example_en: The storm was devastating, but luckily all the crew lived to tell the tale.
collocations.example_zh: 暴风雨极具毁灭性，但幸运的是所有船员都大难不死。

collocations.meaning: 和平与和睦地共处生活
collocations.example_en: The treaty allowed both communities to live in peace and harmony.
collocations.example_zh: 该条约使两个族群得以和平与睦邻共处。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在……方面教育、训练（某人）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He had been carefully schooled in diplomacy from an early age.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他自幼便接受了严格的外交礼仪训练。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 严格约束自己做……；强迫自己适应……
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She schooled herself to remain completely calm during cross-examinations.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她强迫自己在交叉盘问时保持绝对镇定。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 训练/调教某人做某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The trainer schooled the young horse to obey voice commands.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 驯马师训练这匹小马听从口令指示。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （鱼群等海洋生物）聚集成群游动
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Herring naturally school together to confuse larger predators.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 鲱鱼天生聚集游动，以迷惑体型更大的捕食者。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 通过教导使某人改掉（坏习惯或粗鄙举止）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her mentor patiently schooled her out of her reckless impulses.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她的导师耐心地引导她戒掉了鲁莽冲动的毛病。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 进修；系统提升知识或专业技能
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Before taking the management exam, he spent months schooling up on corporate law.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在参加管理层考核之前，他花了几个月专门进修公司法。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……调教成……；训练使之养成（特定思维或行为模式）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Recruits are rigorously schooled into reflexive discipline.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 新兵接受严格的训练，形成本能的纪律性。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 严厉教训/申斥某人；（在辩论或竞技中）完胜并给对方上一课
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The veteran lawyer thoroughly schooled down the arrogant opponent in court.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那位资深律师在法庭上彻底给傲慢的对手好好上了一课。

idioms.meaning: 思想学派；某种特定观点流派
idioms.example_en: There is a prominent school of thought advocating for lower corporate taxes.
idioms.example_zh: 有一个著名的思想流派主张降低企业税率。

idioms.meaning: 老派的；守旧的；具有传统道德风尚的
idioms.example_en: The professor is a gentleman of the old school who still writes letters with a fountain pen.
idioms.example_zh: 教授是位老派的绅士，至今仍坚持用钢笔写信。

idioms.meaning: 社会大学；艰难挫折的生活历练
idioms.example_en: He never attended college; everything he learned came from the school of hard knocks.
idioms.example_zh: 他从未上过大学，他所有的本事都是在社会的摸爬滚打中学来的。

idioms.meaning: 揭丑，搬弄是非；泄露内部秘密
idioms.example_en: I don't mean to tell tales out of school, but Mark was the one who leaked the memo.
idioms.example_zh: 我不想在背后说人闲话，但那份备忘录确实是马克泄露出去的。

idioms.meaning: （口语）给某人上一课；在某方面狠狠教训/击败某人
idioms.example_en: The young prodigy schooled the veteran players on advanced chess tactics.
idioms.example_zh: 这位年轻的神童在高阶棋艺战术上给那些老手们狠狠上了一课。

idioms.meaning: 装酷；自命不凡，不屑于合群
idioms.example_en: He sat at the back of the room acting like he was too cool for school.
idioms.example_zh: 他坐在房间后排，一副自命不凡、不屑与他人为伍的样子。

collocations.meaning: 受过……良好教育/训练；深谙于……
collocations.example_en: She was well schooled in the classical traditions of European art.
collocations.example_zh: 她在欧洲古典艺术传统方面受过极为扎实的熏陶。

collocations.meaning: 收敛/克制脸上的表情；强作镇定
collocations.example_en: He carefully schooled his expression so as not to betray his inner shock.
collocations.example_zh: 他极力克制住脸上的表情，以免暴露内心的震惊。

collocations.example_en: A successful negotiator must learn how to school their temper under pressure.
collocations.example_zh: 成功的谈判代表必须学会在压力下克制自己的脾气。

collocations.example_en: He dropped out of school at seventeen to start his own technology firm.
collocations.example_zh: 他在十七岁时辍学去开创自己的科技公司。

collocations.example_en: In many remote areas, children still have to walk miles to attend school.
collocations.example_zh: 在许多偏远地区，孩子们仍然要步行数英里去上学。

collocations.example_en: After graduating from school, she joined an international NGO.
collocations.example_zh: 从学校毕业后，她加入了一家国际非政府组织。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以……为基础；建立在……之上
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Their successful partnership was founded on mutual trust and shared values.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们成功的合作关系建立在相互信任和共同价值观之上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 基于；以……为根据（较正式）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The legal system is founded upon principles of equality before the law.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该法律体系建立在法律面前人人平等的原则之上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 根植于；建立在……范围之内
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The modern treaty is founded in long-standing international conventions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该现代条约根植于长期确立的国际公约之中。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 有事实根据；建立在事实之上
phrasal_verbs.example_en: None of the allegations appear to be founded on verifiable facts.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这些指控中似乎没有任何一条是有可核实事实作为依据的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把（金属/矿石等）铸造成（特定形状，冶炼专义）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The molten bronze was carefully founded into intricate bell molds.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 熔化的青铜被细致地铸造成造型复杂的钟模。

idioms.meaning: 有充分事实根据的；理由充分的
idioms.example_en: Her concerns about the safety of the plant proved to be well-founded.
idioms.example_zh: 她对该工厂安全性的担忧事实证明是有充分依据的。

idioms.meaning: 毫无根据的；无稽之谈的
idioms.example_en: Fears of an imminent economic collapse turned out to be completely ill-founded.
idioms.example_zh: 对经济即将崩溃的恐慌结果被证实完全是毫无根据的。

idioms.meaning: 开创家族；繁衍显赫后代
idioms.example_en: He arrived as an immigrant and went on to found a prominent business family.
idioms.example_zh: 他以移民身份来到这里，后来开创了一个著名的商业家族。

idioms.meaning: 开创王朝；建立长期统治地位
idioms.example_en: The general seized power and founded a dynasty that lasted three centuries.
idioms.example_zh: 这位将军夺取了政权，并建立了一个延续三个世纪的王朝。

idioms.meaning: 创立学派；开创学术流派
idioms.example_en: The philosopher went on to found a school of thought that challenged classical ethics.
idioms.example_zh: 这位哲学家继而开创了一个挑战古典伦理学的思想学派。

collocations.example_en: She founded a tech startup right after graduating from college.
collocations.example_zh: 大学毕业后她随即创立了一家科技初创公司。

collocations.meaning: 创设机构；创立学院或组织
collocations.example_en: The philanthropist used his fortune to found a world-class research institution.
collocations.example_zh: 这位慈善家利用自己的财富创立了一所世界一流的研究机构。

collocations.example_en: The two scientists jointly founded a biotechnology laboratory.
collocations.example_zh: 这两位科学家共同创办了一所生物技术实验室。

collocations.meaning: 根基稳固的；牢固确立的
collocations.example_en: Our democratic traditions are firmly founded in centuries of public debate.
collocations.example_zh: 我们的民主传统深深植根于数百年的公众辩论之中。

collocations.meaning: 建立定居点；开拓殖民地
collocations.example_en: Pioneers crossed the river and founded a new settlement along the valley.
collocations.example_zh: 开拓者渡过河流，沿着山谷建立了一处新的定居点。

collocations.example_en: The hospital was originally founded as a small military dispensary in 1890.
collocations.example_zh: 该医院最初于1890年作为一所小型军用诊所而创立。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 安置在……内；容纳于；将……装入（保护罩或外壳中）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sensitive electronic sensors are housed in a weather-resistant casing.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 敏感的电子传感器被封装在耐候外壳内。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 收藏于；坐落于；驻扎在
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The precious national archive is currently housed in the city's historic library.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 国家珍贵档案馆目前藏于该市的历史图书馆内。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将……安置在同一处；合住
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Different species of birds should not be housed together in the same aviary.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 不同种类的鸟类不应混合安置在同一个大鸟笼内。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 外包安置；安排……住到外面
phrasal_verbs.example_en: When the main dormitories overflowed, students were housed out in local homestays.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当主宿舍满员后，学生们被安置在当地寄宿家庭居住。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 收藏妥当；妥善储藏
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The vintage machinery was securely housed away during the harsh winter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 严冬期间，这批老式机械被妥善封存起来。

idioms.meaning: 博得满堂喝彩；激起全场雷鸣般掌声
idioms.example_en: Her electrifying musical performance brought the house down.
idioms.example_zh: 她激动人心的音乐表演博得了全场观众的雷鸣般喝彩。

idioms.meaning: 料理家务；掌管家政
idioms.example_en: He worked remotely from home while keeping house for his family.
idioms.example_zh: 他一边在家远程工作，一边料理家务。

idioms.meaning: 建立小家庭；安家并开始独立生活
idioms.example_en: After getting married, the couple decided to set up house in a quiet suburb.
idioms.example_zh: 婚后，这对夫妇决定在一个宁静的郊区安家生活。

idioms.meaning: 整顿清除内部不良人员/作风；彻底大扫除
idioms.example_en: The new CEO wasted no time in cleaning house across top management.
idioms.example_zh: 新任首席执行官毫不迟疑地彻底整顿了高管层团队。

idioms.phrase: eat sb out of house and home
idioms.meaning: 把某人吃穷；大吃特吃耗尽主人的粮食
idioms.example_en: My teenage sons and their friends are eating me out of house and home.
idioms.example_zh: 我十几岁的儿子和他们的朋友快把我吃得倾家荡产了。

idioms.meaning: 由店家出钱；免费招待
idioms.example_en: The bartender apologized for the delay and said the drinks were on the house.
idioms.example_zh: 调酒师为延误致歉，并表示这几杯饮品由酒吧免费招待。

collocations.meaning: 安置难民；为难民提供居所
collocations.example_en: Temporary shelters were constructed to house thousands of displaced refugees.
collocations.example_zh: 修建了临时避难所，用来安置数以千计流离失所的难民。

collocations.example_en: The new wing of the museum houses an extensive collection of modern art.
collocations.example_zh: 博物馆的新展翼陈列着丰富的现代艺术藏品。

collocations.example_en: The convention center is scheduled to house an international trade exhibition.
collocations.example_zh: 会议中心按计划将承办一场国际贸易展。

collocations.meaning: 充分妥善地安置；提供适宜住所
collocations.example_en: The local council struggles to adequately house low-income families.
collocations.example_zh: 地方委员会正竭力为低收入家庭提供妥善的住房安置。

collocations.example_en: Disaster victims were temporarily housed in the high school gymnasium.
collocations.example_zh: 受灾群众被临时安置在中学体育馆内。

collocations.example_en: The aircraft's streamlined fuselage houses two powerful turbofan engines.
collocations.example_zh: 飞机的流线型机身容纳了两台强劲的涡扇发动机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 表达关爱；宠爱；疼爱（多用于美式非正式英语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Grandparents just want to hug and love on their grandchildren whenever they visit.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 祖父母每次探望孙辈时，总想给他们拥抱并好好宠爱他们一番。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 爱抚；亲吻拥抱；讨好
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The puppy ran over and began to love up on everyone in the room.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 小狗跑过来，开始对房间里的每个人亲昵撒娇。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 爱上；迷恋上（某人或某物）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They fell in love with each other the moment they met in college.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们在大学里相遇的那一刻就彼此坠入了爱河。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 深爱着；与……相爱
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He realized he had been deeply in love with his best friend for years.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他意识到自己多年来一直深深爱着他最好的朋友。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……做爱；发生性关系
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The couple made love by the fireplace on a cold winter night.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这对情侣在寒冷的冬夜于壁炉旁温存缠绵。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 逐渐喜欢上；慢慢爱上
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She hated spicy food at first, but she eventually learned to love it.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她起初讨厌辛辣食物，但最终慢慢喜欢上了它。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因某特质/某事而深爱某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I love her for her honesty, kindness, and brilliant sense of humor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我爱她是因为她的诚实、善良和绝妙的幽默感。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 极度喜爱；疼爱得要命
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She loves her younger brother to death despite their frequent arguments.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管他们经常吵架，但她还是爱死她弟弟了。

idioms.meaning: 毫无好感；互相厌恶；视同水火
idioms.example_en: There was no love lost between the two political rivals during the debate.
idioms.example_zh: 辩论期间，这两位政界对手之间毫无好感、针锋相对。

idioms.meaning: 心甘情愿做的工作；情愿付出劳力的事情
idioms.example_en: Restoring the vintage sports car took three years, but it was a true labor of love.
idioms.example_zh: 修复这辆老式跑车花了三年时间，但这完全是出于热爱的自愿付出。

idioms.meaning: 神魂颠倒；彻底坠入爱河
idioms.example_en: Mark was head over heels in love with Sarah from the first date.
idioms.example_zh: 从第一次约会起，马克就彻底为萨拉神魂颠倒了。

idioms.meaning: 严厉的爱；用严厉手段迫使其自立的爱
idioms.example_en: Sometimes parents need to practice tough love to help their children overcome addiction.
idioms.example_zh: 有时父母需要采取严厉的爱，以帮助孩子克服成瘾问题。

idioms.meaning: 看在上帝的份上；求求你（用于表达愤怒、绝望或恳求）
idioms.example_en: For the love of God, please turn down that loud music!
idioms.example_zh: 看在老天爷的份上，求你把那吵闹的音乐关小一点吧！

idioms.meaning: 情人眼里出西施；爱情让人盲目
idioms.example_en: She ignored all his obvious flaws because love is truly blind.
idioms.example_zh: 她忽视了他所有明显的缺点，因为爱情确实是盲目的。

collocations.example_en: Please send my love to your parents when you call them tonight.
collocations.example_zh: 今晚给你父母打电话时，请代我向他们问好。

collocations.example_en: They fell madly in love while backpacking across Europe.
collocations.example_zh: 他们在欧洲背包旅行时疯狂地相爱了。

collocations.example_en: He gathered his courage and finally declared his love to her.
collocations.example_zh: 他鼓起勇气，终于向她表白了爱意。

collocations.meaning: 单相思；单恋；未得回报的爱
collocations.example_en: The novel portrays the painful bitterness of unrequited love.
collocations.example_zh: 这部小说刻画了单相思带来的痛苦与心酸。

collocations.example_en: Children thrive when parents regularly show love and affection.
collocations.example_zh: 当父母经常表达爱意和温情时，孩子们会茁壮成长。

collocations.example_en: After years of failed relationships, she finally found true love.
collocations.example_zh: 在经历了多年的感情波折后，她终于寻得了真爱。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 取消（活动/计划）；叫走（人或动物以停止攻击）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They had to call off the football match because of heavy rain.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于大雨，他们不得不取消了足球比赛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 需要，要求；去接（某人），去取（某物）；公开呼吁
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sudden crisis calls for immediate action from the management team.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这场突如其来的危机需要管理团队立即采取行动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回电话；叫回，召回（产品或人员）；再次面试
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'm in a meeting right now; can I call you back in half an hour?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我现在正在开会，半小时后给你回电话可以吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 召集，请来（专业人士帮忙）；顺道拜访；打电话通报（请病假等）；收回（贷款/钞票）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The local police decided to call in forensic experts to examine the crime scene.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当地警方决定请法医专家来勘验犯罪现场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 大声呼喊；公开指责，批评；调动，派出（紧急救援/军队）；号召罢工
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She didn't hesitate to call out her colleague for making sexist comments.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她毫不犹豫地公开指责同事发表性别歧视言论。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 正式呼吁，请求；探访，拜访；点名（回答问题）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The United Nations called on both nations to declare an immediate ceasefire.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 联合国呼吁两国立即宣布停火。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打电话给；征召入伍；调出（电脑数据）；唤起（回忆）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He was called up to the army right after graduating from high school.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他高中刚毕业就被征召入伍了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 四处打电话打听；顺道走访/拜访
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I called around several garages to find the cheapest quote for the repair.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我给好几家修理厂打了电话，想找最便宜的维修报价。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因公叫走；因突发事件使离开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The doctor was called away to perform an emergency operation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 医生因有一台紧急手术而被叫走了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 引起，唤起；展现出，使产生（勇气、力量等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The proposal called forth a storm of protest from local residents.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该提议激起了当地居民一阵强烈的抗议浪潮。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顺便拜访；路过顺道探望
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I will call by your office this afternoon to drop off the signed documents.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我今天下午会顺路去你的办公室送签字的文件。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （船只、火车）停靠于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The cruise ship will call at several Mediterranean ports next week.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这艘邮轮下周将停靠地中海的几个港口。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以……命名（多用于英式英语，美式多为 name after）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was called Rose after her maternal grandmother.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她是随她外祖母的名字被命名为罗丝的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 责骂，训斥；祈求降下（灾祸、诅咒）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The manager called down the clerks for their recurring carelessness.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经理因办事员们一再粗心大意而训斥了他们。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 招呼过来；点名宣读
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The teacher called over the students to distribute the examination papers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 老师把学生们叫过来分发试卷。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顺道探访某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's call in on aunt Mary while we are in town.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们在城里的时候顺路去看看玛丽阿姨吧。

idioms.meaning: 今天就到此为止；收工；停止工作
idioms.example_en: We've made substantial progress on the project, so let's call it a day.
idioms.example_zh: 我们的项目取得了实质性进展，今天就收工吧。

idioms.meaning: 掌权；发号施令；作决定
idioms.example_en: In this department, it is the director who calls the shots.
idioms.example_zh: 在这个部门里，发号施令做主的人是主任。

idioms.meaning: 实话实说；直言不讳
idioms.example_en: She always calls a spade a spade, even when the truth is uncomfortable.
idioms.example_zh: 即便真相令人不快，她也总是直言不讳、直截了当。

idioms.meaning: 决定放弃；就此作罢；协议分手
idioms.example_en: After years of constant arguing, they mutually agreed to call it quits.
idioms.example_zh: 经过多年的不断争吵，他们一致同意就此分手。

idioms.meaning: 侥幸脱险；千钧一发；险情
idioms.example_en: That speeding truck almost hit our car—it was a very close call.
idioms.example_zh: 那辆超速的卡车差点撞上我们的车——真是千钧一发。

idioms.meaning: 定调子；掌权；操纵局面
idioms.example_en: The biggest investor naturally gets to call the tune in the boardroom.
idioms.example_zh: 最大的投资者自然能在董事会里掌握主导权。

idioms.meaning: 待命；随叫随到
idioms.example_en: Surgeons are frequently on call throughout weekends in case of emergencies.
idioms.example_zh: 遇到紧急情况时，外科医生在周末通常需要随叫随到待命。

collocations.example_en: The recent scientific discoveries call into question earlier theories about planetary formation.
collocations.example_zh: 最近的科学发现使先前关于行星形成的理论受到了质疑。

collocations.meaning: 唤起对……的注意；提醒关注
collocations.example_en: The report calls attention to the growing problem of youth unemployment.
collocations.example_zh: 该报告提醒人们关注日益严重的青年失业问题。

collocations.meaning: 宣布举行大选；召集会议
collocations.example_en: The prime minister decided to call an early election to consolidate power.
collocations.example_zh: 首相决定提前举行大选以巩固权力。

collocations.example_en: The municipal government called a halt to construction until environmental safety was ensured.
collocations.example_zh: 市政府叫停了施工，直到环境安全得到保障为止。

collocations.example_en: Solving this complex engineering problem will call into play all your technical skills.
collocations.example_zh: 解决这个复杂的工程问题将需要调动你所有的专业技能。

collocations.example_en: The railway union voted overwhelmingly to call a nationwide strike.
collocations.example_zh: 铁路工会以压倒性多数投票决定举行全国性罢工。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 到达，露面；显现，容易看得见；使显眼
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We waited for over an hour, but he didn't show up.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们等了一个多小时，但他根本没露面。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使某人难堪，使出丑；比某人表现更优而使其相形见绌
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please don't argue with me in public and show me up.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 拜托别在公开场合跟我争吵让我难堪。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 炫耀，卖弄；衬托出，使显得更突出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He loves to show off his wealth by driving luxury cars.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他喜欢通过开豪车来炫耀自己的财富。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 带某人参观，领某人四处走走
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Welcome to our new headquarters; let me show you around.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 欢迎来到我们的新总部，我带您四处参观一下吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 领入，引见…进去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The receptionist smiled and showed the next candidate in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 前台面带微笑，把下一位应聘者领了进去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 送客，领某人出门
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Thank you for coming; my assistant will show you out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 感谢您的光临，我的助理会送您出去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 透过…显露出来；（感情、真相等）流露，暴露
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her deep-seated anxiety began to show through her calm facade.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她内心的焦虑开始透过平静的表象显露出来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 引导某人到（特定位置或房间）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The waiter showed us to our reserved table by the window.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 服务生把我们引到了靠窗的预订餐位。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 带领某人参观（建筑物、庄园等）并详细解说
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The real estate agent showed them over the historic cottage.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 房产中介带领他们详细参观了那栋历史悠久的乡间小屋。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 公开露面，现身；显露真面目
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He dared not show himself in the city after the scandal broke.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 丑闻曝光后，他不敢在城里公开露面。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 展现，宣扬，显示（某种品质、荣耀或力量）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The majestic architecture shows forth the grandeur of the ancient empire.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这座宏伟的建筑彰显出古代帝国的辉煌与雄伟。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 亮牌对决；摊牌
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Both players showed down their cards to reveal the winner.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 两名选手同时亮牌摊决，以分出胜负。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把某人领进（特定房间或办公室）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I was shown into a grand conference room with polished oak tables.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我被领进了一间摆着光滑橡木长桌的气派会议室。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在记录或屏幕上显示为…，呈现为…
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The tiny fracture didn't show up on the initial X-ray.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那处微小的骨裂在最初的X光片上并未显示出来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在某人面前故意卖弄/显摆
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The children were performing daring stunts to show off to their peers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 孩子们做着各种大胆的特技动作，在同龄人面前显摆。

idioms.meaning: 抢尽风头，成为全场瞩目的焦点
idioms.example_en: The child actor completely stole the show with his heartfelt monologue.
idioms.example_zh: 那位小演员凭借发自肺腑的独白彻底抢尽了风头。

idioms.meaning: 露出真面目，显露本来嘴脸
idioms.example_en: Under intense financial pressure, he finally showed his true colors.
idioms.example_zh: 在巨大的经济压力下，他终于露出了真面目。

idioms.meaning: 向某人传授诀窍，指导新手熟悉门道
idioms.example_en: A senior engineer was assigned to show the new recruit the ropes.
idioms.example_zh: 一位资深工程师被指派指导这名新员工熟悉业务门道。

idioms.meaning: 逐客，将某人扫地出门；解雇某人
idioms.example_en: When he refused to follow safety protocols, the manager showed him the door.
idioms.example_zh: 当他拒绝遵守安全规程时，经理直接将他扫地出门。

idioms.meaning: 举手表决
idioms.example_en: The motion was passed easily by an overwhelming show of hands.
idioms.example_zh: 通过压倒性的举手表决，该提案顺利通过。

idioms.meaning: 掌管大局，当家做主
idioms.example_en: Although his father founded the company, Mark now runs the show.
idioms.example_zh: 虽然是他父亲创办了这家公司，但如今由马克全面掌管大局。

collocations.example_en: The global economy is beginning to show tentative signs of recovery.
collocations.example_zh: 全球经济开始呈现出试探性的复苏迹象。

collocations.example_en: You should show respect for traditional customs when visiting abroad.
collocations.example_zh: 到国外旅游时，你应该尊重当地的传统习俗。

collocations.example_en: Several prominent venture capitalists have shown interest in our startup.
collocations.example_zh: 已有数家知名风投机构对我们的初创企业表现出兴趣。

collocations.example_en: She sent a personalized card to show gratitude to all her supporters.
collocations.example_zh: 她寄出了一张手写贺卡，向所有支持者表达感激之情。

collocations.meaning: 毫无悔意；毫不仁慈/心狠手辣
collocations.example_en: The judge noted that the defendant showed no remorse for his actions.
collocations.example_zh: 法官指出，被告对自己的行为毫无悔意。

collocations.example_en: The patient's condition has shown steady improvement over the weekend.
collocations.example_zh: 整个周末患者的病情都有了持续稳定的好转。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 想要（做某事）；感觉像…，给人以…的感觉
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'm exhausted and just feel like staying home tonight.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我筋疲力尽，今晚只想待在家里。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 感觉有精力/能力应付（某事）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I didn't feel up to attending the noisy cocktail party after work.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 下班后我觉得实在没精力去参加嘈杂的鸡尾酒会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 同情，体谅；用手摸索寻找
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I really feel for anyone who has suffered through such a tragedy.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我对经历过如此不幸的每一个人都深表同情。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 试探，摸底（某人的想法、意向）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's feel out the management before formally submitting our proposal.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在正式提交方案之前，我们先探探管理层的口风。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 摸索，四处摸探（以寻找某物）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He felt around in the dark for the bedside lamp switch.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在黑暗中摸索着寻找床头灯的开关。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （非礼性地）抚摸某人身体，摸索
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He was arrested after attempting to feel up a fellow passenger on the train.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在列车上企图猥亵一名乘客后被当场逮捕。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对…怀有某种感情/态度
phrasal_verbs.example_en: How do you really feel towards the recent changes in company policy?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你对公司近期的政策变动究竟是怎么看的？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 随意，尽管去做某事（不必拘束）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Feel free to help yourself to any drinks and snacks in the fridge.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 冰箱里的饮料和零食请随意享用，不用客气。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 情绪低落，感到沮丧
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Whenever you feel down, listening to upbeat music can help.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 每当你感到情绪低落时，听听欢快的音乐会有所帮助。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 彻底体验，细细感受
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Therapy helps individuals feel through repressed traumatic experiences.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 心理治疗有助于个体彻底梳理并面对被压抑的创伤体验。

idioms.meaning: 感到无拘无束，感觉像在自己家一样舒适自在
idioms.example_en: The hosts were so warm and hospitable that we felt at home immediately.
idioms.example_zh: 主人非常热情好客，让我们立刻感到宾至如归。

idioms.meaning: 身体略感不适，有点小病小痛
idioms.example_en: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I think I'll skip the gym.
idioms.example_zh: 我今天感觉身体有点不舒服，所以打算不去健身房了。

idioms.meaning: （因经济困难）手头拮据，感受到财政压力
idioms.example_en: With surging inflation, working families everywhere are feeling the pinch.
idioms.example_zh: 随着通货膨胀飙升，各地的工薪家庭都感受到了手头拮据的压力。

idioms.meaning: 打心底直觉到，对…有强烈的预感
idioms.example_en: I can feel it in my bones that something extraordinary is about to happen.
idioms.example_zh: 我有一种强烈的直觉，非比寻常的大事即将发生。

idioms.phrase: feel on top of the world
idioms.meaning: 感到极度幸福，春风得意，飘飘欲仙
idioms.example_en: After receiving the scholarship, she felt on top of the world.
idioms.example_zh: 拿到奖学金后，她感觉幸福得如同登上世界之巅。

idioms.meaning: 怨恨，心怀芥蒂（常用在 no hard feelings 中表示“别往心里去”）
idioms.example_en: We had a fierce debate, but there are no hard feelings between us.
idioms.example_zh: 我们辩论得很激烈，但彼此之间绝没有心存芥蒂。

collocations.meaning: 感到一种…感（如归属感、成就感等）
collocations.example_en: Volunteering gave him a renewed sense of purpose and fulfillment.
collocations.example_zh: 志愿服务让他重新获得了一种人生目标感与充实感。

collocations.meaning: 觉得有义务/不得不去做某事
collocations.example_en: I felt obliged to clarify the misunderstanding before rumors spread.
collocations.example_zh: 我觉得有责任在谣言扩散前把误会解释清楚。

collocations.meaning: 对…感触极深，非常关切/在乎
collocations.example_en: She feels deeply about animal rights and devotes weekends to shelter work.
collocations.example_zh: 她对动物权益深感关切，并将周末时间都奉献给了收容所工作。

collocations.example_en: Small retail shops are feeling the direct impact of online commerce.
collocations.example_zh: 小型零售店正切身承受着电子商务带来的直接冲击。

collocations.meaning: 感到一阵剧烈的（内疚、嫉妒、悲伤等）痛楚
collocations.example_en: He felt a sharp pang of guilt for forgetting his mother's birthday.
collocations.example_zh: 因为忘记了母亲的生日，他心头掠过一阵强烈的内疚。

collocations.example_en: His gentle voice and calm demeanor made the nervous patient feel at ease.
collocations.example_zh: 他温和的语调和平静的举止让紧张的患者渐渐放松下来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 起飞；迅速走红/蓬勃发展；脱下（衣物）；匆忙离去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her tech startup really took off after securing the initial round of venture capital.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在获得首轮风险投资后，她的初创科技公司迅速蓬勃发展起来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 爆炸；警报响起；食物变质；突然离开；进行/进展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The bomb squad arrived just minutes before the device was set to go off.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 拆弹小组在爆炸装置预定引爆前几分钟赶到了现场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 下（车/船/飞机）；动身出发；下班；免受惩罚
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He was lucky to get off with just a warning instead of a heavy fine.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他很幸运，只受到口头警告而免遭高额罚款。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 关闭（电源/水源等）；转弯/驶离；使厌烦/失去兴趣
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Remember to turn off the lights before you leave, and take the next exit off the highway.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 离开前记得关灯，并在高速公路的下一个出口拐出。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 推迟/推延；使反感/打消念头；使分心
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We had to put off the meeting until Friday because several key members were indisposed.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 因为几位核心成员身体不适，我们不得不将会议推迟到周五。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 取消（活动/计划）；叫走/命令...停止进攻
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They decided to call off the outdoor concert due to torrential rain.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于倾盆大雨，他们决定取消这场户外音乐会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 出发/启程；引爆/触发；激起；衬托/烘托
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The hikers set off early in the morning to reach the summit before noon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 徒步旅行者清晨就出发了，以便在中午之前登顶。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 切断/中止（供应）；阻断；断绝（关系/继承权）；使隔绝
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Heavy snowfall completely cut off the mountain village from the outside world.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 大雪使这个山村彻底与外界隔绝。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 取得成功/得到回报；还清（债务）；收买/贿赂；解雇付清遣散费
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All those late nights of studying finally paid off when she passed the bar exam.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当她通过律师资格考试时，所有熬夜苦读的努力终于得到了回报。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 解雇/裁员；停止/停止打扰；戒除（烟酒等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The automaker was forced to lay off hundreds of factory workers during the recession.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经济衰退期间，这家汽车制造商被迫裁减了数百名工厂工人。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 减少/下降；顺道放下（人或物）；打瞌睡/入睡
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I can drop you off at the subway station on my way to the office.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我在去办公室的路上顺便可以送你到地铁站下车。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 做成/艰难完成；把车开出路面停靠；扯下/脱下
phrasal_verbs.example_en: No one believed they could pull off such an ambitious merger, but they did.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 没人相信他们能做成如此庞大的并购交易，但他们成功了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 炫耀/卖弄；衬托/彰显出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He bought an expensive sports car just to show off to his neighbors.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他买了一辆昂贵的跑车，纯粹是为了向邻居们炫耀。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 后退；放弃（干涉/要求）；态度缓和
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The union refused to back off from its demand for higher safety standards.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工会拒绝在提高安全标准的要求上做出退让。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 折断；断绝（关系/谈判）；突然中止讲话
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The two countries broke off diplomatic relations following the border clash.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 边境冲突爆发后，两国断绝了外交关系。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （感觉、药效等）逐渐消失/减弱
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The painkiller began to wear off after four hours, and his back started aching again.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 止痛药的药效在四个小时后逐渐消退，他的背部又开始疼了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 勾销/注销（债务）；认定...毫无价值/不予考虑；撞毁（车辆）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Critics were too quick to write off the young director after his first film flopped.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在这位年轻导演的首部电影票房惨败后，评论界过早地认定他毫无前途。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 斥责/训斥
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The manager told him off for repeatedly showing up late to team briefings.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经理严厉训斥了他，因为他屡次在团队例会上迟到。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 敲竹杠/多收钱；剽窃/抄袭；撕下
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Tourists are often ripped off by unscrupulous street vendors near the monument.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 纪念碑附近不讲诚信的街头摊贩经常对游客漫天要价。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （球赛）开球；正式开始；挑起争端/爆发
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The annual technology festival is scheduled to kick off next Monday.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一年一度的科技节定于下周一正式开幕。

idioms.meaning: 摆脱困境/脱身；免受责罚；（电话听筒）没挂好
idioms.example_en: Admitting his mistake early got him off the hook with the disciplinary committee.
idioms.example_zh: 及早承认错误使他免受了纪律委员会的严厉处分。

idioms.meaning: 即兴地；未经准备地
idioms.example_en: She gave a brilliant speech entirely off the cuff without looking at any notes.
idioms.example_zh: 她没看任何讲稿，完全即兴发表了一场精彩绝伦的演说。

idioms.meaning: 不公开发表的；非正式私下透露的
idioms.example_en: The senator spoke off the record about the ongoing internal deliberations.
idioms.example_zh: 参议员以不公开发表的方式私下透露了正在进行的内部审议情况。

idioms.meaning: 境况更好；更宽裕；明智的做法是
idioms.example_en: You would be far better off investing your savings in index funds than in speculative stocks.
idioms.example_zh: 与其投资投机性股票，将积蓄投入指数基金你的境况会好得多。

idioms.meaning: 人迹罕至的；偏僻独特的
idioms.example_en: We chose a secluded cabin off the beaten track for our summer vacation.
idioms.example_zh: 我们选择了一处远离尘嚣、人迹罕至的僻静小木屋来度暑假。

idioms.phrase: off the top of one's head
idioms.meaning: 凭记忆粗略估计；不假思索地
idioms.example_en: Off the top of my head, I'd say the renovation will cost around fifty thousand dollars.
idioms.example_zh: 不假思索地凭直觉估算，我认为翻新费用大约需要五万美元。

idioms.meaning: 断断续续地；间歇地
idioms.example_en: It rained off and on throughout the entire weekend, spoiling our camping plans.
idioms.example_zh: 整个周末断断续续地下着雨，打乱了我们的露营计划。

collocations.meaning: 失去平衡；措手不及/心慌意乱
collocations.example_en: The tough opening question caught the spokesperson completely off balance.
collocations.example_zh: 开场那个棘手的问题让新闻发言人瞬间措手不及。

collocations.example_en: The competitor's aggressive price reduction caught our sales department off guard.
collocations.example_zh: 竞争对手激进的降价策略让我们销售部猝不及防。

collocations.meaning: 禁止入内；禁止讨论/触及
collocations.example_en: The military testing facility is strictly off limits to unauthorized personnel.
collocations.example_zh: 该军事试验基地严禁未经授权的人员进入。

collocations.example_en: An off-duty police officer stepped in and disarmed the suspect.
collocations.example_zh: 一名当时不当班的警察果断介入并缴下了嫌疑人的武器。

collocations.example_en: Let's stick to the agenda so that our discussion doesn't drift off track.
collocations.example_zh: 让我们紧扣议程，免得讨论偏离了正题。

collocations.example_en: Early poll predictions turned out to be wildly off the mark.
collocations.example_zh: 早期的民调预测结果最终证明相差甚远。

collocations.example_en: His assessment of the company's financial health was entirely off base.
collocations.example_zh: 他对公司财务状况的评估完全是大错特错。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 保持静止不动；停滞不前/毫无进展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Technology never stands still, so professionals must constantly upgrade their skills.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 技术永远不会停滞不前，因此专业人员必须不断提升自己的技能。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 保持不动；肃静/保持静止
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The doctor asked the nervous child to keep still while she examined his ear.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 医生检查耳朵时，嘱咐那个紧张的孩子保持别动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 静止不动；别乱动
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Hold still for just a second so I can take a clear photograph of you.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别动，定住一秒钟，这样我能给你拍一张清晰的照片。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 安静坐着；坐视不管（常用于否定句）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Management cannot simply sit still while competitors capture our core market share.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在竞争对手掠夺我们核心市场份额之际，管理层绝不能坐视不管。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 静卧不动；平躺静止
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The injured runner was instructed to lie still until the medical team arrived.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 受伤的赛跑选手被要求静静躺着别动，直到医疗队赶来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 停留在原位不动；保持静止状态
phrasal_verbs.example_en: When encountering a wild bear, experts recommend you stay still rather than flee.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当遭遇野熊时，专家建议保持静止不动，切莫慌忙逃跑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 突然定住；僵住不动
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The deer froze still the instant it heard the rustle of leaves in the brush.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 小鹿一听到灌木丛中树叶的沙沙声，瞬间吓得定住不动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 依然保持静止；保持缄默平静
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The surface of the mountain lake remained perfectly still in the dawn light.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在晨曦中，高山湖泊的湖面依然平静如镜、纹丝不动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 安静下来；镇定；止息
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Be still and listen carefully to the instructions before you touch the machinery.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 安静下来，在触碰机械之前仔细听清楚操作指令。

idioms.meaning: 静水流深；大智若愚；表面沉静者内心深沉
idioms.example_en: He seldom speaks in public, but still waters run deep—his strategic insights are unmatched.
idioms.example_zh: 他很少公开发言，但静水流深——他的战略洞察力无人能及。

idioms.meaning: 更好的是；更妙的是
idioms.example_en: We can email them today, or better still, arrange a face-to-face meeting tomorrow.
idioms.example_zh: 我们今天可以发邮件给他们，或者更好的是，明天安排一次面谈。

idioms.meaning: 尽管如此；毕竟；话虽如此
idioms.example_en: The plan is risky; still and all, it remains our only realistic avenue for survival.
idioms.example_zh: 这项方案风险很高；话虽如此，它依然是我们求生存的唯一现实途径。

idioms.meaning: 时间凝固；时光停滞
idioms.example_en: Walking through the ancient ruined temple, it felt as though time stood still.
idioms.example_zh: 漫步走过这座古老破败的寺庙时，让人感觉时光仿佛凝固了一般。

idioms.phrase: in the still of the night
idioms.meaning: 在万籁俱寂的深夜
idioms.example_en: A distant siren broke the silence in the still of the night.
idioms.example_zh: 在万籁俱寂的深夜，远处的一声警笛划破了宁静。

idioms.meaning: 内心微弱的声音；良知的呼唤
idioms.example_en: Despite the applause of the crowd, a still small voice warned him against arrogance.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管人群掌声雷动，内心微弱的声音仍在警告他切勿骄傲自满。

idioms.meaning: 坐立难安；躁动不安
idioms.example_en: Excited about tomorrow's excursion, the children simply could not sit still.
idioms.example_zh: 想到明天的远足旅行，孩子们兴奋得根本坐不住。

collocations.meaning: 平息某人的恐惧；消除忧虑
collocations.example_en: The captain's calm demeanor helped still the passengers' mounting fears.
collocations.example_zh: 机长沉着冷静的风度帮助平息了乘客们日益加剧的恐慌。

collocations.meaning: 平息风浪；缓和紧张局势
collocations.example_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly behind the scenes to still the troubled waters between the nations.
collocations.example_zh: 外交官们在幕后不知疲倦地斡旋，以平息两国间的紧张局势。

collocations.example_en: Traffic came to a complete standstill following a multi-vehicle pileup on the bridge.
collocations.example_zh: 大桥上发生多车连环相撞事故后，交通彻底陷入停滞。

collocations.example_en: A nationwide rail strike brought the country's transport network to a standstill.
collocations.example_zh: 全国范围的铁路大罢工使该国的交通运输网络陷入瘫痪。

collocations.example_en: The art student spent the afternoon sketching a still life of fruit and copper bowls.
collocations.example_zh: 这位艺术系学生花了一整个下午素描一组水果与铜碗的静物画。

collocations.example_en: Would you prefer sparkling mineral water or still water with your dinner?
collocations.example_zh: 用餐时您想要带气矿泉水还是不带气水？

collocations.meaning: 无风的空气；死寂的空气
collocations.example_en: Smoke from the campfire rose straight up into the crisp, still air.
collocations.example_zh: 营火产生的青烟笔直地升入清冷无风的空气中。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 训斥，责备，怒斥
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The teacher told him off for repeatedly arriving late to class.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 老师因他屡次上课迟到而严厉训斥了他。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 告发，打小报告；对…产生明显不良影响，使显出疲态
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't tell on your brother, and get some rest before the stress starts to tell on your health.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别向家长告你弟弟的状；赶紧休息一下吧，别让压力累垮了身体。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分辨，区分（两者或多者）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The twin sisters look so identical that even their closest friends can hardly tell them apart.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这对双胞胎姐妹长得太像了，就连最亲近的朋友也几乎分不清她们。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从…中辨别出…，区分…与…
phrasal_verbs.example_en: At that distance, it was nearly impossible to tell a dog from a wolf.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在那个距离下，几乎不可能把狗和狼分辨开来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 讲述，陈述；表明，显示出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Ancient legends tell of a lost kingdom buried beneath the shifting sands.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 古老的传说讲述了一个被埋藏在流沙之下的失落王国。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对…不利，成为对…不利的证据或因素
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His complete lack of relevant experience told heavily against him in the job interview.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 完全缺乏相关经验在求职面试中对他极为不利。

idioms.meaning: 老实说，说实话
idioms.example_en: To tell the truth, I was completely surprised by their sudden decision to merge.
idioms.example_zh: 说实话，他们突然决定合并让我感到非常意外。

idioms.meaning: 时间会证明一切，日后见分晓
idioms.example_en: Only time will tell whether this massive investment will yield the expected profits.
idioms.example_zh: 只有时间才能证明这笔巨额投资能否带来预期的利润。

idioms.meaning: （表示完全感同身受或无奈赞同）可不是嘛，那还用你说
idioms.example_en: "Finding an affordable apartment in this city is impossible." "Tell me about it!"
idioms.example_zh: “在这个城市找一套租得起的公寓简直不可能。”“可不是嘛！”

idioms.phrase: you never can tell / there's no telling
idioms.meaning: 谁也说不准，很难预料
idioms.example_en: There's no telling how the market will react to the new regulations tomorrow.
idioms.example_zh: 谁也说不准明天市场会对新规作出何种反应。

idioms.meaning: 搬弄是非，泄露内部秘密
idioms.example_en: I don't mean to tell tales out of school, but the project manager is planning to resign.
idioms.example_zh: 我不想搬弄是非泄露内幕，但项目经理确实打算辞职了。

idioms.phrase: tell sb a thing or two
idioms.meaning: 狠狠教训某人一顿；给某人点颜色瞧瞧
idioms.example_en: If he speaks to me so rudely again, I'm going to tell him a thing or two.
idioms.example_zh: 如果他再对我这么无礼，我一定要好好教训他一顿。

collocations.example_en: Can you tell the difference between authentic leather and synthetic materials?
collocations.example_zh: 你能辨别真皮与合成皮革之间的区别吗？

collocations.example_en: He promised never to tell a lie to his parents again.
collocations.example_zh: 他保证再也不对父母撒谎了。

collocations.example_en: Children usually learn how to tell the time when they enter primary school.
collocations.example_zh: 孩子们通常在进入小学时学习看钟表认时间。

collocations.example_en: The old woman by the temple claimed she could tell fortunes using tarot cards.
collocations.example_zh: 庙旁的老妇人声称自己能用塔罗牌为人算命。

collocations.example_en: Truth be told, we simply didn't have enough budget to execute the original campaign.
collocations.example_zh: 坦白讲，我们根本没有足够的预算来执行最初的营销方案。

collocations.meaning: 讲述故事；说明问题，反映情况
collocations.example_en: The financial figures tell a very different story from what the executives claim.
collocations.example_zh: 财务数据所反映的情况与高管们宣称的大相径庭。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 模拟推演，对（局势、对策及各种后果）进行兵棋推演
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The national security team met to game out multiple response scenarios for the border crisis.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 国家安全团队开会推演应对边境危机的多种预案。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 比赛/较量正式打响（常作短语谓语或感叹语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Now that our main competitor has matched our prices, it is officially game on.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 既然主要竞争对手已经调整了价格与我们抗衡，这场商战就正式打响了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 做好迎战准备；装备就绪
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The esports athletes spent the whole afternoon gaming up for the weekend championship.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 电竞选手们花了一整个下午全面备战周末的总决赛。

idioms.meaning: 诡计被识破，败局已定，全完蛋了
idioms.example_en: When the police surrounded the warehouse, the smugglers realized the game was up.
idioms.example_zh: 当警察包围仓库时，走私犯们意识到一切都完了。

idioms.meaning: 走漏风声，泄露秘密，露出马脚
idioms.example_en: We wanted the farewell party to be a surprise, but his nervous smile gave the game away.
idioms.example_zh: 我们本想把欢送会办成惊喜，但他紧张的笑容露出了马脚。

idioms.phrase: beat sb at their own game
idioms.meaning: 用某人擅长的招数打败某人，以其人之道还治其人之身
idioms.example_en: The startup beat the tech giant at its own game by deploying cutting-edge AI faster.
idioms.example_zh: 这家初创公司通过更快地部署前沿人工智能，在科技巨头最擅长的领域击败了对方。

idioms.meaning: 按规则办事，讲究公道；遵循行业潜规则
idioms.example_en: If you want to advance in corporate politics, you have to learn how to play the game.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你想在企业内部晋升，就必须学会适应职场规则。

idioms.meaning: 处于领先地位，占得先机
idioms.example_en: Investing in renewable energy early allowed the firm to stay well ahead of the game.
idioms.example_zh: 及早投资可再生能源使该企业在行业中保持了绝对领先地位。

idioms.phrase: two can play at that game
idioms.meaning: 谁都会耍这种把戏，以牙还牙（警告对方自己也能采用同类手段）
idioms.example_en: If they cut their advertising rates to steal our clients, two can play at that game.
idioms.example_zh: 如果他们靠降低广告费来抢我们的客户，我们也能奉陪到底。

collocations.meaning: 钻制度漏洞，利用规则漏洞谋取不正当利益
collocations.example_en: Several wealthy investors managed to game the tax system through complex offshore trusts.
collocations.example_zh: 几位富有的投资者通过复杂的离岸信托钻税收制度的空子。

collocations.meaning: 夸夸其谈，话说得漂亮（但未必能做到）
collocations.example_en: He talks a good game during interviews, but his actual delivery falls far short.
collocations.example_zh: 他在面试时说得头头是道，但实际工作表现却差得远。

collocations.meaning: 提升个人表现，提高业务水准
collocations.example_en: With younger talents entering the team, the senior engineers had to raise their game.
collocations.example_zh: 随着年轻人才加入团队，资深工程师们也不得不提高自己的专业水平。

collocations.example_en: By defying the regulatory authorities, the CEO is playing a very dangerous game.
collocations.example_zh: 公然违抗监管机构，这位首席执行官正在铤而走险。

collocations.meaning: 合法的捕猎对象；人人皆可批评或戏弄的目标
collocations.example_en: Celebrities often complain that their private lives are treated as fair game by the tabloids.
collocations.example_zh: 名人经常抱怨他们的私生活被小报当作随意猎奇攻击的靶子。

collocations.meaning: 最终阶段，残局，决定性结局
collocations.example_en: Diplomats are now entering the end game of the protracted trade negotiations.
collocations.example_zh: 外交官们目前正进入这场旷日持久的贸易谈判的收官阶段。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 渴望，盼望，热切期盼（某人或某物）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After years in the arid desert, she longed for the cool mountain air.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在干旱的沙漠生活多年后，她极度渴望感受凉爽的山间空气。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 深切追忆，深切向往（多指对失去的岁月或事物）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In his twilight years, the old poet still longed after the passions of his lost youth.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在迟暮之年，这位老诗人依然深切追忆着逝去青春的热情。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 极度渴望做某事，迫切希望
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Separated by war, they longed to see each other once again.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 被战火分离的他们，迫切希望能再次见到彼此。

phrasal_verbs.phrase: long for sb to do sth
phrasal_verbs.meaning: 期盼某人做某事，渴望某事发生
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The coach longed for his star player to regain full fitness before the final.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教练迫切盼望他的明星球员在决赛前恢复到最佳状态。

idioms.meaning: 全心全意地渴望，发自内心地期盼
idioms.example_en: He longed with all his heart for a peaceful end to the bitter conflict.
idioms.example_zh: 他全心全意地期盼这场激烈的冲突能够和平收场。

idioms.meaning: 翘首以盼那一天的到来
idioms.example_en: She longed for the day when justice would finally be served.
idioms.example_zh: 她翘首以盼正义终将伸张的那一天到来。

idioms.phrase: long to the point of pain
idioms.meaning: 渴望得心痛，相思成疾
idioms.example_en: Far away from her homeland, she longed for her family to the point of pain.
idioms.example_zh: 远离故土的她思念家人到了心痛的地步。

idioms.meaning: 极度渴望挣脱束缚，渴望自由
idioms.example_en: Trapped in an unfulfilling corporate routine, she longed to break free and travel the world.
idioms.example_zh: 困在毫无成就感的公司日常中，她极度渴望挣脱束缚去环游世界。

idioms.meaning: 极度渴望片刻安宁
idioms.example_en: After hours of managing screaming toddlers, the exhausted mother longed for peace and quiet.
idioms.example_zh: 在带了几个小时哭闹的幼儿后，疲惫的母亲极度渴望能有片刻安宁。

collocations.meaning: 不顾一切地渴望，极度盼望
collocations.example_en: The refugees desperately longed for a safe haven away from violence.
collocations.example_zh: 难民们极度渴望能有一个远离暴力的避难所。

collocations.meaning: 暗自渴望，内心深处期盼
collocations.example_en: Though she appeared content, she secretly longed to pursue a career in painting.
collocations.example_zh: 虽然她看起来很满足，但内心深处其实一直渴望从事绘画事业。

collocations.example_en: During his first cold winter abroad, he longed for home and familiar comforts.
collocations.example_zh: 在异国的第一个寒冬里，他倍感思乡，渴望熟悉的温暖与慰藉。

collocations.meaning: 渴望被接纳，期盼获得认同
collocations.example_en: Every teenager naturally longs for acceptance among their peers.
collocations.example_zh: 每个青少年都自然而然地渴望获得同龄人的接纳与认同。

collocations.example_en: Stuck in the same monotonous job for ten years, he longed for a change.
collocations.example_zh: 在同一份单调的工作上干了十年，他极度渴望做出改变。

collocations.meaning: 渴望获得第二次机会，期盼重新来过
collocations.example_en: Regretting his hasty decision, he longed for a second chance to explain himself.
collocations.example_zh: 为自己草率的决定后悔不已，他渴望能有第二次机会向对方解释清楚。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 出发动身；以...开始；促使/逗引某人开始做某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We should start off early before the traffic builds up; what started off as a small argument soon escalated.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们应该在路上拥堵前尽早动身；起初的一点小争执很快便升级了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 动身启程；起初打算/最初以某种身份从业
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He started out as an unpaid intern and ended up running the entire division.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他最初只是一名没有薪水的实习生，最终却掌管了整个部门。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 启动运转（机器/设备）；创办，开办（公司/项目）；突然爆发或站起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The engine started up smoothly; two college dropouts started up a tech firm in their garage.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 引擎顺利启动了；两名大学退学生在车库里创办了一家科技公司。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 着手处理，开始做/吃；开始唠叨或指责某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's finish the report before we start on the new budget; don't start on me about my habits again.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们先把报告做完再着手做新预算；别又开始拿我的生活习惯唠叨我了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 重新开始，从头再来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The draft had too many structural flaws, so the editor advised her to scrap it and start over.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 初稿结构缺陷过多，因此编辑建议她推倒重来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 开始动手/着手干；开始批评、抱怨或攻击某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: As soon as we sat down at the table, my uncle started in on his political grievances.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们刚在餐桌旁坐下，我叔叔就开始大倒他的政治牢骚。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从...开始，以...为起点
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The chef recommended starting with the fresh scallop ceviche.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 主厨建议先从新鲜的腌生鲜贝这道前菜开始品尝。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 动身返程；因吃惊或畏惧而猛然退缩
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We packed our bags and started back as the sun began to set; he started back when the branch snapped.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 太阳开始落山时我们收拾行装动身返程；树枝咔嚓折断时，他吓得往后一退。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 帮助或指导某人入门；引发某人开始大笑、痛哭或滔滔不绝
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A brief joke was enough to start the children off laughing hysterically.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一句简短的笑话就足以逗得孩子们歇斯底里地大笑起来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因惊吓而猛地跳起或缩身；突然迅速动身离开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The deer started away into the dense woods the moment it sensed human presence.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一察觉到有人类的气息，那只鹿便受惊猛地蹿进了密林中。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 翻开新的一页，重新再来，洗心革面
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Moving to a new city offered him a precious chance to start afresh.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 搬到一座新的城市为他提供了一个重新开始人生的宝贵机会。

idioms.meaning: 从零开始，白手起家，从一无所有开始
idioms.example_en: After the fire destroyed their workshop, the founders had to start from scratch.
idioms.example_zh: 大火摧毁作坊后，创始团队不得不从零开始重新创业。

idioms.meaning: 率先行动，带头开展，抛砖引玉拉开序幕
idioms.example_en: To start the ball rolling, the chairman pledged a personal donation of ten thousand dollars.
idioms.example_zh: 为带头推动活动开展，主席率先认捐了一万美元。

idioms.meaning: 首先，作为开头第一点（常用于列举理由或批评）
idioms.example_en: We can't afford the vacation; for a start, the airfares are outrageous.
idioms.example_zh: 我们承担不起这次度假；首先，机票价格就贵得离谱。

idioms.phrase: get off to a flying start
idioms.meaning: 旗开得胜，取得开门红，开局势如破竹
idioms.example_en: The new product got off to a flying start, selling out within twenty-four hours.
idioms.example_zh: 新产品取得了开门红，在二十四小时内便销售一空。

idioms.meaning: 别提了，别惹我打开话匣子（表示一旦展开讲就会抱怨个没完）
idioms.example_en: Don't get me started on the public transport here; trains are perpetually delayed.
idioms.example_zh: 别跟我提这儿的公共交通了，火车永远在晚点。

idioms.meaning: 既往不咎，不计前嫌，重新开始
idioms.example_en: Both managers agreed to put past rivalries behind them and start with a clean slate.
idioms.example_zh: 两位经理一致同意放下过去的恩怨，重新建立合作关系。

idioms.meaning: 开局不利，出师不顺
idioms.example_en: The merger was off to a bad start when key executives resigned on day one.
idioms.example_zh: 核心高管在第一天就集体辞职，使得这次合并出师不利。

collocations.example_en: She took a leap of faith and left her secure job to start a business.
collocations.example_zh: 她毅然辞去了稳定的工作，勇敢迈出一步去开办自己的企业。

collocations.example_en: They bought a house in the suburbs and decided it was the right time to start a family.
collocations.example_zh: 他们在郊区买了房，并觉得是时候生儿育女、组建家庭了。

collocations.meaning: 打破沉默，挑起话头，开启对话
collocations.example_en: He made a witty remark about the weather to start a conversation with the woman beside him.
collocations.example_zh: 他就天气说了句俏皮话，与身旁的女士攀谈起来。

collocations.example_en: Dry leaves and high winds made it terrifyingly easy to start a catastrophic forest fire.
collocations.example_zh: 干燥的落叶和狂风使得引发灾难性森林大火变得极易发生。

collocations.example_en: He turned the ignition key, but the old battery failed to start the engine.
collocations.example_zh: 他转动点火钥匙，但老化的电瓶没能将发动机发动起来。

collocations.meaning: 从零打基础，从基层逐步做起
collocations.example_en: The software architecture had to be redesigned and started from the ground up.
collocations.example_zh: 该软件架构必须彻底重新设计，从零开始搭建基础。

collocations.example_en: Construction crews are scheduled to start work on the new highway extension next Monday.
collocations.example_zh: 施工队预定于下周一正式着手新高速公路延伸段的建设。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 陪伴某人；给某人作伴
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'll stay here and keep you company while you wait for the doctor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你在等医生的时候，我留在这儿陪你作伴。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与…分手/分道扬镳；与…断绝往来；因意见分歧而离开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The manager parted company with the club after a string of poor performances.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在一连串糟糕的赛果之后，该经理与俱乐部和平解约、分道扬镳。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 常与…在一起；与…交往/鬼混
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His parents were worried that he was keeping company with known troublemakers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他的父母担心他一直和已知的捣蛋分子混在一起。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 陪伴某人；陪同某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Would you bear me company on my evening walk around the lake?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你愿意陪我在湖边散散晚步吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 喜欢和某人在一起；喜欢某人的陪伴
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Although they have different backgrounds, they genuinely enjoy each other's company.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管背景不同，他们彼此都很喜欢对方的陪伴。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 喜欢独处；喜好清静
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He is an introverted writer who strongly prefers his own company.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他是个内向的作家，非常喜欢独处。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 主动寻求与某人交往；想和某人待在一起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: During hard times, he would always seek the company of his childhood friends.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在逆境时，他总会找儿时的朋友聚在一起。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 交友不慎；结交坏朋友；误入歧途
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The young man drifted away from his studies after falling into bad company.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那个年轻人在交友不慎后荒废了学业。

idioms.meaning: 有同行者（因而无需尴尬/自责）；大有人在
idioms.example_en: If you failed the exam, you're in good company—half the class did too.
idioms.example_zh: 要是你考试不及格，也别难过，全班有一半人都没过呢。

idioms.meaning: 两人成伴，三人不欢；二人世界容不下第三者
idioms.example_en: I won't join you two at dinner—two's company, three's a crowd.
idioms.example_zh: 我就不掺和你们俩吃晚餐了——二人世界，三人多余。

idioms.meaning: 倒霉有人作伴心稍宽；同病相怜
idioms.example_en: He was glad others also got wet in the rain, proving misery loves company.
idioms.example_zh: 看到其他人也被雨淋了，他竟感到一丝宽慰，真是倒霉有人陪心稍宽。

idioms.meaning: 在座各位除外；不包括在场的人
idioms.example_en: Politicians can never be trusted, present company excepted, of course.
idioms.example_zh: 政客从来都不可信，当然，在座的各位除外。

idioms.phrase: a man is known by the company he keeps
idioms.meaning: 观其友而知其人；物以类聚，人以群分
idioms.example_en: Remember that a man is known by the company he keeps, so choose your friends wisely.
idioms.example_zh: 记住，观其友而知其人，所以交朋友务必慎重。

idioms.meaning: 为了作伴；为了不感到孤单
idioms.example_en: Living alone in the countryside, she adopted a stray cat for company.
idioms.example_zh: 独自在乡村生活，她收养了一只流浪猫来作伴。

collocations.example_en: She has been running the tech company successfully for over a decade.
collocations.example_zh: 她成功经营这家科技公司已经十多年了。

collocations.phrase: start / set up / found a company
collocations.example_en: The two college friends decided to set up a software company together.
collocations.example_zh: 那两位大学好友决定联手创办一家软件公司。

collocations.example_en: The local airline is a subsidiary of a major European parent company.
collocations.example_zh: 这家本土航空公司是一家大型欧洲母公司的子公司。

collocations.example_en: Transparency is strictly required for any publicly listed company.
collocations.example_zh: 对于任何一家上市公司而言，信息公开透明都是硬性要求。

collocations.meaning: 公司文化 / 公司规章制度
collocations.example_en: Encouraging open feedback is a central pillar of our company culture.
collocations.example_zh: 鼓励公开反馈是我们公司文化的核心支柱。

collocations.meaning: 与他人在一起；身处社交场合
collocations.example_en: He behaves very differently when he is in company compared to when he is alone.
collocations.example_zh: 他身处众人之中与独处时的表现大不相同。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 说服/劝说某人做某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They managed to talk her into accepting the promotion despite the heavy workload.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管工作量繁重，他们还是成功劝服她接受了这次升职。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 劝阻某人做某事；说服某人放弃做某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her parents tried everything to talk her out of dropping out of college.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她父母竭尽所能劝阻她不要从大学退学。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以居高临下的口吻对…说话；傲慢地对…说话
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't talk down to me as if I know nothing about this project.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别用那副居高临下的口气对我说话，搞得好像我对这个项目一无所知似的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 说服某人让步降价；压制/压倒某人的声音；劝阻（企图自杀等）某人；指挥（故障飞机）安全降落
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I negotiated firmly and managed to talk the seller down to $400.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我坚定地讨价还价，成功说服卖家把价格降到了400美元。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顶嘴；回嘴；反驳
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Children shouldn't talk back to their teachers when being corrected.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 学生在受到批评时不应该顶撞老师。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 商量；详细讨论；商讨
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's sit down with a cup of coffee and talk over the proposal.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们坐下来喝杯咖啡，把这个提案好好商量一下。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向某人步步讲解/指导；透彻讨论以疏导化解
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The technician patiently talked me through the software installation process.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 技术人员耐心地步步指导我完成了软件的安装过程。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 说服某人改变立场或主意
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He was strongly opposed to the idea at first, but we finally talked him round.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他起初强烈反对这个想法，但我们最终说服了他回心转意。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 绕弯子回避（核心话题）；不直接触及实质
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Stop talking around the issue and tell us directly why the budget failed.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别再兜圈子顾左右而言他了，直接告诉我们为什么预算没通过。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 大肆吹捧；夸大…的重要性或价值
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sales team is talking up the new features to drive pre-orders.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 销售团队正在大肆宣传新功能以刺激预订量。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 通过坦诚交谈解决（问题/矛盾）；畅所欲言倾诉消除心结
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Couples need to talk out their differences rather than holding grudges.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 夫妻双方应该把分歧摊开谈透，而不是暗自怀恨。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 自顾自地对某人说教；单向唠叨而不给对方插嘴机会
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I felt he was just talking at me instead of having a real conversation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我觉得他只是在单方面对我唠叨说教，根本不是在真正交流。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 彻底梳理讨论；透彻思考交流
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We need to talk through all the potential risks before signing the contract.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在签署合同之前，我们需要把所有潜在风险全面透彻地梳理一遍。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 不停地闲扯；通过交谈打发（时间）；借解释消除（疑虑等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They sat on the porch and talked the evening away.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们坐在门廊上，天南海北地闲聊打发了整个傍晚。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 谈论；谈及；流露出…的迹象/传闻
phrasal_verbs.example_en: There was talk of an impending merger throughout the entire office.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 整个办公室都在传言即将发生并购。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与…交谈；严肃训诫/告诫某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His supervisor will have to talk to him about his persistent tardiness.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他的主管不得不找他谈话，严肃敲打他一再迟到的问题。

idioms.meaning: 三句话不离本行；在社交场合大谈工作业务
idioms.example_en: We promised not to talk shop at the dinner party, but we couldn't resist.
idioms.example_zh: 我们答应过晚宴上不聊工作，但最后还是忍不住三句话不离本行。

idioms.meaning: 说得头头是道；说得天花乱坠（通常与 walk the walk 连用）
idioms.example_en: He can certainly talk the talk, but let's see if he can deliver results.
idioms.example_zh: 他确实能说会道、讲得头头是道，但且看他能不能拿出实际成果。

idioms.meaning: 吹大牛；说大话；夸夸其谈
idioms.example_en: He talks big about his wealth, but he actually rents that luxury car.
idioms.example_zh: 他大吹特吹自己多么富有，其实那辆豪车是他租来的。

idioms.meaning: 信口雌黄；胡说八道；不懂装懂
idioms.example_en: Ignore his opinion on economics—he's just talking through his hat.
idioms.example_zh: 别理他对经济学的见解——他纯粹是在不懂装懂、胡说八道。

idioms.meaning: 把某人的耳朵都说出茧来；喋喋不休地说个没完
idioms.example_en: My neighbor caught me in the hallway and nearly talked my ear off.
idioms.example_zh: 邻居在楼道里撞见我，没完没了地讲个不停，差点把我耳朵说出茧来。

idioms.meaning: 这才像话；这才对嘛；正合我意
idioms.example_en: A weekend trip to the beach? Now you're talking!
idioms.example_zh: 周末去海滩度假？这才对嘛，正合我意！

idioms.meaning: 金钱万能；钱能通神；有钱能使鬼推磨
idioms.example_en: In professional sports negotiations, money talks louder than sentiment.
idioms.example_zh: 在职业体育的商业谈判中，金钱往往比情怀更有话语权。

collocations.meaning: 说话在理 / 胡说八道
collocations.example_en: It's refreshing to hear someone talk sense in this heated debate.
collocations.example_zh: 在这次激烈的争辩中，听到有人说了几句明白在理的话，真令人耳目一新。

collocations.meaning: 言归正传谈正事；洽谈生意业务
collocations.example_en: After enjoying our coffee, let's get down to work and talk business.
collocations.example_zh: 喝完咖啡后，我们言归正传谈正事吧。

collocations.example_en: The team was encouraged to talk openly about any bottlenecks they encountered.
collocations.example_zh: 团队成员被鼓励畅所欲言，提出自己遇到的任何瓶颈。

collocations.example_en: The coach needs to have a serious talk with the captain before the final match.
collocations.example_zh: 教练在决赛前需要和队长认真谈一谈。

collocations.example_en: She was invited to give a talk on renewable energy at the annual summit.
collocations.example_zh: 她受邀在年度峰会上就可再生能源作专题报告。

collocations.example_en: He tried to use sweet talk to persuade her into lending him the car.
collocations.example_zh: 他试图用甜言蜜语哄骗她说服她借车给自己。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 还清（债务）；取得成功，得到好结果；收买，贿赂；付清工资并解雇
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Years of hard work finally paid off when she was promoted to partner.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经过多年的辛勤努力，她在晋升为合伙人时终于得到了回报。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 偿还（欠款）；报复，惩罚；报答
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'll pay you back next Friday as soon as I get my salary.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 下周五我一领到工资就还你钱。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为……付款；因……付出代价，受到惩罚
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He drove recklessly and paid for his carelessness with a suspended license.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他鲁莽驾驶，最终为自己的粗心付出了被吊销驾照的代价。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 支付巨款，赔付；渐渐放出（绳索）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The insurance company had to pay out millions following the storm damage.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 暴风雨灾害发生后，保险公司不得不赔付数百万元。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 付清全部欠款；（尤指勉强或被迫）交款
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After several formal warnings, the tenant finally paid up the overdue rent.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经过几次正式警告后，租客终于结清了拖欠的房租。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把（钱）存入银行账户
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She went straight to the branch to pay in a check.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她径直去银行网点存入了一张支票。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向（基金、养老金或特定账户）定期存入/缴纳款项
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He has been paying into a private pension fund for over twenty years.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 二十多年来他一直定期缴纳个人养老金。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分期偿还，逐步减少（债务总额）；当场付清首付
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The government is trying to pay down the national debt through fiscal reforms.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 政府正试图通过财政改革来逐步削减国家债务。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为……承担一部分费用，贴补
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her parents offered to pay towards the cost of her tuition fees.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她父母主动提出帮她承担一部分学费。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把（收到的款项）立即转付给他人；放出（缆绳）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All the profits from the deal were immediately paid away to creditors.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这笔交易的所有利润随即全数转付给了债权人。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把（款项）正式转交/移交给官方或指定受益人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The executor paid over the inheritance to the rightful heirs.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 遗产执行人将遗产正式移交给了合法继承人。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 自掏腰包支付；从（某笔专款/预算）中支出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Travel expenses must be paid out of the departmental budget.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 差旅费必须从部门预算中支出。

idioms.meaning: 花大价钱，被敲竹杠，付出过高的代价
idioms.example_en: They had to pay through the nose for last-minute flight tickets during peak season.
idioms.example_zh: 在旺季，他们不得不花大价钱购买临近起飞的机票。

idioms.meaning: 自食其果，承担（享乐或鲁莽行为的）后果
idioms.example_en: If you live beyond your means for years, you will eventually have to pay the piper.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你多年来一直入不敷出，最终必然要自食其果。

idioms.meaning: 口惠而实不至，做表面文章，虚应故事
idioms.example_en: The management paid lip service to workplace safety but cut the protective gear budget.
idioms.example_zh: 管理层口头上承诺重视职场安全，却削减了防护用具的预算。

idioms.meaning: 吃苦熬出头，历经磨砺获得认可或资格
idioms.example_en: She spent a decade working night shifts at local clinics, paying her dues before becoming chief surgeon.
idioms.example_zh: 她在地方诊所上了十年的夜班，历尽艰辛熬出头，才成为主任医师。

idioms.phrase: pay sb back in their own coin
idioms.meaning: 以其人之道还治其人之身
idioms.example_en: When he refused to share information, the rival team paid him back in his own coin.
idioms.example_zh: 当他拒绝共享信息时，对手团队以其人之道还治其人之身。

idioms.meaning: 作恶无好下场，违法犯罪终遭惩罚
idioms.example_en: The convicted fraudster learned the hard way that crime doesn't pay.
idioms.example_zh: 被定罪的诈骗犯尝到了苦头，明白了多行不义必自毙的道理。

collocations.example_en: Please pay close attention to the safety instructions demonstrated by the crew.
collocations.example_zh: 请仔细留意机组人员演示的安全须知。

collocations.phrase: pay a visit / pay a call
collocations.example_en: We decided to pay a visit to our former teacher while staying in town.
collocations.example_zh: 在城里停留期间，我们决定去探望一下当年的老师。

collocations.example_en: Thousands gathered at the square to pay tribute to the fallen heroes.
collocations.example_zh: 成千上万的人聚集在广场上，向牺牲的英雄们致敬。

collocations.meaning: 自食其力，自掏腰包（不欠人情/不依赖他人）
collocations.example_en: He worked part-time throughout college to pay his own way.
collocations.example_zh: 他在大学期间一直做兼职，自食其力完成学业。

collocations.meaning: 产生丰厚收益，带来长期回报
collocations.example_en: Investing in employee training always pays dividends in the long run.
collocations.example_zh: 从长远来看，投资员工培训总会带来丰厚的回报。

collocations.meaning: 支付溢价，支付额外费用
collocations.example_en: Consumers are willing to pay a premium for organic produce.
collocations.example_zh: 消费者愿意为有机农产品支付溢价。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 索要，请求；自找（麻烦/批评）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If you don't wear a helmet while cycling at high speed, you're asking for trouble.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你高速骑行时不戴头盔，那就是在自找麻烦。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 邀请（某人）出去约会
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He finally gathered the courage to ask her out for dinner on Friday.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他终于鼓起勇气，邀请她周五共进晚餐。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 四处打听，向周围人询问
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I don't know a reliable plumber, but I can ask around for recommendations.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我不认识靠谱的水管工，但我可以四处打听一下推荐。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 问候，询问（某人的近况或身体状况）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Whenever I meet Mrs. Gable, she asks after my mother's health.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 每当我碰见盖布尔夫人，她都会问候我母亲的身体情况。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 邀请（某人）进屋
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't leave the delivery driver standing out in the rain; ask him in for a moment.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别让快递员站在雨里，请他进屋坐会儿吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 邀请（某人）到自己家里做客
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We should ask the new neighbors over for drinks this weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这个周末我们应该请新邻居来家里喝一杯。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回请（某人）；邀请（求职者）参加第二轮面试
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her presentation was so impressive that the board asked her back for a final interview.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她的陈述非常出色，董事会邀请她参加最后一轮面试。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打听，垂询有关……的情况
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Several prospective buyers called to ask about the condition of the house.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 好几个意向买家打电话来询问房子的具体状况。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 邀请（某人）到乡间或楼下
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They asked us down to their country cottage for the bank holiday weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们邀请我们在公共假期去他们乡下的度假小屋小住。

idioms.meaning: 依我看，在我看来（用于表达个人观点）
idioms.example_en: If you ask me, the whole marketing campaign is a waste of money.
idioms.example_zh: 依我看，整场营销活动纯粹是浪费钱。

idioms.meaning: 只要开口就能得到，唾手可得
idioms.example_en: There are plenty of grants available for young entrepreneurs, just for the asking.
idioms.example_zh: 有大量面向青年创业者的补助资金，只要提出申请就能拿到。

idioms.meaning: 别提了！一言难尽！（表示情况很糟糕或尴尬）
idioms.example_en: 'How was your journey back?' 'Don't ask! The flight was canceled twice.'
idioms.example_zh: “你返程顺利吗？”“别提了！航班取消了两次。”

idioms.meaning: 自讨苦吃，自作自受，活该
idioms.example_en: Walking down unlit alleys late at night holding expensive gadgets is just asking for it.
idioms.example_zh: 大半夜拿着贵重数码产品在黑黢黢的巷子里晃荡，简直是自讨苦吃。

idioms.meaning: 异想天开，提出过高或不可能的要求
idioms.example_en: Expecting a zero-error rate in such a complex prototype is asking for the moon.
idioms.example_zh: 指望如此复杂的样机达到零差错率，简直是异想天开。

idioms.phrase: ask no questions and hear no lies
idioms.meaning: 少打听就少听假话（劝人莫管闲事）
idioms.example_en: Where did I find the cash? Ask no questions and you'll hear no lies.
idioms.example_zh: 这钱我是从哪儿弄来的？少问少听假话，别多管闲事。

collocations.example_en: I hate to impose, but could I ask a favor of you regarding tomorrow's shift?
collocations.example_zh: 我真不想麻烦你，但能不能请你帮个忙替一下明天的班？

collocations.example_en: You must ask permission from the property owner before filming on site.
collocations.example_zh: 在此地拍摄前，你必须先征求业主的许可。

collocations.example_en: She consulted her mentor to ask advice on career transitions.
collocations.example_zh: 她向导师请教关于职业转型的建议。

collocations.example_en: The seller is refusing to budge below the original asking price of $400,000.
collocations.example_zh: 卖家拒绝在原先40万美元的挂牌要价上做出任何让步。

collocations.example_en: The junior officer asked leave to visit his ailing father.
collocations.example_zh: 这位初级军官请假去探望生病的父亲。

collocations.example_en: Journalists gathered outside the hall to ask tough questions about the subsidy cuts.
collocations.example_zh: 记者们聚集在大厅外，就削减补贴一事提出了尖锐的质问。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 迄今为止；到目前为止；到某种程度
phrasal_verbs.example_en: So far, we have received over five hundred applications for the position.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 到目前为止，我们已经收到了五百多份该职位的申请。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 远至（某地）；就……而言；达到……程度
phrasal_verbs.example_en: As far as I'm concerned, the decision has already been finalized.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 就我而言，这项决定已经最终敲定了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 远非；决不；完全不
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The project is far from complete, and we need at least another month.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这个项目远未完成，我们至少还需要一个月时间。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: ……得多；大大；最（常与形容词/副词最高级或比较级连用）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: This is by far the most challenging case the detective has ever handled.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这是该侦探迄今处理过的最具挑战性的案件，没有之一。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 无疑；大大；远远（强调程度极大）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She is far and away the best candidate for the chief executive role.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她无疑是担任首席执行官一职的最佳人选。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 前卫的，怪异奇特的；极棒的（俚语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His theories sounded far out at first, but recent experiments prove him right.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他的理论起初听起来十分怪诞，但最近的实验证明他是对的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 四面八方；到处；广泛地
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Volunteers travelled far and wide to gather support for the conservation initiative.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 志愿者们奔赴各地，为这项环保倡议争取广泛支持。

phrasal_verbs.phrase: insofar as / in so far as
phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在……范围内；在……程度上
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The policy was successful insofar as it reduced short-term unemployment.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该政策在降低短期失业率的限度内是成功的。

idioms.meaning: 与……大相径庭；与……相差甚远
idioms.example_en: The lavish hotel was a far cry from the cramped cabin they stayed in last summer.
idioms.example_zh: 这家奢华的酒店与他们去年夏天住的狭小木屋相去甚远。

idioms.meaning: 稀少；罕见；不常发生
idioms.example_en: Affordable housing options in the city centre are becoming few and far between.
idioms.example_zh: 市中心经济实惠的住房选择正变得越来越少。

idioms.meaning: 做得过火；做得太过分
idioms.example_en: Constructive criticism is fine, but personal insults really go too far.
idioms.example_zh: 提出建设性意见没问题，但人身攻击就实在太过分了。

idioms.phrase: far be it from me to do sth
idioms.meaning: 绝非我想（委婉表达批评、异议或干涉）
idioms.example_en: Far be it from me to tell you how to run your team, but morale seems low.
idioms.example_zh: 我绝无意对你的团队管理指手画脚，但现在团队士气似乎很低落。

idioms.meaning: 看某人能走多远；看某种尝试能取得多大进展（常带怀疑口吻）
idioms.example_en: He refused our assistance, so let's see how far he gets on his own.
idioms.example_zh: 他拒绝了我们的帮助，那就看看他凭自己能撑多久吧。

idioms.meaning: 在有限范围内尚可；就其本身而言还行（暗示不够全面或彻底）
idioms.example_en: His analysis is accurate as far as it goes, but it ignores the underlying economic factors.
idioms.example_zh: 就其本身而言他的分析是准确的，但忽略了深层的经济因素。

collocations.meaning: 与……相隔甚远；与……毫无关联
collocations.example_en: Academic theories are often far removed from everyday classroom reality.
collocations.example_zh: 学术理论往往与日常课堂的实际情况相差甚远。

collocations.example_en: The tech firm remains far ahead of its competitors in chip innovation.
collocations.example_zh: 该科技公司在芯片创新方面依然遥遥领先于竞争对手。

collocations.example_en: Without digital infrastructure, rural schools will fall far behind urban ones.
collocations.example_zh: 如果没有数字化基础设施，乡村学校将远远落后于城市学校。

collocations.meaning: 远道；远离家乡；远离本题
collocations.example_en: Researchers had to travel far afield to find undamaged rainforest ecosystems.
collocations.example_zh: 研究人员不得不远涉他乡，寻找未遭破坏的雨林生态系统。

collocations.meaning: 大得多 / 糟糕得多 / 好得多（程度副词搭配）
collocations.example_en: The environmental consequences turned out to be far greater than predicted.
collocations.example_zh: 事实证明，对环境造成的后果远比预期的严重得多。

collocations.example_en: Their initial quarterly revenue estimates were far off the mark.
collocations.example_zh: 他们最初对季度营收的估算大错特错。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （人或物）遭遇……；发生……情况；结果如何（通常用于疑问句）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I often wonder what became of my childhood friend after he moved abroad.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我常常想知道我那位儿时玩伴移居国外后现状究竟如何。

idioms.meaning: 成为第二本能；成为习惯；习以为常
idioms.example_en: After months of rigorous drill, safety protocols have become second nature to the crew.
idioms.example_zh: 经过数月的严格操练，安全规范已成为机组人员的下意识本能。

idioms.meaning: 成为历史；被淘汰；不复存在
idioms.example_en: Traditional incandescent light bulbs have virtually become history in many markets.
idioms.example_zh: 传统的白炽灯泡在许多市场上几乎已经成为历史。

idioms.phrase: become a shadow of one's former self
idioms.meaning: 风光不再；大不如前；憔悴不堪
idioms.example_en: Following the chronic illness, the legendary athlete became a shadow of his former self.
idioms.example_zh: 长期患病之后，这位传奇运动员的风采已大不如前。

idioms.meaning: 某人/某事将来会怎么样；命运将如何
idioms.example_en: If the factory closes down, what will become of the local workers and their families?
idioms.example_zh: 如果工厂倒闭，当地的工人和他们的家庭该何去何从？

idioms.meaning: 成年；达到法定年龄；（事物）达到成熟期
idioms.example_en: The young prince took control of the estate once he became of age.
idioms.example_zh: 年轻的王子一旦成年，便接管了这处庄园。

collocations.example_en: Consumers have become acutely aware of data privacy issues in recent years.
collocations.example_zh: 近年来，消费者已经敏锐地意识到了数据隐私问题。

collocations.example_en: It took the exchange students several weeks to become accustomed to the local diet.
collocations.example_zh: 交换生们花了几个星期才习惯当地的饮食。

collocations.meaning: 变得明朗；水落石出；显而易见
collocations.example_en: It soon became clear that the contract negotiations were heading toward a breakdown.
collocations.example_zh: 形势很快明朗起来，合同谈判正走向破裂。

collocations.example_en: With the launch of commercial space flights, orbital tourism has finally become a reality.
collocations.example_zh: 随着商业太空飞行的启动，轨道旅游终于成为了现实。

collocations.example_en: She decided to become involved in local politics to improve community schooling.
collocations.example_zh: 她决定投身地方政治，以改善社区学校教育。

collocations.meaning: 显现出来；变得显而易见
collocations.example_en: The design flaws became apparent as soon as the prototype entered the stress testing phase.
collocations.example_zh: 原型机一旦进入压力测试阶段，设计缺陷就立刻显现出来了。

collocations.example_en: Without urgent habitat protection, dozens of rare amphibian species will become extinct.
collocations.example_zh: 如果不紧急保护栖息地，数十种珍稀两栖动物将会灭绝。

collocations.example_en: Rapid advances in software may cause standard hardware devices to become obsolete faster.
collocations.example_zh: 软件技术的飞速进步可能会使标准硬件设备更快地被淘汰。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……归入；将……算作（成员或一类）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I am proud to number him among my closest friends.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我很自豪能将他视作我最亲密的朋友之一。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 总数达到；以（成百上千等数量级）计
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The protesters were estimated to number in the tens of thousands.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 据估计，抗议者的人数达到了数万人。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （队列人员）依次报数
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sergeant ordered the squad to fall in and number off.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 军士命令小队集合并依次报数。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 给……按顺序标号；编号
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please number up all the pages before binding the report.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 装订报告前，请给所有页面按顺序编上页码。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……并列；视作……同类
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His latest novel can be numbered with the greatest classics of our time.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他的最新小说堪与我们时代最伟大的经典之作并列。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 被列入……之中；属于……之列
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was numbered among the most influential scientists of the century.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她被列为本世纪最具影响力的科学家之一。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 按编号逐一核对；依序清点
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The warehouse staff numbered down the crates against the shipping manifest.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 仓库管理员对照货运清单逐一核对了板条箱的编号。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 数出；按定额分配编号
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The tickets were carefully numbered out for each sector of the stadium.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 体育场各个区域的门票都已仔细编号并发放。

idioms.meaning: 屈指可数；时日无多；气数已尽
idioms.example_en: With profits plummeting, the CEO's days at the company are numbered.
idioms.example_zh: 随着利润暴跌，这位首席执行官在该公司的日子屈指可数了。

idioms.meaning: 狠狠伤害/打击某人；严重损坏某物；欺骗愚弄
idioms.example_en: That flu really did a number on me; I was in bed for a whole week.
idioms.example_zh: 那场流感可把我折腾惨了，我整整卧床了一周。

idioms.meaning: 看穿某人的底细；摸透某人的把戏
idioms.example_en: He tried to charm his way out of trouble, but the boss already had his number.
idioms.example_zh: 他试图靠献殷勤脱困，但老板早就看穿了他的底细。

idioms.meaning: 机械死板地；照章办事；按步就班地
idioms.example_en: The film follows the genre conventions strictly by the numbers without any surprises.
idioms.example_zh: 这部电影完全是按部就班地套用类型片套路，没有任何惊喜。

idioms.meaning: 某人气数已尽；死期已到；大祸临头
idioms.example_en: When the engine caught fire at 30,000 feet, the pilot thought his number was up.
idioms.example_zh: 当引擎在三万英尺高空起火时，飞行员以为自己的死期到了。

idioms.meaning: 人多势众；人多更安全
idioms.example_en: Hikers are advised to travel in groups because there is safety in numbers.
idioms.example_zh: 建议徒步旅行者结伴同行，因为人多更安全。

idioms.meaning: 数字游戏（只注重冷冰冰的统计量而忽略质量或实质）
idioms.example_en: Modern recruitment has become a ruthless numbers game dominated by algorithms.
idioms.example_zh: 现代招聘已沦为一场由算法主导的残酷数字游戏。
