idioms.meaning: 许多；大量的
idioms.example_en: There could be any number of reasons why she didn't reply to your email.
idioms.example_zh: 她没回复你的邮件可能会有许多种原因。

collocations.example_en: Casualties from the earthquake are feared to number in the thousands.
collocations.example_zh: 据恐，地震中的伤亡人数已达数千人。

collocations.example_en: She has faced hardships without number throughout her career.
collocations.example_zh: 在她的职业生涯中，她经历了无数的艰难困苦。

collocations.example_en: The endangered birds are steadily dwindling in number due to habitat loss.
collocations.example_zh: 由于栖息地丧失，这种濒危鸟类的数量正不断缩减。

collocations.example_en: The exhibits must be numbered consecutively for the auction catalog.
collocations.example_zh: 拍卖图录中的展品必须按顺序连续编号。

collocations.example_en: Subscribers to the online platform continue to grow in number each month.
collocations.example_zh: 该在线平台的用户订阅数量每月都在持续增长。

collocations.example_en: A vast number of complaints were lodged after the train service collapsed.
collocations.example_zh: 列车服务瘫痪后，收到了大量的投诉。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 自作主张；随自己的便；自行其是
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You don't have to follow my advice; just please yourself.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你没必要听我的建议，随你自己的便吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对……感到满意；欣慰
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The board was exceptionally pleased with the quarterly financial results.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 董事会对季度的财务业绩格外满意。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 很乐意做某事；荣幸地做某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We are pleased to announce the launch of our next-generation software.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们非常高兴地宣布推出我们下一代软件。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因……而高兴；为……感到欣喜
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The director was pleased by the warm reception of her debut film.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 导演因其处女作受到热烈欢迎而深感欣慰。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 致力于让客户满意；尽力讨人喜欢
phrasal_verbs.example_en: At our boutique hotel, the staff always aim to please.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在我们的精品酒店，员工们始终致力于让客人满意。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 极力取悦；竭力迎合
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He constantly strove to please his demanding father, often at great personal cost.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他竭力讨好挑剔的父亲，往往为此付出了巨大的个人代价。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 未能令人满意；不讨好
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The new redesign failed to please the company's core user base.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 新的重新设计未能让该公司的核心用户群体感到满意。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 试图取悦；力求讨好
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Politicians often seek to please swing voters with last-minute tax cuts.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 政客们往往试图在最后一刻通过减税来取悦摇摆选民。

idioms.meaning: 非常高兴；心满意足；得意扬扬
idioms.example_en: When she heard she won the scholarship, she was as pleased as Punch.
idioms.example_zh: 当听说自己赢得了奖学金时，她高兴得合不拢嘴。

idioms.meaning: 随你的便；极其/非常（如 calm as you please）
idioms.example_en: He walked right past the security guards, cool as you please.
idioms.example_zh: 他从保安身边大摇大摆地走了过去，显得极其淡定。

idioms.meaning: 难以取悦；挑剔苛刻
idioms.example_en: The food critic is notoriously hard to please, but she loved the soup.
idioms.example_zh: 这位美食评论家出了名的难以取悦，但她却非常喜欢这道汤。

idioms.meaning: 请问；请听我说；竟然（用于表示惊讶、愤慨或嘲讽）
idioms.example_en: They charged us fifty dollars for parking, if you please!
idioms.example_zh: 他们竟然收了我们五十美元的停车费，真不可思议！

idioms.meaning: 但愿；老天保佑
idioms.example_en: Please God, may the surgery go smoothly and the biopsy come back clear.
idioms.example_zh: 老天保佑，但愿手术一切顺利且活检结果正常。

idioms.meaning: 赏心悦目；养眼
idioms.example_en: The minimalist interior design is functional and pleases the eye.
idioms.example_zh: 极简主义的室内设计兼具实用性与赏心悦目的美感。

idioms.meaning: 容易满足；随和不挑剔
idioms.example_en: Grandpa is very easy to please; a cup of tea and a good book make his day.
idioms.example_zh: 爷爷非常容易满足，一杯茶和一本好书就能让他开心一整天。

collocations.meaning: 急于讨好；渴望令人满意
collocations.example_en: As a newcomer to the firm, he was overly anxious to please his superiors.
collocations.example_zh: 作为公司的新人，他过分急于讨好自己的上司。

collocations.meaning: 随心所欲；想做什么就做什么
collocations.example_en: Now that she is retired, she can travel the world and do as she pleases.
collocations.example_zh: 现在她退休了，可以环游世界，随心所欲地生活。

collocations.meaning: 使某人极其高兴；深得某人欢心
collocations.example_en: The glowing reviews pleased the author immensely after months of anxiety.
collocations.example_zh: 经历数月的焦虑后，这些热烈的好评让作者感到无比欣慰。

collocations.meaning: 试图讨好每个人；面面俱到
collocations.example_en: You cannot lead effectively if you spend all your time trying to please everyone.
collocations.example_zh: 如果你把所有时间都花在试图讨好每个人上，你就无法进行有效的领导。

collocations.example_en: Working under an impossible to please supervisor burned out the entire marketing team.
collocations.example_zh: 在一名称得上无法讨好的主管手下工作，让整个营销团队心力交瘁。

collocations.example_en: Golden retrievers are famous for being friendly and eager to please.
collocations.example_zh: 金毛寻回犬以性格友善、乐于讨人欢心而闻名。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用……向（某地或某机构）提供服务/补给；配备……设施
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The island community is regularly serviced with medical supplies and fresh water by sea.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该海岛社区定期通过海运补给医疗物资和淡水。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （商业/IT）将服务或维护业务外包；从外部获取技术服务
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The logistics firm decided to service out its fleet maintenance to an external contractor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家物流公司决定将其车队的维护业务外包给外部承包商。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 由……提供运营/交通/网络/维护等服务
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The new industrial park is well serviced by direct high-speed rail and bus links.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这个新工业园区拥有直达高铁和公交线路的良好交通配套服务。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为……进行维修保养；针对（特定用途或负债）进行服务或结算
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You need to take your generator in to be serviced for the upcoming winter season.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你需要把发电机送去检修保养，以备即将到来的冬季使用。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 引入……提供服务；调入设备或人员进行检修
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Specialist technicians were serviced in to upgrade the mainframe servers over the weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 专业技术人员在周末被调集进来升级主机服务器。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 停机维护；逐项关停检修
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The refinery operators had to service down two processing units due to mechanical wear.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于机械磨损，炼油厂操作员不得不停机检修两个处理单元。

idioms.meaning: 对……口惠而实不至；空口说白话；敷衍应付
idioms.example_en: The management paid lip service to environmental protection while continuing to dump waste.
idioms.example_zh: 管理层口口声声说支持环保，实际上却在继续倾倒废物。

idioms.meaning: 临时征用；把……派上临时用场
idioms.example_en: When the bus broke down, local minivans were pressed into service to transport the passengers.
idioms.example_zh: 大巴抛锚后，当地的小型面包车被临时征用来转运乘客。

idioms.meaning: 对某人有用；能为某人效劳/提供帮助
idioms.example_en: Please let me know if I can be of any service to you during your stay.
idioms.example_zh: 在您逗留期间，如果我能为您提供任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

idioms.meaning: 随时听候某人吩咐；乐意为某人效劳
idioms.example_en: "I am entirely at your service, sir," the concierge replied with a courteous bow.
idioms.example_zh: “先生，我随时听候您的吩咐，”门房礼貌地鞠躬回答道。

idioms.meaning: 为某人提供服务；帮某人一个忙；效劳
idioms.example_en: He rendered a valuable service to the company by negotiating a critical truce with suppliers.
idioms.example_zh: 他通过与供应商达成关键和解，为公司立下了一大功劳。

idioms.meaning: （机器、车辆或工具）经久耐用、服役多年；参军服役
idioms.example_en: This old tractor has seen service on the farm for over four decades and still runs smoothly.
idioms.example_zh: 这台老拖拉机在农场服役了四十多年，运转依然顺畅。

collocations.meaning: 偿还债务/贷款的利息（或本息）
collocations.example_en: The developing nation is struggling to service its enormous foreign debt.
collocations.example_zh: 这个发展中国家正苦于偿还其巨额的外债利息。

collocations.meaning: 检修/保养汽车、车辆或引擎
collocations.example_en: You ought to have your car serviced regularly to prevent costly breakdowns.
collocations.example_zh: 你应当定期保养汽车，以防出现花费高昂的故障。

collocations.meaning: 服务/维护客户或业务账户
collocations.example_en: Our senior account executives are assigned to service high-net-worth clients.
collocations.example_zh: 我们的资深客户经理被指派专门维护高净值客户。

collocations.meaning: 向某个区域或市场提供营运路线、基础设施或商业服务
collocations.example_en: The low-cost airline plans to service several emerging secondary cities next year.
collocations.example_zh: 这家廉价航空公司计划明年开通多条飞往新兴二线城市的航线。

collocations.meaning: 满足……的需求；为……的需要服务
collocations.example_en: The revised curriculum is tailored to service the needs of an increasingly digital workforce.
collocations.example_zh: 修订后的课程专为满足日益数字化劳动力队伍的需求而设计。

collocations.meaning: 全面检修；定期维护保养
collocations.example_en: The elevator was fully serviced last month, so the sudden breakdown surprised everyone.
collocations.example_zh: 电梯上个月才做过全面检修，因此突然故障让大家十分惊讶。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 陪伴/支持某人度过（艰难时期、疾病、危机等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her family rallied to support her through the grueling chemotherapy treatments.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在家人的同心陪伴和支持下，她挺过了艰辛的化疗疗程。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在（某项事业、决策或行动）中给予某人支持/鼓励
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The board unanimously agreed to support the CEO in her ambitious restructuring plan.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 董事会一致同意支持首席执行官雄心勃勃的重组计划。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用（资金、证据、资源等）赞助/证实/支持某人或某物
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The university supported the young researchers with substantial seed grants and lab space.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 大学用充裕的种子基金和实验室空间大力资助这批年轻的研究人员。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 支撑起；支护；在物理或心理上支撑使之不倒
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They used heavy timber beams to support up the sagging roof of the old barn.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们用粗大的木梁将旧谷仓下陷的屋顶支撑起来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 由……支撑/资助；以……为论据支持
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The entire canopy is supported by slender titanium pillars.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 整个顶棚仅由几根纤细的钛合金立柱支撑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （IT/运维）全程技术兜底支持；维持外部系统兼容运作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The software vendor has pledged to support out the legacy operating system until 2030.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该软件厂商已承诺对传统旧版操作系统提供技术支持直至2030年。

idioms.meaning: 作为支持……的理由；为了声援/支援……
idioms.example_en: Thousands of demonstrators marched through the capital in support of electoral reform.
idioms.example_zh: 数以千计的示威者在首都游行，以声援选举制度改革。

idioms.meaning: 支持……；为（理论、观点）提供依据；增添可信度
idioms.example_en: Recent archaeological findings lend strong support to the theory of early human migration.
idioms.example_zh: 最新的考古发现为早期人类迁徙理论提供了强有力的支持。

idioms.meaning: 公开表态支持/拥护（某人或观点）
idioms.example_en: Several prominent economists have come out in support of the proposed tax cuts.
idioms.example_zh: 几位著名经济学家已公开表态支持这项减税提案。

idioms.meaning: 争取/赢得……的支持与协助
idioms.example_en: The charity aims to enlist the support of local businesses to build the community shelter.
idioms.example_zh: 该慈善机构旨在争取当地企业的支持来建立社区收容所。

idioms.meaning: 团结聚集起来声援/支持
idioms.example_en: Voters across the country rallied in support of the embattled prime minister.
idioms.example_zh: 全国选民团结一致，声援深陷政治困境的首相。

idioms.meaning: 承受……的重量；（引申）担负起……的沉重负担
idioms.example_en: The old stone bridge can no longer support the weight of heavy commercial trucks.
idioms.example_zh: 这座古老的石桥已无法再承受重型商业货车的重量。

collocations.example_en: He worked two jobs simultaneously to support his growing family.
collocations.example_zh: 他同时打两份工来抚养他人口日增的家庭。

collocations.meaning: 证实/支持假说、理论或主张
collocations.example_en: There is currently insufficient clinical data to support this controversial claim.
collocations.example_zh: 目前尚无充分的临床数据能够证实这一有争议的主张。

collocations.meaning: 支持/拥护（某个运动队、俱乐部）
collocations.example_en: He has supported Liverpool Football Club ever since he was a little boy.
collocations.example_zh: 从孩提时代起，他就一直是利物浦足球俱乐部的忠实球迷。

collocations.meaning: 支持/赞成提案、动议或政策
collocations.example_en: The majority of lawmakers voted to support the climate transition bill.
collocations.example_zh: 多数立法议员投票支持这项气候转型法案。

collocations.meaning: 极力/全力/全心全意支持
collocations.example_en: We wholeheartedly support the peace initiatives undertaken by the United Nations.
collocations.example_zh: 我们全心全意支持联合国采取的和平倡议。

collocations.meaning: 在经济上资助/在资金与精神上给予支持
collocations.example_en: The endowment fund was established to financially support underprivileged college students.
collocations.example_zh: 该留本基金的设立旨在资助家庭贫困的大学生。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 畅所欲言；展现出/带来（机会）；开张/开门营业；加速/开足马力
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It took months of counseling before he finally began to open up about his traumatic past.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经过数月的心理咨询，他才终于开始敞开心扉倾诉自己痛苦的过去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 展开/铺开；（视野、道路等）变得开阔；（性格）变得开朗/活跃
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The narrow mountain path eventually opens out onto a magnificent valley.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 狭窄的山间小道最终通向一片开阔壮丽的山谷。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 面朝/通向（某处）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The French doors in the living room open onto a sunlit balcony.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 客厅里的法式落地窗通向一个阳光明媚的阳台。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 连通到；直接进入（另一空间）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The kitchen opens directly into a spacious dining area.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 厨房直接连通一个宽敞的用餐区。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以…开场/开始
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The orchestra opened with a dramatic overture that captivated the audience.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 管弦乐队以一段扣人心弦的序曲开场，瞬间吸引了观众。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （房间等）由…分出/与…相连
phrasal_verbs.example_en: There are three small guest bedrooms opening off the main hallway.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 主走廊旁边连着三间小客房。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向…猛烈开火；对…发起激烈抨击
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The opposition party opened up on the minister over the new tax proposals.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 反对党针对新税收提案向部长发起了猛烈抨击。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向后翻折/敞开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Fold the top flap and open back the sides to unpack the equipment.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 折起顶部的翻盖并将两侧向后展开以取出设备。

idioms.meaning: 引起一连串麻烦；触碰棘手复杂的难题
idioms.example_en: Investigating that corruption rumor will open a huge can of worms for the board.
idioms.example_zh: 调查那起腐败传闻会给董事会惹来一大堆极难处理的麻烦。

idioms.meaning: 使某人大开眼界；使某人看清事实真相
idioms.example_en: Working in rural clinics really opened her eyes to the severe healthcare inequalities.
idioms.example_zh: 在乡村诊所工作的经历真正让她看清了医疗资源匮乏与不平等的现实。

idioms.meaning: 大开方便之门；引发无法遏制的连锁反应/泛滥之势
idioms.example_en: Approving this single exception could open the floodgates to hundreds of similar requests.
idioms.example_zh: 批准这一个特例可能会打开闸门，引来成百上千个类似的申请。

idioms.meaning: 保持开放的心态；不带成见
idioms.example_en: We should keep an open mind until we have examined all the available evidence.
idioms.example_zh: 在审查完所有现有证据之前，我们应该保持客观开放的态度。

idioms.meaning: 创造机会；铺平道路
idioms.example_en: Earning a degree from a prestigious university often opens doors in the financial sector.
idioms.example_zh: 从名牌大学获得学位通常能在金融行业为个人开启大量机遇之门。

idioms.meaning: 揭开旧伤疤；重提令人痛苦的往事
idioms.example_en: I didn't mean to open an old wound by bringing up her previous marriage.
idioms.example_zh: 我提起她上一段婚姻并不是存心想揭她的旧伤疤。

collocations.example_en: You need two forms of identification to open a bank account.
collocations.example_zh: 你需要两种身份证明文件才能开立银行账户。

collocations.example_en: The soldiers were ordered not to open fire unless directly threatened.
collocations.example_zh: 士兵们接到命令，除非受到直接威胁，否则不得开火。

collocations.example_en: Both nations agreed to open a constructive dialogue to de-escalate border tensions.
collocations.example_zh: 两国同意展开建设性对话，以缓解边境紧张局势。

collocations.example_en: The senator will open the debate on the proposed climate bill tomorrow morning.
collocations.example_zh: 参议员将于明早带头就拟议的气候法案展开辩论。

collocations.example_en: The auctioneer opened the bidding at five thousand dollars.
collocations.example_zh: 拍卖师以五千美元作为起拍价拉开了竞价序幕。

collocations.example_en: The dentist asked the patient to open wide so she could inspect the molar.
collocations.example_zh: 牙医让患者把嘴张大，以便检查臼齿。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 建立/设立；安排/组织；安装/装配；陷害/设局陷害
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She managed to set up her own consulting firm within a year of graduating.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 毕业不到一年，她就成功创办了自己的咨询公司。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 出发/启程；引起/激起；引爆/触发（警报或装置）；衬托/显出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Smoke from the kitchen set off the fire alarm and forced an evacuation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 厨房冒出的浓烟触发了火灾警报，迫使所有人撤离。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 动身/启程；着手/打算；陈述/阐明；陈列/摆放
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The document sets out the government's long-term environmental objectives clearly.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该文件清晰地阐明了政府的长期环保目标。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 着手处理/开始做；攻击/痛打
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Immediately after the flood receded, volunteers set about cleaning the community center.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 洪水一退去，志愿者们便立刻着手清理社区活动中心。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （坏天气、疾病或不良状态）到来并持续；陷入
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Before panic could set in, the flight crew calmly instructed everyone on safety procedures.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在恐慌情绪蔓延开来之前，机组人员冷静地向大家说明了安全须知。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 推迟/阻碍（进程）；使花费（巨款）；使远离（道路或边缘）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The unexpected technical glitch set back the project's launch by two full months.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 突如其来的技术故障将项目的上线时间推迟了整整两个月。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 留出/拨出（时间或金钱）；把…置于一旁/暂不理会；撤销/驳回（判决）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's set aside our personal differences and focus entirely on finishing the task.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 让我们先把个人分歧放在一边，全力以赴完成任务。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 写下/记下；放下；制定/规定；让（乘客）下车
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company handbook sets down strict rules regarding employee confidentiality.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 员工手册明确规定了关于员工保密的严格准则。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 阐明/陈述；启程/出发
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In his opening statement, the lawyer set forth the core facts of the lawsuit.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在开场陈词中，律师详细陈述了本案的核心事实。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使与众不同/突出；留出/拨出（专款或时间）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her deep domain expertise and calm leadership style set her apart from other applicants.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 深厚的专业素养和沉稳的领导风格使她在众多应聘者中脱颖而出。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使对立/煽动反对；权衡/对照
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The dispute over land inheritance tragically set brother against brother.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 土地继承权之争令人痛心地导致了兄弟反目成仇。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （使）袭击/攻击；唆使（狗等）扑向
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The guard threatened to set the dogs on anyone attempting to climb the perimeter fence.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警卫威胁说，谁要是敢翻越围栏，就放狗撕咬。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 全力以赴干起来/大干起来；开始争吵/大打出手
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If we all set to right now, we can easily finish the harvesting before sunset.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果我们现在一起大干起来，完全可以在日落前完成收割。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 积蓄/留出（资金备用）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She tries to set by a modest portion of her salary every month for emergencies.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她每个月都会设法存下一小部分薪水以备不时之需。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将（钟表）拨快；提出（论点、建议）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't forget to set forward your clocks by one hour when daylight saving begins.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 夏令时开始时，别忘了把时钟拨快一小时。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 委任…主管/指派…监管
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A seasoned director was set over the regional branches to streamline operations.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一位经验丰富的总监被任命主管各区域分部，以优化运营效率。

idioms.meaning: 澄清事实；纠正误解
idioms.example_en: The spokesperson called a press briefing to set the record straight regarding the allegations.
idioms.example_zh: 发言人召开了新闻发布会，以澄清针对这些指控的事实真相。

idioms.meaning: 把目光投向；立志追求/争取
idioms.example_en: Having dominated the national tournament, the swimmer has set her sights on Olympic gold.
idioms.example_zh: 在横扫全国锦标赛后，这位游泳选手已将目光锁定在奥运金牌上。

idioms.meaning: 板上钉钉；一成不变/不可更改
idioms.example_en: These schedule proposals are preliminary, so none of the dates are set in stone yet.
idioms.example_zh: 这些日程安排只是初步方案，因此日期都还没板上钉钉。

idioms.meaning: 定下基调；确立风气
idioms.example_en: The CEO's opening remarks set an optimistic tone for the entire annual summit.
idioms.example_zh: 首席执行官的开幕致辞为整场年度峰会定下了乐观积极的基调。

idioms.meaning: 一心想要；渴望得到
idioms.example_en: He had set his heart on studying architecture in Paris ever since childhood.
idioms.example_zh: 他从小就一心渴望去巴黎攻读建筑学。

idioms.meaning: 使某人感到放松/自在
idioms.example_en: The interviewer's friendly smile instantly set the nervous candidate at ease.
idioms.example_zh: 面试官友善的微笑让紧张的应聘者立刻放松了下来。

idioms.meaning: 取得惊人成就；引起轰动（常用于否定句）
idioms.example_en: His debut novel won praise, but it hardly set the world on fire commercially.
idioms.example_zh: 他的处女作小说获得了好评，但在商业上并未引起太大轰动。

collocations.example_en: Senior managers are expected to set an example of punctuality and accountability.
collocations.example_zh: 高级管理人员应当在守时和负责方面树立榜样。

collocations.example_en: The Supreme Court ruling is likely to set a legal precedent for future privacy cases.
collocations.example_zh: 最高法院的裁决很可能会为未来的隐私权案件开创司法先例。

collocations.example_en: The committee set a strict deadline of Friday at noon for submitting project bids.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会设定了严格的截止日期：周五中午前必须提交项目投标书。

collocations.example_en: Protesters set fire to piles of trash outside the embassy during the demonstration.
collocations.example_zh: 抗议者在游行示威期间点燃了使馆外的垃圾堆。

collocations.example_en: The athlete set a new world record in the 400-meter hurdles yesterday.
collocations.example_zh: 这位运动员昨天在400米栏比赛中创下了新的世界纪录。

collocations.example_en: New evidence presented by the defense persuaded the judge to set the prisoner free.
collocations.example_zh: 辩方出示的新证据促使法官当庭释放了该名囚犯。

collocations.example_en: Detectives set an elaborate trap to catch the counterfeiters red-handed.
collocations.example_zh: 便衣警探设下周密的圈套，企图将造假分子当场人赃并获。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……搞砸；弄坏；弄伤或严重伤害（某人）；使精神崩溃/陷入混乱
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He really fucked up the presentation by losing his temper.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他因为发脾气把那场汇报彻底搞砸了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 滚开，走开；游手好闲，消磨时间
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Tell him to fuck off and leave us alone.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 叫他滚开，别来烦我们。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 瞎胡闹，鬼混；乱搞男女关系（出轨）；瞎摆弄（机器或装置）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Stop fucking around and get back to work.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别胡闹了，赶紧回去干活。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 招惹，挑衅；瞎动，摆弄；捉弄，玩弄
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You really don't want to fuck with that guy; he's dangerous.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你最好别去招惹那家伙，他很危险。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 坑害，背叛，亏待（某人）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His business partner completely fucked him over and ran away with the money.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他的商业合伙人彻底坑了他一把，卷款潜逃了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 故意耍弄某人；对某人出尔反尔，浪费某人时间
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Quit fucking me around and give me a straight answer.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别再耍我了，给我一个痛快的回答。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 挥霍，虚度（时间、金钱等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He fucked away his entire inheritance within two years.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他不到两年就把所有遗产挥霍一空。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 仓促且马虎地做完某事；胡乱混过去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't just fuck through your assignment at the last minute.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别等到最后一分钟才胡乱应付你的作业。

idioms.meaning: 在乎，介意（常用于否定句或疑问句）
idioms.example_en: I honestly don't give a fuck what they think of me.
idioms.example_zh: 我真的一点都不在乎他们怎么看我。

idioms.meaning: 到底怎么回事；搞什么鬼（表达极度震惊或愤怒）
idioms.example_en: What the fuck is going on out there?
idioms.example_zh: 外头到底搞什么鬼？

idioms.meaning: 一无所有，屁都没有；毫无作用
idioms.example_en: I worked all day and got fuck all to show for it.
idioms.example_zh: 我辛苦干了一整天，结果什么都没拿到。

idioms.meaning: 闭上臭嘴；彻底闭嘴
idioms.example_en: Shut the fuck up and listen to what I'm saying.
idioms.example_zh: 闭上你的臭嘴，听我把话说完。

idioms.meaning: 去他的，算了（表示放弃、厌烦或听天由命）
idioms.example_en: Fuck it, let's just go home and forget about the party.
idioms.example_zh: 去他的，咱们直接回家吧，别管那个派对了。

idioms.meaning: 极其，非常（口语强化副词短语）
idioms.example_en: It's cold as fuck outside, so put on a warm coat.
idioms.example_zh: 外面冷得要命，穿件暖和的大衣吧。

collocations.phrase: scare the fuck out of sb
collocations.example_en: That sudden loud noise scared the fuck out of me.
collocations.example_zh: 那声巨响把我的魂都快吓飞了。

collocations.phrase: beat the fuck out of sb
collocations.example_en: They threatened to beat the fuck out of him if he talked.
collocations.example_zh: 他们威胁说如果他敢走漏风声，就打断他的腿。

collocations.phrase: annoy / bother the fuck out of sb
collocations.meaning: 把某人烦死；极度惹恼某人
collocations.example_en: His constant complaining annoys the fuck out of everyone.
collocations.example_zh: 他没完没了的抱怨快把所有人都烦死了。

collocations.example_en: A single mistake could fuck up the whole operation completely.
collocations.example_zh: 一个细小的疏忽就可能把整项行动彻底毁掉。

collocations.example_en: We were freezing the fuck out waiting for the delayed bus.
collocations.example_zh: 等那趟晚点的公交车时，我们快被冻成冰棍了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （使）聚集在一起；联合，归拢到一起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The children grouped together under the shelter to avoid the rain.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 孩子们聚在雨棚下躲雨。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 组队；集合成小组
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's group up and tackle the final project together.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们组队一起做期末项目吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 环绕聚集在……周围
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Curious tourists grouped around the street performer.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 好奇的游客们团团围在街头艺人身旁。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……划分/归类为；分成（若干类或组）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The participants were grouped into four distinct categories.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 参与者被划分为四个不同的类别。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 归入……门下；归在……标题/类别之下
phrasal_verbs.example_en: These symptoms are usually grouped under the umbrella of chronic fatigue.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这些症状通常被归入慢性疲劳综合征的范畴。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 按照……进行分类/分组
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You can group the files by date or file size in this folder.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你可以在此文件夹中按日期或文件大小对文件进行分类。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分批分开；分成几个小队单独行动
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The tour guide told the visitors to group off for the workshop.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 导游让参观者分成若干小组参加工作坊。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……归为一组；把……与……归并在一起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In biological taxonomy, this species is often grouped with sea birds.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在生物分类学中，该物种常与海鸟归为一类。

idioms.meaning: 集体努力；团队合作成果
idioms.example_en: Winning this championship was truly a group effort.
idioms.example_zh: 赢得这次锦标赛确实是整个团队共同努力的结果。

idioms.meaning: 群体动力学；团队人际互动关系
idioms.example_en: The manager needs to understand the group dynamics before assigning roles.
idioms.example_zh: 经理在分派角色之前需要先摸清团队的人际互动情况。

idioms.meaning: 群体盲思（因屈从团队共识而缺乏独立判断）
idioms.example_en: The board's disastrous decision was a classic case of groupthink.
idioms.example_zh: 董事会灾难性的决定是典型的群体盲思产物。

idioms.meaning: 融入群体；成为圈内人
idioms.example_en: It took several months for the newcomer to really feel part of the group.
idioms.example_zh: 新来的人花了几个月的时间才真正感觉自己融入了这个集体。

idioms.meaning: 同龄人；年龄段群组
idioms.example_en: This educational program is tailored specifically for the 6-to-12 age group.
idioms.example_zh: 这个教育项目是专门为6至12岁年龄段儿童量身打造的。

collocations.example_en: The teacher asked the class to break into small groups for discussion.
collocations.example_zh: 老师让全班分成若干小组进行讨论。

collocations.example_en: Local residents formed a support group to help flood victims.
collocations.example_zh: 当地居民成立了一个互助小组来帮助洪灾灾民。

collocations.meaning: 按类别对某物进行归类
collocations.example_en: The librarian grouped the new books by subject category.
collocations.example_zh: 图书管理员按主题门类对新书进行了归类。

collocations.example_en: Adolescents are heavily influenced by the opinions of their peer group.
collocations.example_zh: 青少年深受其同辈群体观点的影响。

collocations.example_en: We conducted a focus group to gather customer feedback on the new prototype.
collocations.example_zh: 我们组织了一次焦点小组访谈，以收集客户对新原型的反馈。

collocations.example_en: Young urban professionals are the primary target group for this product.
collocations.example_zh: 年轻的都市白领是该产品的主要目标受众。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把（员工或官员）临时借调/调派至；屈居于……之后
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was seconded to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a two-year assignment.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她被临时借调到外交部工作两年。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 临时调离，抽调至外地或外单位工作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Several experienced engineers were seconded away to resolve the crisis at the overseas branch.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 几位经验丰富的工程师被抽调到海外分部去解决危机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 借调进入（某项目组、特别行动队或机构）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He was seconded into the task force to lead the financial audit.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他被抽调进入特别行动组负责财务审计工作。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 派往外部机构任职；（体育/拳击中）担任场外助手
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The bank seconded out several executives to advise the fledgling tech startup.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 银行借调了几名高管去为那家初创科技公司提供指导。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在竞赛或搏击中充当助手；协助调入
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His veteran coach seconded in the corner during the championship bout.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在冠军争夺战中，他的资深教练在拳台角落实时充当场边助手。

idioms.meaning: 首屈一指，不亚于任何人或物
idioms.example_en: The quality of their customer service is second to none in the industry.
idioms.example_zh: 他们的客户服务质量在业内首屈一指。

idioms.meaning: 转念一想；进一步考虑后
idioms.example_en: I was going to stay home, but on second thought, I think I'll join you.
idioms.example_zh: 我原本打算留在家里，但转念一想，我觉得还是跟你们一起去吧。

idioms.meaning: 屈居次席，充当副手；处于次要地位
idioms.example_en: He was tired of playing second fiddle to his more charismatic partner.
idioms.example_zh: 他厌倦了充当那个更有魅力的搭档的副手。

idioms.meaning: （对决定或计划）产生动摇、疑虑或后悔
idioms.example_en: She started having second thoughts about moving across the country alone.
idioms.example_zh: 她开始对自己独自一人搬到全国另一端产生疑虑。

idioms.meaning: 恢复精力，缓过劲来；重拾干劲
idioms.example_en: After a short break and a hot cup of coffee, the runners got a second wind.
idioms.example_zh: 短暂休息并喝了杯热咖啡后，选手们恢复了体力，重拾干劲。

idioms.meaning: 成为第二天性，习以为常的习惯
idioms.example_en: After decades behind the wheel, driving defensively has become second nature to him.
idioms.example_zh: 驾车数十年后，防御性驾驶对他来说已经成了第二天性。

idioms.meaning: 间接地；从旁人处传闻得知
idioms.example_en: I only heard the news at second hand, so take it with a grain of salt.
idioms.example_zh: 这消息我只是间接听来的，所以姑且听之，别全信。

collocations.example_en: I would like to second the motion to approve the proposed budget.
collocations.example_zh: 我愿附议批准拟定预算的动议。

collocations.example_en: The committee member stood up immediately to second her nomination for president.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会成员立即起立附议她担任总裁的提名。

collocations.meaning: 被临时借调/派往（某组织或部门）
collocations.example_en: Dr. Evans has been seconded to the World Health Organization for six months.
collocations.example_zh: 埃文斯博士已被借调到世界卫生组织工作六个月。

collocations.meaning: 赞同/支持某人的言论或观点
collocations.example_en: I heartily second your remarks regarding the need for better communication.
collocations.example_zh: 对于你提到需要加强沟通的看法，我由衷赞同。

collocations.example_en: Profits must never come before safety, but here they seem to come second to nothing.
collocations.example_zh: 利润绝不能凌驾于安全之上，但在这里安全似乎总要给利润让路。

collocations.meaning: 每隔一天/周（即每两天/两周一次）
collocations.example_en: The team holds progress check-in meetings every second week.
collocations.example_zh: 团队每隔一周举行一次项目进展审查会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用拉索/牵索加固或拉紧（桅杆、帐篷或建筑构件）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They had to guy up the communication mast securely before the storm arrived.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在暴风雨来临之前，他们必须用牵索把通信塔牢牢固定住。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向外拉紧牵索以保持平衡或固定
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Workers guyed out the temporary scaffolding to prevent it from swaying.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工人们向外拉紧临时脚手架的缆风绳，以防止其晃动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用地锚或拉索向下牵拉固定
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Make sure you guy down the marquee properly to stop it from blowing away.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 务必用拉绳把大帐篷向下扎紧固定，防止被风吹走。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 胡闹，开玩笑，嬉皮笑脸（口语非正式）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Stop guying around and focus on finishing the report before the deadline.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别胡闹了，集中注意力在截止时间前把报告做完。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拿某人取笑，捉弄/打趣某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His classmates loved to guy him about his outrageous new hairstyle.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他的同学们很喜欢拿他那标新立异的新发型取笑他。

idioms.meaning: 自作聪明的人；自命不凡者；（美俚）黑帮分子
idioms.example_en: Don't get smart with me, you wise guy, or you'll be sent to the principal's office.
idioms.example_zh: 别跟我耍小聪明，你这个自作聪明的家伙，否则就把你送到校长办公室去。

idioms.meaning: 替罪羊；顶黑锅的人
idioms.example_en: The junior manager realized he was being set up as the fall guy for the company's financial fraud.
idioms.example_zh: 那位初级经理意识到自己正被当成公司财务欺诈案的替罪羊。

idioms.meaning: 随和亲切的普通人；老好人
idioms.example_en: Despite his immense wealth and celebrity status, he behaves like a regular guy.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管坐拥巨额财富与明星声望，他待人接物却像个随和朴素的普通人。

idioms.meaning: 硬汉；作风强硬不容招惹的人
idioms.example_en: He acts like a tough guy on the outside, but deep down he has a gentle heart.
idioms.example_zh: 他表面上装作一副硬汉模样，但内心深处其实非常温柔。

idioms.phrase: the good guys and the bad guys
idioms.meaning: 正派与反派；好人与恶徒
idioms.example_en: Real-world international politics is rarely a simple battle between good guys and bad guys.
idioms.example_zh: 现实世界中的国际政治极少能被简单地归纳为好人与坏人之间的决斗。

idioms.meaning: 平民百姓；处于弱势的小人物/小公司
idioms.example_en: The proposed tax reforms are designed to ease the economic burden on the little guy.
idioms.example_zh: 这项拟议中的税制改革旨在减轻普通底层老百姓的经济负担。

collocations.meaning: 充当替罪羊，出面背黑锅
collocations.example_en: He refused to play the fall guy for the blunders committed by his superiors.
collocations.example_zh: 他拒绝为上司犯下的愚蠢错误去充当替罪羊。

collocations.meaning: 为人正直靠谱、讲义气值得信赖的人
collocations.example_en: You can count on Mark to keep his word; he is a completely stand-up guy.
collocations.example_zh: 你可以完全信赖马克恪守诺言，他是个极其正直讲义气的人。

collocations.example_en: Inspect every guy wire thoroughly to ensure the radio antenna withstands high winds.
collocations.example_zh: 仔细检查每一根缆风绳，以确保无线电天线能够抵御强风。

collocations.meaning: 无情地嘲弄/戏谑某事或某人
collocations.example_en: The satirist guying the pompous political rhetoric had the entire audience in stitches.
collocations.example_zh: 那位讽刺作家无情地调侃浮夸的政治辞令，逗得全场观众哄堂大笑。

collocations.meaning: 你们（北美口语中广泛指代群体，不分男女）
collocations.example_en: What are you guys planning to order for dinner tonight?
collocations.example_zh: 你们大家今晚打算点什么当晚餐？

collocations.meaning: 好好先生；老实友善的人（有时带贬义，暗示缺乏魄力）
collocations.example_en: They say nice guys finish last, but his genuine integrity eventually won everyone over.
collocations.example_zh: 人常说‘老好人往往吃亏’，但他真诚的为人最终赢得了所有人的赞同。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 碰头；聚会，会面
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's meet up for coffee this weekend to catch up on everything.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们这个周末找个地方喝杯咖啡碰个头，好好聊聊近况吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 遭遇，蒙受（反对/批评/失败等）；与……正式会见/商谈
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The proposed tax reforms met with fierce resistance from local businesses.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这项拟议的税制改革遭到了当地企业的强烈抵制。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……会合；偶然碰见
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'm planning to meet up with some old university friends in London.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我正打算在伦敦与几位大学老友碰头叙旧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （到车站、机场等）接（下车/下飞机的）人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her parents drove to the station to meet her off the late train.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她父母开车去火车站接那趟晚班火车到站的她。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 聚拢；汇合；集合商议
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The committee members meet together once a month to review project progress.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 委员会成员每月齐聚一次以审查项目进展。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 返回原处碰头；重新集合
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You have an hour of free time, then let's meet back at the museum entrance.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 大家有一小时自由活动时间，然后我们在博物馆入口处重新集合。

idioms.meaning: 收支相抵；维持生计
idioms.example_en: With rising living costs, many young families struggle to make ends meet.
idioms.example_zh: 随着生活成本攀升，许多年轻家庭难以维持收支平衡。

idioms.meaning: 迁就某人；各让半步；达成妥协
idioms.example_en: If you are willing to lower the price slightly, we can meet you halfway on the delivery date.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你方愿意稍作降价，我们可以在交货日期上做出让步。

idioms.phrase: more (to sth) than meets the eye
idioms.meaning: 别有内情；表面之下另有玄机；并不像看上去那么简单
idioms.example_en: Don't dismiss his strange behavior; there is definitely more to this than meets the eye.
idioms.example_zh: 别对他的反常举动不以为意，这事情肯定远没有表面那么简单。

idioms.meaning: 棋逢对手；遇上劲敌
idioms.example_en: The reigning champion finally met his match in yesterday's intense final.
idioms.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在昨天的激烈决赛中终于遇到了旗鼓相当的劲敌。

idioms.meaning: 惨遭覆灭；遭到毁灭性打击
idioms.example_en: The tech startup met its Waterloo when a major competitor launched a free alternative.
idioms.example_zh: 当一家巨头竞争对手推出同类免费产品时，这家科技初创公司遭遇了滑铁卢。

idioms.meaning: 去世；归西；见上帝
idioms.example_en: The old sailor felt his time had come to meet his maker.
idioms.example_zh: 老水手感到自己大限已到，该去见上帝了。

collocations.meaning: 赶上截止日期；按期完成
collocations.example_en: The team worked around the clock to meet the strict project deadline.
collocations.example_zh: 团队日夜连轴转以赶上项目紧迫的截止日期。

collocations.example_en: Applicants must meet all the academic criteria before being considered for an interview.
collocations.example_zh: 申请者必须先符合所有学术标准，才会进入面试考量。

collocations.meaning: 达到某人的期望；满足预期
collocations.example_en: The final cut of the film failed to meet the critics' high expectations.
collocations.example_zh: 这部电影的最终公映版未能达到影评人们的高期望。

collocations.example_en: The healthcare system has shown remarkable resilience in meeting the challenge.
collocations.example_zh: 该医疗体系在应对这一挑战时展现出了非凡的韧性。

collocations.meaning: 直视某人的双眼；与某人目光相接
collocations.example_en: She was too ashamed to meet her father's eyes after confessing the truth.
collocations.example_zh: 坦白真相之后，她羞愧得不敢直视父亲的双眼。

collocations.example_en: The scholarship is designed to help gifted students meet the cost of tuition.
collocations.example_zh: 该奖学金旨在帮助有天赋的学生承担学费开支。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 逐步建立，积累；增强（体质/信心）；积聚（压力/拥堵）；吹捧，盛赞
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He managed to build up a successful global business from scratch.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他白手起家，逐步建立起一家成功的全球化企业。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以……为基础；基于……进一步发展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We must build on the achievements of the previous quarter to reach our annual goal.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们必须在上一季度的成果基础上进一步发展，以达成年度目标。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将……嵌入；把……作为固定组成部分纳入
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Safety checks should be built in from the very beginning of the design phase.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 安全审查机制应从设计初期就内置进去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……构建进……；使（条款/特质等）成为……的一部分
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Flexibility is built into the contract to allow for market volatility.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 合同中融入了灵活性条款，以应对市场波动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 扩建，扩展（基础设施、功能模块或网络业务）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Telecom operators are investing billions to build out nationwide 5G networks.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 电信运营商正斥资数十亿美元扩建全国范围的5G网络。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 围绕……构建；以……为核心组织
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The entire marketing strategy was built around user-generated content.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 整套营销策略都是围绕用户生成内容来搭建的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 朝……方向积蓄努力；为……铺垫推进
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All the rigorous training drills are building towards the championship match next month.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 所有高强度的严密训练都是在为下个月的锦标赛蓄力冲刺。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在……之上建造；（建筑）覆盖遮挡
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The ancient Roman ruins were completely built over during the Middle Ages.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那座古罗马遗址在中世纪时期被彻底建起的建筑覆盖了。

idioms.meaning: 架设桥梁；消除分歧，建立友好沟通关系
idioms.example_en: The diplomat worked tirelessly to build bridges between the two hostile nations.
idioms.example_zh: 那位外交官不知疲倦地工作，以在敌对的两国之间架起沟通的桥梁。

idioms.meaning: 建造空中楼阁；做白日梦；耽于幻想
idioms.example_en: Stop building castles in the air and start putting your ideas into practical action.
idioms.example_zh: 别再构筑空中楼阁了，赶紧把想法付诸实际行动吧。

idioms.meaning: 从头开始搭建；从零做起；白手起家
idioms.example_en: They had to build the software infrastructure from the ground up after the server crash.
idioms.example_zh: 在服务器彻底崩溃后，他们不得不从零开始重新构建软件底层架构。

idioms.meaning: 收集论据；为支持或反对……建立充分论据或证据链
idioms.example_en: Detectives spent months quietly building a solid case against the fraud ring.
idioms.example_zh: 侦探们耗费数月时间，悄悄搜集证据，构建了针对该诈骗团伙的完整指控链。

idioms.meaning: 把希望寄托在……上
idioms.example_en: You shouldn't build all your hopes on getting that specific promotion.
idioms.example_zh: 你不应该把所有希望都寄托在获得那次特定的晋升上。

idioms.meaning: 推陈出新；发明/制造更胜一筹的革新产品
idioms.example_en: To dominate the market, our engineering team needed to build a better mousetrap.
idioms.example_zh: 要想主导市场，我们的工程研发团队需要推出更卓越的突破性产品。

collocations.example_en: She spent decades building an enviable reputation as an impartial investigative journalist.
collocations.example_zh: 她花了数十年时间树立起作为一名公正调查记者的极高声誉。

collocations.meaning: 建立人际关系；增进融洽互信
collocations.example_en: The sales team excels at building lasting relationships with corporate clients.
collocations.example_zh: 该销售团队极其擅长与企业客户建立持久的互信关系。

collocations.example_en: The early victory did wonders to build team morale after a long slump.
collocations.example_zh: 在长期的低迷之后，前期的这场胜利对提振全队士气起到了奇效。

collocations.meaning: 集聚势头；形成良好势头
collocations.example_en: The clean energy campaign is rapidly building momentum across the country.
collocations.example_zh: 这场清洁能源倡议运动正在全国范围内迅速形成声势。

collocations.meaning: 提升能力；增强承载/生产能力
collocations.example_en: International aid was channeled to help build capacity in local medical facilities.
collocations.example_zh: 国际援助被用于帮助提升当地医疗机构的承载救治能力。

collocations.meaning: 凝聚共识；达成广泛一致
collocations.example_en: The committee managed to build broad consensus on key environmental targets.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会成功在关键环境治理目标上凝聚了广泛共识。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 照顾/照料；喜欢/想要（尤用于否定或疑问句）；关爱/倾心
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She spent years caring for her elderly parents, and rarely had time for herself.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她悉心照料年迈的双亲多年，自己几乎没有闲暇时间。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在乎/关心/看重
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He genuinely cares about the environment and tries to live a sustainable life.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他是真心地在乎环境保护，并努力践行可持续的生活方式。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 愿意/想要（常用于疑问句或否定句，表客气礼貌）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Would you care to join us for a cup of coffee before the lecture starts?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 讲座开始前，你愿意和我们一起去喝杯咖啡吗？

idioms.meaning: 毫不在乎/一点也不放在心上
idioms.example_en: I couldn't care less what gossip they are spreading about my decision.
idioms.example_zh: 对于他们关于我决定的流言蜚语，我一点都不在乎。

idioms.meaning: 保重/再见（离别用语）；当心/留神
idioms.example_en: Take care on the icy roads; the weather forecast warned of sudden freezing rain.
idioms.example_zh: 结冰的路面上要当心，天气预报警告有突发冻雨。

idioms.meaning: 管他呢/我才不在乎/就算...也与我无关
idioms.example_en: You can leave right now for all I care; your complaints won't change my mind.
idioms.example_zh: 就算你现在就走我也不在乎，你的抱怨改变不了我的心意。

idioms.meaning: 转交/由...转交（用于信函地址）
idioms.example_en: Send the documentation to the project manager, care of the human resources department.
idioms.example_zh: 请将文件寄给项目经理，由人力资源部转交。

idioms.phrase: not care a fig / not care a damn
idioms.meaning: 丝毫不介意/根本无所谓
idioms.example_en: He doesn't care a damn about winning anyone's approval.
idioms.example_zh: 他根本不在乎是否能博得任何人的认可。

collocations.meaning: 照料/看护；处理/解决（问题、事务）
collocations.example_en: Don't worry about the travel arrangements; our agency will take care of everything.
collocations.example_zh: 别担心行程安排，我们旅行社全权负责处理一切。

collocations.meaning: 格外小心/十分留心去做某事
collocations.example_en: She took great care to explain every technical term so everyone could follow along.
collocations.example_zh: 她非常用心地解释每一个专业术语，以便大家都能听得懂。

collocations.meaning: 谁在乎呢？/管它呢？（表示轻蔑或无关紧要）
collocations.example_en: So what if we missed the beginning of the show? Who cares?
collocations.example_zh: 就算我们错过了演出的开场又怎样？谁在乎呢？

collocations.example_en: The volunteers care deeply about animal welfare and rescue stray pets every week.
collocations.example_zh: 志愿者们极其关切动物福利，每周都会去救助流浪宠物。

collocations.example_en: The parcel was clearly stamped 'fragile: handle with care' to prevent damage.
collocations.example_zh: 包裹上清楚地印有“易碎物品，小心轻放”字样以防破损。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抓紧/抓牢；等一下/（电话中）别挂断；坚持住
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Could you hold on a minute while I retrieve your account details?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 请您稍候片刻别挂断，我调取一下您的账户信息好吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 举起/支撑；延误/耽搁；持械抢劫；经受住检验/保持强健
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Our shipment was held up at customs for three weeks due to incomplete paperwork.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于单据不全，我们的货物在海关被耽搁了整整三周。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 伸出（手等）；坚持抵抗/抵御；抱有（希望）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The besieged garrison held out for weeks despite severe food shortages.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管粮食极度匮乏，被围困的守军仍旧顽强坚守了数周。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抑制/克制（情感、泪水）；阻止/阻碍；隐瞒（事实）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He struggled to hold back his tears as he delivered the farewell speech.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在致告别辞时，他拼命克制着不让眼泪掉下来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 推迟/延迟；击退/抵挡；（雨雪等恶劣天气）暂未降临
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Fortunately, the storm held off until the outdoor wedding ceremony was over.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 幸运的是，暴风雨一直憋着没下，直到室外婚礼仪式结束。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 压制/抑制（成本、通胀等）；保住（工作/职位）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite his health struggles, he managed to hold down a demanding job in finance.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管身体抱恙，他还是设法保住了这份要求极高的金融工作。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抓紧不放；守住/保留（资产、职位、信念）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Investors were advised to hold on to their tech shares despite the market volatility.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管市场波动剧烈，投资者仍被建议继续持有手头的科技股。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因...而轻视/对...耿耿于怀/怪罪
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I know you made a mistake in the past, but nobody holds it against you now.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我知道你过去犯过错，但现在没人会因此怪罪你。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 憋住/忍住（笑声、愤怒等内心情感）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She could hardly hold in her excitement when she opened the acceptance letter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 拆开录取通知书的那一刻，她几乎按捺不住内心的狂喜。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将...延期/保留待议；（电影等）延长放映期
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Because of time constraints, the committee agreed to hold over the budget discussion until next week.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于时间紧迫，委员会同意将预算讨论推迟到下周进行。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 坚守/恪守（承诺、原则）；使遵守/强求按...行事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The board decided to hold the contractor to the terms originally agreed upon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 董事会决定要求承包商严格遵守最初商定的条款。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 赞同/支持（常用否定句，如 not hold with）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: My grandfather never held with the idea of relying on credit cards for daily expenses.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我祖父从来不赞同日常开销依赖信用卡的做法。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 滔滔不绝地讲/大发议论
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The professor held forth on the decline of classical civilizations for nearly two hours.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教授就古典文明的衰亡滔滔不绝地讲了将近两个小时。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 坚持要求/不达目的不罢休
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The union rejected the initial settlement and held out for a ten percent pay raise.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工会拒绝了最初的和解方案，坚持要求加薪百分之十。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对...有所隐瞒/不向...吐露实情
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I get the feeling that you are holding out on me regarding what happened at the meeting.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我感觉关于会议上发生的事，你对我有所隐瞒。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （使）团结一致/结合成一体；（物品）保持完整不散架
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her visionary leadership was the sole force that held the coalition together during the crisis.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她富有远见的领导力是危机期间维持联盟团结的唯一力量。

idioms.meaning: 慢点/别急/耐心点
idioms.example_en: Hold your horses! We need to verify the facts before publishing the report.
idioms.example_zh: 慢着点，别着急！我们发表报告前需要先核实事实。

idioms.meaning: 代挑大梁/代为主持大局/代为看守
idioms.example_en: I'll be out of the office for lunch, so can you hold the fort while I'm away?
idioms.example_zh: 我出去吃午饭，我不在的时候你能帮我盯一下办公室吗？

idioms.meaning: （论据、解释等）站得住脚/合乎情理
idioms.example_en: His alibi did not hold water once the forensic team examined the security footage.
idioms.example_zh: 一旦法医团队审查了监控录像，他的不在场证明就完全站不住脚了。

idioms.meaning: 搁置/推迟/暂停某事
idioms.example_en: The expansion plans were put on hold due to unforeseen supply chain disruptions.
idioms.example_zh: 由于供应链出现不可预见的紊乱，扩张计划已被搁置。

idioms.meaning: 屏住呼吸/屏息以待（期待或担忧某事）
idioms.example_en: The crowd held their breath as the gymnast executed the difficult dismount.
idioms.example_zh: 体操运动员完成难度极高的下法动作时，全场观众屏息凝视。

idioms.meaning: 毫无限制/全力以赴/不留情面
idioms.example_en: The election debate turned into a no holds barred brawl between the rival candidates.
idioms.example_zh: 竞选辩论演变成了两位对立候选人之间毫无顾忌的激烈混战。

idioms.meaning: 守住底线/坚持立场不退让；（电话中）别挂断
idioms.example_en: The union leaders refused to budge and vowed to hold the line on pension benefits.
idioms.example_zh: 工会领袖拒绝让步，誓言在退休金待遇上坚守底线。

collocations.meaning: 认为...应承担责任/追究...的责任
collocations.example_en: The public demanded that company executives be held accountable for the catastrophic leak.
collocations.example_zh: 公众要求追究公司高管对这起灾难性泄漏事件的责任。

collocations.example_en: The shareholders agreed to hold an extraordinary general meeting next Tuesday.
collocations.example_zh: 股东们同意在下周二召开临时股东大会。

collocations.example_en: She firmly holds the belief that early education lays the foundation for lifelong success.
collocations.example_zh: 她坚信早期教育奠定了终生成功的基础。

collocations.example_en: The documentary was so compelling that it held the audience's attention from start to finish.
collocations.example_zh: 这部纪录片极其引人入胜，从头到尾紧紧抓住了观众的注意力。

collocations.example_en: He held office as mayor for eight years, championing public transit reforms.
collocations.example_zh: 他担任市长职务长达八年，积极倡导公共交通改革。

collocations.meaning: 将某人扣为人质/囚禁某人
collocations.example_en: The hijackers held the passengers hostage for twelve hours before negotiating a surrender.
collocations.example_zh: 劫持者将乘客扣为人质长达十二小时，随后才谈判投降。

collocations.meaning: 占据主导地位/极有影响力/统治
collocations.example_en: Traditional conservative values still hold sway in the southern rural communities.
collocations.example_zh: 传统的保守价值观在南部乡村社区依然占据主导地位。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……分批拍卖；将……分块划分分配
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The bankrupt company's assets were lotted out to various private buyers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家破产公司的资产被分批拍卖给了各家私人买家。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 命中注定由某人承担；落在某人头上作为责任或命运
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It fell to her lot to break the tragic news to the waiting family.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 向守候的家属通报这一不幸消息的艰难责任落到了她的头上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抽签；抓阄决定
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We drew lots to decide who would clean the kitchen over the weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们通过抽签来决定周末谁负责打扫厨房。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 掷骰决疑；抽签表决
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The soldiers cast lots to determine who would undertake the dangerous patrol.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 士兵们通过抽签来决定谁去执行这项危险的巡逻任务。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 决定与……休戚与共；把自己的命运与……绑在一起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He left his corporate job to throw in his lot with a promising tech startup.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他辞去了大企业的工作，决定把自己的前途押在一支极具潜力的高科技初创团队上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……同甘共苦；与……结成命运共同体
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The rebels chose to cast in their lot with the allied forces across the border.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 叛军选择与境外的盟军结盟，休戚与共。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分批拍卖卖掉；零星售出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The antique dealer lotted off the vast collection over a three-day auction.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 古董商在一场为期三天的拍卖会上将大批藏品分批尽数拍卖。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分块划界并分配（土地或资产）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The developers parceled and lotted the farmland into suburban housing estates.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 开发商把农田划分成若干地块，用于建造郊区住宅小区。

idioms.meaning: 手头有大量待办事项；事务缠身；操心的事情很多
idioms.example_en: Between studying for finals and working part-time, she has a lot on her plate right now.
idioms.example_zh: 一边备战期末考一边兼职打工，她眼下手头的事多得忙不过来。

idioms.meaning: 全部；整个；统统；所有人/物
idioms.example_en: The wind knocked over the flowerpots and smashed the whole lot.
idioms.example_zh: 狂风刮倒了花盆，把它们全都摔碎了。

idioms.meaning: 不可救药的人；品德恶劣的人；败类
idioms.example_en: His neighbors warned him that the tenant downstairs was a bad lot.
idioms.example_zh: 邻居们提醒他，楼下的那个租客是个品行不端的家伙。

idioms.meaning: 这就是命运；某人的命数本就如此
idioms.example_en: He endured the relentless winter cold with patience, murmuring that such was his lot.
idioms.example_zh: 他默默忍受着严冬的酷寒，低语着这大概就是自己的命数。

idioms.meaning: 相当多；频频；常常
idioms.example_en: They travel abroad quite a lot during the summer holidays.
idioms.example_zh: 暑假期间他们经常出国旅行。

idioms.meaning: 改善自己的生活处境；提升个人社会地位
idioms.example_en: Many immigrants endured hardships in the hope of bettering their lot.
idioms.example_zh: 许多移民忍受着艰难困苦，只为了能改善自己的生存境遇。

collocations.meaning: 许多；大量（修饰可数或不可数名词）
collocations.example_en: We still have a lot of work to complete before the deadline tomorrow.
collocations.example_zh: 在明天的截止日期之前，我们仍有大量工作需要完成。

collocations.example_en: Finding an empty spot in the shopping mall parking lot was almost impossible.
collocations.example_zh: 在商场停车场里找到一个空车位简直难如登天。

collocations.meaning: 未开发的空地；荒废地皮
collocations.example_en: The neighborhood children turned the vacant lot into an impromptu soccer field.
collocations.example_zh: 社区的孩子们把那块闲置空地改成了临时足球场。

collocations.meaning: 某人的命运境遇；命中注定的生活状态
collocations.example_en: Instead of complaining about her lot in life, she worked tirelessly to earn a degree.
collocations.example_zh: 她没有怨天尤人，而是夜以继日地努力攻读学位。

collocations.meaning: 多谢；非常感谢（亦可用于讽刺语境）
collocations.example_en: Thanks a lot for stepping in to cover my shift when I was sick.
collocations.example_zh: 非常感谢你在我生病时赶来顶替我的班次。

collocations.meaning: （拍卖会上的）一件拍卖品；一批拍品
collocations.example_en: Lot number 45, an 18th-century landscape oil painting, fetched a record price.
collocations.example_zh: 第45号拍品——一幅18世纪的风景油画——拍出了创纪录的高价。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 关机；切断电源；逐渐降低功率；（人）放松减压
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Be sure to power down your workstation before leaving the office for the weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 周末离开办公室前，请务必关闭工作站的电源。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 开机；接通电源启动；给……蓄力赋能；力量逐渐增强
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The medical scanning system takes roughly two minutes to fully power up.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该医疗扫描系统大约需要两分钟才能完全启动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 强行攻克；咬紧牙关坚持完成；硬撑着度过难关
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite feeling fatigued, the team managed to power through the final sprint of the project.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管感到疲惫不堪，团队还是咬紧牙关咬下了项目的最后冲刺。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 关机；关闭设备电源
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Flight attendants asked all passengers to power off their portable electronic devices.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 乘务员要求所有乘客关闭便携式电子设备的电源。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 开机；通电启动
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Press and hold the side button to power on the new tablet.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 按住侧边按键即可开机启动这台新平板电脑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 势不可挡地推进；全速迅猛前进
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The renewable energy sector continues to power ahead despite broader economic headwinds.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管面临宏观经济逆风，可再生能源行业依然在全速强劲推进。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 高歌猛进；疾速奔驰前行
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The high-speed train powered along the tracks through the countryside.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 高铁列车动力澎湃地在穿行乡野的铁轨上疾驰。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 加速甩开对手；绝尘而去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In the final lap of the race, the champion powered away from the rest of the pack.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在比赛的最后一圈，卫冕冠军猛烈加速甩开其他选手绝尘而去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因断电而停机；强力击球使对方出局
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The backup generators kicked in immediately when the main system powered out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当主电力系统断电停机时，备用发电机立即启动介入。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 削减发动机推力/降低功率输出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The pilot powered back the twin engines as the aircraft commenced its gradual descent.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当飞机开始缓慢下降时，飞行员收小了双引擎的推力。

idioms.meaning: 当局；执政者；有决定权的掌权人士
idioms.example_en: The proposed curriculum change still requires approval from the powers that be.
idioms.example_zh: 拟议中的课程改革仍需获得掌权主管当局的批准。

idioms.meaning: 利用权力耍威风；陶醉于发号施令的自大狂妄行为
idioms.example_en: Demanding that his staff work on national holidays seemed like nothing more than a power trip.
idioms.example_zh: 强令员工在法定节假日加班，看起来纯粹是他在滥用权力耍官威。

idioms.phrase: do sb a power of good
idioms.meaning: 对某人大有裨益；使某人身心获益匪浅
idioms.example_en: A relaxing week by the seaside will do you a power of good after all that stress.
idioms.example_zh: 承受了这么大压力后，去海边放松一周会让你身心大有裨益。

idioms.meaning: 知识就是力量
idioms.example_en: In modern negotiation, knowledge is power; knowing your rival's bottom line guarantees success.
idioms.example_zh: 在现代谈判中，知识就是力量；摸清对手的底线就能确保胜券在握。

idioms.meaning: 幕后掌舵人；实际掌权者；太上皇
idioms.example_en: Although his brother held the official title, he was widely regarded as the power behind the throne.
idioms.example_zh: 虽然他兄弟顶着正式头衔，但他被普遍认为是真正的幕后掌权者。

idioms.meaning: 均势；权力制衡
idioms.example_en: The unexpected election results radically shifted the balance of power in parliament.
idioms.example_zh: 出人意料的选举结果彻底改变了议会内部的权力制衡格局。

collocations.example_en: The coalition government came to power pledging comprehensive economic reform.
collocations.example_zh: 联合政府承诺实施全面的经济改革后上台执政。

collocations.example_en: The official was impeached following an investigation into gross abuse of power.
collocations.example_zh: 在对严重滥用权力的问题展开调查后，该官员被正式弹劾。

collocations.example_en: A severe blizzard triggered a widespread power outage across the eastern coast.
collocations.example_zh: 一场猛烈的暴风雪导致东海岸大范围断电。

collocations.example_en: Persistent inflation continues to erode the purchasing power of middle-class households.
collocations.example_zh: 持续的通货膨胀不断侵蚀中产家庭的实际购买力。

collocations.example_en: The city plans to decommission the aging coal-fired power plant by the end of next year.
collocations.example_zh: 该市计划在明年年底前淘汰停运那座老化的燃煤发电厂。

collocations.meaning: 太阳能发电；太阳能动力
collocations.example_en: The entire agricultural facility operates entirely on solar power and battery storage.
collocations.example_zh: 该农业设施完全依赖太阳能与电池储能系统运转。

collocations.example_en: A bitter power struggle broke out among top executives following the CEO's retirement.
collocations.example_zh: 首席执行官退休后，高层管理人员之间爆发了一场激烈的权力斗争。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 汇报；返回报到；把（信息/决定）反馈给
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was asked to investigate the issue and report back to the board next week.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她受命调查该问题，并在下周向董事会汇报情况。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向……汇报工作（对某人负责）；前往某处报到
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In your new role, you will report directly to the marketing director.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在你的新职位上，你将直接向市场总监汇报。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 电话联络报平安；报到登记
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All field agents are required to report in every four hours.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 所有外勤人员都必须每四小时电话报备一次。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 就……进行报道；对……作出评估报告
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The journalist was assigned to report on the upcoming general election.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这名记者受命对即将举行的大选进行追踪报道。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （委员会）正式提交（法案或调查报告）供讨论
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The Senate committee is expected to report out the bill by Friday.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 参议院委员会预计将在周五前将该法案提交审议。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打电话请假（尤指因病缺勤）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Several factory workers reported off with the flu this morning.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 今天早上几名工厂工人打电话请病假说得了流感。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向上级传达；自下而上汇报
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Any security breaches must be immediately reported up the chain of command.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 任何安全违规行为都必须立即逐级上报。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在……部门名下报账；归……管辖报告
phrasal_verbs.example_en: These travel expenses should be reported under operational costs.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这些差旅费用应归入运营成本项下报销。

idioms.meaning: 报到上班；报到就役
idioms.example_en: New recruits are expected to report for duty at 0800 hours tomorrow.
idioms.example_zh: 新入伍人员需于明日早晨八点整报到就役。

idioms.meaning: 据报失踪
idioms.example_en: Two hikers have been reported missing in the national park after the storm.
idioms.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，据报有两名徒步旅行者在该国家公园失踪。

idioms.meaning: 名声好的；广受好评的
idioms.example_en: The charity only partners with business leaders of good report.
idioms.example_zh: 该慈善机构只与声誉卓著的商界领袖合作。

idioms.phrase: give a good report of oneself
idioms.meaning: 表现出色；发挥优异
idioms.example_en: The young tennis player gave a very good report of herself in her debut tournament.
idioms.example_zh: 这名年轻网球选手在她的首秀巡回赛中表现相当出色。

idioms.meaning: 根据坊间传闻；据普遍传闻
idioms.example_en: It was, on common report, the most haunted mansion in the county.
idioms.example_zh: 据大家普遍相传，那是该郡最邪门的一座凶宅。

collocations.example_en: He went to the local station immediately to report the theft of his passport.
collocations.example_zh: 他立即前往当地警局报案护照被盗。

collocations.example_en: The airline reported a record annual profit despite rising fuel costs.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管燃油成本上升，该航空公司仍公布了创纪录的年度利润。

collocations.example_en: The engineering team met every morning to report progress on the project.
collocations.example_zh: 工程团队每天早晨开会汇报项目进展。

collocations.phrase: report sb to the police / authorities
collocations.example_en: She threatened to report her neighbor to the authorities for illegal dumping.
collocations.example_zh: 她威胁要就非法倾倒垃圾一事向有关部门告发邻居。

collocations.example_en: It has been widely reported that the company plans to lay off staff.
collocations.example_zh: 据广泛报道，该公司计划裁减员工。

collocations.example_en: Patients who report mild symptoms are advised to recover at home.
collocations.example_zh: 反映仅有轻微症状的患者被建议居家休养。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 张贴（告示）；在网络上发布；（篮球）在低位背身单打
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They posted up flyers all over town to advertise the charity concert.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们在全镇各处张贴传单宣传慈善音乐会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 寄出；投递（信件/包裹）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I need to post off these tax documents before the deadline tomorrow.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我得在明天截止日期前把这些税务文件寄出去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 寄送（批量物品）；派驻外地
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The brochures will be posted out to subscribers by the end of the week.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 宣传册将在本周末前邮寄给所有订阅者。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回寄；把（回复/填写的表格）寄回
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please complete the questionnaire and post it back using the envelope provided.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 请填写完问卷并使用所附信封寄回。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 寄走；匆忙离去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She posted the manuscript away to several publishers and waited anxiously.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她把书稿寄给了数家出版社，随后焦急地等待答复。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 发布到（网页/社交平台）；寄送至某地
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't post sensitive personal information to public forums.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 不要在公开论坛上发布敏感的个人信息。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……寄过来/寄过去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Could you post the spare keys over if you find them in the drawer?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你在抽屉里找到了备用钥匙，能邮寄过来吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （会计）记入；过账到（账户）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Ensure every transaction is properly posted into the general ledger.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 确保每笔交易都准确无误地记入总账。

idioms.meaning: 随时向某人通报最新情况
idioms.example_en: I'm heading into the meeting now; I'll keep you posted on any decisions.
idioms.example_zh: 我现在要去开会了，有任何决定我会随时告知你最新情况。

idioms.meaning: 完全聋的；极其耳背的
idioms.example_en: You'll have to shout louder; my grandfather is as deaf as a post.
idioms.example_zh: 你得喊大声点，我爷爷耳朵完全背了。

idioms.phrase: be beaten / pipped at the post
idioms.meaning: 在最后一刻惜败；功亏一篑
idioms.example_en: The candidate ran a strong campaign but was pipped at the post by a narrow margin.
idioms.example_zh: 该候选人选势强劲，但最终以微弱劣势在冲刺关头惜败。

idioms.meaning: 处处碰壁；四处奔波折腾
idioms.example_en: We were driven from pillar to post trying to get our visa applications approved.
idioms.example_zh: 为了让签证申请获批，我们到处奔波碰壁，被折腾得够呛。

idioms.meaning: 简单多数制；捷足先登者获胜
idioms.example_en: The election was conducted under the traditional first-past-the-post system.
idioms.example_zh: 该选举是按照传统的简单多数票当选制进行的。

idioms.meaning: 将某人远远甩在后面；使某人望尘莫及
idioms.example_en: Their rival's new software update left the entire industry at the post.
idioms.example_zh: 竞争对手推出的新软件更新让整个行业都望尘莫及。

collocations.example_en: Thousands of fans posted comments congratulating the team on their victory.
collocations.example_zh: 数千名粉丝发布评论祝贺该队获胜。

collocations.meaning: 公布强劲/创纪录的业绩
collocations.example_en: The tech giant posted strong results for the third consecutive quarter.
collocations.example_zh: 该科技巨头已连续第三个季度公布强劲业绩。

collocations.example_en: His family managed to raise enough money to post bail for his release.
collocations.example_zh: 他的家人好不容易凑齐了钱交纳保释金将他保释出来。

collocations.example_en: The library posted a notice informing patrons of the changed opening hours.
collocations.example_zh: 图书馆张贴了一张通知，告知读者变更后的开放时间。

collocations.meaning: 派某人驻外/派往海外任职
collocations.example_en: As a senior diplomat, she was posted abroad to Tokyo for three years.
collocations.example_zh: 作为高级外交官，她被派驻海外东京任职三年。

collocations.example_en: The commander ordered them to post guards at every entrance of the compound.
collocations.example_zh: 指挥官命令他们在营区的所有入口布署岗哨。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 忙于；使自己专注于做某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She busied herself with preparing dinner while the guests settled in the living room.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 客人们在客厅安顿下来时，她忙着准备晚餐。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为……忙前忙后；忙碌地张罗某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He busied himself about the garden, pruning roses and clearing fallen leaves.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在花园里忙前忙后，修剪玫瑰并清理落叶。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 不停地忙碌；持续埋头苦干
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The clerks were busy away behind their counters filing the afternoon paperwork.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 职员们在柜台后忙个不停，归档下午的文件。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 四处忙碌；忙着做零碎杂活
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Grandma always busies around the house from dawn till dusk.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 奶奶从早到晚总是在屋里屋外忙个不停。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （通信工程中）将电话线置忙；人工闭塞线路
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The technician busied out the faulty circuit to prevent incoming calls from being dropped.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 技术员将故障线路置忙，以防呼入电话掉线。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 赶快开始动手干；忙碌起来；（俚语）发生性关系
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We have a strict deadline tomorrow, so we’d better get busy right now.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们明天的截止时间很紧，所以最好现在就赶快行动起来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 保持忙碌；不让自己闲着
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Since her retirement, she has kept busy by volunteering at the local animal shelter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 退休以来，她一直在当地动物收容所做志愿服务，让自己不闲着。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 被……占据时间；忙于应付
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The entire department was busied with audit preparations for the whole month.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 整个部门整整一个月都在忙于应对审计准备工作。

idioms.meaning: 忙得团团转；极度忙碌且充满活力
idioms.example_en: Linda has been as busy as a bee all morning setting up the exhibition booth.
idioms.example_zh: 琳达整个上午都忙得团团转，一直在布置展位。

idioms.meaning: 勤劳忙碌的人；勤快能干的人
idioms.example_en: Tom is such a busy bee that he rarely sits down for more than five minutes.
idioms.example_zh: 汤姆是个大忙人，很少能踏踏实实坐下超过五分钟。

idioms.meaning: 爱管闲事的人；好打探别人隐私的人
idioms.example_en: Our neighbor is an insufferable busybody who always pries into our private affairs.
idioms.example_zh: 我们的邻居是个让人受不了的爱管闲事的人，总爱打听我们的私事。

idioms.meaning: 忙得喘不过气来；分身乏术
idioms.example_en: During the final exam week, college students are often too busy to breathe.
idioms.example_zh: 在期末考试周，大学生们往往忙得喘不过气来。

idioms.meaning: 度过了繁忙充实的一天
idioms.example_en: After having a busy day at the hospital, the surgeon went straight to sleep.
idioms.example_zh: 在医院忙碌了一整天后，外科医生一倒头就睡着了。

collocations.example_en: The manager is currently busy with budget meetings and cannot take calls.
collocations.example_zh: 经理目前正忙于预算会议，无法接听电话。

collocations.example_en: The engineers are busy repairing the damaged power grid.
collocations.example_zh: 工程师们正忙着抢修受损的电网。

collocations.meaning: 让某人有事可做；使某人忙得不可开交
collocations.example_en: The new puppy keeps the whole family busy from morning to night.
collocations.example_zh: 新买的小狗让全家人从早到晚都忙个不停。

collocations.example_en: I tried calling his office several times, but I only got a busy signal.
collocations.example_zh: 我给他办公室打了好几次电话，但一直都是忙音。

collocations.meaning: 紧凑的日程安排；繁忙的时间表
collocations.example_en: Despite her busy schedule, the CEO regularly visits local branch offices.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管日程排得满满当当，这位首席执行官依然定期视察各地分公司。

collocations.meaning: 车水马龙的街道；繁忙的干道
collocations.example_en: Never let children cross a busy street unaccompanied.
collocations.example_zh: 千万不要让孩子独自穿行车流繁忙的街道。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 事先踩点；暗中侦察（尤指为了作案或行动）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The detectives suspected the burglars had cased out the jewelry store weeks in advance.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 侦探们怀疑窃贼在数周前就已暗中踩点过这家珠宝店。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （俚语）探查作案现场；暗中踩点摸底
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The surveillance cameras caught two men casing the joint the night before the break-in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 监控摄像头拍到有两名男子在入室盗窃前夜在此处踩点。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （图书装订）上壳；套壳装订
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The machine cases in hardback book blocks at a rate of fifty copies per minute.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该机器以每分钟五十本的速度将精装书芯装入封壳。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 装箱；打包封装
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Workers cased up the fragile porcelain figurines before loading them onto the freight truck.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工人们在将脆弱的瓷俑装上货车前把它们严密装箱。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 提出支持……的充分理由；据理力争
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The union leader made a strong case for higher wages and improved medical benefits.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工会领导有力地提出了提高薪资和改善医疗福利的充分论据。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 证明……站得住脚；给出令人信服的证据
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The prosecution failed to make out a case against the defendant beyond reasonable doubt.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 检方未能提出无合理疑点的确凿证据来指控被告。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 收集证据以支持/指控；建立证据链
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Federal agents spent three years building a solid fraud case against the syndicate.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 联邦特工花了三年时间搜集确凿证据，对该犯罪团伙提起欺诈指控。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （法庭上）结束举证辩护；（口语中）无需多言，事实不言自明
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You just contradicted your own previous statement, so I rest my case.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你刚才前后矛盾的话正好证明了我说的，我无需再多做辩解了。

idioms.meaning: 以防万一；如果发生意外的话
idioms.example_en: Take an umbrella with you just in case it starts raining later.
idioms.example_zh: 带把伞吧，以防待会儿下雨。

idioms.meaning: 无论如何；不管怎样
idioms.example_en: It may rain, but we are going hiking in any case.
idioms.example_zh: 天可能会下雨，但无论如何我们都会去徒步。

idioms.meaning: 既然如此；在那种情况下
idioms.example_en: You don't eat meat? In that case, I will order a vegetarian pizza for you.
idioms.example_zh: 你不吃肉？既然这样，我给你点个素食比萨。

idioms.meaning: 视情况而定；看具体情形
idioms.example_en: Students may choose either French or Spanish, as the case may be.
idioms.example_zh: 学生可选择法语或西班牙语，视具体情况而定。

idioms.meaning: 典型的例子；恰当的例证
idioms.example_en: Many startups fail due to poor cash management; the company next door is a case in point.
idioms.example_zh: 许多初创公司因现金管理不善而倒闭，隔壁那家公司就是一个典型例证。

idioms.meaning: 显而易见的案子；容易解决且无争议的事情
idioms.example_en: With the suspect's fingerprints on the weapon, the robbery was an open-and-shut case.
idioms.example_zh: 凶器上留有嫌疑人的指纹，这起抢劫案成了一桩显而易见、容易定案的案子。

idioms.meaning: 并非如此；情况并不是这样
idioms.example_en: We assumed the train was delayed, but that was not the case; it was canceled entirely.
idioms.example_zh: 我们原本以为火车晚点了，但事实并非如此，它是彻底取消了。

collocations.example_en: In case of fire, do not use the elevators under any circumstances.
collocations.example_zh: 遇到火灾时，任何情况下都切勿使用电梯。

collocations.meaning: 打赢/打输官司；胜诉/败诉
collocations.example_en: The defense attorney worked tirelessly to win the case for her innocent client.
collocations.example_zh: 辩护律师不知疲倦地工作，终于为她无辜的当事人打赢了这场官司。

collocations.example_en: New DNA technology helped the police solve a cold case from thirty years ago.
collocations.example_zh: 新型DNA技术帮助警方破获了一起三十年前的悬案。

collocations.meaning: 陈述自己的观点或理由；为自己申辩
collocations.example_en: Both parties were given equal opportunity to state their case before the arbitration board.
collocations.example_zh: 双方都有平等的机会在仲裁委员会面前陈述各自的理由。

collocations.example_en: The junior partner was chosen to present the case to the senior leadership team.
collocations.example_zh: 初级合伙人被选出来向高级领导团队汇报此案情况并阐述论点。

collocations.meaning: 最坏的情况；最糟的设想
collocations.example_en: In a worst-case scenario, the flood could submerge the entire lower valley.
collocations.example_zh: 在最坏的情况下，洪水可能会淹没整个下河谷。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 发生在……身上；遭遇；临到……头上
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I hope nothing bad has happened to them on their way home.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我希望他们回家路上没出什么意外。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 偶然发现；碰巧遇到
phrasal_verbs.example_en: While cleaning the attic, she happened upon an old bundle of love letters.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在打扫阁楼时，她偶然发现了一捆旧情书。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 碰巧路过；偶然出现
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We were stranded with a flat tire until a friendly driver happened along.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们的车爆胎被困在路上，直到一位热心的司机碰巧路过。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 偶然经过；顺道走访
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If you happen by the post office, could you drop this letter in the mailbox?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你刚好路过邮局，能帮我把这封信投进邮箱吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 偶然来访；顺便进来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He just happened in while we were discussing the upcoming trip.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们正在讨论即将到来的旅行时，他恰巧进来了。

idioms.meaning: 碰巧；恰好；其实
idioms.example_en: As it happens, I know the person who runs that design studio.
idioms.example_zh: 碰巧的是，我正好认识经营那家设计工作室的人。

idioms.meaning: 天有不测风云；意外总是难免的（常用于安慰）
idioms.example_en: Don't worry about breaking the glass—accidents will happen.
idioms.example_zh: 别为打碎杯子难过了，意外总是难免的。

idioms.meaning: 促成事情落实；有魄力办成实事
idioms.example_en: She is an ambitious project manager who knows how to make things happen.
idioms.example_zh: 她是一位雄心勃勃的项目经理，非常善于把想法落到实处。

idioms.meaning: 无论发生什么；不管怎样
idioms.example_en: Whatever happens, remember that you have done your absolute best.
idioms.example_zh: 无论结果如何，记住你已经拼尽全力了。

idioms.meaning: 不论发生什么事；任凭风浪起
idioms.example_en: Happen what may, we will stand by our original promise.
idioms.example_zh: 不论发生什么，我们都会信守最初的承诺。

idioms.meaning: 隐患重重的情况；极易出事故的祸根
idioms.example_en: Driving that old car with worn-out brakes is an accident waiting to happen.
idioms.example_zh: 开着那辆刹车磨损严重的旧车上路，简直就是拿生命在开玩笑。

collocations.meaning: 碰巧做某事；刚好做某事
collocations.example_en: Do you happen to know what time the supermarket closes tonight?
collocations.example_zh: 你碰巧知道今晚超市几点关门吗？

collocations.example_en: It just so happens that I have an extra ticket to the concert.
collocations.example_zh: 正好我这里多了一张音乐会的门票。

collocations.meaning: 必然会发生；早晚会发生
collocations.example_en: Given their poor communication, a misunderstanding was bound to happen.
collocations.example_zh: 鉴于他们沟通不良，产生误会是迟早的事。

collocations.meaning: 谁都可能遇到；人之常情
collocations.example_en: Don't beat yourself up over the mistake; it could happen to anyone.
collocations.example_zh: 别为这个失误自责了，谁都有可能犯这种错。

collocations.meaning: 静观其变；看事态如何发展
collocations.example_en: Instead of reacting immediately, let's wait to see what happens next.
collocations.example_zh: 与其立刻做出反应，不如让我们先静观其变。

collocations.example_en: You look completely exhausted—what happened?
collocations.example_zh: 你看上去疲惫不堪，出什么事了？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 处于劣势；吃亏；受损失
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Small local businesses often lose out when giant retailers move into town.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当零售巨头入驻城镇时，本地小商家往往会处于劣势。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 输给某人/某事物；败在……手下
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Our agency lost out to a bigger rival during the final round of bidding.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在最后一轮竞标中，我们机构惜败给了一个更大的竞争对手。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 错失……的良机；错失（利益或机会）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If you don't submit your application today, you might lose out on the grant.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你今天不提交申请，可能就会错失这笔资助金。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 沉浸于；沉醉于；专心致志于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Whenever he feels stressed, he loses himself in classical music.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 每当感到压力重重时，他就会沉浸在古典音乐中。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因……而失去某人/某物；把某人/某物拱手让给
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company lost its top engineer to an overseas competitor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家公司的一位顶尖工程师被一家海外竞争对手挖走了。

idioms.meaning: 发疯；丧失理智；精神失常
idioms.example_en: With all this relentless noise, I feel like I'm about to lose my mind.
idioms.example_zh: 噪音一直没完没了，我觉得自己快要疯掉了。

idioms.meaning: 发脾气；大发雷霆
idioms.example_en: He rarely loses his temper, but the customer's rude remark crossed the line.
idioms.example_zh: 他很少发脾气，但那个顾客粗鲁的言辞实在太过分了。

idioms.meaning: 失去冷静；按捺不住脾气
idioms.example_en: Try to stay focused during the negotiation and don't lose your cool.
idioms.example_zh: 谈判过程中尽量保持专注，千万别失了分寸与冷静。

idioms.meaning: 慌了手脚；冲动得失去理智
idioms.example_en: When the fire alarm went off, she completely lost her head and ran outside.
idioms.example_zh: 火警警报响起时，她彻底慌了神，径直冲到了门外。

idioms.meaning: 丢脸；丢面子；名誉扫地
idioms.example_en: The manager apologized publicly, preferring to lose face rather than hide the truth.
idioms.example_zh: 这位经理公开道歉，宁愿丢面子也不愿隐瞒真相。

idioms.meaning: 与……失去联系；与……脱节
idioms.example_en: They used to be close friends, but they gradually lost touch after university.
idioms.example_zh: 他们曾经是亲密的好友，但大学毕业后逐渐断了联系。

idioms.meaning: 毫无顾忌；没什么好失去的
idioms.example_en: You might as well apply for the position; you have nothing to lose.
idioms.example_zh: 你大可去申请那个职位，反正你也没什么可失去的。

collocations.example_en: Don't lose sight of your long-term goals while dealing with day-to-day tasks.
collocations.example_zh: 在处理日常杂务时，切莫忘记你的长远目标。

collocations.meaning: 忘记时间；失去对……的了解或联络
collocations.example_en: I was so absorbed in my book that I completely lost track of time.
collocations.example_zh: 我读书读得太入迷，完全忘了时间。

collocations.example_en: The teacher finally lost patience with the disruptive students.
collocations.example_zh: 老师最终对那些捣乱的学生失去了耐心。

collocations.example_en: Investors began to lose confidence following the unexpected drop in profits.
collocations.example_zh: 在利润意外下滑后，投资者们开始丧失信心。

collocations.meaning: 迷路；迷失方向；偏离正轨
collocations.example_en: We lost our way in the thick fog and had to consult the GPS.
collocations.example_zh: 我们在浓雾中迷了路，只得求助于GPS导航。

collocations.example_en: Traditional cable networks are losing ground to streaming platforms.
collocations.example_zh: 传统有线电视网络正在逐步输给流媒体平台。

collocations.example_en: The driver lost control of the vehicle on the icy road.
collocations.example_zh: 司机在结冰的路面上失去了对车辆的控制。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 发展成；演变成；成长为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Over the years, the small family business developed into a multinational corporation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经过多年的发展，这家小型家族企业演变成了一家跨国公司。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 由……发展而来；源于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The revolutionary software developed from a simple script written by a college student.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这款革命性的软件源于一名大学生编写的简单脚本。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从……产生；由……演变而成
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A close friendship developed out of their shared passion for environmental advocacy.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于对环保倡导的共同热情，他们之间发展出了深厚的友谊。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在……基础上进一步展开/阐述；在……基础上继续发展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The professor asked the student to develop on her initial thesis proposal in the next chapter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教授要求这位学生在下一章中对她最初的论文提纲作进一步展开阐述。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 逐步发展壮大；培育（能力、业务等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They spent nearly a decade developing up a local supply chain from scratch.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们花了近十年时间从零开始建立并壮大了本地供应链。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 沿着……方向发展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Negotiations have not developed along the lines we originally anticipated.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 谈判并未沿着我们最初预期的方向推进。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 通过……逐渐形成/显现
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Leadership qualities typically develop through real-world experience and adversity.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 领导才能通常是在现实经历与困境磨砺中逐渐培养出来的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向着……趋势发展；朝……演变
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The bilateral talks are developing towards a comprehensive trade agreement.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 双边会谈正朝着达成全面贸易协议的方向发展。

idioms.meaning: 临阵退缩；突然退缩
idioms.example_en: He developed cold feet right before signing the high-stakes merger contract.
idioms.example_zh: 就在签署这份高风险并购协议的前一刻，他临阵退缩了。

idioms.meaning: 变得不在乎批评；变得脸皮厚
idioms.example_en: Public figures must develop a thick skin to withstand constant online scrutiny.
idioms.example_zh: 公众人物必须变得处变不惊，以经受住持续不断的网络审视。

idioms.meaning: 养成……的嗜好；喜欢上；逐渐爱好
idioms.example_en: She gradually developed a taste for classical music after attending live concerts.
idioms.example_zh: 在参加了几场现场音乐会后，她逐渐喜欢上了古典音乐。

idioms.meaning: 练就对……的鉴赏眼光；形成敏锐观察力
idioms.example_en: Through years of collecting, the curator developed a sharp eye for authentic antiquities.
idioms.example_zh: 通过多年的收藏实践，策展人练就了一双鉴别真伪文物的敏锐眼光。

idioms.meaning: 掌握……的诀窍；形成某种特殊技能
idioms.example_en: She quickly developed a knack for soothing upset customers over the phone.
idioms.example_zh: 她很快掌握了在电话中安抚情绪激动的顾客的诀窍。

idioms.phrase: develop a mind of its own
idioms.meaning: 不听使唤；自行其是（尤指物品或机构）
idioms.example_en: My old computer seems to have developed a mind of its own, crashing whenever it wants.
idioms.example_zh: 我的旧电脑似乎变得不听使唤了，动不动就自己崩溃死机。

collocations.example_en: Patients usually develop mild symptoms within two to three days of exposure.
collocations.example_zh: 患者通常在接触病毒后两到三天内出现轻微症状。

collocations.example_en: The marketing department is developing a new strategy to attract younger demographics.
collocations.example_zh: 市场部正在制定一项吸引更年轻群体的新策略。

collocations.example_en: He developed a keen interest in robotics during his freshman year.
collocations.example_zh: 他在大一期间对机器人技术产生了浓厚的兴趣。

collocations.example_en: The mentor helped the young artist fully develop her creative potential.
collocations.example_zh: 导师帮助这位年轻艺术家充分发掘了她的创作潜力。

collocations.example_en: It takes conscious effort to break bad patterns and develop healthy daily habits.
collocations.example_zh: 改掉恶习并养成健康的日常习惯需要自觉的努力。

collocations.example_en: Photographers who shoot analog still prefer to develop their own film in a darkroom.
collocations.example_zh: 使用胶片相机的摄影师依然更喜欢在暗房里亲自冲洗胶卷。

collocations.example_en: Internships provide students with opportunities to develop practical workplace skills.
collocations.example_zh: 实习为学生提供了培养实用职场技能的机会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以……为基础；建立在……之上
