phrasal_verbs.example_en: The movie is based on a true story that took place in the late 1990s.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这部电影改编自发生在上世纪90年代末的一个真实故事。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将总部/活动基地设在；居住在（某处办公）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The tech giant chose to base its European headquarters in Dublin.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家科技巨头选择将其欧洲总部设立在都柏林。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 围绕……展开；以……为核心建立
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The entire marketing campaign is based around the concept of sustainability.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 整个营销活动都是围绕可持续发展理念展开的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以……为大本营运营；以此处为据点派驻
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The non-profit operates internationally but is based out of Geneva.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该非营利组织开展国际运作，但以日内瓦为大本营。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 依据；源于（美式口语高频）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We made these financial forecasts based off last quarter's revenue figures.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们根据上个季度的收入数据做出了这些财务预测。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 驻扎在；工作地点定于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The research team will be based at the university's marine laboratory for the summer.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该研究团队夏季将驻扎在大学的海洋实验室工作。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将基地/驻地与……安排在一起；依托……设立据点
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The liaison officers were based with the local authorities to streamline communication.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 联络官被安排在当地官方机构办公，以简化沟通流程。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 立足于；以……作为自己论证的依据
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The defense attorney based herself on precedent set by the supreme court.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 辩护律师以最高法院先前的判例作为自己的辩护依据。

idioms.meaning: （与某人）联系，打招呼；互通情况
idioms.example_en: Let's touch base next Monday to review the updated project timelines.
idioms.example_zh: 我们下周一联系碰一下，核对更新后的项目时间表。

idioms.phrase: cover all the bases / cover all bases
idioms.meaning: 考虑周全；面面俱到；做好万全准备
idioms.example_en: The lawyer reviewed every document meticulously to ensure they had covered all the bases.
idioms.example_zh: 律师仔细审查了每一份文件，以确保他们考虑周全、毫无疏漏。

idioms.meaning: 错误的；不切实际的；大错特错的
idioms.example_en: Her assumption that profits would double this quarter was completely off base.
idioms.example_zh: 她认为本季度利润会翻倍的设想完全是错误的。

idioms.meaning: 取得初步进展；迈出成功第一步（常用于否定）
idioms.example_en: We couldn't even get to first base with the investors because the valuation was too high.
idioms.example_zh: 由于估值过高，我们甚至没能和投资者取得任何实质性的初步进展。

idioms.meaning: 抢占先机；出其不意抢得优势；（棒球）偷垒
idioms.example_en: By launching their product early, the startup stole base on its well-established rivals.
idioms.example_zh: 通过提前发布产品，这家初创企业出其不意地抢先了老牌竞争对手一步。

idioms.meaning: 形成满垒局势；面临全方位的机遇或巨大压力
idioms.example_en: The team loaded the bases in the final inning, keeping fans on the edge of their seats.
idioms.example_zh: 球队在最后一局挤满垒包，让球迷们紧张得屏住了呼吸。

collocations.example_en: The subscription service has built a loyal customer base across North America.
collocations.example_zh: 该订阅服务在整个北美地区建立了忠实的客户群体。

collocations.example_en: In addition to a generous base salary, the position offers commission and annual bonuses.
collocations.example_zh: 除了丰厚的基本工资外，该职位还提供佣金和年终奖金。

collocations.example_en: The tech support team maintains a comprehensive online knowledge base for users.
collocations.example_zh: 技术支持团队为用户维护着一个内容完备的在线知识库。

collocations.meaning: 权力基础；政治势力范围
collocations.example_en: The mayor consolidated his power base by forming alliances with local business leaders.
collocations.example_zh: 市长通过与当地商界领袖结盟巩固了自己的权力基础。

collocations.meaning: 大本营；根据地；家庭所在地
collocations.example_en: Although he travels for business all year round, London remains his home base.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管他常年出差，伦敦依然是他生活的大本营。

collocations.meaning: 扩大……的基础；拓宽支持面
collocations.example_en: The political party made efforts to broaden its voter base ahead of the election.
collocations.example_zh: 该政党在选举前努力扩大其选民基础。

collocations.example_en: Security was tightened around the naval base following the incident.
collocations.example_zh: 该事件发生后，海军基地周围加强了警戒。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打开（电器、开关等）；突然攻击，反目；取决于；使产生性冲动或极度兴奋
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She turned on the television to watch the evening news.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她打开电视看晚间新闻。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 关闭（电器、水源等）；拐弯离开（主路）；使厌烦，令人扫兴
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't forget to turn off the lights before you leave the office.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 离开办公室前别忘了关灯。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 调大（音量、热量等）；意外出现，到场；被偶然发现/找到
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He promised to come, but he didn't turn up until midnight.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他答应过要来，但直到半夜才现身。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 调小（音量、光线等）；拒绝（提议、申请或请求）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She had to turn down the job offer because the salary was too low.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 因为薪水太低，她不得不拒绝了那份工作邀请。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 结果是，证明是；关掉（灯火）；出席，聚集；生产，制造
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The weather forecast was bad, but it turned out to be a sunny day.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 天气预报说不好，但结果却是个大晴天。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 变成，转变为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Over the years, the small village has turned into a bustling tourist town.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这些年来，这个小村庄变成了一座熙熙攘攘的旅游城镇。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 转身，调头；扭转（局势），使好转；迅速完成（任务）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The new CEO managed to turn the failing company around within two years.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 新任首席执行官在两年内成功扭转了这家濒临倒闭的公司。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 翻转，翻身；移交，转让；营业额达到；认真思考，反复思量
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The suspect was arrested and turned over to local police.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 嫌疑人被逮捕后移交给了当地警方。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 上交，呈递；去睡觉；告发，自首
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Students are required to turn in their assignments before Friday noon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 学生们被要求在周五中午之前上交作业。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 求助于，寻求安慰；翻到（书页）；转向，着手于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In times of crisis, people often turn to their family for emotional support.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 遇到危机时，人们常常向家人寻求情感支持。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把…拒之门外，不准进入；转过脸去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Hundreds of disappointed fans were turned away at the door because the venue was full.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 因为场馆已满，数百名失望的歌迷被拒之门外。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 折返，往回走；倒退；阻止…前行
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The blizzard became so intense that the climbers had no choice but to turn back.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 暴风雪变得极其猛烈，登山者们别无选择只能折返。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与…反目成仇；使对…产生敌意
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The public mood quickly turned against the government after the tax hike.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 加税之后，公众情绪迅速转向反对政府。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 背弃，放弃；回避（现实或困境）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: More and more consumers are turning away from fast fashion in favor of sustainable goods.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 越来越多的消费者正在摒弃快时尚，转而选择可持续商品。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拐入（某条道路）；引导…接触/对…产生兴趣
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Turn onto Main Street and drive for another two miles.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 拐进主街，然后再往前开两英里。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 避开，转向一边；忽视，拒绝理睬
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He refused to turn aside from his original principles despite the political pressure.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管面临政治压力，他仍拒绝背弃自己最初的原则。

idioms.meaning: 熟视无睹，装作没看见
idioms.example_en: Management decided to turn a blind eye to minor safety violations.
idioms.example_zh: 管理层决定对轻微的违规安全操作装作没看见。

idioms.meaning: 置若罔闻，充耳不闻
idioms.example_en: The committee turned a deaf ear to all appeals from local residents.
idioms.example_zh: 委员会对当地居民的所有呼吁置若罔闻。

idioms.meaning: 改过自新，翻开崭新的一页
idioms.example_en: After his release from prison, he resolved to turn over a new leaf.
idioms.example_zh: 出狱后，他下定决心改过自新。

idioms.meaning: 反败为胜，扭转局面
idioms.example_en: The challenger managed to turn the tables on the champion in the final round.
idioms.example_zh: 挑战者在最后一轮成功反败为胜击败了卫冕冠军。

idioms.meaning: 扭转局势，力挽狂澜
idioms.example_en: A sudden breakthrough in negotiations helped turn the tide of the crisis.
idioms.example_zh: 谈判中的突发突破扭转了危机的局势。

idioms.meaning: 引人注目，回头率高
idioms.example_en: Her stunning evening gown really turned heads at the gala.
idioms.example_zh: 她在晚会上那件惊艳的晚礼服引得众人纷纷回头。

collocations.example_en: Having solved the immediate issue, we must now turn our attention to the budget.
collocations.example_zh: 解决了眼前的问题后，我们现在必须把注意力转向预算。

collocations.example_en: You cannot simply turn your back on your friends when they need help.
collocations.example_zh: 在朋友需要帮助时，你绝不能弃他们于不顾。

collocations.phrase: take a turn for the better / worse
collocations.example_en: The patient's condition suddenly took a turn for the worse overnight.
collocations.example_zh: 病人的病情在夜间突然恶化。

collocations.example_en: He felt that his creative ideas were being blocked at every turn by bureaucracy.
collocations.example_zh: 他感到自己的创意构想处处受到官僚作风的阻挠。

collocations.meaning: 脸色变苍白 / 脸变红 / （食物）变酸或变味
collocations.example_en: His face turned pale when he heard the shocking news.
collocations.example_zh: 听到那个令人震惊的消息时，他的脸色变得惨白。

collocations.example_en: She decided to change her career path just before turning forty.
collocations.example_zh: 她在即将满四十岁前决定改变自己的职业道路。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （企业、工厂等）关闭，停业，倒闭
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The local bookstore was forced to close down due to online competition.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于线上竞争，这家当地书店被迫停业倒闭。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 逼近，包围；（白昼）变短；（恶劣天气）来临，笼罩
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The police were quietly closing in on the criminal's hideout.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警方正在悄悄逼近罪犯的藏身之所。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （店铺等）打烊，暂时关闭；（伤口）愈合；靠拢，紧挨；隐藏情感
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The shopkeeper usually closes up around eight o'clock in the evening.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 店主通常在晚上八点左右打烊。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 封锁，阻断（道路、区域等）；隔绝
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Police closed off the surrounding streets while firefighters tackled the blaze.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 消防员扑救大火时，警方封锁了周围的街道。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以…结束；清仓甩卖；结清（账户、头寸）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company decided to close out the year with a major marketing campaign.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 公司决定以一场大型营销活动来为这一年收尾。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 淹没，吞没；（水面等在某物下沉后）合拢
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The cold river waters closed over the sunken car in seconds.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 冰冷的河水在几秒钟内便吞没了那辆沉没的轿车。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 靠近，逼近（以便交手/交谈）；以…告终；接受（提议/报价）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The keynote speaker closed with an inspiring message about unity.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 主讲人最后以一段关于团结的鼓舞人心的致辞结束了演讲。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 包围，围拢；笼罩
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Darkness and heavy fog closed round the lost hikers on the mountain.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 黑暗与浓雾笼罩了山上迷路的登山客。

idioms.meaning: 秘密地，不公开地
idioms.example_en: Crucial diplomatic negotiations were held behind closed doors.
idioms.example_zh: 至关重要的外交谈判是在闭门秘密状态下进行的。

idioms.meaning: 紧密团结，携手自卫（以御外侮）
idioms.example_en: The board members closed ranks to defend their controversial policy.
idioms.example_zh: 董事会成员团结一致，共同维护他们那项备受争议的政策。

idioms.meaning: 了结，彻底结束对…的调查或处理
idioms.example_en: Investigators finally closed the book on the decade-old cold case.
idioms.example_zh: 调查人员最终彻底了结了这桩长达十年的悬案。

idioms.phrase: close the stable door after the horse has bolted
idioms.meaning: 亡羊补牢为时已晚，事后才采取防范措施
idioms.example_en: Upgrading security after being hacked is like closing the stable door after the horse has bolted.
idioms.example_zh: 被黑客攻击之后才升级安防措施，无异于亡羊补牢为时已晚。

idioms.meaning: 切中要害，触及痛处
idioms.example_en: His sharp critique of the healthcare system hit a little too close to home.
idioms.example_zh: 他对医疗体系的尖锐批评让人感觉有点太触及痛处了。

idioms.meaning: 对…关上大门，断绝…的可能性
idioms.example_en: The breakdown of talks closed the door on any hopes of a peaceful resolution.
idioms.example_zh: 会谈的破裂断绝了和平解决的所有希望。

collocations.example_en: The sales team worked late into the night to close the multi-million-dollar deal.
collocations.example_zh: 销售团队加班到深夜，终于敲定了这项数百万美元的交易。

collocations.example_en: The government is investing heavily in rural schools to close the educational gap.
collocations.example_zh: 政府正大力投资农村学校以缩小教育差距。

collocations.example_en: The chairman brought the lengthy meeting to a close at 6 p.m.
collocations.example_zh: 董事长在下午六点结束了这场冗长的会议。

collocations.example_en: As summer drew to a close, the students began preparing for the new semester.
collocations.example_zh: 随着夏天接近尾声，学生们开始为新学期做准备。

collocations.example_en: She went to the bank to close her checking account before moving abroad.
collocations.example_zh: 出国前，她去银行注销了自己的支票账户。

collocations.meaning: 形成闭环，落实解决跟进问题
collocations.example_en: We need to follow up with the client to close the loop on this customer complaint.
collocations.example_zh: 我们需要跟进客户，对这起客户投诉彻底形成闭环解决。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 计算总数；（情况、说法等）合乎情理，说得通
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His story just doesn't add up, and I suspect he is hiding something.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他的说法根本说不通，我怀疑他隐瞒了什么。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 总计达；意味着，等同于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All their efforts added up to nothing when the contract fell through.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当合同告吹时，他们所有的努力最终都化为了泡影。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 增加，增添（负担、困难、乐趣等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The bad weather only added to the difficulties of the rescue operation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 恶劣的天气只会增加救援工作的难度。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……包括在内，把……计入
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't forget to add in the cost of shipping when calculating the total price.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 计算总价时，别忘了把运费算进去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 另外加上，附加（费用、建筑等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A 10% service charge will be added on to your final hotel bill.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 最终的酒店账单上会额外加收10%的服务费。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……加在一起，合计
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If you add all these numbers together, the total is over five hundred.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你把所有这些数字加在一起，总数超过五百。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （财务）把（扣除额等）重新计入，回加
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Depreciation must be added back to net profit to calculate the operating cash flow.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 必须将折旧费用重新加回到净利润中以计算经营性现金流。

idioms.meaning: 雪上加霜，伤害之外又加侮辱
idioms.example_en: They rejected his proposal and, to add insult to injury, refused to pay for his travel expenses.
idioms.example_zh: 他们拒绝了他的提案，更雪上加霜的是，还拒绝为他报销差旅费。

idioms.phrase: add fuel to the fire / flames
idioms.meaning: 火上浇油，使事态恶化
idioms.example_en: His angry remarks only added fuel to the fire during the heated debate.
idioms.example_zh: 在激烈的辩论中，他愤怒的言论纯粹是火上浇油。

idioms.meaning: 发表浅见，插话表态
idioms.example_en: If I may add my two cents, I think we should reconsider the launch date.
idioms.example_zh: 恕我直言，我认为我们应该重新考虑发布日期。

idioms.meaning: 为……提供素材，提供论据或生财之道
idioms.example_en: Every scandal in the political arena was just more grist to the satirist's mill.
idioms.example_zh: 政坛中的每一起丑闻都只不过是讽刺作家绝佳的创作素材。

idioms.meaning: 为……增添趣味或生动性
idioms.example_en: The anecdotes in his speech added color to an otherwise dry presentation.
idioms.example_zh: 他在演讲中穿插的轶事为原本枯燥的报告增添了不少生趣。

collocations.example_en: We focus on services that add tangible value to our clients' businesses.
collocations.example_zh: 我们专注于能为客户业务创造切实附加值的服务。

collocations.example_en: The newly discovered evidence adds weight to the theory of human migration.
collocations.example_zh: 新发现的证据进一步增强了人类迁徙假说的说服力。

collocations.meaning: 为……带来更客观或全面的视角
collocations.example_en: Looking at historical data adds useful perspective to the current economic crisis.
collocations.example_zh: 回顾历史数据能为当前经济危机带来更有益的审视视角。

collocations.example_en: She tapped the table to add emphasis to her point.
collocations.example_zh: 她敲了敲桌子以强调自己的观点。

collocations.example_en: Fresh herbs can add a lot of flavor to simple dishes.
collocations.example_zh: 新鲜香草能给普通的菜肴增添许多风味。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顺道拜访，顺路走访
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Can you stop by the pharmacy on your way home to pick up my medicine?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你回家路上能顺道去趟药店帮我拿药吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （长途旅程中）中途停留，转机中途逗留
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We decided to stop over in Singapore for two days en route to Sydney.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们决定在飞往悉尼的途中在新加坡停留逗留两天。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （路途中）短暂停留，稍作歇息
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's stop off at a service station to stretch our legs and grab a coffee.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们在服务区歇一下脚，喝杯咖啡吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顺道探访；留在家中不出门
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'll stop in and see how grandma is doing this afternoon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我今天下午会顺道过去看看奶奶过得怎么样。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 熬夜不睡；堵塞，填补（洞孔）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He stopped up late working on his assignment to meet the deadline.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 为了赶上截止日期，他熬夜做作业。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 散场后留下，滞留不走
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The teacher asked Mark to stop behind after class to discuss his essay.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 老师让马克下课后留下来讨论他的论文。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在外逗留不归，彻夜不归
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her parents were furious when she stopped out until dawn without calling.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她彻夜不归且连电话都不打一个，父母气坏了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （摄影）缩小光圈
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You may need to stop down to increase the depth of field in landscape shots.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 拍风景照时你可能需要缩小光圈以增加景深。

idioms.meaning: 竭尽全力，毫无保留，全力以赴
idioms.example_en: The company pulled out all the stops to ensure the new product launched on time.
idioms.example_zh: 公司倾尽全力以确保新产品能够按时发布。

idioms.meaning: 突然停下脚步，猛然愣住
idioms.example_en: She stopped dead in her tracks when she heard a strange noise behind her.
idioms.example_zh: 听到身后传来奇怪的声音，她吓得猛然停住了脚步。

idioms.meaning: 差点做出某事但悬崖勒马，未到……的地步
idioms.example_en: The manager criticized his performance but stopped short of firing him.
idioms.example_zh: 经理批评了他的表现，但尚未达到开除他的地步。

idioms.meaning: 不择手段，无所顾忌
idioms.example_en: He is an ambitious politician who will stop at nothing to gain power.
idioms.example_zh: 他是一个野心勃勃的政客，为了夺取权力会不择手段。

idioms.meaning: 制止，叫停，彻底终结
idioms.example_en: The headmaster vowed to put a stop to bullying in the school.
idioms.example_zh: 校长发誓要彻底制止校内的霸凌现象。

idioms.meaning: 制止局势恶化，力挽狂澜
idioms.example_en: The team brought in a veteran coach in an attempt to stop the rot.
idioms.example_zh: 球队请来了一位资深教练，试图挽回连续败北的颓势。

collocations.example_en: Nothing could stop him from pursuing his dream of becoming a pilot.
collocations.example_zh: 没有什么能阻挡他追逐成为一名飞行员的梦想。

collocations.example_en: The express train slowly came to a stop at the central platform.
collocations.example_zh: 特快列车缓缓停靠在中央站台。

collocations.example_en: He stopped short in mid-sentence, realizing he had revealed a secret.
collocations.example_zh: 他说到一半突然打住，意识到自己说漏了嘴。

collocations.example_en: The car stopped dead when the engine seized up.
collocations.example_zh: 发动机卡死后，汽车彻底熄火停滞了。

collocations.example_en: The heavy blizzard brought all traffic in the city to a complete stop.
collocations.example_zh: 暴风雪使整座城市的交通完全瘫痪停顿。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 腾出，空出（时间、空间、资源或资金）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Deleting unnecessary files will help free up storage space on your hard drive.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 删除不必要的文件有助于腾出硬盘的存储空间。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使摆脱，使免受（痛苦、债务、束缚或限制）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The innovative therapy helped free her from chronic back pain.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这项创新疗法帮助她摆脱了长期的背痛折磨。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使脱离，使免除（指控、责任或羁绊）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The new evidence finally freed him of all charges.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 新证据最终洗清了他的所有指控。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 释放，放归自由；使免受约束
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The wildlife organization rehabilitated the injured eagle and set it free.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 野生动物救助组织治愈了那只受伤的鹰并将其放归自然。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 挣脱，挣扎逃跑；摆脱（控制、束缚或旧观念）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The hostage managed to break free from his captors and seek help.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 人质设法挣脱了绑架者的控制并寻求帮助。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 切断绳索/束缚以释放；割断联系获得独立
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Firefighters had to cut the driver free from the wreckage of the car.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 消防员不得不破拆汽车残骸将司机救出。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 甩开，摆脱（纠缠、追捕者或负面情绪）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He couldn't shake free of the feeling that he was being watched.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他始终无法摆脱一种被人监视的感觉。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使劲挣脱，撕扯脱身
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She tore free from his grasp and ran toward the crowd.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她一把挣脱他的抓扯，向人群跑去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （通过缓慢移动或用力）逐渐松脱，慢慢挣脱
phrasal_verbs.example_en: With steady patience, the climber worked his trapped foot free.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这位登山者耐心地慢慢将卡住的脚挪了出来。

idioms.meaning: 尽管做某事，请随意做某事
idioms.example_en: Please feel free to ask questions if anything is unclear.
idioms.example_zh: 如果有任何不清楚的地方，请随时提问。

idioms.meaning: 放手让某人自由处理，给某人全权
idioms.example_en: The director gave the designer a free hand to revamp the entire brand.
idioms.example_zh: 总监放手让设计师全权改造整个品牌形象。

idioms.meaning: 无抵押的，全款结清的；摆脱全部债务或责任的
idioms.example_en: After twenty years of payments, they finally owned their house free and clear.
idioms.example_zh: 经过二十年的还贷，他们终于彻底付清房款并完全拥有了这栋房子。

idioms.meaning: 自由自在，无拘无束
idioms.example_en: Now that exams are over, I feel as free as a bird.
idioms.example_zh: 现在考试结束了，我感到无拘无束、无比自在。

idioms.meaning: 享受自由，呼吸自由空气；如释重负
idioms.example_en: After years of living under an oppressive regime, they could finally breathe free.
idioms.example_zh: 在经历了多年的压迫统治后，他们终于能够呼吸自由的空气了。

idioms.phrase: there is no such thing as a free lunch
idioms.meaning: 天下没有免费的午餐
idioms.example_en: They offered a free trial, but remember that there is no such thing as a free lunch.
idioms.example_zh: 他们提供了免费试用，但请记住天下没有免费的午餐。

collocations.example_en: Special forces launched a swift raid to free the hostages.
collocations.example_zh: 特种部队发起迅雷不及掩耳的突袭以解救人质。

collocations.example_en: I'll try to free my schedule tomorrow afternoon so we can meet.
collocations.example_zh: 我明天下午会尽量腾出时间，以便我们碰面。

collocations.meaning: 放空思绪，使心情放松，拓宽思维
collocations.example_en: Meditation helped him free his mind from everyday anxieties.
collocations.example_zh: 冥想帮助他排解了日常焦虑，放空了思绪。

collocations.example_en: Rescue crews worked through the night to free trapped victims from the collapsed building.
collocations.example_zh: 救援人员通宵作业，从倒塌的建筑物中营救受困人员。

collocations.example_en: His solid alibi freed him from suspicion immediately.
collocations.example_zh: 他确凿的不在场证明立即洗清了他的嫌疑。

collocations.example_en: Negotiators worked tirelessly to free the journalists from captivity.
collocations.example_zh: 谈判代表不懈努力，促成了记者摆脱被囚禁的状态。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 朝……进发；必然产生（某种不良结果/命运）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They packed their bags and headed for the airport early in the morning.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们清早收拾好行李，朝机场进发。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拦截，阻截；阻止，化解（冲突、危机等）；动身离开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Diplomats worked frantically to head off an imminent international conflict.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 外交官们争分夺秒地展开斡旋，以化解迫在眉睫的国际冲突。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 主管，率领，掌管（组织、团队或项目）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was appointed to head up the newly created research division.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她被任命主管新设立的研发部门。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 动身，出发，出门
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It is getting late, so we should probably head out before the traffic worsens.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 时间不早了，我们最好在交通恶化之前动身出发。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 返回，往回走
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After spending the weekend at the cabin, we headed back to the city.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在小木屋度过周末后，我们动身返回市区。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 朝……方向前进；走向（某种趋势或状态）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The economy is heading towards a steady recovery.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经济正在迈向稳步复苏。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 前往某处（多指短距离走动，常与 to 连用）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'm going to head over to the library to finish my essay.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我打算去一趟图书馆完成我的论文。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 驶入，走进；面临，遭遇（严峻局势或恶劣天气）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The ship was heading directly into a violent storm.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 轮船正径直驶入一场狂暴的风暴中。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 沿着（街道等）走；前往某地（常指向南或向中心外）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Just head down this corridor and take the second door on your right.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 顺着这条走廊往前走，进右手边第二扇门就是。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 离去，离开，朝相反方向走
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We watched the dark storm clouds heading away toward the mountains.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们看着乌黑的风暴云层逐渐远去，飘向山区。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 归航，返港；朝内走，进屋
phrasal_verbs.example_en: As dusk fell, the fishing boats started heading in toward the harbor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 黄昏降临，渔船开始进港归航。

idioms.meaning: 保持镇静，沉着冷静
idioms.example_en: She managed to keep her head during the emergency and gave clear instructions.
idioms.example_zh: 在紧急情况下她保持了冷静，并下达了清晰的指令。

idioms.meaning: 失去理智，惊慌失措
idioms.example_en: Don't lose your head when unexpected problems arise; take a deep breath.
idioms.example_zh: 当突发问题出现时切勿慌张失措，先深吸一口气。

idioms.meaning: （矛盾、危机等）达到激化点，进入紧要关头
idioms.example_en: The long-standing disputes between the board and management finally came to a head.
idioms.example_zh: 董事会与管理层之间长期的争端终于彻底激化。

idioms.meaning: 神魂颠倒，深深坠入爱河；跌跌撞撞地
idioms.example_en: He fell head over heels in love with her the moment they met.
idioms.example_zh: 他们相遇的那一刻，他就无可救药地爱上了她。

idioms.phrase: bury one's head in the sand
idioms.meaning: 逃避现实，采取鸵鸟政策
idioms.example_en: You cannot just bury your head in the sand and hope the debt will disappear.
idioms.example_zh: 你不能采取鸵鸟政策，指望债务会自动消失。

idioms.meaning: 百思不得其解，感到困惑
idioms.example_en: The sudden drop in sales left the marketing team scratching their heads.
idioms.example_zh: 销售额的骤降让整个营销团队百思不得其解。

idioms.meaning: 狂笑不止，笑破肚皮
idioms.example_en: The comedy was so hilarious that the whole audience laughed their heads off.
idioms.example_zh: 这部喜剧太搞笑了，以至于全场观众都笑破了肚皮。

collocations.meaning: 朝正确的方向发展/前进
collocations.example_en: The initial feedback suggests that our reform is heading in the right direction.
collocations.example_zh: 初步反馈表明我们的改革正朝着正确的方向推进。

collocations.example_en: After the concert ended, she headed straight home without stopping anywhere.
collocations.example_zh: 音乐会结束后，她没有在任何地方停留，直接回了家。

collocations.example_en: Professor Miller was chosen to head the ethics committee.
collocations.example_zh: 米勒教授被选拔领导该伦理委员会。

collocations.example_en: The striker expertly headed the ball into the top corner of the net.
collocations.example_zh: 前锋巧妙地头球破门，球直挂球门死角。

collocations.example_en: The trade minister will head a delegation of top executives on a visit to Asia.
collocations.example_zh: 贸易部长将率领由高管组成的代表团访问亚洲。

collocations.example_en: The sheriff headed a search party deep into the dense forest.
collocations.example_zh: 治安官率领搜救队深入茂密的森林进行搜寻。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 提交，呈交（作业、报告、辞呈等）；上交（失物或违禁品）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Students are required to hand in their final essays by Friday afternoon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 学生们被要求在周五下午前交上期末论文。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分发，散发；给出（建议、批评或惩罚）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The teacher handed out the exam papers while volunteers handed out free water bottles.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 老师分发了试卷，同时志愿者们分发了免费的瓶装水。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 移交，交出（控制权、权力或物品）；引渡，将（嫌疑人）移交给警方
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The outgoing CEO officially handed over control of the company to her successor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 即将离任的首席执行官正式将公司的管理权移交给了继任者。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……传下去，流传；正式宣布（判决或官方裁定）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: This antique pocket watch was handed down from my great-grandfather, and the judge handed down a life sentence.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这块古董怀表是我曾祖父传下来的；法官则宣判了终身监禁。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 退还，归还，交还给原主
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The receptionist checked my passport and handed it back to me.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 接待员检查了我的护照后将其还给了我。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 依次传递，分发给在座的每个人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Could you please hand round these family photo albums so everyone can have a look?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你能把这些家庭相册传阅一下，让大家都看看吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 传递，转交（物品或信息）；传给（后人）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please read this memo carefully and hand it on to the rest of the team.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 请仔细阅读这份备忘录，并将其转交给团队的其他成员。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 交接，移交（任务、工作或项目）；（美式橄榄球中）递手传球
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I need to hand off the project management duties before taking my paternity leave.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在休陪产假之前，我需要把项目管理职责交接出去。

idioms.meaning: 手拉手；密切相关，并存
idioms.example_en: Economic growth and environmental protection must go hand in hand.
idioms.example_zh: 经济增长与环境保护必须齐头并进。

idioms.meaning: 参与……，插手……，对……有贡献或影响
idioms.example_en: She suspected that her rival had a hand in the cancellation of the contract.
idioms.example_zh: 她怀疑自己的竞争对手插手了合同被取消一事。

idioms.phrase: give sb a hand / lend sb a hand
idioms.meaning: 帮某人一把，协助某人
idioms.example_en: Could you give me a hand with lifting this heavy dining table?
idioms.example_zh: 你能搭把手帮我抬一下这张沉重的餐桌吗？

idioms.meaning: 洗手不干，对……撒手不管，拒绝再对……承担责任
idioms.example_en: After years of frustration, he washed his hands of the entire family dispute.
idioms.example_zh: 经过多年的沮丧，他彻底对整个家族纷争撒手不管了。

idioms.meaning: 迫使某人提前采取行动，逼某人表态
idioms.example_en: The leak of the secret files forced the government's hand to launch an official inquiry.
idioms.example_zh: 机密文件的泄露迫使政府不得不提前启动官方调查。

idioms.phrase: bite the hand that feeds you
idioms.meaning: 恩将仇报，过河拆桥
idioms.example_en: Criticizing the company that gave you your big break is biting the hand that feeds you.
idioms.example_zh: 批评给你提供重大机遇的公司无异于恩将仇报。

idioms.meaning: 现挣现吃，勉强度日，仅够糊口
idioms.example_en: With rising inflation, many low-income households are living from hand to mouth.
idioms.example_zh: 随着通胀加剧，许多低收入家庭正过着勉强糊口的生活。

collocations.meaning: 提交辞呈，递交辞职通知
collocations.example_en: He decided to hand in his notice after securing a better job offer abroad.
collocations.example_zh: 在获得一份更好的海外工作后，他决定递交辞职通知。

collocations.phrase: hand sth to sb on a silver platter
collocations.meaning: 拱手相让，不费吹灰之力奉送给某人
collocations.example_en: Nobody is going to hand success to you on a silver platter; you have to earn it.
collocations.example_zh: 没有人会把成功拱手送给你，你必须自己去争取。

collocations.meaning: 大量且迅速地（常形容迅速赚钱或赔钱）
collocations.example_en: During the tech boom, early investors were making money hand over fist.
collocations.example_zh: 在科技繁荣期，早期投资者赚得盆满钵满。

collocations.example_en: The historic manor has changed hands several times over the past century.
collocations.example_zh: 这座历史悠久的庄园在过去一个世纪里数次易主。

collocations.meaning: 失去控制；不假思索地，断然（多指拒绝）
collocations.example_en: The party quickly got out of hand, and the board rejected the proposal out of hand.
collocations.example_zh: 派对很快就失控了；而董事会则当场断然拒绝了该提案。

collocations.meaning: 在控制中；在处理中；手头现存（现金、时间等）
collocations.example_en: Don't panic about the audit—the finance team has the situation well in hand.
collocations.example_zh: 别为审计惊慌——财务团队已经把情况控制得很好了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 相信……的存在；信仰，信奉；赞成，支持；信任，信赖
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She believes in equal opportunities for all and truly believes in her team's potential.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她倡导人人机会均等，并深信自己团队的潜力。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 相信（某人会做出某种举动，多用于否定句或疑问句）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I know he made a mistake, but I would never have believed it of him.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我知道他犯了错，但我绝不敢相信他居然会做出这种事。

idioms.meaning: 信不信由你
idioms.example_en: Believe it or not, we actually finished the entire renovation ahead of schedule.
idioms.example_zh: 信不信由你，我们居然提前完成了全部装修。

idioms.meaning: 眼见为实，百闻不如一见
idioms.example_en: The display quality on this new screen sounds unbelievable, but seeing is believing.
idioms.example_zh: 这款新屏幕的显示质量听起来不可思议，但百闻不如一见。

idioms.meaning: 假装，虚构，白日做梦
idioms.example_en: The children liked to make believe that the living room rug was a vast ocean.
idioms.example_zh: 孩子们喜欢假装客厅的地毯是一片汪洋大海。

idioms.meaning: 千真万确，一点不假，你最好相信
idioms.example_en: "Is this project going to be tough?" "You'd better believe it."
idioms.example_zh: “这个项目会很棘手吗？”“千真万确。”

idioms.meaning: 不敢相信自己的眼睛/耳朵，难以置信
idioms.example_en: When she heard she had won the national scholarship, she couldn't believe her ears.
idioms.example_zh: 当听说自己获得了国家奖学金时，她简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

idioms.meaning: 请相信我，我向你保证，千真万确
idioms.example_en: Believe you me, dealing with the bureaucracy will take much longer than you think.
idioms.example_zh: 相信我，跟官僚机构打交道要花的时间远比你想的要长。

collocations.example_en: We firmly believe that education is the most powerful tool to reduce poverty.
collocations.example_zh: 我们坚信教育是减少贫困的最有力工具。

collocations.example_en: The police have reason to believe that the suspect has fled the country.
collocations.example_zh: 警方有理由相信嫌疑人已经潜逃出境。

collocations.meaning: 使某人相信，给某人造成某种假象或印象
collocations.example_en: Previous advertisements had led customers to believe the service was entirely free.
collocations.example_zh: 先前的广告误导顾客，让他们以为这项服务是完全免费的。

collocations.meaning: 由衷地相信，真诚地认为
collocations.example_en: I genuinely believe that this compromise offers the best outcome for both sides.
collocations.example_zh: 我真诚地认为，这一折中方案对双方而言都是最佳结果。

collocations.example_en: Many people mistakenly believe that cold weather directly causes the common cold.
collocations.example_zh: 许多人误以为寒冷的天气会直接引起普通感冒。

collocations.meaning: 几乎无法相信，难以置信
collocations.example_en: I can hardly believe that ten years have passed since we first met.
collocations.example_zh: 我几乎不敢相信自我们初次相遇以来已经过去十年了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 收到……的信件/电话/消息
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I haven't heard from my college roommate in nearly five years.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我已经将近五年没收到我大学室友的消息了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 听说了关于……的情况；得知某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Did you hear about the massive layoffs announced at the tech firm?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你听说那家科技巨头宣布的大规模裁员了吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 听说过（某人或某事）；（用于否定句）容许，准许
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I offered to pay for dinner, but she wouldn't hear of it.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我提出请客吃晚饭，但她坚决不答应。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 听某人把话说完（耐心地听某人解释）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Before you jump to conclusions, please hear me out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在你匆忙下结论之前，请听我把话说完。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 得到回复，收到回音
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I applied for the marketing position last week and expect to hear back soon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我上周申请了市场部的职位，希望能尽快收到回复。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 听说过关于……的传闻（非正式或方言用法）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Old folks in the village still hear tell of the hidden treasure in the cave.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 村里的老人们仍听说过关于那个山洞里藏有宝藏的传言。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……听完，从头到尾听完
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The manager agreed to hear through the employees' list of grievances.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经理同意把员工们提出的意见清单从头到尾听完。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 听别人说，耳闻
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I hear say that the historical downtown theater is going to be demolished.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我听说市中心那座历史悠久的剧院即将被拆除。

idioms.meaning: 通过小道消息得知，道听途说
idioms.example_en: I heard it on the grapevine that the CEO is planning to resign.
idioms.example_zh: 我从小道消息听说首席执行官打算辞职。

idioms.phrase: never hear the end of sth
idioms.meaning: 没完没了地被唠叨/提起某事
idioms.example_en: If I burn the roast again tonight, I'll never hear the end of it from my brother.
idioms.example_zh: 如果我今晚又把烤肉烤焦了，我弟弟肯定会没完没了地拿这事念叨我。

idioms.meaning: 极其安静，针落有声（通常用于 could hear a pin drop）
idioms.example_en: When the speaker announced the tragic news, you could hear a pin drop in the auditorium.
idioms.example_zh: 当发言人宣布这个悲痛的消息时，整个礼堂安静得针落有声。

idioms.meaning: 产生幻听，听到不存在的声音
idioms.example_en: I must be hearing things; I thought someone called my name in the empty hallway.
idioms.example_zh: 我一定是出现幻听了，我刚才以为空荡荡的走廊里有人在喊我的名字。

idioms.meaning: 表达自己的意见并获得重视/倾听
idioms.example_en: Citizens turned out in huge numbers to make their voices heard at the town hall meeting.
idioms.example_zh: 市民们大量涌向市政厅会议，以便让自己的诉求得到倾听。

idioms.meaning: 绝不同意，坚决反对
idioms.example_en: We wanted to walk home in the rain, but grandmother wouldn't hear of it and called a cab.
idioms.example_zh: 我们本想冒雨走回家，但祖母坚决不同意，硬是叫了一辆出租车。

collocations.meaning: 听得一清二楚，听得明白
collocations.example_en: Can you hear me clearly at the back of the conference room?
collocations.example_zh: 会议室后排的各位能听清楚我的声音吗？

collocations.example_en: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear the high-profile copyright appeal next month.
collocations.example_zh: 最高法院已同意下个月审理这起备受瞩目的版权上诉案。

collocations.meaning: 听取供词；（神父）听取忏悔
collocations.example_en: The priest entered the confessional booth to hear confessions before Mass.
collocations.example_zh: 弥撒开始前，神父走进告解室听取信徒的忏悔。

collocations.meaning: 刺耳的；难以接受的（批评或坏消息）
collocations.example_en: His performance critique was harsh and hard to hear, but completely accurate.
collocations.example_zh: 他对工作表现的批评虽然刺耳且令人难以接受，但完全切中要害。

collocations.meaning: 听到某人的祈祷，回应祈求
collocations.example_en: After weeks of drought, the farmers felt the heavens had finally heard their prayers.
collocations.example_zh: 经过数周的干旱，农民们感到上天终于回应了他们的祈祷。

collocations.meaning: 听到耳语；听到风声或传闻
collocations.example_en: The board members had already heard whispers about the impending merger.
collocations.example_zh: 董事会成员们此前就已经听到了关于即将合并的风声。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 预订一空，排满（多用被动语态 be booked up）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The hotel is completely booked up for the international trade fair next weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 下周末因举办国际贸易展，这家酒店已经被预订一空。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 办理登记入住/签到；为某人安排预约
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please arrive thirty minutes early to book in at the visitor reception desk.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 请提前三十分钟到达，在访客接待台办理签到手续。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 入住，预订（某酒店或场所）的房间
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After landing in London, we booked into a charming boutique hotel near Covent Garden.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在伦敦降落后，我们入住了考文特花园附近一家别致的精品酒店。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 全部订完；登记借出（图书/设备等）；办理退房手续
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All flights to the ski resort were completely booked out during the winter holiday.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 寒假期间飞往滑雪胜地的所有航班都被预订一空。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 登记休假，请假
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I need to book two days off work next week to attend my sister's wedding.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我下周需要请两天假去参加我妹妹的婚礼。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 订上（特定航班、班次或活动的名额）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The travel agent managed to book us on the earliest flight out tomorrow morning.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 旅行社设法为我们订上了明早最早起飞的航班。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 订通票，直接预订至目的地；一票到底
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You can book through to Paris, so you won't need to recheck your luggage during the layover.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你可以直接预订到巴黎的联程票，这样中转时就无需重新托运行李。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 登记，记入名册
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The receptionist booked down our personal details and handed over the room keys.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 接待员登记了我们的个人信息，随后递交了房间钥匙。

idioms.meaning: 将某人绳之以法，严惩某人
idioms.example_en: The authorities promised that the embezzlers would be brought to book swiftly.
idioms.example_zh: 当局承诺将迅速将侵吞公款者绳之以法。

idioms.meaning: 从重惩罚某人，予以最严厉处分
idioms.example_en: The judge decided to throw the book at the repeat offender to deter future crimes.
idioms.example_zh: 法官决定对这名惯犯从重顶格判罚，以儆效尤。

idioms.meaning: 做假账，篡改财务报表
idioms.example_en: The auditor discovered that the senior accountants had been cooking the books for years.
idioms.example_zh: 审计师发现高级会计师们多年来一直在伪造账目。

idioms.meaning: 看透某人，对某人的心思了如指掌
idioms.example_en: She could read her partner like a book and knew instantly that he was hiding something.
idioms.example_zh: 她对自己伴侣的心思了如指掌，一眼就看出他隐瞒了什么事情。

idioms.phrase: take a leaf out of sb's book
idioms.meaning: 以某人为榜样，效仿某人的做法
idioms.example_en: You should take a leaf out of your colleague's book and organize your workspace better.
idioms.example_zh: 你应该向你同事学习，把自己的工作区域整理得井井有条。

idioms.meaning: 对某事作彻底了结，终结某项事务
idioms.example_en: With the final settlement signed, both companies were eager to close the book on the lengthy dispute.
idioms.example_zh: 随着最终和解协议的签署，两家公司都急于彻底终结这场旷日持久的纠纷。

collocations.example_en: Tickets sell out quickly, so it is highly recommended to book well in advance.
collocations.example_zh: 门票销售很快，因此强烈建议提前订票。

collocations.example_en: I booked a table for four at the Italian restaurant for Friday evening.
collocations.example_zh: 我预订了周五晚上那家意大利餐厅的四人桌。

collocations.example_en: She booked a one-way flight to Tokyo after receiving the job offer.
collocations.example_zh: 收到录用通知后，她预订了飞往东京的单程机票。

collocations.example_en: We forgot to book accommodation during peak season and ended up staying far from the city center.
collocations.example_zh: 我们在旅游旺季忘了预订住宿，结果只得住在远离市中心的地方。

collocations.meaning: （交警/裁判）对某人记名处罚或开罚单；邀请某人演出
collocations.example_en: The referee booked the defender for a dangerous tackle near the penalty box.
collocations.example_zh: 裁判因防守队员在禁区附近危险铲球而对他出示黄牌警告（记名处罚）。

collocations.example_en: The seaside resort is fully booked for the entire month of August.
collocations.example_zh: 这家海滨度假酒店在整个八月份都已客满。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 提前规划；预先考虑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You need to plan ahead if you want to book cheap flights during the holidays.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你想在节假日订到便宜机票，就需要提前做好打算。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打算做某事；指望；预计
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We didn't plan on staying overnight, but the weather got worse.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们原本没打算过夜，但天气变得恶劣了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为……做准备；预先防备
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The city is failing to plan for future water shortages.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该市未能为未来的水资源短缺做好准备规划。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 精心设计；全面规划；详细制定
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She had planned out her whole week to make sure she met the deadline.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她把整整一周的时间都规划得妥妥当当，以确保能赶上截止日期。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 围绕……来安排；迁就……调整计划
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We had to plan the conference schedule around the keynote speaker's availability.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们不得不根据主讲嘉宾的空闲时间来调整大会日程。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为……未雨绸缪；为……提早做好筹划
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It is prudent to plan ahead for retirement as early as possible.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽早为退休生活做好筹划是明智之举。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将……纳入计划；将……编入日程
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Make sure you plan regular breaks into your revision timetable.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 确保在你的复习时间表中安排定期的休息时间。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向前规划；作远景规划
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The management team met to plan forward for the next five-year cycle.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 管理团队开会为下一个五年周期制定远景规划。

idioms.meaning: 按计划进行；顺利如期发生
idioms.example_en: If everything goes according to plan, the project will be finished by Friday.
idioms.example_zh: 如果一切按计划进行，项目将在周五前完成。

idioms.meaning: 最周密的计划（常暗示依然可能出错）
idioms.example_en: Even the best-laid plans can go astray when unexpected disruptions occur.
idioms.example_zh: 即使是最周密的计划，在发生意外变故时也可能落空。

idioms.meaning: 行动方案；策略；对策
idioms.example_en: What's our game plan if the client rejects the initial proposal?
idioms.example_zh: 如果客户拒绝了最初的提案，我们的应对策略是什么？

idioms.meaning: 备用方案；后备计划
idioms.example_en: Always have a plan B ready in case your original idea falls through.
idioms.example_zh: 随时准备一个备用方案，以防原定计划落空。

idioms.meaning: 行动计划；具体实施方案
idioms.example_en: The committee drew up an urgent plan of action to address the crisis.
idioms.example_zh: 委员会拟定了一份紧急行动方案来应对这场危机。

idioms.phrase: fail to plan is planning to fail
idioms.meaning: 不做准备就等于准备失败；未雨绸缪方能成事
idioms.example_en: Remember, failing to plan is planning to fail, so outline your steps thoroughly.
idioms.example_zh: 记住，不做计划就等于等着失败，因此要彻底梳理你的行动步骤。

collocations.example_en: The airline had a contingency plan in place for adverse winter weather.
collocations.example_zh: 该航空公司已针对冬季恶劣天气制定了应急预案。

collocations.meaning: 周密地规划；一丝不苟地策划
collocations.example_en: The museum heist had been meticulously planned over several months.
collocations.example_zh: 这起博物馆盗窃案经过了数月缜密周详的策划。

collocations.example_en: The city unveiled a new master plan for public transit expansion.
collocations.example_zh: 市政府公布了一项扩建公共交通系统的全新总体规划。

collocations.example_en: They are making plans to move abroad by the end of the year.
collocations.example_zh: 他们正打算在年底前搬到国外生活。

collocations.example_en: The board approved a five-year strategic plan to drive international growth.
collocations.example_zh: 董事会批准了一项旨在推动国际业务增长的五年战略规划。

collocations.example_en: A sudden drop in budget scuppered their plans to renovate the headquarters.
collocations.example_zh: 预算的骤减使他们翻修总部的计划泡了汤。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对某人指手画脚；对某人呼来喝去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'm sick of him ordering everyone around as if he owns the place.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我烦透了他对大家呼来喝去，搞得好像这里是他开的一样。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 叫外卖（送至家中或办公室）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It's raining outside, so let's just order in pizza tonight.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 外面在下雨，我们今晚就叫披萨外卖吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 点外卖带走；命令某人离开/退席
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Instead of cooking, we decided to order out from the local Thai bistro.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们没做饭，而是决定从当地的泰国小馆点外卖吃。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （裁判）将某人罚出场
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The referee ordered the defender off the pitch after a dangerous foul.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该后卫因恶意犯规被主裁判罚出场外。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 订购（送货上门/点菜送至客房）；调集；征召
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We were exhausted after the flight, so we ordered up room service and rested.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 飞行结束后我们筋疲力尽，于是叫了客房送餐服务后便休息了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 命令某人返回/撤退
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The commander ordered the troops back behind the defensive line.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 指挥官命令部队撤回防御线后方。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 命令某人离去；遣退
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Security guards quickly ordered the demonstrators away from the entrance.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 保安人员迅速勒令示威者离开大门入口。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 命令某人下来；命机降落
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Air traffic control ordered the rogue drone down immediately.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 空中交通管制部门立即命令那架违规无人机降落。

idioms.meaning: 发生故障；不合规矩/行为过分；次序颠倒
idioms.example_en: The coffee machine is out of order, and his rude remarks at the meeting were totally out of order.
idioms.example_zh: 咖啡机坏了，而且他在会议上的无礼言论也完全是不成体统。

idioms.meaning: 为了做某事；以便
idioms.example_en: She took extra night classes in order to qualify for the promotion.
idioms.example_zh: 为了获得晋升资格，她额外参加了夜校课程。

idioms.meaning: 苛刻的要求；难以完成的任务
idioms.example_en: Finishing the entire audit within two days is a rather tall order.
idioms.example_zh: 要在两天内完成全部审计工作，这任务实在太艰巨了。

idioms.meaning: 司空见惯的事；当务之急；盛行的风气
idioms.example_en: Caution and cost-cutting are currently the order of the day across the tech sector.
idioms.example_zh: 谨慎行事和削减成本目前是整个科技行业的当务之急。

idioms.meaning: 整顿内部事务；处理好自身问题
idioms.example_en: The company needs to put its own house in order before criticizing competitors.
idioms.example_zh: 该公司在批评竞争对手之前，需要先整顿好自身的内部问题。

idioms.meaning: 井井有条；整齐有序
idioms.example_en: Before leaving the workshop, he made sure every single tool was in apple-pie order.
idioms.example_zh: 离开车间前，他确保每一件工具都摆放得井井有条。

idioms.meaning: 宣布会议开会；要求某人遵守秩序/安静
idioms.example_en: The speaker rapped his gavel and called the noisy chamber to order.
idioms.example_zh: 议长敲响木槌，要求嘈杂的议会安静下来开始开会。

collocations.example_en: You can place an order directly through our official mobile app.
collocations.example_zh: 您可以直接通过我们的官方移动应用程序下订单。

collocations.example_en: Extra police patrols were deployed to restore law and order in the downtown area.
collocations.example_zh: 市中心增派了巡逻警力以恢复社会治安秩序。

collocations.meaning: 运转正常；处于良好工作状态
collocations.example_en: Inspect all emergency fire alarms to ensure they are in proper working order.
collocations.example_zh: 检查所有的应急火警警报器，确保其处于正常运转状态。

collocations.example_en: Please arrange the historical documents in strict chronological order.
collocations.example_zh: 请将这些历史文件严格按照时间先后顺序排列。

collocations.example_en: The border guards refused them entry, explaining that they were strictly under orders.
collocations.example_zh: 边境警卫拒绝让他们入境，解释说他们纯属奉命行事。

collocations.example_en: The warehouse worked round the clock to fulfil all holiday orders on time.
collocations.example_zh: 仓库昼夜不停地运转，以按时履行所有的节日订单。

collocations.example_en: He quit smoking and took a month off work on strict doctor's orders.
collocations.example_zh: 他严格遵从医嘱，戒了烟并休假了一个月。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 大批杀灭，消灭；扼杀，消除（希望、计划等）；在（剧集或小说中）写死某角色
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The writers decided to kill off her character in the season finale to shock the audience.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 编剧决定在季终集里将她饰演的角色写死，以震撼观众。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 彻底根除，消灭（害虫、杂草等使其绝迹）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Severe frosts in late spring killed out the invasive weed population completely.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 晚春的严重霜冻彻底消灭了这种入侵杂草。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （园艺因严寒或干旱）使（植物枝条）枯萎、冻死到根部
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The harsh winter killed the roses back to ground level, but new shoots appeared in spring.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 严冬将玫瑰冻得只剩贴地根部，但春天又冒出了新芽。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 极其渴望得到，不惜一切代价想要（口语常用 would kill for）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After hiking in the desert all afternoon, I would kill for a cold glass of water.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在沙漠里徒步了整整一下午后，我极度渴望喝到一杯冰水。

idioms.phrase: kill two birds with one stone
idioms.meaning: 一举两得，一石二鸟
idioms.example_en: Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone—you get daily exercise and save money on fuel.
idioms.example_zh: 骑车上班一举两得——既锻炼了身体，又省下了油钱。

idioms.meaning: 打发时间，消磨时光
idioms.example_en: We killed time playing cards at the terminal while waiting for our delayed flight.
idioms.example_zh: 在等待延误航班期间，我们在航站楼里打扑克消磨时间。

idioms.meaning: 着装惊艳迷人，盛装打扮以引人注目
idioms.example_en: She arrived at the charity gala dressed to kill in a stunning crimson evening gown.
idioms.example_zh: 她身穿一袭惊艳的深红色晚礼服，盛装出席了慈善晚会。

idioms.phrase: kill the goose that lays the golden eggs
idioms.meaning: 杀鸡取卵，断绝财路
idioms.example_en: Raising subscription fees too sharply will drive away loyal users and kill the goose that lays the golden eggs.
idioms.example_zh: 过大幅度上调订阅费会赶走忠实用户，无异于杀鸡取卵。

idioms.meaning: 过分殷勤反害人；用极大的善意和宽容感化对方
idioms.example_en: Instead of arguing with the rude customer, the receptionist decided to kill him with kindness.
idioms.example_zh: 接待员没有和那位粗鲁的顾客争吵，而是决定以极其周到的笑脸去感化他。

idioms.meaning: 扫兴，败兴，破坏欢快气氛
idioms.example_en: Bringing up quarterly financial losses at the celebration party really killed the buzz.
idioms.example_zh: 在庆祝派对上提及季度财务亏损实在是太扫兴了。

idioms.meaning: 孤注一掷的极端措施（非好即坏，成败在此一举）
idioms.example_en: The drastic budget restructuring was seen as a kill-or-cure measure to save the bankrupt firm.
idioms.example_zh: 激进的预算重组被视为拯救这家破产企业的孤注一掷之举。

collocations.example_en: The doctor prescribed a stronger medication to help kill the pain after the knee surgery.
collocations.example_zh: 医生开了一种更强效的药物，以帮助缓解膝盖手术后的疼痛。

collocations.example_en: He pulled the patrol car over to the curb and killed the engine to listen carefully.
collocations.example_zh: 他把巡逻车停在路边并熄了火，以便仔细倾听。

collocations.meaning: 否决、扼杀、终止提案/法案/项目
collocations.example_en: Lack of federal funding eventually killed the ambitious high-speed rail proposal.
collocations.example_zh: 由于缺乏联邦资金支持，这项雄心勃勃的高铁提案最终被扼杀。

collocations.meaning: 坏了某人的食欲，倒胃口
collocations.example_en: Eating chocolate cookies right before dinner completely killed the kids' appetite.
collocations.example_zh: 晚饭前吃巧克力饼干彻底败坏了孩子们的胃口。

collocations.meaning: 平息谣言；压下新闻报道，阻止新闻见报
collocations.example_en: The spokesperson issued a swift denial to kill the rumors about the company's impending merger.
collocations.example_zh: 发言人迅速发表澄清声明，以平息关于公司即将合并的传言。

collocations.meaning: 断送某人的机会，毁掉某人的胜算
collocations.example_en: A sudden knee injury just weeks before the trials effectively killed his chances of qualifying.
collocations.example_zh: 选拔赛前几周的突发膝伤彻底断送了他获得参赛资格的希望。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与…有关联；理解、认同并感同身受；与（某人）相处或建立良好沟通
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Many young readers relate strongly to the protagonist's struggle with self-doubt.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 许多年轻读者对主人公与自我怀疑抗争的经历产生了强烈的共鸣。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 追溯至，回顾，与（之前的观点、事件等）联系起来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The professor paused during the lecture to relate the new concept back to the theory discussed last week.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教授在授课时停顿了一下，将这一新概念与上周讨论的理论联系起来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将某事物与某事物联系起来；对照，对照说明
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The study attempts to relate dietary habits to long-term cardiovascular health risks.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该研究试图将饮食习惯与长期的心血管健康风险联系起来分析。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与…互动交往；理解并与…建立人际联系
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Introverted children sometimes find it challenging to relate with large groups of unfamiliar peers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 性格内向的儿童有时会觉得与一大群不熟悉的同龄人互动交往很困难。

idioms.meaning: 毫无共鸣，缺乏可以参照或感同身受的基础
idioms.example_en: Growing up in a privileged environment, he found he had nothing to relate to when reading about urban poverty.
idioms.example_zh: 由于成长在优渥的环境中，他在读到有关城市贫困的内容时完全无法产生共鸣。

idioms.meaning: 详尽叙述，滔滔不绝地讲述
idioms.example_en: The retired diplomat related at length his experiences during the international negotiations.
idioms.example_zh: 那位退休外交官详尽地叙述了他在国际谈判中的亲身经历。

idioms.meaning: 巨细靡遗地讲述，详细陈述
idioms.example_en: The eyewitness was asked to relate in detail everything that had transpired on the evening of the robbery.
idioms.example_zh: 目击者被要求详细陈述抢劫案当晚所发生的一切细节。

idioms.meaning: 在人性/人情层面实现情感共鸣与心灵沟通
idioms.example_en: Despite ideological differences, the two leaders were able to relate on a human level as fathers.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管存在意识形态分歧，这两位领导人作为父亲，在人情层面上达成了共鸣。

idioms.meaning: 与…相处甚洽；与…契合良好
idioms.example_en: The new manager proved to be exceptionally well related to her frontline staff.
idioms.example_zh: 事实证明，这位新经理与她的一线员工相处得极为融洽。

collocations.meaning: 与…密切/直接相关；与…有近亲血缘关系
collocations.example_en: Employee productivity is closely related to job satisfaction and workplace well-being.
collocations.example_zh: 员工的生产力与工作满意度及职场幸福感密切相关。

collocations.meaning: 讲述一段经历、故事或传说
collocations.example_en: Grandmother gathered the children around the fireplace and related a classic folklore tale.
collocations.example_zh: 祖母把孩子们召集在壁炉旁，讲述了一则经典的民间传说故事。

collocations.meaning: 陈述事实真相，叙述事件全过程
collocations.example_en: The investigative journalist calmly related the facts without inserting personal bias.
collocations.example_zh: 这位调查记者客观陈述了事实，没有掺杂任何个人偏见。

collocations.meaning: 阐明因果关系，将原因与结果挂钩
collocations.example_en: It is often difficult in social sciences to definitively relate cause and effect without confounding variables.
collocations.example_zh: 在社会科学中，若不排除混杂变量，往往很难明确厘清因果关系。

collocations.meaning: 分享经历，叙述过往体会
collocations.example_en: Speakers at the summit were invited to relate their experiences of navigating corporate restructuring.
collocations.example_zh: 峰会上的演讲嘉宾受邀分享他们应对企业重组的实战经验。

collocations.meaning: 无法理解，不能感同身受
collocations.example_en: Older generations often fail to relate to the cultural anxieties experienced by Gen Z.
collocations.example_zh: 年长一辈往往无法理解 Z 世代年轻人所经历的文化焦虑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 排队；排列整齐；组织，物色好（人或活动）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Thousands of fans lined up overnight to buy tickets, while the festival had lined up an incredible roster of musicians.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 数千名粉丝通宵排队买票，而音乐节也已筹划好了豪华的演出阵容。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……排成一行；与……保持一致，符合
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company's new environmental policies line up perfectly with international standards.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 公司的新环保政策与国际标准完全一致。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 给……加衬里；用……垫在内侧/覆盖
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She lined the winter coat with soft fleece to keep the child warm.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她在冬衣里加了一层柔软的抓绒内衬，好让孩子保暖。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 划线注销，划掉（文字等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please line through any items on the checklist that are no longer relevant.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 请将清单上任何不再相关的项目划掉。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 勾勒出轮廓；用线划去；[体育]击出平飞球出局
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The manager quickly lined out the main tasks for the coming quarter on the whiteboard.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经理在白板上迅速勾勒出了下个季度的主要任务要点。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用线条画界隔开，划线分隔
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Workers lined off the construction zone to keep pedestrians safe.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工人们用警戒线隔出施工区域以确保行人安全。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 勾画轮廓线，描线
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The illustrator sketched the preliminary figures before carefully lining them in with ink.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 插画师先画了人物初稿，然后用墨水仔细地勾勒出线条。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 沿……划线；使排列整齐
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He lined down the margins of the manuscript with red ink to highlight editorial comments.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他在手稿页边用红墨水画线以突出编辑批注。

idioms.meaning: 服从命令，听从规矩，循规蹈矩
idioms.example_en: Employees who refuse to toe the line risk losing their jobs.
idioms.example_zh: 拒绝遵守公司规章的员工有丢掉工作的危险。

idioms.meaning: 体会言外之意，领悟潜台词
idioms.example_en: If you read between the lines of his email, it's clear he's planning to resign.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你品味一下他邮件的弦外之音，很明显他打算辞职。

idioms.meaning: 划定界限，绝不容许，适可而止
idioms.example_en: I don't mind lending him books, but I draw the line at lending him my car.
idioms.example_zh: 我不介意借书给他，但我绝不能把车借给他。

idioms.meaning: 中饱私囊，敛财，发不义之财
idioms.example_en: Corrupt officials used public infrastructure funds to line their own pockets.
idioms.example_zh: 腐败官员利用公共基建资金来中饱私囊。

idioms.meaning: 越界，过分，逾矩
idioms.example_en: Constructive criticism is welcome, but personal insults cross the line.
idioms.example_zh: 建设性的批评我们欢迎，但人身攻击就越界了。

idioms.meaning: 拿……冒险，把……置于险境
idioms.example_en: Firefighters put their lives on the line every day to protect the community.
idioms.example_zh: 消防员每天都冒着生命危险保护社区安全。

idioms.meaning: 步调一致，顺从，听从指示
idioms.example_en: After hours of heated debate, dissenting members finally fell into line with the committee's decision.
idioms.example_zh: 经过数小时的激烈争论，持不同意见的成员最终顺从了委员会的决议。

collocations.meaning: 沿街站立，列队街道两侧
collocations.example_en: Crowds of cheering supporters lined the streets to welcome the returning champions.
collocations.example_zh: 欢呼雀跃的拥护者们伫立街道两旁，欢迎凯旋的冠军们。

collocations.meaning: 贴满墙壁；摆满货架/书架
collocations.example_en: Old family photographs and vintage clocks lined the walls of the study.
collocations.example_zh: 老旧的家庭照片和复古钟表摆满了书房的墙壁。

collocations.example_en: Salaries will be increased in line with the annual rate of inflation.
collocations.example_zh: 工资将按照年通货膨胀率相应上调。

collocations.meaning: 给某人写信/发短信留便条
collocations.example_en: Drop me a line once you arrive in London so I know you got there safely.
collocations.example_zh: 你一到伦敦就给我留个信，好让我知道你平安抵达。

collocations.example_en: I was thinking of a gift along the lines of a smart watch or wireless earbuds.
collocations.example_zh: 我在考虑送一件类似于智能手表或无线耳机的礼物。

collocations.meaning: 坦诚直言，毫不保留地说清楚；押上赌注
collocations.example_en: The coach laid it on the line: win this match or miss the playoffs entirely.
collocations.example_zh: 教练开门见山地把话说透了：要么拿下这场比赛，要么彻底无缘季后赛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抚养，培养成人；提出（议题/话题）；呕吐
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was brought up by her grandparents, and she brought up the housing issue at yesterday's town hall meeting.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她由祖父母抚养长大，并且在昨天的市民大会上提出了住房问题。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 引起，导致，促成
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The industrial revolution brought about profound economic and social changes worldwide.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工业革命给全世界带来了深远的经济与社会变革。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 发行，推出（新产品/作品）；激发，显现出（某种特质）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company plans to bring out a new smartphone, which they hope will bring out the best in their software engineers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该公司计划推出一款新智能手机，并希望这能激发出软件工程师的最佳潜力。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 降低，缩减；击落，推翻（政权/领导人）；使沮丧
phrasal_verbs.example_en: New legislation aims to bring down inflation, whereas political scandals threatened to bring down the government.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 新法案旨在降低通胀，而政治丑闻则有推翻政府的危险。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 出台，引进（法律/方案）；赚得，带来（收入）；请来（专家/协助）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The consultancy brought in top forensic experts to investigate the case, which brought in substantial revenue.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 咨询公司请来了顶尖的法医专家来调查此案，这项业务带来了可观的收入。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 带回，归还；使回忆起；重新实行，恢复
phrasal_verbs.example_en: That nostalgic melody brings back fond memories of childhood and made citizens demand that the festival be brought back.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那怀旧的旋律唤起了童年的美好回忆，也让市民们要求恢复该节庆活动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 圆满完成，大获成功（尤指克服困难）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Against all odds, the underdog team brought off an incredible victory in the final minutes.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 克服了重重阻碍，这支不被看好的队伍在最后几分钟取得了一场难以置信的胜利。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 引起，诱发（疾病/不良反应）；促进……成长发展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Excessive stress and lack of sleep can easily bring on severe migraines.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 过度的压力和睡眠不足很容易引发严重的偏头痛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 提前（日期/时间）；提出（建议、议案或证据）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The board decided to bring forward the launch date and brought forward several new safety guidelines.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 董事会决定将发布日期提前，并提出了几项新的安全指引。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 随身携带，带……一起来；培养，促成……进步
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Feel free to bring along a friend to the workshop; the mentor will help bring them along quickly.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 欢迎带朋友一起来参加工作坊，导师会帮助他们迅速提升技能。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使苏醒，使恢复知觉；说服，使改变看法；把……带到某人家中
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Paramedics quickly brought the unconscious driver round, and the doctor managed to bring the family round to the idea of surgery.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 医护人员迅速使昏迷的司机苏醒过来，医生也成功说服了家属接受手术方案。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 召集，撮合，使团结凝聚
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The annual cultural festival serves to bring together communities from various ethnic backgrounds.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一年一度的文化节有助于将来自不同种族背景的社区凝聚在一起。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 产生，结出（果实）；提出，展现
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Spring rains brought forth colorful blooms across the hills, inspiring poets to bring forth new verses.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 春雨让漫山遍野繁花盛开，也激发了诗人创作出新的诗句。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 帮……渡过难关/险境；使（重病患者）脱险
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Skilled intensive care doctors managed to bring the critically injured patient through the night.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经验丰富的重症监护医生成功帮助重伤患者挺过了那一晚。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使苏醒，使恢复知觉；使（船只）停住
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A splash of cold water on his face brought him to within seconds.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 脸上一泼冷水让他在几秒钟内就恢复了知觉。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把某人带过来（家里）；说服某人改变立场
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Why don't you bring your roommate over for dinner tonight so we can finally meet?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你今晚为什么不把你室友带到家里一起吃晚饭呢，好让我们见个面？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 压制，镇压；控制住（火势/叛乱等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It took firefighters nearly six hours to bring the blazing warehouse fire under control.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 消防队员花了将近六个小时才将仓库大火彻底控制住。

idioms.meaning: 赢得满堂喝彩，博得全场喝彩
idioms.example_en: The comedian's hilarious impressions brought down the house at the comedy club.
idioms.example_zh: 这位喜剧演员滑稽的模仿表演赢得了全场观众的热烈喝彩。

idioms.meaning: 养家糊口；取得成功，大功告成
idioms.example_en: While his wife managed the local clinic, he worked as a freelance programmer to bring home the bacon.
idioms.example_zh: 妻子经营当地诊所，而他则做自由职业程序员来赚钱养家糊口。

idioms.meaning: 迫使某人屈服，击垮，打垮
idioms.example_en: Prolonged economic sanctions gradually brought the dictator's regime to its knees.
idioms.example_zh: 长期的经济制裁逐渐迫使独裁政权走向屈服与崩溃。

idioms.meaning: 揭露，披露，公布于世
idioms.example_en: Investigative journalists brought to light serious accounting irregularities within the firm.
idioms.example_zh: 调查记者揭露了该企业内部严重的财务违规行为。

idioms.meaning: 将某人绳之以法，将某人缉捕归案
idioms.example_en: Police detectives vowed to bring the serial burglar to justice before the end of the month.
idioms.example_zh: 警局刑警誓言在本月底前将这名连环盗窃犯绳之以法。

idioms.meaning: 使想起，使人联想到
idioms.example_en: The rustic architecture of this resort brings to mind traditional Tuscan villages.
idioms.example_zh: 这处度假村朴实的建筑风格让人联想到传统的托斯卡纳村庄。

idioms.meaning: 使某人深切认识到，使某人彻底明白
idioms.example_en: The terrifying car accident finally brought home to him the real dangers of texting while driving.
idioms.example_zh: 那场可怕的车祸终于让他深刻意识到了开车发短信的巨大危险。

collocations.example_en: A sudden power outage brought all commuter trains in the metropolitan area to a complete halt.
collocations.example_zh: 突如其来的停电使大都市区的所有通勤列车全部停运。

collocations.example_en: Flawed methodology in the initial trials brought the efficacy of the drug into question.
collocations.example_zh: 初期试验中的方法缺陷使该药物的疗效受到了广泛质疑。

collocations.example_en: Solving this complex puzzle brings into play both mathematical logic and creative intuition.
collocations.example_zh: 解开这个复杂的谜题需要同时调动数学逻辑与创造性直觉。

collocations.meaning: 使成为焦点，使清晰明了
collocations.example_en: The ongoing climate crisis has brought into focus the urgent need for renewable energy sources.
collocations.example_zh: 持续的气候危机让人们更加关注对可再生能源的迫切需求。

collocations.meaning: 使某人感动得热泪盈眶
collocations.example_en: The soldier's unexpected reunion with his daughter brought tears to the eyes of everyone present.
collocations.example_zh: 那名士兵与女儿的出人意料的团聚让在场的所有人都感动落泪。

collocations.example_en: The signing of the peace treaty finally brought decades of armed conflict to an end.
collocations.example_zh: 和平条约的签署终于结束了长达数十年之久的武装冲突。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 期盼，期望得到；指望
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We are all hoping for good weather this weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们都在期盼这个周末能有个好天气。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （正式/书面）信赖，寄希望于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Throughout the crisis, the villagers placed their hope in the new leader.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在整场危机中，村民们把希望寄托在新的领导人身上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抱有希望，寄予厚望（多用于否定句或疑问句）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Doctors hold out little hope of a complete recovery.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 医生们对彻底康复不抱太大希望。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把全部希望寄托在……上
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She pinned all her hopes on getting the scholarship to study abroad.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她把出国留学的全部希望都寄托在获得这笔奖学金上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 放弃希望，不再指望
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Rescue workers have not given up hope of finding survivors under the rubble.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 救援人员尚未放弃在废墟下搜寻幸存者的希望。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使某人抱有过高期望
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I don't want to build up her hopes until the contract is officially signed.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在合同正式签署之前，我不想让她抱过高的期望。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 粉碎某人的希望，使期望破灭
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sudden injury dashed his hopes of competing in the Olympic Games.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 突如其来的伤病击碎了他参加奥运会的希望。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抱存希望；痴心等待（常用于 live in hope of doing sth）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He continues to live in hope that one day his artwork will be recognized.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他依然心怀希望，坚信总有一天自己的艺术作品会得到认可。

idioms.meaning: 抱有一线希望，明知渺茫仍心存侥幸
idioms.example_en: They hoped against hope that the missing flight might still be found safe.
idioms.example_zh: 他们明知希望渺茫，却仍抱有一线生机，期盼失联航班能平安被找到。

idioms.meaning: 做最好的打算，抱乐观期待（常与 prepare for the worst 搭配）
idioms.example_en: We've done all the preparation we could, so now we just have to hope for the best.
idioms.example_zh: 我们已经做好了所有能做的准备，现在只能抱最好的打算了。

idioms.phrase: not have a hope in hell
idioms.meaning: 绝无可能，毫无成功的指望
idioms.example_en: Without any prior experience, he didn't have a hope in hell of getting the managerial job.
idioms.example_zh: 没有任何相关经验，他根本不可能拿到那个管理岗位。

idioms.meaning: 留得青山在，不愁没柴烧；只要活着就有希望
idioms.example_en: Don't despair yet; where there's life, there's hope.
idioms.example_zh: 先别绝望；留得青山在，总会有希望的。

idioms.meaning: 一线希望，微弱的生机
idioms.example_en: The discovery of fresh water provided a glimmer of hope for the stranded hikers.
idioms.example_zh: 淡水源的发现为受困的徒步旅行者带来了一线生机。

idioms.meaning: 祈求好运，暗自祈祷
idioms.example_en: I've submitted my application; now I can only cross my fingers and hope.
idioms.example_zh: 我已经递交了申请；现在只能暗自祈祷好运降临了。

collocations.example_en: I sincerely hope that our cooperation will continue to flourish in the future.
collocations.example_zh: 我由衷期盼我们未来的合作能够继续蓬勃发展。

collocations.phrase: in the hope of doing sth
collocations.meaning: 怀着……的希望，期望做某事
collocations.example_en: She moved to the capital in the hope of finding a better career path.
collocations.example_zh: 她搬到首都，希望能找到更好的职业发展道路。

collocations.example_en: The board has high hopes for the new marketing campaign.
collocations.example_zh: 董事会对这次新的营销活动寄予了厚望。

collocations.example_en: The vintage car was so badly damaged that the mechanic said it was beyond hope.
collocations.example_zh: 这辆老式汽车损坏极其严重，修理工说已经回天乏术了。

collocations.example_en: The ambassador expressed hope that bilateral trade talks would resume soon.
collocations.example_zh: 大使表达了希望双边贸易谈判能尽快恢复的期待。

collocations.meaning: 唯一的希望，绝处逢生的手段
collocations.example_en: This experimental therapy represents the patient's only hope.
collocations.example_zh: 这项实验性疗法是该患者唯一的希望。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抚养，供养；为……做好准备；（法律/规定）做出明文规定
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He works two jobs to provide for his family, while the contract provides for an annual bonus.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他打两份工来供养家庭，而合同中也明文规定了年终奖金。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 防御，防范，预防（潜在损失、危险或不利情况）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The emergency fund is designed to provide against unforeseen financial crises.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该应急基金旨在防范不可预见的财务危机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 给某人提供某物，装备/供应所需资源
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The organization provides low-income families with free medical supplies.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该机构向低收入家庭提供免费医疗用品。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向某人提供某物，递交或分配资源给对象
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The department will provide real-time updates to all stakeholders throughout the transition.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该部门将在整个交接期间向所有利益相关方提供实时动态。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从……中拨付/提供（资金或补偿）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The damages were provided out of the company's reserve funds.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 赔偿金是从公司的储备金中拨付的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 自力更生，自给自足
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was taught from a young age how to work hard and provide for herself.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她自幼便懂得如何努力工作并自力更生。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 反馈提供（数据、成果或支持）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The software is calibrated to provide back analytical metrics every twenty minutes.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该软件经过校准，每二十分钟反馈提供一次分析指标。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 提前准备，预先供给
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The expedition leader made sure to provide ahead for harsh winter conditions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 探险队队长确保提前为严苛的寒冬条件做足了物资储备。

idioms.meaning: 只要，在……条件下（引导条件从句）
idioms.example_en: You may borrow the vehicle, provided that you return it with a full tank of gas.
idioms.example_zh: 你可以借用这辆车，前提是你还车时必须加满油。

idioms.meaning: 提供公平竞争的环境与机会
idioms.example_en: New regulatory policies aim to provide a level playing field for emerging startups.
idioms.example_zh: 新的监管政策旨在为新兴初创企业提供公平竞争的环境。

idioms.meaning: 提供救命稻草，提供关键生机/援助
idioms.example_en: The emergency government subsidy provided a lifeline to struggling small retailers.
idioms.example_zh: 政府紧急补贴为苦苦挣扎的小型零售商提供了一条救命稻草。

idioms.meaning: 提供进阶垫脚石，为进一步发展创造条件
idioms.example_en: This entry-level internship provided a stepping stone to a successful career in finance.
idioms.example_zh: 这份初级实习工作为他日后在金融界的成功发展提供了宝贵的垫脚石。

idioms.meaning: 天无绝人之路，车到山前必有路（安慰人不必担忧未来生计）
idioms.example_en: Don't lose sleep over tomorrow's troubles; have faith and God will provide.
idioms.example_zh: 别为明天的烦恼夜不能寐；坚定信心，天无绝人之路。

idioms.meaning: 提供万全之策，提供一劳永逸的解决方案
idioms.example_en: Technological innovation helps, but it cannot provide a silver bullet for climate change.
idioms.example_zh: 技术创新虽有助益，但无法为气候变化问题提供一劳永逸的万全之策。

collocations.example_en: The summit provided an invaluable opportunity for leaders to discuss green energy.
collocations.example_zh: 此次峰会为各国领导人讨论绿色能源提供了极其宝贵的机会。

collocations.meaning: 提供资金支持/财政援助
collocations.example_en: Local charities stepped in to provide financial assistance to affected families.
collocations.example_zh: 当地慈善机构施以援手，向受灾家庭提供经济援助。

collocations.meaning: 提供独到见解，对……给出深刻剖析
collocations.example_en: The research report provides valuable insight into changing consumer behaviors.
collocations.example_zh: 该研究报告对消费者行为的变迁提供了颇有价值的深刻见解。

collocations.example_en: The council has an obligation to provide essential services such as sanitation and water.
collocations.example_zh: 市政委员会有义务提供环卫和供水等基本公共服务。

collocations.example_en: Applicants must provide proof of residence before their IDs can be renewed.
collocations.example_zh: 申请人在更换身份证件前必须出具居住证明。

collocations.meaning: 提供庇护所，提供避难处
collocations.example_en: The community center was quickly converted to provide shelter for storm evacuees.
collocations.example_zh: 社区中心被迅速改建，为风暴疏散人员提供临时庇护所。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分包；外包（将部分工作转交给外部人员承包完成）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The publisher decided to job out the indexing and proofreading to freelancers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 出版社决定将索引编制和校对工作外包给自由职业者。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分担工作；两人合做一份全职工作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After having children, Sarah and her colleague agreed to job-share the marketing manager role.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 生完孩子后，萨拉和她的同事商定共同分担市场经理这一职位。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 找工作；求职
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He spent three exhausting months job-hunting before landing a position in tech.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在科技行业谋得一个职位之前，他经历了三个月精疲力竭的求职过程。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （金融或博彩）事后诸葛亮；根据已知结果反推分析
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It is easy to job backward and say we should have sold the shares at their peak.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 事后诸葛亮地说我们本该在峰值时卖掉股票，这谁都会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 重创；彻底击败；狠狠修理/整治
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The harsh winter frost really did a job on our garden plants.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 严酷的冬霜确实重创了我们花园里的植物。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 做好/干好（工作）；小题大做地拖延耗时
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't make a job of fixing that loose shelf; it should only take five minutes.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 修那个松掉的架子别小题大做拖拖拉拉的，五分钟就该搞定了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 工作失职；没有尽到职责
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The security team fell down on the job, allowing unauthorized visitors into the facility.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 安保团队严重失职，让未经许可的访客进入了设施内部。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 勾结作案；设局行骗；搞阴谋预谋
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The detectives suspected that the warehouse break-in was a put-up job involving the manager.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 侦探们怀疑这次仓库失窃案是经理里应外合设下的圈套。

idioms.meaning: 正是所需要的；正中下怀
idioms.example_en: A hot bowl of chicken soup was just the job on such a freezing evening.
idioms.example_zh: 在如此寒冷的夜晚，一碗热腾腾的鸡汤正是所需之物。

idioms.meaning: 幸亏；幸好；做得好
idioms.example_en: It's a good job you reminded me, otherwise I would have missed the train.
idioms.example_zh: 幸好你提醒了我，否则我就赶不上火车了。

idioms.phrase: make the best of a bad job
idioms.meaning: 在逆境中尽力而为；随遇而安
idioms.example_en: Our flight was cancelled, so we made the best of a bad job and explored the local town.
idioms.example_zh: 我们的航班取消了，于是我们随遇而安，顺便逛了逛当地的小镇。

idioms.phrase: give sth up as a bad job
idioms.meaning: 自认倒霉而放弃；认定某事不可救药而撒手
idioms.example_en: After tinkering with the old engine for three days, he gave it up as a bad job.
idioms.example_zh: 折腾那台旧引擎三天之后，他认定它没救了便彻底放弃。

idioms.meaning: 做某事费尽周折；感到吃力困难
idioms.example_en: You'll have a job persuading the board to approve such a risky venture.
idioms.example_zh: 想要说服董事会批准这么冒险的投资项目，你可有得费劲了。

idioms.phrase: more than one's job is worth
idioms.meaning: 冒丢掉饭碗的危险（常用于拒绝破例）
idioms.example_en: I can't let you in without a security badge—it's more than my job's worth.
idioms.example_zh: 没有工牌我可不能放你进去——这会让我丢掉饭碗的。

idioms.meaning: 在工作岗位上；在执勤中
idioms.example_en: Employees are strictly forbidden from drinking alcohol while on the job.
idioms.example_zh: 员工在工作期间严禁饮酒。

collocations.meaning: 谋得工作；成功获得一份职位
collocations.example_en: She beat hundreds of applicants to land a job at a prestigious consulting firm.
collocations.example_zh: 她击败了数百名应聘者，成功在一流咨询公司谋得一职。

collocations.meaning: 保住工作；长期稳定地工作
collocations.example_en: Despite his health struggles, he managed to hold down a full-time job.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管饱受健康困扰，他还是设法保住了一份全职工作。

collocations.meaning: 工作满意度；职业成就感
collocations.example_en: High salaries don't always translate into greater job satisfaction.
collocations.example_zh: 高薪并不总是等同于更高的工作满意度。

collocations.example_en: Many workers prioritize job security over lucrative bonuses during recessions.
collocations.example_zh: 经济衰退期间，许多工人把工作稳定性看得比丰厚奖金更重要。

collocations.example_en: Over two hundred candidates applied for the senior analyst job.
collocations.example_zh: 两百多名候选人应聘了高级分析师一职。

collocations.example_en: The competitive job market requires graduates to acquire specialized skills.
collocations.example_zh: 竞争激烈的就业市场要求毕业生必须掌握专业技能。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 调皮捣蛋；（机器、身体部位等）出毛病/发作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: My knee always acts up right before it rains, making walking uncomfortable.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 下雨前我的膝盖总是隐隐作痛出毛病，走起路来很难受。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 依据…行事；遵照办理；对…起作用/产生影响
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Police acted on an anonymous tip and discovered the hidden cache of weapons.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警方根据一条匿名线索采取行动，发现了这处隐藏的武器库。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把…表演出来；将（内心冲动或负面情绪）付诸肆虐行为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Children often act out their anxieties through aggressive behavior in school.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 儿童往往会通过在学校里的攻击性行为来发泄内心的焦虑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 充当；担任；起…的作用
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The vice president will act as the interim CEO until a replacement is hired.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在聘请到接任者之前，副总裁将暂代首席执行官一职。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 表现得像；行为举止如同
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Stop acting like a spoiled child and take responsibility for your errors.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别表现得像个被宠坏的孩子，为你自己的过错承担责任吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 代表；代理（某人行使权利）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A prominent attorney was hired to act for the defendant throughout the trial.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 聘请了一位著名律师在整个审判过程中代表被告人。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对待（某人）；对…的态度举止
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He has always acted towards his stepchildren with genuine warmth and patience.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他对待继子女向来真诚温暖且富有耐心。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在…指令/规定下行事；遵从…
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The soldiers claimed they were merely acting under direct orders from their commander.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 士兵们声称他们只是在遵从指挥官的直接命令。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 反抗；采取行动违抗/对抗
phrasal_verbs.example_en: By selling company secrets, he acted against the fundamental interests of his firm.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 通过出卖公司机密，他的行为违背了公司的根本利益。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 参演（电影/话剧）；在…中扮演角色
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She gained international fame after acting in an award-winning independent drama.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在参演了一部屡获殊荣的独立剧情片后，她获得了国际声誉。

idioms.meaning: 振作起来；理清头绪并有条不紊地行动
idioms.example_en: You need to get your act together if you plan to graduate on time this year.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你打算今年按时毕业，就必须振作起来，好好规划了。

idioms.meaning: 改邪归正；端正行为；整顿不良作风
idioms.example_en: The coach warned the athlete to clean up his act or face being dropped from the roster.
idioms.example_zh: 教练警告该运动员要端正言行，否则将被移出参赛名单。

idioms.meaning: 表现得成熟点；举止符合年龄身份
idioms.example_en: Stop throwing petty tantrums in public meetings and act your age.
idioms.example_zh: 别在公开会议上乱发小脾气了，成熟稳重点吧。

idioms.meaning: 难以企及的前任；难以超越的榜样/前例
idioms.example_en: The previous CEO doubled profits, making her a tough act to follow for any successor.
idioms.example_zh: 前任首席执行官将利润翻了一番，这让任何继任者都难以超越。

idioms.meaning: 参与分一杯羹；插手捞取好处
idioms.example_en: Seeing the massive profits in e-commerce, rival firms quickly got in on the act.
idioms.example_zh: 看到电子商务蕴含的巨额利润，竞争对手们迅速介入分一杯羹。

idioms.meaning: 当场被抓；抓现行
idioms.example_en: The burglar was caught in the act of prying open the back window.
idioms.example_zh: 窃贼在撬后窗时被当场捉获。

idioms.meaning: 装腔作势；装模作样；掩盖真实感受
idioms.example_en: She was deeply hurt inside, but she put on an act of complete indifference.
idioms.example_zh: 她内心深受伤害，表面上却装出一副漠不关心的样子。

collocations.meaning: 真诚行事；出于善意行事
collocations.example_en: The bank insisted it acted in good faith when granting the commercial loan.
collocations.example_zh: 银行坚称在发放该笔商业贷款时是出于善意合规行事的。

collocations.example_en: The defendant argued that he used physical force purely in self-defense.
collocations.example_zh: 被告辩称他使用武力纯粹是出于正当防卫。

collocations.example_en: Try not to act on impulse when making major financial investments.
collocations.example_zh: 在做出重大财务投资时，切忌凭一时冲动行事。

collocations.example_en: The designated solicitor was authorized to act on behalf of the family estate.
collocations.example_zh: 指定的事务律师获权代表该家族遗产全权行事。

collocations.example_en: The government was commended for acting decisively to curb the epidemic.
collocations.example_zh: 政府因果断采取行动遏制疫情蔓延而受到赞誉。

collocations.meaning: 充当催化剂；促使…快速发生
collocations.example_en: The technological innovation acted as a catalyst for widespread industry reform.
collocations.example_zh: 这项技术创新成为了推动全行业大变革的催化剂。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 导致；造成…的结果
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sudden downpour resulted in severe traffic congestion across the city.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 突如其来的暴雨导致全城交通严重拥堵。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 由…引起；起因于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Many illnesses result directly from chronic stress and lack of sleep.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 许多疾病都是由长期压力和睡眠不足直接引起的。

idioms.meaning: 结果；因此
idioms.example_en: He injured his knee and, as a result, had to withdraw from the marathon.
idioms.example_zh: 他膝盖受伤，因此不得不退出马拉松比赛。

collocations.example_en: Months of intense negotiations ultimately resulted in success.
collocations.example_zh: 数月紧张的谈判最终以成功告终。

collocations.example_en: The new marketing strategy failed to produce the desired result.
collocations.example_zh: 新的营销策略未能取得预期的成效。

idioms.meaning: 看来似乎如此；貌似如此（用于委婉陈述）
idioms.example_en: It would seem that the system was hacked several days ago.
idioms.example_zh: 该系统似乎在几天前就已被黑客入侵。

idioms.phrase: seem like a good idea at the time
idioms.meaning: 当时看来是个好主意（暗示事后证明是个错误）
